papers.title: Reasoning Consistency Scanning: A Framework for Auditing Chain-of-Thought Validity in AI Safety Evaluations
papers.abstract_en: Prior work has shown that chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is often unfaithful: a model's stated reasoning does not reliably reflect the process that produced its output. Detecting unfaithfulness, though, requires controlled experimental interventions, which cannot be applied to evaluation transcripts after the fact. We turn instead to a more tractable question that has received less attention: whether the stated reasoning is logically consistent with the answer it accompanies. Unlike faithfulness, consistency can be assessed from a transcript alone, with no intervention. We introduce reasoning consistency scanning, a reusable method for detecting this property in AI safety evaluation transcripts. Our contributions are fourfold. First, we formalize reasoning consistency as distinct from faithfulness and define a six-subtype taxonomy of inconsistency. Second, we build a validated benchmark of 60 transcripts, manually adapted from InstrumentalEval outputs. Third, we implement a working scanner for InspectScout, the first to target this property in safety evaluation transcripts. Fourth, we report results across four generator models and three evaluations from inspect_evals, showing that reasoning inconsistency is present, detectable, and varies systematically across both models and task types.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出推理一致性扫描（Reasoning Consistency Scanning）框架，用于检测AI安全评估记录中链式思维（CoT）推理与最终答案之间的逻辑一致性。与忠实性（faithfulness）不同，一致性可从评估记录本身判定，无需实验干预。作者形式化了一致性的六类不一致子类型，构建了60条记录的人工验证基准，并在InspectScout中实现了扫描器，对四个生成模型和三种评估任务的结果显示推理不一致普遍存在且可检测。
Motivation: 现有检测CoT推理是否忠实的方法需要控制实验干预，无法事后应用于评估记录；而推理一致性问题未被充分研究，但其仅凭记录即可评估，具有更高可操作性。
Method: 形式化定义了与忠实性不同的推理一致性概念，并给出六类不一致子类型；通过人工改编InstrumentalEval输出构建60条记录的验证基准；在InspectScout评估框架中实现扫描器。
Result: 在四个生成模型和三种inspect_evals评估任务上检测到推理不一致现象，且不一致性在不同模型和任务类型间呈现系统性差异。
Conclusion: 推理一致性扫描可作为AI安全评估中审核CoT有效性的可复用工具，补充现有忠实性分析方法。

papers.title: Vision Foundation Models in Radiology: A Scoping Review of Data, Methodology, Evaluation and Clinical Translation
authors: Ana Jiménez-Pastor (1) ((1) Quantitative Imaging Biomarkers in Medicine
papers.abstract_en: Vision foundation models (VFMs) are increasingly being developed for radiological imaging, yet their definition, development and evaluation remain heterogeneous. We conducted a PRISMAScR scoping review of peer-reviewed studies published between January 2017 and March 2026 describing foundation models trained exclusively on radiological imaging data. Sixty-seven studies were included and mapped across three pillars: data scale and heterogeneity, architectural and pretraining scalability, and downstream transferability and generalization. Datasets primarily covered brain MRI, thoracoabdominal CT, and chest X-ray, ranging from fewer than 100,000 samples to multi-million-image cohorts. Transformer-based architectures and self-supervised pretraining predominated, particularly masked image modeling, contrastive learning and multi-stage approaches. Evaluation focused mainly on segmentation and classification, whereas cross-center, cross-scanner, anatomical and modality-shift validation was inconsistently reported. Alignment with FUTURE-AI principles was uneven. Overall, radiology-specific VFMs show promising transferability, but clinical translation remains constrained by limited data representativeness, heterogeneous benchmarks, incomplete reporting and insufficient deployment-oriented evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对2017年1月至2026年3月间发表的、专门在放射影像数据上训练的视觉基础模型进行了系统综述，纳入67篇研究，从数据规模与异质性、架构与预训练可扩展性、下游迁移与泛化三个维度进行分析。结果显示，Transformer架构和自监督预训练（特别是掩码图像建模、对比学习和多阶段方法）占主导地位，评估主要集中在分割和分类任务，但跨中心、跨设备、跨解剖区域和跨模态的验证报告不一致，且与FUTURE-AI原则的契合度参差不齐。总体而言，放射学专用基础模型展现出有前景的可迁移性，但临床转化仍受限于数据代表性不足、基准异质、报告不完整和缺乏部署导向评估。
Motivation: 放射学影像中视觉基础模型的定义、开发和评估方法存在高度异质性，缺乏系统性的梳理和标准化框架。
Method: 遵循PRISMAScR指南进行范围综述，检索并筛选2017年至2026年3月间发表的同行评审研究，最终纳入67篇，从数据规模/异质性、架构/预训练可扩展性、下游迁移/泛化三个支柱映射分析。
Result: 数据集主要覆盖脑部MRI、胸腹部CT和胸部X光，样本量从小于10万到数百万；Transformer架构和自监督预训练（掩码图像建模、对比学习、多阶段）为主流；评估集中于分割和分类；跨中心、跨设备、跨解剖区域和跨模态验证报告不一致；与FUTURE-AI原则的契合度不均。

papers.title: Why Fake ? Unveiling the Semantic Vocabulary of Deepfake Detectors
papers.abstract_en: Deepfake (DF) technology poses a significant threat to information integrity, driving the need for robust detection methods. Most DF detectors only consider predicting a binary label for whether the input is real or fake, lacking the justification required for real-world applications like legal proceedings. Explainable DF Detection has emerged to address this limitation, but existing techniques frequently fall short by either relying on human annotations for precise artifact localization or generating superficially plausible textual explanations without grounding. This work investigates the use of post-hoc explainable AI (XAI) to analyze the decision-making process of state-of-the-art black-box DF detectors. Specifically, we employ Encoding-Decoding Direction Pairs (EDDP), a technique suitable for uncovering the concept space of DF detectors (their semantic vocabulary) as well as the mechanism for writing and reading concept information to and from internal representations. Our analysis reveals previously hidden real and fake features learned implicitly during detector training, offering nuanced explanations unattainable through conventional methods. This enables global model understanding, spatially aware concept localization, and counterfactual what-if analysis, all contributing to a deeper comprehension of DF detection strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用后验可解释AI（XAI）中的编码-解码方向对（EDDP）技术，分析深度伪造（Deepfake）检测器的决策过程，揭示其内部隐含的真实与伪造语义概念。该方法实现了全局模型理解、空间感知定位和反事实分析，提供比传统二分类输出更丰富的解释。
Motivation: 现有深度伪造检测器仅输出二元标签，缺乏可解释性；而现有的可解释方法要么依赖人工标注进行精确定位，要么生成无根据的表面文本解释。
Method: 采用编码-解码方向对（EDDP）技术，通过分析黑盒检测器的内部表示，发现其概念空间（语义词汇）以及读写机制。
Result: 揭示了检测器隐含学习到的真实与伪造特征，实现了空间感知的概念定位和反事实分析，提供传统方法无法获得的细致解释。
Conclusion: 该方法有助于深入理解深度伪造检测策略，但未报告具体性能指标或局限性。

papers.title: Continual Learning With Participation Privacy: An Auditable Buffering-Aggregation Recipe
papers.abstract_en: Modern federated and streaming learning systems often release intermediate models, so privacy must hold for the full trajectory under adaptive interaction. Motivated by participation privacy, we study single-edit neighboring user streams, where one insertion/deletion shifts all subsequent updates and defeats standard Hamming-neighbor continual-release analyses. We give an auditable modular recipe. A randomized buffering wrapper emits bins of size $[U,2U]$, reducing single-edit streams to a Hamming-style per-bin update stream with explicit backlog/delay guarantees, where $U$ is calibrated by the privacy parameters $(\varepsilon,δ)$. We then prove a certification theorem identifying when a non-adaptive Hamming-neighbor DP proof for a continual primitive lifts to adaptive inputs: the primitive must use fresh per-round randomness and have a stable one-round privacy profile under common adaptive context. Together, these ingredients yield trajectory-level $(\varepsilon,δ)$-DP for single-edit streams using standard primitives (e.g., tree prefix sums), with an explicit privacy--latency link via $U$.
papers.comment: This version corrects and clarifies the independent-decomposability condition underlying the adaptive-safety result in the ICML 2026 paper, with corresponding revisions to the affected statements and proofs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对持续学习中参与隐私的隐私保护问题，提出一种可审计的缓冲-聚合方法。通过随机化缓冲包装器和认证定理，将单编辑用户流转化为汉明邻域流，并利用标准原语实现轨迹级差分隐私，明确隐私与延迟的权衡。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习和流式学习系统在自适应交互下发布中间模型，但单编辑用户流（插入/删除改变后续所有更新）使标准汉明邻域持续释放分析失效，需要新的隐私保护方法。
Method: 提出模块化方法：随机化缓冲包装器发射大小为[U,2U]的bin，将单编辑流简化为每bin的汉明风格更新流；认证定理识别非适应汉明邻域DP证明何时适用于自适应输入，要求原语使用每轮新鲜随机性且具有稳定的隐私配置。
Result: 使用树前缀和等标准原语即可为单编辑流提供轨迹级(ε,δ)-DP，并通过U建立显式的隐私-延迟联系。
Conclusion: 本文为持续学习中的参与隐私提供了一种可审计、模块化的缓冲-聚合方案，将单编辑邻域挑战转化为标准汉明邻域分析，并揭示了隐私与延迟的权衡。

papers.title: Memory Scarcity, Open Models, and the Restructuring of the AI Industry, 2026-2030 -- A quantitative scenario analysis of inference economics, training-cost divergence, and infrastructure solvency
papers.abstract_en: We analyze how four forces restructure the AI industry over 2026-2030: the DRAM/HBM price surge, frontier-capable open-weight models (GLM-5.2), rapid inference-efficiency gains (near-Shannon-limit KV-cache compression, lightweight local runtimes), and the entry of Meta and xAI into compute resale on fleets bought before the memory repricing. Formulating inference economics in dollars per petabyte of bandwidth delivered (\$/PB) -- model-agnostic for bandwidth-bound decode -- we show the entrant-incumbent cost gap never closes: a depreciation conveyor delivers newly amortized fleets to incumbents faster than hardware prices normalize (3.2x in 2026, 1.9x in 2027, re-widening to 3-4x by 2029-30). Training bifurcates into a luxury tier (\$18-38B per frontier run by 2030) and a mass tier (previous-frontier parity via RL/distillation falling toward \$5M). Solvency of the announced buildout is confined to a corridor requiring roughly 2x annual token-demand growth for four years with sticky premium pricing; a measurement critique shows public token trackers overstate monetizable demand, and all pre-Q2-2026 projections predate the industry's shift from token maximization to token minimization. A vintage-breakeven analysis finds 2026 and 2028-29 capacity each fatally exposed to one pricing regime, with only the 2027 vintage robust. A greenfield custom-silicon entrant removes the merchant margin but not the memory premium (central outcome: 25% success/34% mediocre/41% loss, improvable via staged go/no-go gates). China's LineShine LX2 -- domestic HBM on a standard ISA -- decouples its cost curve from the memory crisis. Scenario probabilities: Rotating Landlord Oligopoly 25%, Commoditization Crash 25%, Jevons Absorption 20%, System-Layer Re-differentiation 18%, Geopolitical Bifurcation 12%. Solvency now depends on monetized bandwidth demand, premium stickiness, and vintage ownership.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对2026-2030年AI行业的结构重组进行了定量情景分析，重点研究了DRAM/HBM价格飙升、开源模型（如GLM-5.2）、推理效率提升（接近香农极限的KV-cache压缩）以及Meta和xAI进入算力转售市场等四股力量。通过将推理经济学表述为每PB带宽的美元成本（$/PB），展示了新进入者与现有企业之间的成本差距从未弥合：折旧传送带使新摊销的算力集群更快地流向现有企业。训练分为奢侈层（到2030年每个前沿模型运行180-380亿美元）和大众层（通过RL/蒸馏降至约500万美元）。已宣布的建设计划的偿付能力受到严格约束，需要每年约2倍的令牌需求增长才能维持四年。
Motivation: AI行业面临内存稀缺和成本飙升，现有分析缺乏对未来五年的定量情景分析，特别是推理经济学、训练成本分化和基础设施偿付能力的系统建模。
Method: 使用定量建模方法，提出$/PB（每PB带宽美元）的推理成本度量，分析折旧传送带效应、训练成本分化、偿付能力走廊，并对多种情景（旋转地主寡头、商品化崩溃、杰文斯吸收、系统层重新差异化、地缘政治分裂）赋予概率。
Result: 新进入者与现有企业的成本差距始终存在（2026年3.2倍，2027年1.9倍，2029-30年重新扩大至3-4倍）；训练成本在2030年分化至180-380亿美元（前沿）和500万美元（前前沿）；偿付能力需要约2倍年令牌需求增长并维持高价；2026年和2028-29年产能分别暴露于单一定价制度，只有2027年产能稳健。
Conclusion: AI行业的偿付能力取决于货币化带宽需求、溢价粘性和算力集群的年代归属；内存稀缺将持续重塑行业结构，开源模型和推理效率提升无法消除成本差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometric--Nongeometric Optimizer Calculus: A Modular Language for Reachable Gradient Methods
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive optimizers mix several mechanisms: a metric or preconditioner maps gradients to descent directions, while estimation, memory, step-size control, constraints, stochasticity, target modification, and discretization determine which directions are available and how they are used. We introduce geometric--nongeometric optimizer calculus, a modular language for auditing reachable gradient methods under explicit oracle, budget, state, and rule constraints. The geometric module is a positive cometric family that maps covectors to parameter-space directions; the nongeometric modules are information, memory, control, operator, noise, target, and discretization mechanisms. The main formal result is a direction-expressivity theorem: away from critical points, full positive-definite geometry expresses exactly the strict descent directions. We then define restricted direction residuals for admissible metric families, prove exact expressivity conditions for diagonal and block geometries, and separate this direction-level diagnostic from condition-number geometric complexity. The resulting design problem is a Pareto optimization over module budgets, not a single universal optimizer ordering. We also lift pointwise residuals to a trajectory-level residual complexity that couples direction mismatch with the variation of the explaining geometry. We include diagnostic prototypes only as evidence for the language: a high-information full-metric probe solves deterministic quadratic benchmarks to numerical precision, while a practical Muon-style PyTorch candidate gives small-scale evidence that matrix-operator updates can be audited by the calculus. The paper is a theory and benchmark-language manuscript; it does not claim large-scale optimizer state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出几何-非几何优化器演算（geometric-nongeometric optimizer calculus），一种模块化形式语言，用于在显式预言机、预算、状态和规则约束下审计可达梯度方法。主要形式结果是一个方向可表达性定理，并定义了受限方向残差，将设计问题转化为模块预算的帕累托优化。文中仅提供诊断原型作为语言证据，不声称大规模优化器的state-of-the-art性能。
Motivation: 自适应优化器混合多种机制，但缺乏统一的模块化语言来审计在约束条件下哪些梯度方向是可达的，这限制了优化器设计的理论理解和系统性比较。
Method: 引入几何与非几何模块：几何模块为正度规族，将余向量映射到参数空间方向；非几何模块包括信息、记忆、控制、算子、噪声、目标及离散化机制。通过方向可表达性定理严格刻画可达方向集，并定义方向残差用于诊断。
Result: 定理表明，远离临界点时，完整正定几何恰好表达严格下降方向；对角和分块几何有精确可表达性条件；将设计问题重构为模块预算的帕累托优化，并引入轨迹级残差复杂度。全量度探针求解确定二次基准至数值精度，Muon式PyTorch候选在小规模上可被演算审计。
Conclusion: 本文贡献一套理论语言和基准，用于审计优化器可达方向，而非提出新的最佳优化器；未来可应用于分析各类自适应优化器的设计空间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Restricted Dynamic Geometric Complexity: Certificates for Structured Preconditioning
papers.abstract_en: Optimization geometrodynamics views optimizer state as evolving geometry. Its full positive-definite quadratic benchmark gives the least affine-invariant deformation needed to reduce condition number when arbitrary metrics are allowed. This paper records that benchmark in the present notation and develops restricted dynamic geometric complexity: an intrinsic certificate distance for reaching a target condition-number class when the metric is restricted to a specified family. The main proved results are monotonicity and submanifold-distance principles, diagonal and block reachability as linear matrix inequality feasibility problems, an exact two-dimensional diagonal complexity formula, and affine-invariant Kronecker projection theorems with normal equations, computable mismatch certificates, Armijo solver convergence, auxiliary self-conditioned K-target bounds, and Hessian-relative candidate certificates through an exact Kronecker Loewner-sandwich reachability condition, including a Kronecker expression threshold and a fixed-basis exact subproblem. Low-rank spectral models, curvature-proxy inflation, stochastic restricted complexity, discrete geometric length, and expression--estimation--flow--discretization accounting are presented as diagnostic interfaces rather than full optimizer characterizations. The resulting language turns structural preconditioner questions into geometric distance, reachability, and certificate problems. The repository includes deterministic toy and synthetic workflows that check diagonal expression gaps, block primal/dual certificates, Kronecker spectral width, and Hessian-relative Kronecker candidate certificates on small quadratic instances, together with low-rank spectral monotonicity.

Motivation: 现有优化几何动力学方法在允许任意度量时给出了完全正定二次基准，但实际中度量常被限制在特定参数族内，缺乏系统性的几何距离和可达性工具来评估结构预条件子的质量。
Method: 定义受限动态几何复杂度作为到目标条件数类的内在证书距离，通过线性矩阵不等式（LMI）将对角和分块可达性转化为可行性问题，并利用仿射不变的Kronecker投影定理导出精确条件表达式，包括Kronecker Loewner-三明治可达性条件。
Result: 主要理论成果包括二维对角复杂度精确公式、Kronecker表达式阈值、固定基精确子问题，以及低秩谱单调性等。实验部分在小型二次实例上验证了对角表达间隙、块原始/对偶证书、Kronecker谱宽度和Hessian相对Kronecker候选证书。

papers.title: Validate the Dream Before You Trust Its Verdict: Admissibility for World-Model Simulators
papers.abstract_en: Across robotics, World Models (WMs) are increasingly used to evaluate action policies by simulating the consequences of actions in an imagined world, and returning a success or safety verdict. Yet a verdict is only as trustworthy as the WM that produced it, and the WM itself needs to be certified. In video-generation WMs, fidelity metrics such as Fréchet Video Distance (FVD) reward visual realism, but ignore whether the world responds correctly to the policy's actions, including those unseen in training. Classical simulation-based validation assumes a trusted simulator evaluating an untrusted policy, whereas generative WMs are themselves unverified learned artifacts. Hence, we argue that any WM used as a test oracle must first be accredited before its verdicts can serve as evidence. Building on credibility practices from safety-critical simulation, including Verification, Validation & Accreditation (VV&A), Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF), and scenario-based testing standards, we define an admissibility ladder (L0-L4) that a WM must climb before its closed-loop verdicts are accepted as assurance evidence. Our framework is embodiment-agnostic, and is instantiated in autonomous driving (AD), where assurance methods for traditional simulation are most mature. Applied to two driving WMs, the lower rungs reveal a reversal: the model that ranks higher on visual generation quality (L0) ranks lower on action-following (L1-L2), so visual fidelity does not predict the action-robustness a closed-loop verdict depends on.
papers.comment: Accepted at RSS 2026 Workshop on Robot World Models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出世界模型（WM）作为闭环测试裁判时，必须先通过一个可接受性阶梯（L0-L4）认证，才能将其裁决作为保障证据。该框架独立于具体具身形式，并在自动驾驶领域实例化。实验表明，视觉生成质量高的模型在动作跟随能力上可能反而更差，因此视觉保真度不能预测闭环裁决所需的动作鲁棒性。
Motivation: 世界模型被广泛用于评估动作策略的闭环结果，但其本身是未经验证的机器学习产物，其裁决的可信度需要系统性的认证方法。
Method: 借鉴安全关键仿真中的可靠性实践（如VV&A、SOTIF和基于场景的测试标准），定义了一个L0-L4的可接受性阶梯，要求世界模型在每一级达到相应标准后才能用于提供闭环证据。
Result: 在自动驾驶领域对两个驾驶世界模型进行测试，结果显示较低阶梯上出现反转：视觉生成质量（L0）排名高的模型在动作跟随（L1-L2）上排名反而低。
Conclusion: 视觉保真度不能预测闭环裁决所需的动作鲁棒性，因此世界模型在用作测试裁判前必须经过多级认证。

papers.title: DiffCVE: Diffusion-based Compressed Video Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Perceptual quality enhancement of severely compressed videos remains challenging due to complex artifact patterns and substantial information loss. Recent diffusion models have demonstrated strong generative capability for visual restoration, but directly applying them to compressed video often ignores compression degradation characteristics and may introduce structure-inconsistent hallucinations. To address this issue, this paper presents a diffusion-based compressed video enhancement method, named DiffCVE. Coding Prior-enhanced Dual Conditioning (CPDC) branches are designed to jointly model compressed video and coding prior conditions, where coding priors including residuals and motion vectors provide complementary structural and motion guidance during the diffusion denoising process. To make the diffusion process aware of compression severity, a Compression Degradation Semantic Prompting (CDSP) mechanism is introduced to leverage QP-conditioned textual prompts together with LoRA fine-tuning. In addition, a Coding Prior-guided Weighted Fusion (CPWF) module is incorporated into the VAE decoder to fuse VAE encoder and coding prior encoder features with QP-predicted weights. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in improving perceptual quality, especially under severe compression settings. The project page with enhanced video demonstrations is available at https://wqmaker.github.io/projects/DiffCVE/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于扩散模型的压缩视频增强方法 DiffCVE，通过编码先验双条件分支（CPDC）、压缩退化语义提示（CDSP）和编码先验引导加权融合（CPWF）模块，提升严重压缩视频的感知质量。实验表明该方法在改善感知质量方面有效，尤其在严重压缩设置下。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型直接用于压缩视频增强时忽略压缩退化特性，可能产生结构不一致的幻觉。
Method: 提出 DiffCVE 方法，包括编码先验增强的双条件分支（CPDC）联合建模压缩视频和编码先验（残差和运动向量），压缩退化语义提示（CDSP）利用 QP 条件文本提示和 LoRA 微调，以及编码先验引导加权融合（CPWF）在 VAE 解码器中融合特征。
Result: 实验表明该方法在改善感知质量上有效，尤其在严重压缩设置下。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法利用编码先验和压缩退化感知机制提升压缩视频增强效果。

papers.title: Prototype-Anchored Generalized Manifold Regression for Unknown-Domain Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection (Single-DGOD), which aims to transfer a detector trained on a single source domain to multiple unseen domains. Existing methods mainly rely on simulation-driven strategies, such as data augmentation or textual prompts, to enlarge the training distribution. However, finite simulations can hardly cover the dynamic variations of real-world scenarios, often causing overfitting to synthetic styles and limited robustness to complex structural degradations. Inspired by the manifold hypothesis, we argue that semantic features, despite diverse visual changes, should lie on a compact and stable low-dimensional manifold. Therefore, robust generalization requires rectifying deviant samples back to this semantic manifold, rather than exhaustively simulating external perturbations. To this end, we propose Manifold Regression with Visual-Text Dual Chain-of-Thought (MR-DCoT), which formulates unknown-domain generalization as a manifold regression problem. MR-DCoT first uses a Visual-Text Dual Chain-of-Thought module to combine VLM-guided semantic evolution with diffusion-based structural perturbation, generating structured off-manifold hard examples. It then introduces Class-Specific Prototype Anchoring to learn a rectification operator that projects deviant features toward the source semantic manifold. By integrating outlier generation and semantic correction into a closed loop, MR-DCoT effectively narrows the distribution gap and improves robustness under unseen shifts. Extensive experiments on three complementary benchmarks, including adverse-weather detection, real-to-art generalization, and zero-shot semantic segmentation, demonstrate the effectiveness and versatility of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出原型锚定广义流形回归方法（MR-DCoT）解决单域广义目标检测问题。该方法利用视觉-文本双链思维模块生成偏离流形的困难样本，并通过类特定原型锚定学习矫正算子，将偏离特征投影回源语义流形，从而缩小分布差距并在未知域上提升鲁棒性。实验在恶劣天气检测、真实到艺术泛化和零样本语义分割等基准上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有单域广义目标检测方法依赖数据增强或文本提示模拟外部扰动，但有限模拟难以覆盖真实场景的动态变化，容易过拟合合成风格且对复杂结构退化鲁棒性不足。
Method: 提出流形回归框架（MR-DCoT），包括视觉-文本双链思维模块（融合VLM引导的语义演化与扩散结构扰动生成偏离流形的样本）和类特定原型锚定（学习矫正算子将偏离特征投影回源语义流形），形成闭环的异常生成与语义矫正。
Result: 在三个互补基准（恶劣天气检测、真实到艺术泛化、零样本语义分割）上，MR-DCoT有效缩小分布差距并提升对未知域偏移的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 通过将未知域泛化视为流形回归问题，结合异常生成与语义矫正，可有效提升跨域目标检测的泛化能力。

papers.title: Does AI Understand Imaging? A Systematic Benchmark of Agentic AI for Computational Imaging Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) and agentic AI have shown strong performance on semantic visual tasks, but it remains unclear whether they can handle the physics and inverse problems that underlie computational imaging. We present ImagingBench, a benchmark of 20 computational imaging tasks spanning five categories: ray and wave optics, image signal processing, inverse reconstruction, computational sensing, and calibration. ImagingBench evaluates three complementary settings: Expert, fixed expert-guided inverse reconstruction; Planner, planner-guided inverse reconstruction; and Forward, forward-system simulation for consistency checking. We benchmark leading proprietary and open-source image-centric multimodal systems, including Gemini, GPT, and Qwen, and compare them with representative task-specific non-agentic baselines. Across tasks, agentic models remain consistently weaker than specialized methods, especially on computational sensing problems such as lensless imaging, event-based reconstruction, time-of-flight imaging, and holography. Planner guidance provides only modest and inconsistent gains over the fixed-prompt Expert baseline. Although the models often generate visually plausible outputs, their reference-based fidelity remains poor, revealing a substantial gap between semantic visual competence and physically grounded imaging performance. ImagingBench provides a unified testbed for measuring this gap and tracking progress in agentic AI for computational imaging.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 11 figures. Preprint / work in progress. Paper Webpage: https://cirp-lab.github.io/imagingbench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ImagingBench，一个包含 20 项计算成像任务的基准测试，覆盖射线和波动光学、图像信号处理、逆重建、计算传感和校准五大类。评估了 Gemini、GPT、Qwen 等主流视觉-语言模型在三种设置下的表现，并与专用方法对比。发现 agentic AI 在计算成像任务上持续弱于专用方法，尤其在无透镜成像、事件重建、飞行时间成像和全息术等计算传感问题上表现不佳，虽然输出视觉上合理但物理保真度差，揭示了视觉语义能力与物理成像能力之间的差距。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型在语义视觉任务上表现优异，但尚不清楚它们能否处理计算成像涉及的物理和逆问题，缺乏统一的测试基准。
Method: 构建 ImagingBench，包含 20 个计算成像任务，设计三种评估设置：Expert（固定专家引导逆重建）、Planner（规划器引导逆重建）和 Forward（前向系统模拟一致性检查），并对比多种开源和商业多模态系统与专用基线。
Result: 所有 agentic 模型在计算成像任务上显著弱于专用方法，尤其在计算传感问题上；Planner 设置相比固定提示的 Expert 设置仅带来微小且不稳定的提升；模型输出视觉上合理，但基于参考的保真度指标很差。
Conclusion: 存在语义视觉能力与物理成像能力之间的显著差距，ImagingBench 为衡量这一差距并追踪 agentic AI 在计算成像中的进展提供了统一测试平台。

papers.title: EditVerse3D: High-Quality 3D Object Editing with Region-Aware Learning
papers.abstract_en: Local editing of 3D objects remains a long-standing challenge. When interacting with 3D content, humans naturally tend to specify a coarse region of interest for modification rather than defining precise editing boundaries. However, previous methods rely on fully edited 2D images, precise 3D masks, or redundant pipelines, which present a gap. To bridge this gap, we propose EditVerse3D, a novel 3D editing framework that enables high-quality object editing under such coarse guidance. Our approach takes as input a 3D object to be edited, a coarse 3D bounding box indicating the target region, and a reference 2D image describing the desired modification. It produces a coherent, high-fidelity edited 3D object. To facilitate this editing, we introduce a novel region-aware adaptive loss that emphasizes hard-to-learn regions and balances the objective between target and preserved areas. Complementing our loss function, we enhance model robustness and generalization through targeted data augmentations, such as training with scaled 3D masks and filtering out unrealistic editing pairs. We construct a large-scale 3D editing dataset derived from parts information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EditVerse3D achieves superior visual quality and quantitative performance compared to existing 3D editing approaches. Please visit our project page at https://editverse3d.github.io.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EditVerse3D，一个基于区域感知学习的3D物体局部编辑框架。输入包含待编辑的3D物体、粗粒度的3D边界框和参考2D图像，输出高质量的编辑后3D物体。引入区域感知自适应损失，强调难学习区域并平衡目标与保留区域的损失。通过数据增强和构建大规模3D编辑数据集，实验表明视觉和定量性能优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有3D物体局部编辑方法依赖完全编辑的2D图像、精确的3D掩码或复杂流水线，与人类自然指定粗略区域进行修改的习惯存在差距。
Method: 提出EditVerse3D框架，使用粗粒度3D边界框和参考2D图像。引入区域感知自适应损失，对难学习区域加权，并平衡编辑目标与保留区域的损失。采用缩放3D掩码训练和过滤不真实编辑对等数据增强。
Result: 在多个数据集上，EditVerse3D在视觉质量和定量指标上优于现有3D编辑方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调EditVerse3D在粗粒度用户指导下实现高质量3D物体局部编辑，并验证了区域感知损失和数据增强的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Predicting LLM Safety Before Release by Simulating Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Pre-deployment safety evaluations aim to inform the downstream risks of releasing a new AI model. Yet most evaluations provide limited evidence about how often undesired model behavior will occur in deployment: they generally have insufficient coverage, are unrepresentative, and are generally recognizable as tests. To address these concerns, we study a simple way to simulate a model deployment: starting from de-identified conversations from a previous model deployment, we hold fixed the initial conversation prefix and regenerate the next response using a candidate model. The resulting responses can then both be audited for novel misalignments and used to estimate the prevalence of model misbehavior before deployment. We evaluate deployment simulation across four GPT-5-series deployments, using registered, outcome-blinded predictions for GPT-5.4 and retrospective analyses of three earlier releases. We find that deployment simulation produces informative estimates of post-deployment misbehavior rates and outperforms baselines based on adversarially selected production data; its evaluation-awareness point estimates were also much closer to production traffic than those from traditional evaluations. We also identify the realism of tool resampling as a central challenge for further improving predictions and share results suggesting that this challenge is surmountable even in complex tool-use settings. Finally, we show that deployment simulation can be seeded from public chat datasets and remain informative about production misbehavior rates, suggesting a path for external researchers to run deployment-grounded evaluations without access to private production logs. Overall, deployment simulation helps evaluators forecast how language models will behave in the real world and supports more quantitative assessment of deployment risk.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种通过模拟部署来预测大语言模型（LLM）发布后安全风险的方法。该方法从以往模型部署的去标识化对话中提取初始对话前缀，并用候选模型重新生成后续响应，从而评估模型行为。在GPT-5系列部署的评估中，该方法能提供对部署后不当行为率的有信息量的估计，优于基于对抗性选择生产数据的基线，且其评估感知点估计更接近生产流量。
Motivation: 现有预部署安全评估无法充分预测模型在实际部署中发生不当行为的频率，存在覆盖率不足、缺乏代表性且容易被识破的问题。
Method: 从先前模型部署的去标识化对话中固定初始前缀，使用候选模型重新生成响应，然后对响应进行审计，以发现新的失调并估计不当行为发生率。
Result: 在四个GPT-5系列部署中，注册了结果盲预测的GPT-5.4和三个早期版本的回顾分析表明，该方法能产生有信息量的不当行为率估计，优于基于对抗性选择生产数据的基线，且评估感知点估计更接近生产流量。
Conclusion: 部署模拟有助于评估者预测语言模型在真实世界中的行为，支持对部署风险进行更定量的评估。主要挑战在于工具重采样的真实性，但结果表明即使在复杂工具使用场景下也可解决。此外，该方法可使用公共聊天数据集作为种子，仍能对生产不当行为率保持信息量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Comparative Study of Domain-adapted VLMs for General Document Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Document Visual Question Answering (DocVQA) presents a complex multimodal challenge, requiring models to exploit visual, textual, and layout information from documents. Although Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown remarkable performance in text-vision tasks, their robustness and transferability to different document domains remains underexplored. In this study, we present a comprehensive evaluation of 8 open-source pretrained VLMs on DocVQA in three different document domains: industrial documents of varying type, infographics, and presentation slides. We systematically assess model performance under zero-shot evaluations, fully supervised finetuning with inter- and intra-dataset evaluations, and few-shot learning evaluations of knowledge transfer between domains. Our findings demonstrate that while large pretrained VLMs possess strong zero-shot baselines for structured layouts, their performance strongly decreases on visually complex layouts of infographics and slides. Although parameter scaling is a dominant factor on performance, supervised finetuning yields higher relative gains in smaller architectures. Furthermore, our cross-domain and few-shot experiments show that visual understanding is the main bottleneck for DocVQA, not a lack of knowledge from the VLMs. Using 50 target domain samples, the models finetuned in DocVQA with datasets of different domains rapidly adapt to the target domain documents, even surpassing their fully supervised counterparts in some cases.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, accepted at the Automatically Domain-Adapted and Personalized Document Analysis workshop of the ICDAR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了8个开源视觉语言模型（VLM）在文档视觉问答（DocVQA）任务上，针对工业文档、信息图和幻灯片三个不同领域的表现。研究发现，大型VLM在结构化布局上具有强零样本性能，但在视觉复杂布局上性能显著下降；参数规模是主导因素，但小模型通过微调获得更大相对提升；视觉理解是主要瓶颈，使用50个目标域样本微调可快速适应甚至超越全监督。
Motivation: 尽管VLM在文本视觉任务上表现优异，但其在不同文档领域的鲁棒性和迁移性尚未被充分探索，特别是对工业文档、信息图和幻灯片等多种文档类型的DocVQA性能缺乏系统性评估。
Method: 对8个开源预训练VLM进行零样本评估、全监督微调（包括域内和跨域评估）以及少样本学习实验，覆盖工业文档、信息图和幻灯片三个领域。
Result: 大型VLM在结构化布局上零样本性能强，但在信息图和幻灯片等复杂视觉布局上性能大幅下降；参数缩放是主要因素，但小架构通过监督微调获得更高相对增益；跨域和少样本实验表明视觉理解是主要瓶颈，使用50个目标域样本微调可快速适应，甚至在某些情况下超越全监督对照组。
Conclusion: 摘要强调DocVQA的主要瓶颈在于视觉理解而非VLM的知识缺乏，少量目标域样本即可实现高效域适应。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Entropy Pacing Policy Optimization for Multi-Task Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recent breakthroughs of Reinforcement Learning (RL) have highlighted its potential for complex agentic Large Language Model (LLM) tasks. However, existing efforts largely focus on single-task settings, whereas real-world deployment necessitates a generalist agent capable of solving multiple tasks simultaneously. In this work, we identify a critical yet underexplored phenomenon in multi-task agentic RL: different tasks can exhibit exploration-exploitation pace mismatch. Specifically, easier tasks may converge early to low-entropy policies that hinder learning on harder tasks, while harder tasks can, in turn, push easier tasks back toward high-entropy exploration. This back-and-forth interaction creates inter-task entropy crossovers and frequent entropy spikes. Inspired by this observation, we introduce Entropy Pacing Policy Optimization (EPPO) for multi-task agentic LLMs, which coordinates entropy across tasks to stabilize multi-task optimization. At the core of EPPO is a task-wise dynamic clipping mechanism that replaces the fixed clipping threshold in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a task entropy-aware adaptive bound, tightening updates for over-confident tasks while relaxing them for under-explored ones. Experiments on the multi-task agentic benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed EPPO yields results superior to its counterparts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多任务智能体强化学习中不同任务探索-利用步调不匹配的问题，提出熵调步策略优化（EPPO），通过任务动态裁剪机制自适应调整GRPO的裁剪阈值，协调任务间的熵以稳定优化。实验表明EPPO在多任务智能体基准上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法主要针对单任务，而多任务智能体LLM部署中，不同任务存在探索-利用步调不匹配，导致熵交叉和尖峰，影响学习效率。
Method: EPPO的核心是任务动态裁剪机制，用任务熵感知的自适应边界替换GRPO的固定裁剪阈值，对过度自信的任务收紧更新，对探索不足的任务放松更新。
Result: 在多任务智能体基准上，EPPO取得优于对比方法的性能。
Conclusion: 通过协调任务熵，EPPO能够稳定多任务优化过程，提升多任务智能体RL的效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Accurate and Fast Clinical Body Composition: A Resource-Efficient Hierarchical Segmentation Framework for Multi-Source CT
papers.abstract_en: Background: Automated 3D segmentation of muscles and adipose tissue from CT is vital for body composition analysis, but multi-source data heterogeneity and high CPU memory demands hinder clinical deployment. Methods: We propose a coarse-to-fine hierarchical framework to segment ten tissue structures. Efficiency is optimized using Dynamic Spacing and Anisotropic Patching, a Group Inference mechanism for low-memory sliding-window processing, and Topology-Aware Asymmetric Resampling for fast post-processing. Results: The framework was trained on 1,558 CT volumes from seven public and two private datasets, and evaluated on an independent test cohort (N=105), per-structure Dice coefficients ranged from 0.924 to 0.982. Eight major structures met the +-10% relative error clinical acceptance limit. On a 12-core CPU workstation, the GPU-free pipeline averaged 44.5 seconds per volume with 4.73 GB peak memory. Conclusion: This framework balances accuracy and efficiency, enabling robust, large-scale body composition analysis on standard CPU workstations.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种由粗到细的层次化分割框架，用于从CT图像中自动分割肌肉和脂肪等十种组织结构。该框架通过动态间距和异性贴片、分组推理机制以及拓扑感知非对称重采样优化了效率和内存使用。在1558个CT体积上训练，在独立测试集（N=105）上每个结构的Dice系数从0.924到0.982，八种主要结构满足±10%相对误差临床接受限。在12核CPU工作站上，无需GPU的流水线平均每体积44.5秒，峰值内存4.73 GB。
Motivation: 多源CT数据的异质性和高CPU内存需求阻碍了自动身体成分分析在临床中的部署。
Method: 提出粗到细的层次化分割框架，包含动态间距和异性贴片（Dynamic Spacing and Anisotropic Patching）、分组推理机制（Group Inference）用于低内存滑动窗口处理，以及拓扑感知非对称重采样（Topology-Aware Asymmetric Resampling）用于快速后处理。
Result: 在1558个CT体积上训练，独立测试集（N=105）上每个结构的Dice系数范围0.924-0.982，八种主要结构满足±10%相对误差临床接受限。在12核CPU工作站上，无需GPU的流水线平均每体积44.5秒，峰值内存4.73 GB。
Conclusion: 该框架在准确性和效率之间取得平衡，能够在标准CPU工作站上实现稳健的大规模身体成分分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stage-Aware Adaptation and Distribution Calibration for Subject-Driven Personalized Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Subject-driven personalized text-to-image generation requires a pretrained diffusion model to acquire a specific subject from a few reference images while preserving subject identity, following novel text prompts, and maintaining sample diversity. Existing optimization-based methods instantiate subject adaptation through full fine-tuning, textual embedding optimization, or low-rank parameter updates; PaRa further constrains personalization from the perspective of parameter rank reduction. However, a uniform low-rank constraint or a uniform adapter strength cannot explicitly distinguish the capacity requirements of different denoising stages. Moreover, inference-time candidate selection driven mainly by identity similarity may compress the selected samples in the visual representation space. We decompose the problem into two complementary components: SPaRa denotes training-side stage-aware low-rank adaptation, DCAL denotes inference-side distribution-calibrated candidate selection, and SPaRa-DCAL denotes the combined framework. Theoretical analysis shows that timestep-dependent scaling controls the effective perturbation magnitude of a low-rank adapter, while identity-biased candidate selection restricts the radius of selected features around the reference center under explicit conditions. Auditable experiments under the SDXL and DreamBooth 30-subject protocol show that DCAL improves 1-LPIPS, CLIP-I, DINO-I, and CLIP-T on a fixed LoRA candidate pool, while revealing a clear trade-off with CLIP/DINO pairwise diversity and pairwise LPIPS. These results indicate that personalized generation should be evaluated through identity consistency, text alignment, and representation diversity rather than identity metrics alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对主题驱动的个性化文本到图像生成任务，提出训练端阶段感知低秩适配（SPaRa）和推理端分布校准候选选择（DCAL）的联合框架。理论分析表明时间步依赖缩放控制低秩适配器的有效扰动幅度，而身份偏置的候选选择会限制所选特征在参考中心周围的半径。实验在SDXL和DreamBooth 30主题协议下显示，DCAL在固定LoRA候选池上提升了1-LPIPS、CLIP-I、DINO-I和CLIP-T指标，但牺牲了CLIP/DINO配对多样性和配对LPIPS。
Motivation: 现有方法如PaRa对参数秩施加统一约束，或使用统一适配强度，无法显式区分不同去噪阶段的能力需求；同时推理时主要基于身份相似度进行候选选择，可能压缩样本在视觉表示空间中的多样性。
Method: 将问题分解为两个互补组件：训练端提出阶段感知低秩适配（SPaRa），即根据去噪时间步动态调整低秩适配器的缩放因子；推理端提出分布校准候选选择（DCAL），通过校准选择分布来平衡身份一致性与多样性。
Result: 在SDXL和DreamBooth 30主题协议下，DCAL在固定LoRA候选池上相对于基线改进了1-LPIPS、CLIP-I、DINO-I和CLIP-T，但降低了CLIP/DINO配对多样性和配对LPIPS。
Conclusion: 个性化生成应通过身份一致性、文本对齐和表示多样性三维度评估，而非仅依赖身份指标。

papers.title: PUF: Plug-and-Play Uncertainty-Aware Fusion for Online 3D Scene Graph Generation
papers.abstract_en: Online 3D scene graph generation builds a persistent, structured representation of a scene by incrementally fusing 2D observations into a global 3D graph. Existing online methods treat this fusion as a fully deterministic pipeline, where we identify three sources of uncertainty that are overlooked: observation, 2D model, and 3D representation. We propose PUF: a Plug-and-play, Uncertainty-aware, and training-free Fusion framework. Scene graph node association is reformulated as a probabilistic likelihood over semantic and spatial factors, replacing binary accept/reject gates. Dirichlet evidence accumulation distributes class and relationship evidence across plausible candidates proportional to association likelihood. An optional class-conditional prior completes edges for sparsely or never co-observed object pairs. We instantiate PUF with both a 3D Gaussian and a 3D voxel backend and observe consistent improvements, demonstrating its ability to generalize across different representations. Experiments on the 3DSSG and ReplicaSSG benchmarks show that our method substantially outperforms existing approaches while maintaining real-time latency. These results establish uncertainty-aware fusion as a principled and effective paradigm for online 3D scene understanding. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/yyyyangyi/PUF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PUF，一种即插即用、不确定性感知、无需训练的在线三维场景图融合框架。通过将节点关联重新表述为语义和空间因素的概率似然，并使用Dirichlet证据积累分配证据，同时引入类别条件先验补全边，在3DSSG和ReplicaSSG基准上显著优于现有方法，并保持实时延迟。
Motivation: 现有在线3D场景图生成方法将融合视为确定性管道，忽略了观察、2D模型和3D表示这三种不确定性来源。
Method: 提出PUF框架：节点关联重新表述为语义和空间因素的概率似然，取代二元接受/拒绝门；Dirichlet证据积累按关联似然将证据分配给候选；可选的类别条件先验补全稀疏或从未共现对象对的边。支持3D高斯和3D体素后端。
Result: 在3DSSG和ReplicaSSG基准上大幅优于现有方法，同时保持实时延迟。
Conclusion: 不确定性感知融合被确立为在线3D场景理解的一个原则性和有效范式。

papers.title: TACoS: Weakly Supervised Learning of Two-Dimensional Materials from Scribble Annotations to Precise Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: The precise pixel-level localization of 2D material flakes is crucial for high-throughput screening. However, traditional fully supervised methods rely on dense annotations, which are costly and time-consuming, severely limiting the practical deployment of segmentation models. This paper proposes TACoS, a specialized scribble segmentation framework tailored for 2D materials. First, we design a unified framework that integrates semi-supervised consistency learning with structured tree energy constraints. This framework comprises two core components: an unlabeled weak-strong distribution alignment module and a tree energy regularization module. The former employs cosine consistency constraints to enhance prediction alignment across views. Meanwhile, the latter utilizes minimum spanning trees to establish pixel affinity relationships and generate structure-aware soft pseudo labels for online semantic guidance. Next, we introduce asymmetric regional contrast learning. This approach fuses high-confidence predictions from the weak augmentation branch with scribbles to form augmented labels, and construct category prototypes in the representation space. Simultaneously, we prioritize contrastive constraints on challenging pixels in boundary-unlabeled regions. This strategy enhances intra-class cohesion and inter-class separation at the representation level, effectively reducing category confusion in low-contrast edges and complex backgrounds. Experiments conducted on the constructed graphene and MoS2 datasets demonstrate that our method TACoS achieves over 96% of fully supervised performance using less than 0.6% annotated data. Furthermore, it exhibits superior structural coherence and boundary stability in scenarios with weakly contrasting edges and complex backgrounds, providing an efficient and scalable solution for automated high-throughput screening of 2D material flakes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对二维材料薄片像素级分割中密集标注成本高的问题，提出弱监督的涂鸦分割框架TACoS。该方法结合半监督一致性学习与结构化树能量约束，并引入非对称区域对比学习。在石墨烯和MoS2数据集上，使用不到0.6%的标注数据即可达到完全监督性能的96%以上。
Motivation: 传统全监督分割方法依赖密集像素级标注，成本高昂且耗时，严重限制了二维材料分割模型的实际部署。
Method: 提出TACoS框架，包含三个核心部分：1）基于半监督一致性学习和树能量约束的统一框架，包括未标记弱-强分布对齐模块（用余弦一致性约束）和树能量正则化模块（用最小生成树建立像素亲和关系生成软伪标签）；2）非对称区域对比学习，融合弱增强分支的高置信预测与涂鸦形成增强标签，构建类别原型；3）对边界未标记区域中的难分像素优先施加对比约束。
Result: 在构建的石墨烯和MoS2数据集上，使用不到0.6%的标注数据，TACoS达到完全监督性能的96%以上，并在弱对比边缘和复杂背景下表现出更好的结构一致性和边界稳定性。
Conclusion: TACoS为二维材料薄片的高通量筛选提供了高效且可扩展的弱监督分割方案，显著降低标注需求。

papers.title: NoDrift3R: Raymap-Guided Coupling for Drift-Robust Unposed Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Pose-Free Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for fast scene reconstruction. However, its performance degrades significantly in long image sequences due to cumulative camera pose estimation drift, which propagates errors into geometric modeling and severely limits rendering fidelity. In this work, we revisit the long-sequence bottleneck and identify pose drift as the primary factor restricting reconstruction quality. Furthermore, while SfM-based pseudo ground-truth poses introduce sensor noise, purely rendering-based supervision often leads to optimization instability and local minima due to the entangled optimization of geometry and pose. To address the challenges, we propose a synergistic pose-free framework that explicitly couples geometry and appearance via a Raymap-Guided Coupling Module (RGC). Concretely, we anchor Gaussian centers to raymap-induced geometry and jointly optimize RGB reconstruction, raymap consistency, and camera regularization under a unified objective, yielding a bidirectional feedback loop: stronger geometry improves rendering, and appearance supervision in turn refines geometry and pose. To further stabilize learning across wide temporal ranges, we introduce a Dual-Frequency Viewpoint Scheduling strategy that combines easy-to-hard interval expansion with replay of short-interval pairs. Extensive experiments across in-domain and cross-domain datasets show consistent gains in both rendering and pose estimation, with notably improved robustness on long sequences. Ablation studies validate our central insight: explicitly designed geometry-appearance synergy is the key to scalable and drift-robust pose-free feed-forward 3D reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无位姿前馈3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）在长图像序列中因累积相机位姿漂移导致重建质量下降的问题，提出NoDrift3R框架。通过射线图引导耦合模块（RGC）将高斯中心锚定到射线图诱导的几何上，联合优化RGB重建、射线图一致性和相机正则化，形成双向反馈循环。还引入双频视点调度策略，结合易到难的间隔扩展和短间隔对重放。实验表明在域内和跨域数据集上渲染和位姿估计均有提升，尤其长序列鲁棒性显著。
Motivation: 无位姿前馈3DGS在长序列中因相机位姿漂移导致几何建模错误和渲染质量下降，而基于SfM的伪真值位姿引入传感器噪声，纯渲染监督导致优化不稳定和局部最小值。
Method: 提出射线图引导耦合模块（RGC），将高斯中心锚定到射线图几何，联合优化RGB、射线图一致性和相机正则化；并采用双频视点调度策略（DFVS），结合间隔扩张和短间隔对重放。
Result: 在域内和跨域数据集上渲染和位姿估计一致提升，长序列鲁棒性显著改善；消融实验验证几何-外观协同设计是核心。
Conclusion: 显式设计的几何-外观协同是可扩展且抗漂移的无位姿前馈3D重建的关键。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ASFR-Net: Adversarial Alignment and Spatio-Frequency Refinement Network for Heterogeneous Remote Sensing Image Change Detection
papers.abstract_en: The core challenge of heterogeneous change detection in remote sensing imagery lies in effectively decoupling genuine land-cover changes from significant modal disparities caused by distinct imaging mechanisms. These intrinsic inconsistencies are prone to introducing pseudo-changes, thereby constraining detection accuracy. To address this, we propose a novel, end-to-end adversarial spatio-frequency refinement network (ASFR-Net). Initially, a modality-invariant representation learner (MIR-Learner) guides the backbone to extract modality-invariant features, effectively bridging the primary domain gap. Subsequently, to address persistent residual modal differences, we design an innovative spatio-frequency synergistic enhancement module (SFEM), which identifies and suppresses sensor-specific noise and artifacts that are difficult to discern in the spatial domain by leveraging frequency-domain processing. Multi-level difference features are then computed from these refined representations and fed into a decoder equipped with cascaded hierarchical guided fusion module (HGFM) blocks to generate precise change maps. To alleviate the data scarcity in heterogeneous tasks, we construct and release a new high-resolution benchmark specifically focused on building changes: the visible-near-infrared heterogeneous change detection (VisNIR-HCD) dataset. It presents unique scientific challenges arising from deceptive visual similarity and non-linear spectral inversions, providing a robust platform for evaluating model generalization. Extensive experiments on VisNIR-HCD and public datasets demonstrate that ASFR-Net achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance, significantly outperforming existing methods. The source code and the VisNIR-HCD dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/LuoYang2024/ASFR-Net.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种端到端的对抗性空频精化网络（ASFR-Net），用于异质遥感图像变化检测。通过模态不变表示学习器（MIR-Learner）缩小域差距，并设计空频协同增强模块（SFEM）抑制传感器噪声，最后使用层级引导融合模块（HGFM）生成变化图。同时构建了新的可见光-近红外异质变化检测基准数据集VisNIR-HCD。实验表明该方法达到当前最优性能。
Motivation: 异质遥感图像变化检测的核心挑战在于真实地表变化与不同成像机制导致的模态差异之间的解耦，现有方法容易引入伪变化，检测精度受限。
Method: 提出ASFR-Net，包含三个关键组件：模态不变表示学习器（MIR-Learner）引导骨干网络提取模态不变特征；空频协同增强模块（SFEM）利用频域处理抑制传感器噪声；层级引导融合模块（HGFM）处理多级差异特征并生成变化图。
Result: 在VisNIR-HCD数据集和公开数据集上，ASFR-Net达到最优性能，显著超越现有方法。
Conclusion: 本文提出的对抗性空频精化网络有效解耦异质遥感图像中的模态差异与真实变化，并提供了新的基准数据集VisNIR-HCD以推动该领域研究。

papers.title: Information Allocation Dynamics in Neural Network Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Different optimizers have different update biases, but these biases are usually implicit. Existing studies mainly analyze or control such biases from the geometry of the final solution. However, how optimizer bias forms during training still lacks a clear internal mechanism. This paper proposes an information allocation dynamics perspective. It interprets optimizer implicit bias as the relative allocation of training signals between weight-like and bias-like parameter pathways. This allocation can be described and adjusted by a continuous preconditioning exponent \(p\). To characterize this mechanism, we first analyze the update contributions of weight and bias to the same residual signal in a minimal linear model. The weight correction term preserves input-dependent residual signals, while the bias correction term preserves the residual mean direction. They therefore correspond to different projection pathways of the residual signal. After substituting the preconditioned update into the residual update equation, the optimizer can change the relative strength of the weight correction term and the bias correction term through different preconditioning factors. Therefore, optimizer implicit bias is not only reflected in the final solution or the global training trajectory. It is also reflected in the relative write-in ratio of training signals across different parameter pathways. Overall, this paper moves the analysis of optimizer implicit bias from solution-space geometry to update dynamics during training. It reveals that the relative update allocation between weight and bias-like parameters is an important dynamical mechanism that affects parameter trajectories and generalization behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出信息分配动力学视角，将优化器的隐式偏向解释为权重路径与偏置路径之间训练信号的相对分配。通过连续预处理指数 p 描述和调整这种分配，并在最小线性模型中分析权重项和偏置项对残差信号的不同投影路径，揭示优化器偏向不仅体现在最终解或全局轨迹，还体现在训练信号在不同参数路径上的相对写入比率。
Motivation: 现有研究主要从最终解的几何结构分析或控制优化器偏向，但缺乏训练过程中偏向形成的内在机制。
Method: 提出信息分配动力学视角，通过预处理指数 p 控制权重与偏置参数路径的相对更新强度；在最小线性模型中推导权重项保持输入依赖残差、偏置项保持残差均值方向，并将其代入残差更新方程分析。
Result: 发现优化器隐式偏向表现在训练信号沿不同参数路径的相对写入比率，而不仅仅是最终解几何或全局轨迹。
Conclusion: 该工作将优化器偏向分析从解空间几何转向训练过程中的更新动力学，揭示了权重与偏置参数间的相对更新分配是影响参数轨迹和泛化行为的关键动态机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prior-matched evaluation of operational Earth-observation classifiers: a three-number reporting method demonstrated on Sentinel-1 internal-wave detection
papers.abstract_en: The Internal Waves Service screens the Sentinel-1 Wave-mode archive for internal solitary waves, routing detections to experts whose adjudication time is the resource the effort exists to conserve. Because attention is the cost of error, precision leads. Its classifier was trained and reported at a one-to-one class balance, fixed before the operational rate could be known. That rate has since emerged at roughly one scene in twenty, and a balanced-test score badly overstates the precision a validator meets. A model that scores 0.794 balanced-test precision scores 0.192 in real operation: the gap is a systematic artefact of reporting at the wrong prior, invisible to the metric most work quotes. We show the mismatch to be an evaluation problem in the costume of a training one at a fixed recall, prior correction and calibration cannot move precision, and answer it with a prior-matched reporting method based on three figures: balanced-test, operational-prior, and real post-deployment, whose contrast is the honest measure. A precision-first, leakage-controlled development cycle then improves the classifier lever by lever, each promoted only against a pre-registered margin; added capacity not clearing it, calibration inert, feature aggregation the one real lift, so the honest negatives are as much a result as the gain. Holding recall at a floor of 0.80 and certifying against a sealed, single-read lockbox, the promoted model reports 0.927 precision at the operational prior; an out-of-time check confirms discrimination transfers to unseen periods while a fixed operating point does not. Prior-matched reporting, begin balanced, then move to the prior as the stream reveals it, transfers to any operational Earth-observation service bootstrapping a rare-event detector under a prior it has yet to discover.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对地球观测分类器在操作环境中因先验概率不匹配导致的性能高估问题，提出一种基于三个数字（平衡测试、操作先验、实际部署后）的先验匹配报告方法。以Sentinel-1内波检测为例，展示了平衡测试精度0.794与实际操作精度0.192的巨大差距，并通过先验匹配报告方法使分类器在操作先验下达到0.927精度（召回率0.80）。该方法可推广到其他地球观测服务中。
Motivation: 地球观测分类器通常在平衡类上报告性能，但操作中罕见事件的先验概率远低于平衡假设，导致精度被严重高估。现有评估方法无法揭示这一系统性偏差，需要一种能反映真实操作条件的报告方法。
Method: 提出先验匹配报告方法，要求分类器在三个先验水平上报告性能：平衡测试（1:1）、操作先验（已知的罕见率，如1:20）、以及实际部署后（随流数据变化的先验）。通过对比这三个数字来真实反映分类器的操作表现，并采用精度优先、泄漏控制的发展周期，仅提升符合预注册边界的改进。
Result: 在Sentinel-1内波检测任务中，平衡测试精度为0.794，但操作先验下仅0.192。应用先验匹配报告和开发流程后，在操作先验下达到0.927精度（召回率下限0.80），且通过外部时间验证表明判别力可迁移到未见时间段。
Conclusion: 先验匹配报告方法能消除因先验不匹配导致的操作性能误解，适用于任何在未知先验下启动罕见事件检测的地球观测服务。强调精度的真实衡量需要代价感知，且报告数字应随流数据先验动态调整。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Fractal KV-Cache Archives: Lossless Symbolic Storage with In-Place Retrieval for Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: The key-value (KV) cache dominates the memory cost of long-context autoregressive inference, and a growing body of work compresses it through quantization, eviction, or offloading. We study a complementary question: once a position's KV state has been quantized to codebook indices, how should the resulting symbol stream be stored, and can the storage layer do more than store? A family of contractive iterated-map codes that serialize a symbol sequence into a sequence of low-dimensional real vectors is revisited, and it is shown that they form a natural archive format for a quantized KV cache with the following features. The method provides exactly the access pattern a growing cache requires. It is lossless, it runs in linear time, and supports O(1) random access and O(1) amortized append. A controlled study of the quantizer feeding this archive is conducted on GPT-2 with 1024-token contexts. Keeping a small exact window (4 attention sinks + 32 recent tokens) and archiving the rest, per-head residual vector quantization reduces the archived cache by 36-54x relative to an fp16 cache at a perplexity cost of 11-15%, and we quantify a sharp key/value asymmetry -- quantizing keys is roughly 4x more damaging than quantizing values, consistent with prior low-bit KV work -- and use it to allocate bits in a hybrid scheme. Finally, we show the archive is simultaneously a search index: approximate substring queries execute directly on the stored vectors, and matched context is decoded from the matched vector without ever materializing the surrounding text. We release all code; every number reproduces from a single command on a laptop CPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了一种无损分形KV缓存归档格式，用于存储量化的KV状态。该方法通过迭代映射编码将符号序列转化为低维向量，支持O(1)随机访问和O(1)均摊追加，且同时可作为搜索索引。实验表明，在GPT-2上使用残差向量量化可将缓存压缩36-54倍，但键的量化比值的量化破坏性大4倍。
Motivation: 长上下文自回归推理中KV缓存内存开销巨大，现有压缩方法多关注量化、驱逐或卸载，但忽略了量化后符号流的存储和检索效率问题。
Method: 使用收缩迭代映射编码将符号序列序列化为低维实向量，形成归档格式，支持无损、线性时间、O(1)随机访问和O(1)均摊追加。结合残差向量量化器，并利用键/值不对称性进行混合位分配。
Result: 在GPT-2 1024上下文上，小窗口加归档方式实现36-54倍压缩，困惑度损失11-15%。键量化破坏性约为值量化的4倍。该归档同时支持近似子串查询，无需显式重建上下文。
Conclusion: 分形KV缓存归档是一种高效的无损存储方案，兼具压缩和索引能力，但依赖量化器性能，且目前仅在短上下文GPT-2上验证。

papers.title: Sparse Attention for Dense Open-Vocabulary Prediction in CLIP
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) relies on softmax-based self-attention, a strictly positive distribution that assigns probability mass to every pair of tokens-even semantically irrelevant ones. While these dense softmax weights are effective for gathering broad context during pre-training, they spread attention across many low-salience tokens, producing noise that obscures the fine-grained, spatially localized cues required for dense, open-vocabulary prediction. We study an inference-time substitution of the row-wise softmax in the final visual self-attention layers with the $α$-entmax transform, applied across both the standard query-key attention and self-correlation variants. Because entmax applies a data-dependent threshold that maps low scores exactly to zero, it acts as an implicit denoiser, zeroing contextually irrelevant dependencies while redistributing mass onto the most relevant tokens. We evaluate on open-vocabulary tasks-dense semantic segmentation (Pascal VOC, Pascal Context, ADE20K) and fine-grained retrieval (FG-OVD)-and find the gain from attention sparsification is proportional to how much the baseline attention spreads off the target class.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在CLIP的最后视觉自注意力层中将softmax替换为α-entmax变换，以生成稀疏注意力权重，从而减少噪声，提升开放词汇密集预测（如语义分割和细粒度检索）的性能。实验表明，注意力稀疏化带来的收益与基线注意力在目标类别上的分散程度成正比。
Motivation: CLIP的softmax注意力分配概率给所有token对，包括语义无关的，这在密集预测任务中引入噪声，掩盖了细粒度空间线索。
Method: 在推理时，将CLIP最后视觉自注意力层的逐行softmax替换为α-entmax变换，该变换通过数据依赖的阈值将低分数映射为零，实现隐式去噪，并应用于标准查询-键注意力和自关联变体。
Result: 在开放词汇语义分割（Pascal VOC, Pascal Context, ADE20K）和细粒度检索（FG-OVD）任务上评估，发现注意力稀疏化的增益与基线注意力在目标类别上的分散程度成正比。
Conclusion: 注意力稀疏化可以有效提升CLIP在密集开放词汇预测任务中的性能，且增益与基线注意力的分散度相关。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Distributed Sparse Interventions in Language Models
authors: 4) ((1) Max Planck School of Cognition (2) Center for Lifespan Psychology Max Planck Institute for Human Development (3) Machine Learning Group Technische Universität Berlin (4) Berlin Institute for the Foundations of Learning and Data (BIFOLD))
papers.abstract_en: Language models perform a wide range of tasks at varying levels of abstraction with the capacity to flexibly infer tasks from context, execute multiple tasks simultaneously, and select among competing tasks. To study the role of model components in task behaviour, their causal influence can be investigated through interventions. Prior work on model steering has largely focused on interventions along global directions in activation space, modeling task representations as approximately linear and additive. By studying interventions at the neuron level, we find substantial, neuron-specific nonlinear effects on model outputs that are not captured by current steering approaches. We introduce Distributed Sparse Interventions (DSI), an intervention approach that considers nonlinearities and interactions between neurons across layers to identify sparse sets of neurons that elicit task-relevant computations. Across a range of tasks, we demonstrate that DSI can activate task behaviour in instruction-tuned language models by localising and intervening on as few as 0.01% of neurons, highlighting the effectiveness of sparse, distributed interventions in the neuron basis. Additionally, adopting a set-based perspective enables computations over the identified neuron sets, offering insights into the roles of individual neurons by analysing their effects across tasks. Through sparse interventions, DSI enables fine-grained control over model behaviour, localisation of task-relevant neuron sets, and furthers our understanding of task composition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现现有语言模型干预方法（全局激活空间方向）忽略了神经元级别的非线性效应，提出分布式稀疏干预（DSI），考虑跨层神经元间的非线性交互，识别稀疏神经元集合进行干预。实验表明，DSI仅需干预指令微调模型中0.01%的神经元即可激活目标任务行为，实现细粒度控制。
Motivation: 现有模型干预大多基于激活空间的全局方向，假设任务表征近似线性可加，但神经元层面存在被忽略的非线性效应，限制了干预精度。
Method: 提出分布式稀疏干预（DSI），在神经元层面对干预进行建模，考虑非线性与跨层交互，通过优化寻找稀疏的神经元集合进行因果干预。
Result: 在多个任务上，DSI仅干预0.01%的神经元即可激活指令微调语言模型的任务行为，并支持基于集合的计算分析。
Conclusion: DSI通过稀疏干预实现了对模型行为的细粒度控制，能定位任务相关神经元集合并分析其跨任务角色，加深了对任务组合的理解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Weight-Space Physics: Interpretable Hypernetworks for Lattice Quantum Field Theories
papers.abstract_en: Lattice field theory is the workhorse of non-perturbative physics, used to simulate phenomena from the strong nuclear force to critical phenomena in materials. Its Boltzmann distributions are parametrized analytically by coupling constants, but these bare parameters are weak predictors of observables -- extracting physics typically requires extensive simulation. While normalizing flows have emerged as effective samplers at fixed couplings, it remains difficult to interpret what these networks have learned. This raises a natural question: can the physics be read off directly from the flow network parameters themselves, and can those parameters be generated for unseen theories? We propose lattice field theory as a testbed for neural network interpretability: because the target physics is qualitatively well-understood and smoothly varying, it provides ideal synthetic data with known ground truth. To this end, we introduce JEPAWG, a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture-based Weight Generator that maps couplings directly to flow weights via a learned latent space. On a scalar theory at lattices of size $6^2$ to $11^2$, the JEPAWG latent space recovers the correct intrinsic dimension of the underlying manifold, locates the phase transition, and encodes a finite-size shift aligned with the 2D Ising exponent $ν\approx 1$, allowing us to uncover physical structure by studying the network weights alone. This suggests the fascinating idea of treating the network weights as a new type of physical observable. As a generator, JEPAWG also interpolates and extrapolates to unseen couplings effectively and remains robust to weight-space discontinuities introduced by multi-seed training data, outperforming PCA, AE, and VAE baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JEPAWG，一种基于联合嵌入预测架构 (Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture) 的权重生成器，将格子场论中的耦合常数直接映射为流模型的网络权重，旨在通过权重空间本身揭示物理结构。在标量场论的小格子（6² 到 11²）上，JEPAWG 的潜在空间恢复了底层流形的正确本征维数，定位了相变点，并编码了与二维 Ising 指数 ν≈1 一致的有限尺寸漂移。该方法还能有效插值和外推到未见过的耦合常数，并比 PCA、AE 和 VAE 基线更鲁棒。
Motivation: 格子场论中，标准抽样方法需要大量仿真才能从裸参数中提取可观测量，而归一化流虽能有效抽样，但其网络学到的表示难以解释。作者希望将格子场论作为神经网络可解释性的测试平台，直接由网络权重读出物理规律，并实现跨耦合常数的权重生成。
Method: 提出 JEPAWG（Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture-based Weight Generator），通过一个学习的潜在空间将耦合常数映射为流模型的权重（超网络）。该架构利用联合嵌入预测来捕捉权重与物理参数之间的关系。
Result: 在 6² 到 11² 格子上的标量理论中，JEPAWG 的潜在空间恢复了流形的正确本征维数，检测到相变点，且有限尺度漂移与 2D Ising 指数 ν≈1 一致。作为生成器，它能有效插值和外推到未见耦合常数，并对多种子训练数据引入的权重空间不连续性具有鲁棒性，性能优于 PCA、AE 和 VAE。
Conclusion: 作者提出将网络权重本身视为一种新的物理可观测量，并展示了通过权重空间分析揭示物理结构的可能性。该方法在格子场论中有效，但摘要未提及在更大格子或更复杂理论中的局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Widest-Path Reachability Fields for Connectivity-Preserving Slender Structure Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Segmenting slender curvilinear structures such as retinal vessels, cracks, and roads demands topological correctness, as even a single-pixel discontinuity can fragment a continuous network and invalidate downstream analysis. Under standard binary-mask supervision, models optimized for pixel-level overlap frequently produce topologically broken predictions. We trace this to a fundamental mismatch: pixel-wise losses distribute gradients uniformly, yet connectivity hinges on a sparse set of bottleneck pixels. These pixels are vastly outnumbered by thick structures and background, rendering their aggregate gradient contribution negligible. We term this phenomenon topological gradient starvation (TGS). To address it, we propose Widest-Path Reachability Fields (WPRF), a differentiable Max-Min reachability objective that redirects gradient flow to connectivity bottlenecks. The module is plug-and-play, backbone-agnostic, and incurs no inference overhead. WPRF implements a differentiable Max-Min objective via dynamic programming on a domain-restricted graph, coupled with a bottleneck-aware observation term that balances gradient contributions across varying structures. Compared to prior topology-aware losses that rely on post-hoc skeletonization or homology computation, WPRF directly optimizes end-to-end reachability via differentiable Max-Min algebra, enabling gradient flow to concentrate on connectivity bottlenecks without auxiliary structures. We introduce OMVIS, a new oral microvessel segmentation dataset. Experiments across nine architectures and six datasets validate the bottleneck-focused gradient routing mechanism. WPRF improves 87\% of experiments with fixed hyperparameters and achieves clDice gains of 7.2 percentage points on structurally fragile datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对细长结构分割中的拓扑断裂问题，提出最宽路径可达域 (WPRF)，一种可微的最大-最小可达性目标，将梯度导向连接瓶颈。WPRF 是即插即用的骨干无关模块，无推理开销。在九个架构和六个数据集上，固定超参数下改善 87% 的实验，在结构脆弱数据集上 clDice 提升 7.2 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有分割模型在像素级重叠指标上表现良好，但常产生拓扑断裂的预测，因为连通性依赖于稀疏的瓶颈像素，而逐点损失无法有效聚焦于这些瓶颈，导致拓扑梯度饥饿 (TGS)。
Method: 提出 WPRF，通过域限制图上的动态规划实现可微的最大-最小目标，并引入瓶颈感知的观察项以平衡不同结构上的梯度贡献。直接端到端优化可达性，无需后处理骨架化或同调计算。
Result: 实验在九个架构、六个数据集上验证，固定超参数下 87% 的实验得到改善，在结构脆弱数据集上 clDice 提升 7.2 个百分点。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种即插即用的拓扑纠正模块，可无缝集成到现有分割框架中，且不增加推理成本。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ColorFM: An Optimization-to-Learning Framework for Color Transfer via Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Color transfer aims to align the color distribution of a source image with that of a reference image while preserving structural and semantic consistency. However, existing methods often suffer from inaccurate global mapping, semantic misalignment, and visual artifacts. To address these issues, we propose ColorFM, an optimization-to-learning framework. ColorFM connects online optimization to offline inference by reformulating color transfer as the transport of pixel distributions along velocity fields via Flow Matching. Specifically, we introduce ColorFM-O, an instance-specific optimization scheme that fits the velocity field through hierarchical color coupling guided by semantic priors. By numerically integrating the induced flow trajectories, ColorFM-O produces precise and semantically consistent color transfer results, while generating high-quality paired data as pseudo-supervision. Building upon this, we design ColorFM-L, an efficient feed-forward model trained on the generated pairs. Through implicit state modeling, ColorFM-L extracts deep semantic features to predict flow parameters for bidirectional linearized transport, ensuring accurate color transfer. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ColorFM-L outperforms state-of-the-art methods in visual quality, structural fidelity, and semantic consistency, successfully combining the accuracy of optimization with the speed of feed-forward inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ColorFM，一个将在线优化与离线推理相结合的框架，用于颜色迁移。通过流匹配（Flow Matching）将颜色迁移重新表述为沿速度场的像素分布传输。包括实例特定优化方案ColorFM-O和高效前馈模型ColorFM-L。实验证明ColorFM-L在视觉质量、结构保真度和语义一致性上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有颜色迁移方法常存在全局映射不准确、语义错位和视觉伪影等问题。
Method: 提出ColorFM框架，包含ColorFM-O（实例特定优化，通过语义先验指导的分层颜色耦合拟合速度场）和ColorFM-L（在前者生成的伪监督数据上训练的前馈模型，通过隐式状态建模预测流参数实现双向线性化传输）。
Result: 摘要声称ColorFM-L在视觉质量、结构保真度和语义一致性上优于最先进方法，成功结合了优化的准确性和前馈推理的速度。
Conclusion: 所提框架通过将优化转化为学习，实现了颜色迁移的准确与高效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tree-of-Thoughts Reasoning for Text-to-Image In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: In text-to-image in-context learning (T2I-ICL), a model has to infer a latent compositional pattern from fewshot demonstrations for generating a query image. Recent studies show that state-of-the-art multimodal large language models struggle with this setting, particularly due to limited compositional reasoning and sensitivity to prompt construction. In this work, we propose a Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT) reasoning framework for T2I-ICL that introduces a multi-stage reasoning and selection layer that generates, evaluates, and selects among multiple candidate hypotheses before constructing the final prompt for image synthesis. By exploring alternative reasoning branches and selecting a coherent interpretation, the proposed approach mitigates prompt ambiguity and compositional errors. We implement the proposed approach in a complete ToT-T2IICL inference pipeline and evaluate it on the CoBSAT benchmark. Both qualitative and quantitative results show that structured multi-branch reasoning leads to more consistent and semantically aligned image generation compared to baseline and Chain-of-Thought prompting strategies, without any additional training or fine-tuning.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at IEEE SMC 2026. Code available at https://github.com/Pandastep/ToT-T2I-ICL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于思维树（Tree-of-Thoughts, ToT）的推理框架，用于文本到图像的上下文学习（T2I-ICL），通过多阶段推理和选择层生成、评估和选择多个候选假设，从而缓解提示歧义和组合错误。在CoBSAT基准上的定性和定量结果表明，无需额外训练或微调，该方法比基线和思维链提示策略能产生更一致且语义对齐的图像生成。
Motivation: 现有最先进的多模态大语言模型在T2I-ICL任务中表现不佳，主要受限于组合推理能力不足和对提示构建敏感。
Method: 提出ToT推理框架，包含多阶段推理和选择层：先生成多个候选推理分支，再评估并选择最一致的解释，最后构建提示用于图像合成。
Result: 在CoBSAT基准上，无需任何额外训练或微调，该方法在生成一致性和语义对齐方面优于基线和Chain-of-Thought提示策略。
Conclusion: 结构化多分支推理能够有效提升T2I-ICL的图像生成质量，且不依赖于训练或微调。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A knowledge-augmented dataset of high-risk driving scenarios with LLM annotations for autonomous driving
papers.abstract_en: Safe autonomous driving requires both rapid responses to common high-risk events and deeper reasoning over rare, extreme long-tail scenarios in traffic safety. These scenarios are severely under-represented in naturalistic driving data, and existing trajectory and language-augmented datasets seldom provide high-risk event labels, semantic annotations, and verifiable safety signals. Here we present K-Risk, a knowledge-augmented dataset that combines structured driving trajectories with large language model generated semantic annotations for safety-critical driving scenarios. K-Risk integrates 20 human-driven and autonomous-vehicle trajectory datasets from Europe, China, and the United States, covering highways, urban freeways, intersections, and roundabouts. Using a unified risk-centric extraction pipeline, K-Risk curates 31,398 high-risk events, together with a 1,036-event extreme subset of near-collision cases. Each event is released as a synchronized trajectory, metadata, and language triplet containing structured scenario descriptions, abnormal-behavior notifications, and, for a representative subset, causal risk analyses and action recommendations validated through a closed-loop simulator with iterative reflection. By combining multi-dimensional risk annotations, interpretable language supervision, and verifiable decisions, K-Risk bridges structured traffic trajectories, semantic reasoning, and decision supervision, providing a standardized foundation for developing and evaluating next-generation risk-aware autonomous driving agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个知识增强的数据集 K-Risk，用于自动驾驶高风险场景。该数据集整合了来自欧洲、中国和美国的 20 个人工驾驶和自动驾驶轨迹数据集，通过统一的风险提取流程，筛选出 31,398 个高风险事件（包括 1,036 个近碰撞事件）。每个事件包含同步的轨迹、元数据和由大语言模型生成的语义标注（如场景描述、异常行为通知、因果风险分析和行动建议），并通过闭环模拟器进行验证。K-Risk 旨在连接结构化交通轨迹、语义推理和决策监督，为开发风险感知的自动驾驶代理提供标准化基础。
Motivation: 自然驾驶数据中高风险和极端长尾场景严重不足，现有轨迹和语言增强数据集缺乏高风险事件标签、语义标注和可验证的安全信号。
Method: 通过统一的风险提取管道从现有轨迹数据集中提取高风险事件，并使用大语言模型生成语义注释（场景描述、异常行为通知、因果风险分析和行动建议），部分注释通过闭环模拟器迭代反射验证。
Result: K-Risk 包含 31,398 个高风险事件和 1,036 个近碰撞极端事件，每个事件以轨迹、元数据和语言三元组形式发布。
Conclusion: K-Risk 提供了多维度风险注释、可解释的语言监督和可验证的决策，为开发下一代风险感知自动驾驶代理奠定了基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GeoProp: Grounding Robot State in Vision for Generalist Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Proprioception is fundamental to robotic manipulation, yet standard fusion methods often treat it as an isolated vector lacking explicit alignment with visual tokens. Without a direct correspondence between 3D kinematics and 2D feature maps, manipulation policies struggle to ground the robot's state within the scene, frequently underperforming even vision-only baselines. To address this, we introduce GeoProp, a lightweight, plug-and-play adapter that aligns proprioception with vision through explicit geometric grounding and spatial feature sampling. GeoProp projects the robot state onto the image plane to sample localized visual features, constructing a grounded state token. It then injects state-derived spatial priors into the corresponding visual features via FiLM modulation. To capture motion intent, GeoProp further samples features at a short-horizon predicted coordinate derived from recent kinematics, providing look-ahead visual context. Across 67 tasks, GeoProp improves Diffusion Policy by 8.7% on 63 simulation tasks and pi_0 by 4.0% on the RoboTwin subset, and yields a 10.6% average gain across both policy families in the real world, while adding only 2-3% to the parameter count. These results demonstrate that GeoProp is a simple yet high-impact inductive bias for generalist embodied policies. Project page: https://alibaba-damo-academy.github.io/GeoProp/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GeoProp，一种即插即用的轻量级适配器，通过将机器人状态投影到图像平面并采样局部视觉特征，从而将本体感觉与视觉对齐，构建接地状态标记（grounded state token）。摘要报告在63个模拟任务上扩散策略平均提升8.7%，在RoboTwin子集上pi_0提升4.0%，真实世界平均提升10.6%，仅增加2-3%参数。
Motivation: 标准融合方法通常将本体感觉视为孤立向量，缺乏与视觉标记的显式对齐，导致操作策略难以将机器人状态接地（ground）到场景中，甚至常常不如仅视觉的基线。
Method: 提出GeoProp适配器：将机器人状态投影到图像平面以采样局部视觉特征，构建接地状态标记；通过FiLM调制将状态驱动的空间先验注入对应的视觉特征；进一步在由近期运动学预测的短时域坐标处采样特征，提供前瞻视觉上下文。
Result: 在总共67个任务中，GeoProp在63个模拟任务上使扩散策略提升8.7%，在RoboTwin子集上使pi_0提升4.0%，真实世界平均提升10.6%，仅增加2-3%参数。
Conclusion: 该方法是一种简单但高影响力的归纳偏好（inductive bias），可用于通用具身策略。

papers.title: Video-Based Detection of squint and cataract for accessibility-aware adaptive web interface rendering
papers.abstract_en: Squint and cataract are major ocular disorders that majorly affect visual perception and interaction capability. This paper proposes a real-time video-based automated detection system for squint and cataract detection based on computer vision and image processing methods. The proposed system uses a media-pipe face-mesh (a 478-point facial landmark detection model) to extract geometric ocular features for multi-class squint classification. Simultaneously, The presence and severity cataract is estimated through grayscale intensity and histogram-based lens opacity analysis. The system records short video sequences with standard laptop or mobile cameras, which can be deployed at low costs and on a large scale. The experimental performance has shown great accuracy in the detection of squint (98.39%) and classification of cataract (96.90%). Besides automatic ocular analysis, the proposed framework is also made accessible for visual impairment inference which will be integrated with future adaptive user interface and Web accessibility systems for people with visual impairment.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于视频的实时自动检测系统，用于检测斜视和白内障。系统使用media-pipe face-mesh提取几何眼部特征进行多类斜视分类，同时通过灰度强度和直方图分析评估白内障严重程度。实验显示斜视检测准确率98.39%，白内障分类准确率96.90%。该框架可集成到未来的自适应用户界面和网页可访问性系统中。
Motivation: 斜视和白内障严重影响视觉感知和交互能力，现有检测方法成本高或不可大规模部署，需要一种低成本、大范围的实时自动检测方法。
Method: 系统采用media-pipe face-mesh（478点面部标志检测模型）提取几何眼部特征用于斜视分类，并通过灰度强度和直方图分析评估白内障的浑浊度。
Result: 斜视检测准确率98.39%，白内障分类准确率96.90%。
Conclusion: 该系统可低成本部署，未来可集成到自适应用户界面和网页可访问性系统中，帮助视觉障碍者。

papers.title: Operational Reframing and Approval-Framed Delegation in Multi-Agent LLM Safety
papers.abstract_en: Safety evaluations of multi-agent LLM systems often compare a direct prompt with a planner-executor pipeline and report the difference as a single "pipeline effect." We argue that this aggregate is difficult to interpret because it conflates three mechanisms: harmful intent may be reframed as plausible operational work, the planner may refuse or transform the request, and the executor may act under delegation prompts implying prior approval. To separate these factors, we introduce a five-condition controlled contrast design, evaluated on 30 synthetic harmful scenarios and an exploratory external validation set from four agent-safety benchmarks using LLM-judged compliance. Our results show that aggregate pipeline safety is not a stable architectural property. Operational reframing is the most portable risk signal, increasing compliance for GPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek across both scenario sets, while Claude is comparatively resistant. Planner behavior can offset this risk mainly through refusal; however, when the planner produces executable steps, the executor may become more compliant than under the direct operational baseline. Approval-framed delegation is sensitive to prompt design, model pairing, and scenario source, and a skeptical executor prompt sharply reduces compliance. Raw-direct model rankings can also mispredict deployed planner-executor behavior. Gemini is safest under raw direct prompts in the primary set yet shows the largest amplification with a Claude planner, rising from 8.9 percent to 38.9 percent compliance. GPTs near-zero aggregate pipeline effect instead hides a reframing increase canceled by planner refusal. These findings suggest that multi-agent safety evaluations should report reframing, planner behavior, delegation framing, and model pairing separately before attributing failures to architecture itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑多智能体LLM安全评估中常用的“直接提示 vs. 规划-执行管道”对比方法，认为单一的“管道效应”难以解释，因为它混淆了操作重构、规划者行为和委托框架三种机制。作者引入五条件对照设计，在30个合成有害场景和四个代理安全基准上评估，发现聚合管道安全性不是稳定的架构属性：操作重构是最具迁移性的风险信号，能增加GPT、Gemini和DeepSeek的合规性，而Claude相对抵抗。规划者主要通过拒绝来抵消风险，但若产生可执行步骤，执行者可能比直接操作基线更合规。批准框架委托对提示设计、模型配对和场景来源敏感，怀疑性执行者提示可大幅降低合规性。原始直接模型排名可能误导实际部署的规划-执行行为。
Motivation: 现有多智能体LLM安全评估将直接提示与规划-执行管道的合规率差异报告为单一“管道效应”，但这一聚合指标难以解释，因为它混淆了三种不同机制（操作重构、规划者拒绝/转换、委托框架下的执行者行为）。
Method: 提出一种五条件受控对照实验设计，在30个合成有害场景和四个代理安全基准的探索性外部验证集上，使用LLM评判合规性，分别隔离操作重构、规划者行为和委托框架三种因素。
Result: 操作重构是最具迁移性的风险信号，使GPT、Gemini和DeepSeek的合规性增加（Claude相对抵抗）；规划者行为主要通过拒绝抵消风险，但若产生可执行步骤则可能增加执行者合规性；批准框架委托高度依赖提示设计、模型配对和场景来源，怀疑性执行者提示大幅降低合规性。Gemini在原始直接提示下最安全（8.9%合规），但搭配Claude规划者后合规率升至38.9%；GPT的零管道效应源于操作重构增加被规划者拒绝所抵消。
Conclusion: 多智能体安全评估应在归因于架构之前，分别报告操作重构、规划者行为、委托框架和模型配对的影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AT-Attn: Temporal-Aware Cross-Attention for Longitudinal Multimodal Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: In longitudinal Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis support, clinical and imaging information is often collected at irregular visits. Integrating these multimodal observations may improve diagnostic assessment, but naive fusion can degrade performance when MRI is noisy or intermittently unavailable. We propose AT-Attn, a temporal-aware multimodal framework that combines Change-and-Time encoding, time-biased asymmetric cross-attention, and gated fusion to integrate MRI with longitudinal clinical information. We evaluate AT-Attn on an MRI-retained ADNI cohort of 1,520 patients using structural MRI, six cognitive-scale trajectories, and seven static clinical variables under patient-level five-fold cross-validation. The main asymmetric AT-Attn model achieves accuracy 0.719+/-0.024, macro F1 0.721+/-0.023, ROC-AUC 0.873+/-0.013, and PR-AUC 0.783+/-0.018, outperforming unimodal and naive multimodal fusion baselines while remaining competitive with strong tabular baselines. These results suggest that a temporal-aware and constrained fusion strategy can help structural MRI contribute clinically relevant complementary information for patient-level AD diagnosis support.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE BIBM 2026. 8 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AT-Attn，一种时间感知的多模态框架，用于纵向阿尔茨海默病诊断。框架包括变化-时间编码、时间偏置非对称交叉注意力和门控融合，整合结构MRI与纵向临床信息。在ADNI队列1520名患者上的五折交叉验证显示，主模型准确率0.719±0.024，ROC-AUC 0.873±0.013，优于单模态和朴素多模态融合基线。
Motivation: 纵向AD诊断中，临床和影像信息常在不规则访视下收集，朴素多模态融合在MRI有噪声或间歇缺失时性能下降，需要时间感知的融合策略。
Method: 提出AT-Attn框架，包含Change-and-Time编码（捕捉变化和时间间隔）、时间偏置非对称交叉注意力（让MRI关注临床信息的时间模式）、以及门控融合（动态加权多模态特征）。
Result: 在ADNI数据集上，AT-Attn主模型达到准确率0.719±0.024、宏F1 0.721±0.023、ROC-AUC 0.873±0.013、PR-AUC 0.783±0.018，超越单模态和朴素融合基线，与强表格基线竞争。
Conclusion: 时间感知和受限的融合策略能使结构MRI为患者级AD诊断提供临床相关的互补信息，验证了跨模态时间对齐的重要性。
