papers.title: Structural Adversarial Attacks on Relational Deep Learning under Integrity Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Relational Deep Learning (RDL) has become a standard methodology for machine learning on relational databases: the database is encoded as a heterogeneous temporal graph in which tuples become nodes and primary-key to foreign-key (PK-FK) dependencies become typed edges, over which a graph neural network is trained for downstream prediction. We study the adversarial robustness of this pipeline. We consider a white-box attacker who knows how the graph is built and the model is trained, reasons about perturbations on the graph, but can only act on the upstream database, by rewiring foreign-key references while preserving the integrity constraints of the schema (foreign-key validity, the degree-one FK constraint, and functional dependencies). This restricts the attacker to a constrained, combinatorial set of admissible edits under a global perturbation budget, which is intractable to explore exhaustively and made non-additive by GNN message passing. We investigate seven attack heuristics - two random sampling baselines and five gradient-guided variants that exploit differentiable edge masks - and evaluate them on the RelBench rel-f1 benchmark. Gradient-based attacks consistently outperform random baselines on regression tasks, whereas gains on classification are smaller, which we attribute to low label-flip rates and greater local stability of classification outputs.
papers.comment: To be presented at the VLDB Workshop AI for Databases
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究关系深度学习（RDL）的对抗鲁棒性，考虑白盒攻击者通过重写外键引用来扰动上游数据库，同时保持模式完整性约束。在RelBench rel-f1基准上评估了七种攻击启发式方法，发现基于梯度的攻击在回归任务上优于随机基线，但在分类任务上收益较小。
Motivation: 关系深度学习在关系数据库上广泛使用，但其对抗鲁棒性尚未充分研究。现有攻击方法未考虑数据库完整性约束对攻击的限制。
Method: 提出一个白盒攻击框架，攻击者通过重写外键引用来扰动数据库图结构，同时保持外键有效性、一度外键约束和函数依赖。设计了七种攻击启发式：两种随机基线和五种基于可微分边掩码的梯度引导变体。
Result: 在RelBench rel-f1基准上的实验表明，基于梯度的攻击在回归任务上持续优于随机基线，而在分类任务上改进较小，归因于低标签翻转率和分类输出的局部稳定性。
Conclusion: 论文强调了在关系深度学习攻击中考虑完整性约束的重要性，并指出梯度引导方法在回归攻击中的有效性，但分类攻击仍有挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Is Randomness Necessary for Adaptive Data Analysis?
papers.abstract_en: The Adaptive Data Analysis (ADA) problem formalizes the challenge of preventing false discovery and overfitting when a dataset is repeatedly reused. Formally, our input is a dataset containing $n$ i.i.d. samples from an unknown distribution $\mathcal{P}$ over a domain $\mathcal{X}$, and our goal is to answer a sequence of $k$ adaptively chosen statistical queries with respect to $\mathcal{P}$. The main question is how many queries we can support (i.e., how large $k$ can be), primarily as a function of the number of samples $n$. This question has been intensively studied and is relatively well-understood for randomized mechanisms: there are computationally efficient mechanisms that support $k \approx n^2$ queries, and no computationally efficient mechanism can answer $k \gg n^2$ queries. In this paper, we address a fundamental question: is randomness necessary for ADA? Despite a decade of work on ADA, this question remains open. A folklore observation dating back to the initial works on ADA is that randomness is not necessary when the analyst is computationally bounded. Yet, the necessity of randomness against computationally unbounded analysts has remained elusive. Our main contribution resolves this gap in the information-theoretic Random Oracle model. Perhaps surprisingly, we show that randomness is strictly necessary to answer a non-trivial number of adaptive queries: when the analyst is unbounded, any deterministic mechanism can be forced to fail after just $k = \tilde{O} (n)$ queries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自适应数据分析（ADA）中随机性的必要性。在信息论随机预言机模型下，证明对于计算无界分析者，任何确定性机制在回答约O(n)个自适应查询后必然失败，而随机机制可支持约n^2个查询，表明随机性在ADA中严格必要。
Motivation: 自适应数据分析中防止虚假发现和过拟合至关重要，但随机性是否必要一直未解。此前仅知对计算有界分析者随机性非必要，对无界分析者的情形尚不明确。
Method: 在信息论随机预言机模型下，通过构造对抗性分析者，证明确定性机制回答超过约O(n)个自适应查询时必然出错。
Result: 确定性机制最多支持k = O(n)个查询，而随机机制可支持k ≈ n^2个查询，表明随机性严格提供更强能力。
Conclusion: 随机性在自适应数据分析中对无界分析者也是必要的，填补了该领域的理论空白。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prior-aware and Context-guided Group Sampling for Active Probabilistic Subsampling
papers.abstract_en: Subsampling significantly reduces the number of measurements, thereby streamlining data processing and transfer overhead, and shortening acquisition time across diverse real-world applications. The recently introduced Active Deep Probabilistic Subsampling (A-DPS) approach jointly optimizes both the subsampling pattern and the downstream task model, enabling instance- and subject-specific sampling trajectories and effective adaptation to new data at inference time. However, this approach does not fully leverage valuable dataset priors and relies on top-1 sampling, which can impede the optimization process. Herein, we enhance A-DPS by integrating a deterministic (fixed) prior-informed sampling pattern derived from the training dataset, along with group-based sampling via top-k sampling, to achieve more robust optimization, method we call Prior-aware and context-guided Group-based Active DPS (PGA-DPS). We also provide a theoretical analysis supporting improved optimization via group sampling, and validate this with empirical results. We evaluated PGA-DPS on three tasks: classification, image reconstruction, and segmentation, using the MNIST, CIFAR-10, fastMRI knee, and hyperspectral AeroRIT datasets, respectively. In every case, PGA-DPS outperformed A-DPS, DPS, and all other sampling methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种先验感知和上下文引导的组采样方法（PGA-DPS），用于改进主动深度概率子采样（A-DPS）。通过集成基于训练数据集的确定性子采样模式和基于top-k的组采样，增强了优化鲁棒性，并在分类、图像重建和分割任务上取得了优于A-DPS和其他方法的结果。
Motivation: A-DPS没有充分利用数据集先验，且依赖top-1采样，可能阻碍优化过程。
Method: PGA-DPS结合了从训练数据集导出的确定性先验信息采样模式，以及通过top-k采样实现的组采样，并提供了理论分析支持组采样改进优化。
Result: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10、fastMRI knee和AeroRIT数据集上的分类、图像重建和分割任务中，PGA-DPS均优于A-DPS、DPS及其他采样方法。
Conclusion: PGA-DPS通过先验信息和组采样有效提升了A-DPS的优化性能，在多个领域得到验证。

papers.title: Navigating Hierarchy: Hyperbolic Learning on Brain Graphs for Disorder Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Functional brain networks exhibit a hierarchical organization across ROI, community, and whole-brain levels, supporting local processing, inter-community coordination, and global integration. Recent studies have demonstrated that brain community-aware modeling is beneficial for both diagnosis and biomarker identification of brain networks. However, existing brain graph modeling methods often struggle to model ROI-community interactions, thereby failing to fully exploit the hierarchy across ROI, community, and whole-brain network levels. To address this issue, inspired by deep hyperbolic learning in modeling hierarchical structures, we propose a novel framework, termed Hyperbolic Learning on Brain Graphs (HLBG), for brain network analysis. The core idea of HLBG is to exploit the inherent hierarchical geometry of hyperbolic space to model the hierarchical relationships among ROIs, functional communities, and the whole-brain network, thereby learning hierarchy-aware and highly discriminative representations for brain network data. Specifically, HLBG first projects representations from ROIs, communities, and the whole-brain network into Lorentzian hyperbolic space. Then, the multi-level hierarchy is imposed via two geometric entailment constraints. In addition, we introduce a new Graph-aware Mamba (GaMamba) model, which incorporates topology-derived structural prompts into Mamba to capture long-range dependencies while preserving graph topological information. Experiments on ABIDE-I and REST-MDD demonstrate that HLBG outperforms state-of-the-art methods and identifies disorder-relevant functional biomarkers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于双曲学习的脑图分析框架HLBG，用于利用功能性脑网络的层次结构（ROI、社区、全脑）进行疾病诊断。HLBG将ROI、社区和全脑表征投影到Lorentzian双曲空间，并通过几何包含约束施加多级层次信息，同时引入图感知Mamba（GaMamba）模型以保留图拓扑并捕获长程依赖。在ABIDE-I和REST-MDD数据集上，HLBG超越了现有方法，并识别出与疾病相关的功能生物标志物。
Motivation: 现有脑图建模方法难以建模ROI-社区交互，未能充分利用ROI、社区和全脑网络级别的层次结构。
Method: HLBG框架：首先将ROI、社区和全脑网络表征投影到Lorentzian双曲空间；然后通过两种几何包含约束强制多级层次；最后引入图感知Mamba（GaMamba）模型，将拓扑结构提示融入Mamba以捕获长程依赖并保留图拓扑信息。
Result: 在ABIDE-I和REST-MDD数据集上，HLBG优于现有方法，并识别出与疾病相关的功能生物标志物。
Conclusion: HLBG利用双曲空间的内在层次几何有效建模脑网络的层次关系，学习层次感知的高判别性表征，为脑网络分析提供新思路。

papers.title: An Hybrid Quantum-Classical Diffusion Model for Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Quantum diffusion models provide a physics-consistent route to generative learning by formulating noising and denoising directly on quantum states. However, applying such models to classical high-dimensional data is constrained by the qubit cost of state encoding and the computational burden of simulating large density operators. We propose a scalable hybrid generative pipeline that combines a classical autoencoder for dimensionality reduction with a mixed-state quantum denoising diffusion probabilistic model (MSQuDDPM) operating in the learned latent space. The autoencoder compresses data into compact latent codes that can be embedded into a small-qubit Hilbert space, after which the quantum diffusion model learns a generative distribution over latent density operators and decodes samples back to the original domain. Algorithmically, we simplify the reverse dynamics by predicting an estimate of the clean state $ρ_0$ at timestep $t$ and computing the one-step reverse update via an analytic backward propagation rule, rather than learning an explicit predictor for $ρ_{t-1}$. We demonstrate the proposed approach on MNIST image generation and discuss how mixed-state quantum diffusion can serve as a practical backbone for hybrid quantum--classical generative modeling under realistic qubit budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种混合量子-经典扩散模型，结合经典自编码器降维与混合态量子去噪扩散概率模型（MSQuDDPM），在潜在空间中进行生成，并在MNIST图像生成上验证可行性。
Motivation: 量子扩散模型直接在高维数据上应用受限于量子比特成本和密度算子模拟负担，需要可扩展的混合方案。
Method: 使用经典自编码器将数据压缩为低维潜在编码，嵌入小量子比特希尔伯特空间，再用MSQuDDPM学习潜在密度算子上的生成分布，并通过预测干净状态和解析反向传播简化逆向动力学。
Result: 在MNIST图像生成上展示了方法有效性。
Conclusion: 混合态量子扩散可在实际量子比特预算下作为混合量子-经典生成建模的实用主干。

papers.title: Multiplication Beyond Groups: Stratified Fourier Mechanisms in Transformer Circuits
papers.abstract_en: Transformers have demonstrated a remarkable ability to learn algorithmic reasoning, yet mechanistic analyses have mostly focused on globally invertible operations such as cyclic addition and group composition. In this work, we investigate how small transformers learn modular integer multiplication over composite moduli, a fundamentally non-invertible operation due to the presence of zero-divisors. We propose the monoid extension: a localized generalization of Group Composition via Representation (GCR) that suggests the learned computation does not rely on a single global representation space. Instead, the model partitions the input space into local hierarchical algebraic regions, where group-like structure survives and Fourier mechanisms can be applied. In transformers trained on square-free modular multiplication, we find that embeddings organize around these regions, attention exhibits class-sensitive routing and low-rank write directions, and local character features explain a large fraction of the model's output logits. Our results suggest that representation-theoretic mechanisms previously identified for group operations can extend beyond groups to more general structures.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 15 figures. Spotlight at the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026. First three authors contributed equally. Code at https://github.com/uw-math-ai/interpreting-monoids
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究小型Transformer如何学习复合模数下的模乘运算（一种非可逆运算）。作者提出幺半群扩展（monoid extension）概念，将群表示理论推广到非群结构，发现模型将输入空间划分为局部层次代数区域，在这些区域内类群结构得以保留，注意力机制表现出类敏感路由和低秩写入，局部特征解释大部分输出logits。这表明表示论机制可超越群结构适用于更一般的代数结构。
Motivation: 现有机制可解释性研究主要关注全局可逆运算（如循环加法、群运算），但对非可逆运算（如含零因子的模乘）的理解不足。
Method: 提出幺半群扩展（monoid extension），将群表示理论（Group Composition via Representation, GCR）推广到更一般的幺半群结构；分析训练于平方自由模乘的小型Transformer的嵌入组织、注意力路由和输出logits。
Result: 嵌入围绕局部层次代数区域组织，注意力表现出类敏感路由和低秩写入方向，局部特征可解释模型输出logits的很大一部分。
Conclusion: 表示论机制可以超越群结构扩展到更一般的代数结构（如幺半群），为理解Transformer在非可逆运算上的算法提供了新视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Complexity-Budgeted, Interaction-Aware Interpretable Model for Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Inherently interpretable classifiers for tabular data typically rely on sparse features, rules, or patterns that users can inspect directly. The marginal feature-screening step common to these methods can discard variables whose predictive value emerges only through joint configurations with other variables. We present Interaction Aware Interpretable Machine Learning (IAIML), a framework that addresses this limitation through three coordinated mechanisms: adaptive per-feature discretization, finite-grid pairwise interaction scoring, and a partitioned explanation budget. Detected interactions are routed through one of two strategies: relaxing the screening filter so that interaction-supported variables enter the pattern search, or constructing explicit pair terms for a sparse downstream classifier. On a 40-dataset panel comprising 24 real-world tabular benchmarks and 16 synthetic interaction stress tests, evaluated under nested cross-validation, IAIML achieves mean AUC within 1.4 points of tuned gradient-boosted ensembles while requiring roughly 14--28 times fewer fitted explanation components. On datasets with strong pairwise interaction structure and low marginal signal, IAIML outperforms all baselines. Among compact interpretable methods, IAIML is comparable to RuleFit in AUC and component count and is less expensive to tune. EBM obtains a small but significant AUC advantage across the full panel, with a substantially larger lookup-table footprint. Performance degrades on datasets requiring higher-order interactions beyond the pairwise scope. Component-isolated ablations confirm that adaptive discretization and interaction-aware admission each contribute incrementally. These results support IAIML as a compact, interaction-aware framework appropriate for settings where bounded explanation size and controlled treatment of feature interactions are design requirements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Interaction Aware Interpretable Machine Learning (IAIML)框架，用于表格数据的内在可解释分类。该框架通过自适应逐特征离散化、有限网格成对交互评分和分区解释预算三个机制，解决传统可解释方法因特征筛选而丢失交互信息的问题。在40个数据集上的实验表明，IAIML的平均AUC与调优后的梯度提升集成方法相差1.4点以内，但所需解释组件数量少14-28倍，且在强成对交互数据集上优于所有基线。
Motivation: 传统可解释分类器在特征筛选步骤中可能丢弃那些仅通过联合配置才能体现预测价值的变量，导致交互信息丢失。
Method: IAIML通过三个协调机制实现：自适应逐特征离散化、有限网格成对交互评分、以及分区解释预算。检测到的交互通过两种策略处理：放宽筛选阈值使交互支持的变量进入模式搜索，或为稀疏下游分类器构建显式成对项。
Result: 在24个真实世界基准和16个合成交互压力测试（共40个数据集）上，IAIML的平均AUC与调优梯度提升集成方法相差1.4点以内，组件数量减少14-28倍。在强成对交互且边际信号低的数据集上，IAIML优于所有基线；与RuleFit相比AUC和组件数相当，且调参成本更低。EBM在全面板上取得微小但显著的AUC优势，但查找表占用更大。性能在需要高阶交互时下降。
Conclusion: IAIML是一个紧凑、交互感知的框架，适用于对解释规模有界且需要受控处理特征交互的设计场景。其性能在成对交互范围内有效，但无法处理更高阶交互。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Progressive Crystallization: Turning Agent Exploration into Deterministic, Lower-Cost Workflows in Production
papers.abstract_en: AI agents deployed for IT operations are typically permanent cost centers because every execution requires full LLM inference, even for previously solved problems. This paper introduces progressive crystallization, a lifecycle that treats agent exploration as a discovery mechanism rather than a permanent execution model. It defines a three-stage execution taxonomy, from fully agent-orchestrated to hybrid to fully deterministic workflows, together with an evidence-based promotion mechanism that converts repeatedly validated agent behaviors into cheaper and more reproducible deterministic workflows, while automatically demoting workflows that regress. Evaluated on a production cloud networking AIOps system processing tens of thousands of incidents per month, the approach increased deterministic execution from 0% to 45% over eight months, reduced per-incident agent costs by more than 70% despite doubling incident volume, and improved safety through greater reproducibility and auditability. The paper also presents the execution taxonomy, promotion and demotion criteria, trace extraction methodology, economic model, safety considerations, and discusses limitations and threats to validity.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为“渐进结晶化”(progressive crystallization)的生命周期方法，将AI agent在IT运维中的探索行为逐步转化为确定性、低成本的工作流。该方法定义了三阶段执行分类法（完全agent编排、混合、完全确定性），并基于证据的晋升/降级机制动态转换工作流。在云网络AIOps生产系统上，八个月内确定性执行从0%提升至45%，单次agent成本降低超过70%，同时提高了可重复性和可审计性。
Motivation: 当前AI agent在IT运维中每次执行都需要完整的大模型推理，导致成本居高不下，即使对于已解决的问题也是如此。缺乏将已验证行为固化为低成本确定性流程的机制。
Method: 提出三阶段执行分类法（agent编排、混合、确定性）与基于证据的晋升/降级机制。通过追踪提取、经济模型和安全考量，将重复验证的agent行为自动转换为更廉价、可复现的确定性工作流。
Result: 在生产力云网络AIOps系统中，八个月内确定性执行从0%增长到45%，处理事件量翻倍，但每事件agent成本降低超过70%，且安全性和可追溯性提升。
Conclusion: 论文表明，通过渐进结晶化方法可以显著降低AI agent在运维中的持续成本，并提高可靠性。但指出存在局限性，例如对动态环境的适应性及降级机制的有效性需进一步验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Making Implicit Preservation Intent Explicit in Conversational Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Conversational image editing requires preserving not only visible content, but also content that temporarily disappears across turns. When newly added or modified content occludes a previously visible region, that region should reappear if it was never semantically changed. However, existing systems often fail to recover such occluded-but-unchanged content, producing inconsistent or hallucinated results. We introduce OCCUR-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for temporal preservation in conversational image editing. OCCUR-Bench provides diverse occlusion-and-revelation scenarios with historical restoration references, enabling evaluation of faithful restoration rather than plausible regeneration. We also propose ReSpec, a training-free framework that makes implicit preservation explicit by pairing restoration-aware instructions with historical visual references. Given an editing history, ReSpec identifies what should persist, selects the historical image state that provides missing visual evidence, and conditions an in-context editor on the resulting instruction and reference image. Experiments show that ReSpec improves restoration fidelity and temporal consistency on OCCUR-Bench, highlighting the need to ground preservation in editing history rather than only the current image.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对对话式图像编辑中由于新增或修改内容遮挡先前可见区域，导致被遮挡但未语义更改的内容无法正确恢复的问题，提出了OCCUR-Bench基准和ReSpec框架。OCCUR-Bench提供遮挡与揭示场景的历史恢复参考，评估忠实恢复而非合理重建；ReSpec通过结合恢复感知指令和历史视觉参考，使得隐式保存意图显式化，无需训练。实验表明ReSpec在OCCUR-Bench上提高了恢复保真度和时间一致性。
Motivation: 现有对话式图像编辑系统在新增内容遮挡先前区域后，不能正确恢复未被语义更改的遮挡内容，产生不一致或幻觉结果。
Method: 提出OCCUR-Bench诊断基准和ReSpec训练无关框架。ReSpec通过识别应持久化的内容，选择提供缺失视觉证据的历史图像状态，并将恢复感知指令与历史视觉参考结合，输入给上下文编辑器。
Result: 在OCCUR-Bench上，ReSpec提升了恢复保真度和时间一致性。
Conclusion: 强调在对话式图像编辑中，应基于编辑历史而非仅当前图像来指导内容保存。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Behavior Leverage Imbalance in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Agentic language models must learn when to call tools, when to consume tool responses, and when to answer directly. This makes multi-teacher on-policy distillation a natural training strategy: one teacher can specialize in tool calls, another in direct responses, and the student can learn from both on its own generated distribution. We show that this strategy can induce a behavior shift that is invisible from aggregate losses alone. In a two-teacher tool-use setting, vanilla generalized knowledge distillation improves tool-call recall but also moves the model toward over-calling, where it calls tools on examples that should be answered directly. Aggregate explanations are insufficient: tool-call samples do not receive more token exposure, and full-sequence per-token divergence is not larger for the tool-call teacher. We instead analyze behavior leverage imbalance: local token-level signals at mode- entry and structural positions, such as <tool_call> and function names, can have disproportionate control over the global generation mode. We propose Soft Clamp, a per-token divergence calibration method that dynamically compresses extreme token-level Jensen-Shannon divergence while preserving nonzero gradients. On APIGen-MT, Soft Clamp reduces over-calling from 13.7% to 9.0% relative to vanilla GKD while matching its decision accuracy. In a BFCL multi-turn diagnostic, it also lowers tool-call loops and repeated calls among GKD variants. These results suggest that multi-teacher OPD should monitor where teacher signals act, not only how large they are in aggregate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多教师在线蒸馏（multi-teacher on-policy distillation）在工具调用语言模型中的应用，发现该策略可能导致模型过度调用工具（over-calling），而聚合损失无法反映此行为偏移。作者提出Soft Clamp方法，通过动态压缩极端逐token的Jensen-Shannon散度来校准，在APIGen-MT上将过度调用率从13.7%降至9.0%，同时保持决策准确率；在BFCL多轮诊断中也减少了工具调用循环。
Motivation: 多教师在线蒸馏在训练工具调用语言模型时，虽然能提升工具调用召回率，但可能导致模型过度调用工具，即在应直接回答的样本上也调用工具，且聚合损失无法检测该偏移。
Method: 提出Soft Clamp方法，一种逐token散度校准技术，动态压缩极端逐token的Jensen-Shannon散度，同时保留非零梯度，以平衡教师信号的影响。
Result: 在APIGen-MT上，Soft Clamp相比原始GKD将过度调用率从13.7%降至9.0%，决策准确率持平；在BFCL多轮诊断中，进一步降低了工具调用循环和重复调用。
Conclusion: 多教师在线蒸馏训练应关注教师信号在序列中具体位置（如<tool_call>标记）的作用，而非仅聚合损失大小。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Riemannian Geometry for Pre-trained Language Model Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the geometric structure of pre-trained language model embeddings matters for interpretability and safety. We ask whether sentence-level classification signal lives in the Riemannian geometry of contextual token embeddings, and probe it by extracting per-token pullback metrics from a learned encoder's analytical Jacobian and aggregating them with the Fréchet mean on the symmetric positive definite (SPD) manifold; we call this procedure Riemannian Mean Pooling (RMP). Across three datasets with non-trivial linguistic structure (CoLA, CREAK, RTE), RMP outperforms Euclidean mean pooling, while on FEVER-Symmetric, a benchmark constructed to remove annotation-driven lexical artifacts, the method correctly stays at chance. Ablations show that a randomly initialised encoder combined with Fréchet aggregation already beats Euclidean pooling on two of the three signal-bearing datasets, localising the source of the gain to the geometric aggregation rather than to learned manifold structure; the trained encoder contributes additional signal specifically on CREAK, the most knowledge-heavy of the three signal-bearing datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究预训练语言模型嵌入的几何结构，提出通过提取每个token的拉回度量并在对称正定流形上聚合Fréchet均值的方法（Riemannian Mean Pooling, RMP）。在CoLA、CREAK、RTE三个数据集上，RMP优于欧几里得均值池化；在去除词汇伪影的FEVER-Symmetric基准上，RMP正确停留在机会水平。消融实验表明性能提升主要来自几何聚合而非学习到的流形结构。
Motivation: 理解预训练语言模型嵌入的几何结构对可解释性和安全性很重要，但现有方法多基于欧几里得空间，忽略黎曼几何可能带来的丰富信号。
Method: 提出RMP方法：从学习到的编码器的解析雅可比矩阵中提取每个token的拉回度量，然后在对称正定流形上通过Fréchet均值聚合这些度量，形成句子级表示。
Result: 在CoLA、CREAK、RTE上RMP优于欧几里得均值池化；在FEVER-Symmetric上正确保持随机水平。消融实验显示随机初始化编码器结合Fréchet聚合已在两个数据集上超过欧几里得池化，增益源于几何聚合。
Conclusion: 黎曼几何为句子级分类信号提供了有效建模方法，未来可探索不同编码器结构和任务下的扩展。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Measuring Intelligence Beyond Human Scale
papers.abstract_en: How can we measure intelligence beyond human capability? Human-authored benchmarks saturate, and above human capability, examiners may not know which tasks are both hard and verifiable. We argue that this difficulty is inherent to absolute-scale evaluation and propose a new paradigm based on relative measurement in which models generate public challenges that separate other systems. Aggregating these outcomes yields an adversarial psychometric rating system that can scale with the systems being measured. We describe practical protocols that reduce incentives for private-information attacks, support judge-free adjudication, and naturally scale with agent capabilities. We instantiate the framework across verifiable and open-ended, non-verifiable domains, illustrating how model-generated evaluation can continue to measure systems beyond the human frontier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对人类作者基准饱和后难以衡量超越人类能力的智能的问题，提出一种基于相对测量的新范式。该范式由模型生成公开挑战来区分其他系统，聚合结果形成对抗性心理测量评级系统，并设计实际协议减少私人信息攻击、支持无评判裁决。框架可应用于可验证和开放式不可验证领域，持续测量超越人类前沿的系统。
Motivation: 人类作者基准饱和后，绝对尺度评估面临困难：超出人类能力时，评审者难以确定哪些任务既难又可验证。
Method: 提出基于相对测量的对抗性心理测量评级系统：模型生成公开挑战以区分其他系统，聚合对抗性结果进行评分；设计协议减少私人信息攻击、支持无评判裁决，并自然随智能体能力扩展。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但说明该方法可应用于可验证和开放式不可验证领域，持续测量超越人类能力的系统。
Conclusion: 该框架能够超越人类前沿持续测量智能，在多种领域实例化有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Data Completeness to Data Sufficiency: A Task-Driven Imaging Framework for Intraoperative CBCT under Quality-Time-Dose Trade-offs
papers.abstract_en: Mobile C-arm cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) has been widely used for real-time intraoperative 3D imaging. However, current practice often mechanically applies the fan-beam CT criterion of "180° plus fan angle" in pursuit of "data completeness" in reconstruction. This review argues that, under the single circular trajectory of three-dimensional cone-beam geometry, complete data are mathematically unattainable; moreover, blindly increasing sampling may exacerbate the trade-off among intraoperative image quality (Q), imaging time (T), and radiation dose (D). Against this background, this review reframes the evaluation of intraoperative CBCT around "data sufficiency" rather than "data completeness." This perspective moves beyond the excessive pursuit of absolute mathematical and analytic accuracy, and instead emphasizes task-specific minimum image-quality thresholds required for clinical decision-making. By synthesizing evidence from multiple clinical scenarios, this review suggests that approximation errors can be acceptable when clinical decision-making requirements are satisfied, thereby achieving a Q-T-D balance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述，重新审视了术中C臂锥束CT（CBCT）的数据完整性标准。作者指出，在单圆轨迹锥束几何下，完整数据在数学上不可达，且盲目增加采样会恶化图像质量（Q）、成像时间（T）和辐射剂量（D）之间的权衡。因此，该综述提出以“数据充分性”替代“数据完整性”，强调满足临床决策所需的最小图像质量阈值，从而在多个临床场景中实现Q-T-D平衡。
Motivation: 现有CBCT术中成像往往机械地应用扇束CT的“180°加扇角”准则追求数据完整性，但这一目标在锥束几何下无法实现，反而加剧了质量、时间与剂量之间的权衡。
Result: 综述综合多个临床场景的证据表明，在满足临床决策要求的前提下，近似误差可以被接受，从而为平衡Q-T-D提供了新视角。
Conclusion: 该综述主张术中CBCT的评价应从“数据完整性”转向“数据充分性”，以任务驱动的图像质量阈值指导成像协议设计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TRACE-Seg3D: Counterfactual Context Auditing For Robust 3D Glioma Segmentation Under Institutional Shift
papers.abstract_en: Medical image segmentation models can achieve strong benchmark performance while remaining sensitive to scanner, protocol, and institutional variation. These context shifts alter image appearance without changing the underlying lesion, allowing models to exploit nuisance cues that Dice and HD95 fail to expose. We present TRACE-Seg3D, a counterfactual context auditing framework for robust 3D medical image segmentation. TRACE-Seg3D preserves lesion-relevant evidence and systematically varies imaging context to quantify prediction stability under controlled context shifts. The framework pairs each segmentation with audit evidence for context sensitivity and anatomical plausibility, enabling case-level reliability assessment beyond overlap-based evaluation. Experiments on BraTS and UTSW glioma segmentation benchmarks demonstrate competitive in-distribution and cross-domain performance. TRACE-Seg3D also exposes context-sensitive failure modes missed by conventional metrics. These results establish counterfactual context auditing as a practical route toward transparent and reliable 3D medical image segmentation under distribution shift. Our code is available at https://github.com/danleneurocom/Counterfactual-Representation-Network.

TL;DR: 本文提出TRACE-Seg3D，一个反事实上下文审计框架，用于鲁棒的3D医学图像分割。该框架通过保留病灶相关证据并系统改变成像上下文，量化分割稳定性，并提供每个分割的上下文敏感性和解剖合理性审计证据。在BraTS和UTSW胶质瘤分割基准上，展示了具有竞争力的分布内和跨域性能，并暴露了传统指标忽略的上下文敏感失败模式。
Motivation: 医学图像分割模型在基准测试中表现良好，但对扫描仪、协议和机构变化敏感。这些上下文变化改变图像外观而不改变病灶，使模型利用干扰线索，而Dice和HD95等指标无法暴露这些问题。
Method: 提出TRACE-Seg3D反事实上下文审计框架：保留病灶相关证据，系统变化成像上下文，量化预测稳定性；为每个分割提供上下文敏感性和解剖合理性审计证据。
Result: 在BraTS和UTSW胶质瘤分割基准上，展示了具有竞争力的分布内和跨域性能，并暴露了传统指标忽略的上下文敏感失败模式。
Conclusion: 反事实上下文审计为分布偏移下透明可靠的3D医学图像分割提供了实用途径。

papers.title: On the Principles of Deep Feedforward ReLU Networks
papers.abstract_en: The architecture of deep feedforward neural networks is ubiquitous in deep learning, either as a whole system or as a subnetwork of other architectures, and thus its mechanism is a key ingredient of the black box of neural networks. On the basis of the simplest two-layer ReLU network, this paper systematically studies the mechanism of deep feedforward ReLU networks with multiple hidden layers and successfully explains the training solution obtained by the back-propagation algorithm. The concept of a path, especially in terms of the relationships between paths, plays a central role in uncovering the mystery of the black box. It is shown that a unit of a deep ReLU network can form a piecewise linear manifold to divide the input space, instead of a hyperplane of the two-layer case. How to efficiently use the hidden-layer units to produce both linear functions and partitions of the input space is also a central problem. The principles of a two-layer ReLU network can be generalized to the deeper case to a large extent, such as multiple strict partial orders and continuity restriction. The combination of the basic and simple principles proposed can yield complicated instantiations including the training solutions, and in this sense the black box of deep feedforward ReLU networks is revealed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了深度前馈ReLU网络的机制，基于最简单的两层ReLU网络，推广到多层隐藏层，并成功解释了反向传播算法得到的训练解。路径概念（尤其是路径间关系）是揭示黑箱的核心。研究表明深度ReLU网络的单元可以形成分段线性流形来划分输入空间，而非像两层情况下的超平面。两层ReLU网络的原则（如多重严格偏序和连续性限制）在很大程度上可推广到更深的情况。
Motivation: 深度前馈神经网络作为整个深度学习系统或其他架构的子网络，其机制是神经网络黑箱的关键组成部分，但尚未被完全理解。
Method: 基于最简单的两层ReLU网络，通过路径概念及其关系，系统研究多层隐藏层的深度前馈ReLU网络，并将两层原则推广到深层。
Result: 展示了深度ReLU网络的单元能形成分段线性流形划分输入空间，且两层网络的原则（多重严格偏序、连续性限制）可推广到深层。
Conclusion: 提出的基本简单原则的组合可以产生包括训练解在内的复杂实例，从这个意义上说，深度前馈ReLU网络的黑箱被揭示。

papers.title: Intrinsic Green's Learning: Supervised Learning on Manifolds via Inverse PDE
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Intrinsic Green's Learning (IGL), a framework that models a target function on a manifold as the solution to a linear PDE whose source term is learned from data. Rather than approximating the target directly, IGL learns a source and integrates it against a Green's kernel. An encoder discovers a low-dimensional coordinate chart on the manifold where both the source and the kernel decompose as low-rank tensors, collapsing a high-dimensional integral into independent one-dimensional integrals with cost linear in the intrinsic dimension. A two-stage algorithm separates coordinate discovery from source fitting, a near-convex linear solve, preventing the dimensional collapse of joint training. Learnable gates on each coordinate automatically discover the intrinsic dimension of the manifold. We validate IGL on synthetic manifolds and on MNIST, where it simultaneously achieves near-optimal classification and automatic recovery of the intrinsic dimension.
papers.comment: Accepted at AI & PDE Workshop @ ICLR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出内在格林学习（IGL），一种在流形上建模目标函数为线性PDE解的方法，通过学习源项并与格林核积分来逼近目标。编码器发现流形上的低维坐标图，使源和核分解为低秩张量，将高维积分转化为独立的一维积分，计算成本与内在维度线性相关。两阶段算法分离坐标发现与源拟合，可学习门控自动发现流形的内在维度。在合成流形和MNIST上验证，同时实现近最优分类和自动恢复内在维度。
Motivation: 现有监督学习方法在流形数据上往往需要高维积分或复杂训练，计算成本高。
Method: IGL通过编码器学习低维坐标图，使源项和格林核分解为低秩张量，将高维积分转化为多个一维积分。使用两阶段算法：先发现坐标，再通过近凸线性求解拟合源项，避免联合训练时的维度坍缩。
Result: 在合成流形和MNIST上，IGL同时达到近最优分类性能并自动恢复流形的内在维度。
Conclusion: IGL提供了一种在流形上高效监督学习的框架，通过格林函数和低维分解降低计算复杂度，并自动发现内在维度。

papers.title: AnchorPrune: Relevance-Anchored Contextual Expansion for Visual Token Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models incur substantial inference costs because high-resolution inputs introduce thousands of visual tokens, many of which are redundant for a given query. Existing pruning methods often combine query relevance and token diversity, yet these objectives can conflict under aggressive compression: relevance-driven selection may overconcentrate the budget on correlated local evidence, while diversity-driven selection may suppress indispensable tokens or retain distinct but uninformative regions. We introduce AnchorPrune, a training-free framework that first constructs a protected relevance anchor and then expands it with complementary visual context. AnchorPrune adaptively determines the anchor size from the novelty profile of relevance-ranked tokens, preserving a compact set of query-critical evidence, and allocates the remaining budget through importance-weighted novelty to recover informative, non-redundant context relative to the anchor. This ordered design prevents contextual expansion from displacing indispensable query cues while improving overall visual coverage. AnchorPrune is lightweight, architecture-aware, and requires neither retraining nor model modification. Across image and video vision-language models and benchmarks, it consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off over training-free baselines, particularly under severe compression. On LLaVA-NeXT-7B, AnchorPrune preserves 97.6% of full-token performance using only 160 of 2,880 visual tokens. These results establish relevance-anchored contextual expansion as an effective principle for efficient multimodal inference. Code is available at https://github.com/MULTI-cau/AnchorPrune.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出了AnchorPrune，一种无需训练的视觉token剪枝框架，通过构建受保护的相关性锚点并扩展互补视觉上下文，平衡了查询相关性和token多样性。在LLaVA-NeXT-7B上，仅用160个token（共2880个）就保留了97.6%的全token性能。
Motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝方法中，相关性驱动和多样性驱动两个目标在激进压缩时可能冲突，导致重要信息丢失或冗余。需要一种有序剪枝策略来兼顾查询关键证据和视觉覆盖。
Method: AnchorPrune先根据相关性排序的token的新颖性分布自适应确定锚点大小，保留查询关键证据；然后用重要性加权的新颖性分配剩余预算，恢复与锚点相关的信息性非冗余上下文。无需训练或修改模型。
Result: 在多个图像和视频视觉语言模型及基准上，AnchorPrune一致改善了精度-效率权衡，尤其在严重压缩下。在LLaVA-NeXT-7B上，用160/2880个token保留了97.6%的全token性能。
Conclusion: 相关性锚定的上下文扩展是高效多模态推理的有效原则，该方法轻量且通用。

papers.title: Gauge-Invariant Learnable Spectral Positional Encodings for Directed Graphs via Hermitian Block Krylov Subspaces
papers.abstract_en: Spectral positional encodings (PEs) for \emph{directed} graphs face two obstacles: magnetic Laplacians require an $O(n^3)$ Hermitian eigendecomposition per potential, and their complex eigenvectors are defined only up to unitary gauge, which prior work handles with basis-invariant architectures. We propose learnable spectral PEs of the form $h_θ(A_q)\,R$, where $A_q$ is a normalized magnetic operator, $h_θ$ a learnable scalar spectral response, and $R$ a block of random probes. Because the PE is a \emph{matrix function} of the operator, it is gauge-invariant by construction. We compute it in a Hermitian block Krylov subspace from sparse matrix--vector products only, prove that $k = O(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ block steps suffice uniformly over heat--resolvent response families, and give a covering-number argument for why low-dimensional structured families generalize where free per-eigenvalue weights overfit. On a directed SBM whose symmetrization is uninformative by construction, direction-blind PEs stay at chance while magnetic Krylov PEs converge to the exact-eigendecomposition oracle as the depth grows. The same probes yield gauge-invariant pairwise features with $1/\sqrt{s}$ Monte-Carlo error, and the undirected $q{=}0$ case improves heterophilous benchmarks over no-PE and polynomial baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对有向图的规范不变可学习谱位置编码方法，通过Hermitian块Krylov子空间计算矩阵函数，避免昂贵特征分解，并证明浅层网络即可逼近热-预解响应族，在定向随机块模型上性能优于方向盲编码。
Motivation: 现有有向图谱位置编码面临磁拉普拉斯算子$O(n^3)$特征分解计算瓶颈，且复特征向量存在规范不确定性，需特殊架构处理。
Method: 提出形式为$h_\theta(A_q)R$的可学习谱位置编码，其中$A_q$是归一化磁算子，$h_\theta$是可学习标量谱响应，$R$是随机探针块；利用Hermitian块Krylov子空间仅通过稀疏矩阵-向量乘积计算，证明$k=O(\log(1/\varepsilon))$步即可均匀逼近热-预解响应族。
Result: 在定向随机块模型上，方向盲编码性能随机，而磁Krylov位置编码随深度增加趋近于精确特征分解的oracle；相同探针以$1/\sqrt{s}$蒙特卡洛误差提供规范不变对特征；无向情形下$q=0$在异嗜性基准上优于无位置编码和多项式基线。
Conclusion: 该方法通过矩阵函数构造天然保证规范不变性，并利用Krylov子空间实现高效计算，适用于大规模有向图。

papers.title: Gimitest: A Comprehensive Tool for Testing Reinforcement Learning Policies
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies can be unsafe and vulnerable to attacks. Ensuring their reliability is often a pain point as existing automated testing methods target only selected environments, testing scenarios, and RL algorithms. To address this, we propose a comprehensive framework for testing single- and multi-agent RL policies under varying conditions. Our implementation of this framework, Gimitest, is an open-source tool that supports various gym frameworks and allows for modifications of their integrated components. This article describes the framework and details Gimitest's functionality and architecture. It showcases its effectiveness in testing multiple RL policies in environments such as the official Farama Gymnasium and PettingZoo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个全面的强化学习策略测试框架 Gimitest，支持单智能体和多智能体策略在不同环境下的测试。该开源工具兼容多种 gym 框架，允许修改集成组件，并在 Farama Gymnasium 和 PettingZoo 环境中展示了有效性。
Motivation: 现有自动化测试方法仅针对特定环境、测试场景和 RL 算法，无法全面保证策略的可靠性和安全性。
Method: 设计并实现了一个综合测试框架 Gimitest，支持单智能体和多智能体 RL 策略，兼容多种 gym 框架，并允许用户修改集成组件以适应不同测试需求。
Result: 在官方 Farama Gymnasium 和 PettingZoo 环境中成功测试了多个 RL 策略，验证了框架的有效性。
Conclusion: Gimitest 作为一个开源工具，为 RL 策略的自动化测试提供了通用且灵活的平台，有助于提升策略的安全性和可靠性。

papers.title: Latent graph encoding of multimodal neuroimaging features with generative AI architectures
papers.abstract_en: While generative models enable encoding of complex neuroimaging data for feature generation and reconstruction, developing optimal architectural frameworks with appropriate encoding and latent space processes is crucial for studying structural and functional properties of the brain. We design a multimodal generative framework for structural and functional magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) features through systematic evaluation of encoding strategies, latent multimodal fusion, and generative model selection. Using structural gray matter volume (GMV) and static functional network connectivity (sFNC) features from a large neuroimaging dataset, we analyze generative frameworks involving variational autoencoders (VAEs), transformers, generative adversarial networks (GANs), and diffusion models. Architectures that employ modality-aware graph encoding of functional connectivity into a lower-dimensional latent space outperform vectorized encoders or direct data space approaches. The proposed multimodal graph VAE (gMMVAE) surpasses alternative generative variants across multiple metrics for generation fidelity, reconstruction quality, efficiency, and latent space discriminability, highlighting its potential for robust multimodal neuroimaging analysis.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文设计了一个多模态生成框架，用于结构和功能磁共振成像（MRI）特征的编码与重建，系统评估了变分自编码器（VAE）、Transformer、生成对抗网络（GAN）和扩散模型等生成架构。研究发现，采用模态感知的图编码将功能连接映射到低维潜在空间的方法优于向量化编码或直接数据空间方法。提出的多模态图VAE（gMMVAE）在生成保真度、重建质量、效率和潜在空间可区分性等指标上超越了其他生成变体，展示了其在鲁棒多模态神经影像分析中的潜力。
Motivation: 生成模型能够对复杂的神经影像数据进行编码以用于特征生成和重建，但需要开发最优的架构框架，特别是针对编码和潜在空间处理，以研究大脑的结构和功能特性。
Method: 基于大规模神经影像数据集的结构灰质体积（GMV）和静态功能网络连接（sFNC）特征，系统比较VAE、Transformer、GAN和扩散模型，并引入模态感知的图编码策略，提出多模态图VAE（gMMVAE）架构。
Result: gMMVAE在生成保真度、重建质量、效率和潜在空间可区分性等多个指标上均优于其他生成变体。
Conclusion: 摘要强调模态感知的图编码和多模态图VAE框架在鲁棒多模态神经影像分析中的潜力。

papers.title: Constrained Decoding for Diffusion Language Models via Efficient Inference over Finite Automata
papers.abstract_en: Constrained decoding is essential for serving LLMs, ensuring that generated outputs follow specific structures such as JSON schema-formatted function calls. Existing systems are designed for autoregressive models and assume left-to-right generation, masking out invalid next tokens at each step. Diffusion language models, however, break this assumption: they sample multiple positions simultaneously from a fully-factorized mean-field distribution at each denoising step. In this paper, we present an exact and tractable algorithm for sampling from the constrained mean-field posterior under any constraint expressible as a finite automaton. Viewing finite automata as graphical models, we obtain tractable representations of the constrained distribution that enable efficient inference. The approach guarantees constraint satisfaction by construction, supports both greedy and sampling-based decoding, and is compatible with parallel and block-wise decoding under arbitrary remasking schedules. Applying depth-reduction techniques from arithmetic circuit theory, we further reduce sampling depth from linear to logarithmic in the sequence length. Empirical evaluations on Dream-7B and LLaDA-8B show substantial accuracy gains across various tasks including function calling (xLAM, BFCL), planning (Sudoku, Countdown), text-to-SQL (Spider), and math reasoning (GSM-Symbolic), with little inference overhead relative to unconstrained decoding. For example, on BFCL-Live, our approach improves Dream-7B's greedy decoding accuracy from 63.9% to 71.5%, and stochastic sampling accuracy from 22.3% to 69.0%, where the unconstrained baseline collapses, with under 5% wall-clock overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散语言模型提出一种基于有限自动机的精确约束解码算法，通过将自动机视为图模型得到易处理的约束后验分布，并利用算术电路深度缩减技术将采样深度从线性降至对数。在Dream-7B和LLaDA-8B上的实验显示，该方法在函数调用、规划、文本到SQL和数学推理等任务上显著提升精度，且推理开销低于5%。
Motivation: 现有约束解码方法仅适用于自回归模型，而扩散语言模型在去噪步骤中同时采样多个位置，无法直接应用。需要为扩散模型设计能处理任意有限自动机约束的高效解码算法。
Method: 将有限自动机视为图模型，导出约束后验分布的易处理表示，实现贪婪和随机采样；并采用算术电路深度缩减技术，将采样深度从线性降至对数，支持并行和块式解码。
Result: 在Dream-7B和LLaDA-8B上，BFCL-Live基准上贪婪解码准确率从63.9%提升至71.5%，随机采样准确率从22.3%提升至69.0%，开销低于5%；其他任务如Spider和GSM-Symbolic也取得增益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法为扩散语言模型提供了高效、精确的约束解码，兼容多种解码策略，且推理开销小，具有良好的实用性。

papers.title: Online Data Selection Is Implicit Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is often treated as a capability-adaptation step, while alignment is attributed to later preference optimization or reinforcement learning. This separation is incomplete: when examples are scored and kept online during fine-tuning, the choice of which data to train on already changes the model's behavioral preferences. We study online data selection as an implicit alignment mechanism. Given the same base model, optimizer, and selected-token budget, we compare random, loss-based, quality-based, and diversity-based online selectors and measure the behavioral drift they induce without any preference optimization. The proposed evaluation tracks helpfulness, refusal rate, verbosity, truthfulness, sycophancy, calibration, and jailbreak robustness, together with diagnostics for which behavioral modes are over-represented in the selected data. We formalize online selection as a reweighted SFT objective whose weights define an implicit preference over response styles and safety postures, so that an online scorer plays the role usually assigned to a reward model. This view predicts that high-scoring data can systematically favor longer, more assertive, more compliant, or more refusal-prone behaviors depending on how the online score is defined. Empirically, selectors that are statistically indistinguishable in task accuracy diverge sharply in refusal rate, verbosity, and sycophancy, and we show that the direction of the shift is predictable from the attribute mixture of the selected data. We introduce Alignment Drift Auditing (ADA), a controlled protocol for quantifying selection-induced behavioral movement, and Alignment-Aware Selection (AAS), a diagnostic online selector that retains data efficiency while constraining drift along safety and style axes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线数据选择作为监督微调中的隐式对齐机制。作者发现，在线选择哪些数据训练已经会改变模型的行为偏好（如帮助性、拒绝率、冗长性等），而无需偏好优化。通过提出的Alignment Drift Auditing (ADA) 和 Alignment-Aware Selection (AAS)，论文展示了不同在线选择器在任务准确率相似时，在安全性和风格轴向上会产生显著不同的行为漂移。
Motivation: 当前观点将监督微调视为能力适应、偏好优化视为对齐，但这种分离不完整。在线数据选择本身就能影响模型的行为偏好，需要系统研究这种隐式对齐效应。
Method: 提出Alignment Drift Auditing (ADA) 协议，用于量化在线数据选择导致的行为漂移；以及Alignment-Aware Selection (AAS) 诊断选择器，在保持数据效率的同时约束安全性和风格轴向的漂移。实验比较了随机、基于损失、基于质量和基于多样性的在线选择器。
Result: 不同在线选择器在任务准确率上统计无差异，但在拒绝率、冗长性和谄媚行为上显著不同，且漂移方向可由所选数据的属性混合预测。
Conclusion: 在线数据选择是一种隐式对齐机制，其效果可通过ADA量化，并通过AAS在保持效率的同时控制行为漂移。

papers.title: Learning social norms enhances compatibility in dynamic human-AI coordination
papers.abstract_en: Humans continuously coordinate with others in dynamic interactions, often through implicit, hard-to-quantify social norms that act as shared tacit expectations among interacting agents. As AI agents, including large language models (LLMs), become embedded in daily life, they increasingly participate in such interactions and reshape social interaction structures. Yet they often fail to coordinate with humans in an effective, considerate, and natural manner. We hypothesize that this gap arises because existing approaches align model behavior with human demonstrations without explicitly quantifying the underlying norms that generate such behavior. We selected pedestrian-vehicle interaction as a representative dynamic interaction and developed a simplified experimental platform that captures its key interactive features. From 3,456 dynamic human interactions collected via this platform, we identified three principles underlying human social norms: outcome predictability, value alignment, and advantage awareness. Incorporating these principles into AI agents significantly improves human-AI coordination. In the closed-loop interaction task with humans, the social-norm-informed LLM achieved a nearly fourfold higher total score than the baseline strategy and outperformed human-human interactions by 43%. These findings indicate that formalizing tacit social norms into explicit, quantifiable principles can enable AI agents to achieve mutually beneficial coordination in dynamic interactions, supporting their more natural integration into human society.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究动态人机协作中社会规范的作用，以行人与车辆交互为场景，通过实验平台收集3456次动态交互，归纳出三个社会规范原则：结果可预测性、价值对齐和优势意识。将这些原则融入AI代理（包括LLM）后，在与人类的闭环交互测试中，社会规范引导的LLM总分比基线策略提高近四倍，且比人类-人类交互高43%。研究表明，将隐性社会规范形式化为显式可量化原则，能提升AI在动态交互中的协调能力。
Motivation: 现有AI代理在动态交互中常未能以有效、体贴、自然的方式与人类协调，原因是其对齐人类行为时未显式量化背后的社会规范。
Method: 选取行人与车辆交互作为代表性动态交互场景，开发简化实验平台收集3456次动态人类交互数据，从中归纳出三个社会规范原则（结果可预测性、价值对齐、优势意识），并将其融入AI代理（包括LLM）的决策中。
Result: 在闭环交互任务中，社会规范引导的LLM总分比基线策略提高近四倍，且比人类-人类交互高43%。
Conclusion: 将隐性社会规范形式化为显式可量化原则，可使AI代理在动态交互中实现互利协调，支持其更自然地融入人类社会。

papers.title: SHTA: Semantic Hard Token Correction and Center Alignment for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in semi-supervised medical image segmentation have achieved remarkable performance through prediction consistency, pseudo-label supervision, and hard-region supervision. However, these methods primarily improve supervision quality rather than explicitly enforcing semantic consistency in the learned representations of hard regions. Consequently, even under increasingly stronger prediction-level supervision, difficult regions exhibiting unstable semantic assignment often fail to establish semantically consistent representations during training, thereby limiting further segmentation improvement. To address this issue, we propose SHTA (Semantic Hard Token Correction and Center Alignment), a lightweight training-time semantic representation branch. Instead of introducing additional prediction supervision, SHTA refines intermediate semantic representations through Semantic Assignment, Hard Token Refinement, and Semantic Center Alignment, thereby improving semantic consistency in hard regions while preserving the original prediction pathway and introducing no additional inference cost. We integrate SHTA into representative semi-supervised segmentation frameworks, including GA-CPS, CPS, URPC, and MagicNet, and conduct evaluations on the Synapse and AMOS datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that SHTA delivers consistent paired improvements across frameworks, with especially clear gains in segmentation accuracy, weak-organ recovery, and semantic ambiguity reduction, while incurring only training-time overhead. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/release_SHTA-42D5/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SHTA（语义硬标记校正与中心对齐），一种轻量级训练时语义表示分支，通过语义分配、硬标记精炼和语义中心对齐来改进半监督医学图像分割中困难区域的语义一致性，不增加推理开销。在Synapse和AMOS数据集上，集成到多个框架中均取得一致改进。
Motivation: 现有半监督医学图像分割方法主要通过预测一致性、伪标签监督和困难区域监督提升监督质量，但未明确强制困难区域学习表示的语义一致性，导致语义分配不稳定的区域无法建立一致表示，限制分割性能。
Method: 提出SHTA作为训练时模块，包含语义分配（Semantic Assignment）、硬标记精炼（Hard Token Refinement）和语义中心对齐（Semantic Center Alignment），修正中间语义表示，保持原始预测路径不变。
Result: 在Synapse和AMOS数据集上，将SHTA集成到GA-CPS、CPS、URPC、MagicNet框架中，均取得分割准确率、弱器官恢复和语义模糊减少上的一致提升。
Conclusion: SHTA通过仅训练时开销改进了半监督医学图像分割中的语义一致性，且不增加推理成本。

papers.title: Multimodal Spatiotemporal-Frequency Fusion with Peak Enhancement for Cellular Traffic Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate forecasting of cellular network traffic is essential for network planning, resource allocation, and quality-of-service assurance in modern mobile communication systems. Real-world traffic often exhibits bursty endogenous dynamics and disturbances triggered by external urban events, which makes reliable prediction highly challenging. Most existing spatiotemporal traffic forecasting methods primarily focus on intrinsic traffic patterns or structural relationships within a single modality, and rarely model burst behavior together with exogenous contextual signals. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{MSPF-Net}, a multimodal cellular traffic forecasting framework that integrates external contextual information. Specifically, MSPF-Net consists of a Spatiotemporal-Frequency Traffic Encoder for capturing temporal, spatial, and spectral traffic patterns, a Peak Enhancement Module for extracting burst-aware representations of sudden spikes, a News Context Representation Module for encoding urban news streams into exogenous contextual embeddings, and a Dynamic Fusion Prediction Module for adaptively integrating these heterogeneous signals to generate forecasts. Experiments on the Milano, Trento, and LTE traffic datasets demonstrate that jointly modeling traffic dynamics, burst patterns, and news contextual signals can effectively improve forecasting performance.

TL;DR: 本文提出MSPF-Net，一种多模态蜂窝流量预测框架，融合外部上下文信息（如新闻事件）。框架包括时空-频率流量编码器、峰值增强模块、新闻上下文表示模块和动态融合预测模块，在米兰、特伦托和LTE数据集上验证了联合建模流量动态、突发模式和新闻上下文信号能够提升预测性能。
Motivation: 现有时空流量预测方法主要关注单一模态的内在模式或结构关系，很少同时建模突发行为和外部上下文信号，导致实际蜂窝网络中突发动态和外部事件引发的干扰难以准确预测。
Method: MSPF-Net包含四个组件：时空-频率流量编码器捕获时间、空间和频谱模式；峰值增强模块提取突发感知表征；新闻上下文表示模块编码城市新闻流；动态融合预测模块自适应整合异构信号生成预测。
Result: 在米兰、特伦托和LTE流量数据集上的实验表明，联合建模流量动态、突发模式和新闻上下文信号能有效提升预测性能。
Conclusion: 融合外部上下文（如新闻事件）有助于提升蜂窝流量预测准确性，尤其在处理突发性流量变化时。

papers.title: Local large deviations for linear-region growth in random piecewise-linear networks
papers.abstract_en: We study a random compositional model for the growth of affine regions in deep piecewise-linear networks. The model is generated by i.i.d.\ perturbations of the symmetric height-one tent map, and the main observable is the number \(N_n\) of affine pieces after \(n\) layers. We prove the existence of a submultiplicative pressure for \(N_n\), yielding exponential upper bounds for both tails of \(n^{-1}\log N_n\). The same argument applies to abstract submultiplicative complexity observables and gives higher-dimensional extensions for convex-polytopal affine-cover counts and worst-line affine-piece counts. Since the true branch count has no matching supermultiplicative inequality, lower bounds require a separate certified construction. We introduce a finite-state defect process that records branches whose future splitting can be guaranteed, and use bridge words to obtain constructive upper-tail lower bounds. In a uniformly favorable small-noise regime, this process is governed by a companion matrix whose Perron root tends to \(2\), implying eventual exclusion of lower tails below \(\log 2-ξ\).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究深度分段线性网络中仿射区域增长的随机组合模型，通过i.i.d.扰动对称高度-1帐篷映射生成，主要可观测量为n层后的仿射片段数N_n。证明了N_n的次可乘压存在性，给出n^{-1}\log N_n双尾指数上界，并推广到更高维的凸多面体仿射覆盖计数和最坏情况仿射片段计数。通过有限状态缺陷过程得到上尾下界，在均匀有利的小噪声区域，伴随矩阵的Perron根趋于2，排除低于\log 2-\xi的下尾。
Motivation: 现有随机组合模型缺乏对深层分段线性网络中线性区域增长率的精确刻画，上下界不匹配。
Method: 建立次可乘压理论给出指数上界，引入有限状态缺陷过程和桥接词构造上尾下界。
Result: 证明了N_n的次可乘压存在性，得到双尾指数上界；在均匀有利小噪声区域，Perron根趋于2，排除下尾低于\log 2-\xi。
Conclusion: 该理论框架可推广至抽象次可乘复杂性观察量和高维情形，但下界依赖构造性证明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Route survival and spectral modification of finite-depth salt-finger plume forests under imposed mean shear
papers.abstract_en: Salt-finger plume forests in a finite layer can differ in strength and in the route by which interfacial activity becomes vertically connected. We use direct three-dimensional simulations to test whether such a route is a short-lived realization-specific transient or a persistent route family under an added mean-shear perturbation. The baseline route atlas holds density ratio, diffusivity ratio, Prandtl number, interface thickness, roughness amplitude, domain, and resolution fixed while varying the imposed interfacial roughness spectrum. Low-mode roughness forms a broad connecting endpoint, high-annulus roughness forms a localized route-memory endpoint, and mixed roughness forms a delayed scale-transfer route. A second mixed realization preserves continuous active-width, spectral, and transport measures after \(t=45\), with mean absolute differences of \(3.1\%\) in \(w\)-active width, \(1.6\%\) in salinity-active width, \(2.8\%\) in broad spectral fraction, and \(3.6\%\) in salt flux, while shifting the binary scalar-contact label. We then impose an initial tanh mean shear on the mixed route. The full-resolution shear case reaches \(t=60\) and preserves finite-depth reach: first velocity contact occurs at \(t=57.75\), first salinity contact occurs at \(t=59.5\), and both times match the unsheared mixed reference. The spectral branch is redistributed. At \(t=60\), the broad fraction is \(1.116\) times the mixed value, the intermediate fraction is \(0.530\) times the mixed value, and the short-wave fraction is \(1.278\) times the mixed value. In this finite-depth configuration, route survival means preserved reach and contact timing with a changed spectral pathway.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过三维直接数值模拟研究有限深度盐指羽流森林在平均剪切作用下的路径生存与光谱调制。结果发现，施加平均剪切后，羽流仍保持接触时间和有限深度到达，但光谱分支发生重分布，宽谱分数增大1.116倍，短波分数增大1.278倍。路径生存表现为接触时序不变而光谱路径改变。
Motivation: 现有研究未明确有限深度盐指羽流森林的路径在剪切扰动下是否为短瞬态还是持久特征。本文旨在检验路径生存性。
Method: 采用三维直接数值模拟，固定基线参数，变化界面粗糙度谱生成不同路径，并对混合路径施加tanh平均剪切，比较接触时间和光谱特征。
Result: 全分辨率剪切情况保持与无剪切参考相同的首次速度接触时间（t=57.75）和盐度接触时间（t=59.5）。光谱分数变化：宽谱分数为混合值的1.116倍，中间分数为0.530倍，短波分数为1.278倍。
Conclusion: 有限深度配置下，路径生存意味着保持接触时间和路径，但光谱路径会改变。

papers.title: Tensorized algorithms and scalable filtering methods for hidden Markov and factorial hidden Markov models
papers.abstract_en: A common method for the representation and analysis of time-series data is the hidden Markov model (HMM), where each observation is associated with a hidden state that evolves over time. However, many real-world systems are influenced by multiple independent factors, which are more naturally represented by factorial hidden Markov models (fHMM), where several hidden Markov chains jointly generate the observed data. Although an fHMM provides a richer and more realistic representation of many real-world systems, it can be reformulated as an equivalent HMM, but with a significantly larger state-space, leading to a severe increase in computational cost. In particular, the forward filtering algorithm, which is central to evaluation, decoding, and estimation tasks, becomes prohibitively expensive even for small systems. This work focuses on developing scalable methods for time-series analysis using tensor algebra to exploit the multidimensional structure of fHMM directly, without constructing intermediate HMM representations. Our novel filtering approach significantly improves computational performance and enables the efficient analysis of large systems and datasets, extending the scope of fHMM and providing a practical framework for data intensive applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对因子隐马尔可夫模型（fHMM）计算成本高的问题，提出利用张量代数直接操作fHMM的多维结构，无需将其转换为等价的但状态空间巨大的HMM，从而开发出可扩展的滤波方法。新方法显著提高了计算性能，使fHMM能够高效分析大规模系统和数据集。
Motivation: 标准fHMM转化为HMM后状态空间指数增长，前向滤波等核心算法计算昂贵，限制了其在大型数据中的应用。
Method: 利用张量代数直接表示和处理fHMM的多维结构，设计了一种新的滤波算法，避免中间HMM构建，通过张量操作实现高效前向滤波。
Result: 新滤波方法显著提高了计算性能，使fHMM能够高效分析大型系统和数据集，但摘要未提供具体数值或对比。
Conclusion: 该研究为fHMM的可扩展分析提供了张量方法，扩展了fHMM在数据密集型时间序列分析中的应用范围。

papers.title: Dissociating the Internal Representations of Sycophancy in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently exhibit sycophancy, where they agree with a user's statement even when incorrect. While sycophancy is often treated as a single defined behavior, it can manifest in substantially distinct ways and circumstances, raising the question of whether this multi-faceted nature is reflected in its internal mechanisms. To address this gap, we dissociate the representations of sycophancy into factual and opinion subtypes -- motivated by the distinction between verifiable claims and subjective beliefs. We train linear probes and construct steering vectors on activations of one subtype and evaluate their transfer to the other subtype to measure to what extent they share representations. We find evidence that different LLMs represent these subtypes differently, with either more unified or more distinct and causally interfering representations. This method of dissociation offers a promising framework for studying the representational structure of complex model behaviors.
papers.comment: Accepted to Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型中谄媚行为的内部表示，将其分解为事实和观点两种子类型，通过线性探针和转向向量分析其表征是否共享。摘要表明不同LLM对这些子类型的表征方式不同，有的更统一，有的更独立甚至存在因果干扰。该方法为研究复杂模型行为的表征结构提供了框架。
Motivation: 谄媚行为常被视为单一行为，但其表现形式多样，研究其内部机制是否反映这种多面性。
Method: 使用线性探针和转向向量，分别针对事实和观点子类型的激活进行训练，然后评估跨子类型的迁移性能，以测量表征共享程度。
Result: 发现不同LLM对两种子类型的表征方式不同，有的更统一，有的更独立且存在因果干扰。
Conclusion: 这种分解方法为研究复杂模型行为的表征结构提供了有前景的框架。

papers.title: Ego-Human Motion Prediction with 3D-Aware LLM
papers.abstract_en: Anticipating human motion from an egocentric perspective is fundamental for proactive assistance in AR/VR, human-robot collaboration, and embodied AI. While recent works incorporate language as a semantic prior to reduce the ill-posed nature of egocentric forecasting, they largely neglect the 3D spatial and semantic context that governs how motion unfolds, and treat pose and language prediction as separate inference streams. We introduce Ego3DLM, built on two core principles: accurate motion forecasting requires explicit spatial and semantic understanding of the 3D environment, and pose and language must be predicted holistically in a single pass, since motion is inherently tied to the semantic interpretation of actions being performed. Given three-point tracking, 3D scene features, and egocentric video, Ego3DLM simultaneously decodes past pose, future pose, past narration, and future narration in a single autoregressive pass, grounding predicted poses and descriptions in one another to enforce cross-modal and temporal consistency. We adopt a three-stage training scheme: (1) spatial-semantic scene awareness pretraining; (2) holistic instruction tuning over all four outputs in a single pass; and (3) GRPO-based reinforcement finetuning with intra- and inter-modal rewards that directly optimize pose-language fidelity. Experiments on the Nymeria benchmark demonstrate that Ego3DLM achieves state-of-the-art performance across future motion prediction, past motion tracking, and motion description, showing that 3D scene grounding and holistic cross-modal prediction yield physically plausible and semantically coherent motion forecasts. The project page is available at https://jaewoo97.github.io/Ego3DLM/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Ego3DLM，一种基于 3D 感知大语言模型 (LLM) 的自我中心人类运动预测方法。该方法利用 3D 场景特征、三点追踪和第一人称视频，在一个自回归过程中同时解码过去和未来的姿态与描述，并通过三阶段训练（空间语义预训练、整体指令微调、GRPO 强化微调）实现跨模态和时间一致性。在 Nymeria 基准上，该方法在未来的运动预测、过去的运动跟踪和运动描述方面均达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有自我中心运动预测方法忽视 3D 空间和语义上下文，且将姿态和语言预测视为分离的推理流，导致预测不准确和不一致。
Method: Ego3DLM 基于两点核心原则：精确的运动预测需要显式的 3D 环境空间和语义理解，以及姿态和语言必须在单次推理中整体预测。采用三阶段训练：空间语义场景感知预训练、整体指令微调（同时预测四个输出）、以及基于 GRPO 的强化微调，使用模态内和模态间奖励直接优化姿态-语言保真度。
Result: 在 Nymeria 基准上，Ego3DLM 在未来的运动预测、过去的运动跟踪和运动描述任务上均取得最先进性能，表明 3D 场景锚定和整体跨模态预测能够产生物理合理且语义连贯的运动预测。
Conclusion: 3D 场景感知和跨模态整体预测是提升自我中心运动预测准确性和一致性的有效途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Physics-guided spatiotemporal neural models for fuel density prediction
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a physics-guided machine learning (PGML) framework for fuel density prediction, integrating physics constraints and domain knowledge into deep learning models to enhance model accuracy and stability. We explore three deep learning architectures -- ConvLSTM, Adaptive Fourier Neural Operator (AFNONet), and Video Vision Transformer (ViViT) -- to model the spatiotemporal evolution of fuel density. Our approach incorporates differentiable physics-informed terms in the loss function, including a mass-conserving fuel transport term and a rate-of-spread estimation. Experimental results, averaged across multiple independent trials, demonstrate that the proposed PGML framework outperforms purely data-driven baselines without physics constraints in both accuracy and stability. This framework enables computationally efficient, physically plausible fire forecasting to support adaptive prescribed burn management.

papers.title: Large Behavior Model: A Promptable Digital Twin of the Retail Customer
papers.abstract_en: Customer behavior modeling underpins recommendation, marketing, and decision support, yet existing approaches either optimize predictive accuracy without explaining decisions or simulate users without grounding them in real behavioral data. We present the Large Behavioral Model (LBM) that learns customer decision making directly from large-scale retail transactions through a unified Person-Environment formulation. Customer state is represented by a behavioral profile derived from historical purchases, while product context is incorporated through retrieval-augmented generation. The model is trained using continued pre-training on verbalized behavioral data, supervised fine-tuning for decision generation, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for evidence-based calibration. We evaluate the proposed framework on purchase prediction, hard-negative discrimination, basket completion, promotion response, and cross-domain voucher redemption. The model consistently outperforms frontier general-purpose language models on in-domain retail tasks while demonstrating strong zero-shot and fine-tuned transfer across retailers and decision domains. Ablation studies show that continued pre-training is the primary driver of behavioral generalization, retrieval is most effective when applied during both training and inference, and reinforcement learning improves reliance on explicit behavioral evidence over generic language-model priors. These results demonstrate that behavioral knowledge encoded in transaction histories can be effectively learned by language models, providing a scalable foundation for customer digital twins and behavior simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出大型行为模型 (LBM)，从大规模零售交易中学习客户决策，采用统一的 Person-Environment 表述。模型通过行为档案表示客户状态，结合检索增强生成融合产品上下文，训练包括持续预训练、监督微调和强化学习。在购买预测、难负样本判别、购物篮完成、促销响应和跨域券兑换等任务上，LBM 持续优于前沿通用语言模型，并展示出跨零售商和决策域的迁移能力。消融研究表明持续预训练是关键驱动，检索在训练和推理时同时使用最有效，强化学习增强对显性行为证据的依赖。
Motivation: 现有客户行为建模要么只优化预测准确性而不解释决策，要么模拟用户却不基于真实行为数据，缺乏可解释性和数据根基。本文旨在直接学习大规模交易中的决策逻辑，构建可提示的数字孪生。
Method: 提出 LBM，通过 Person-Environment 统一表述：客户状态来自历史购买的言语化行为档案，产品上下文经检索增强生成 (RAG) 融入。训练分三阶段：对言语化行为数据持续预训练、监督微调生成决策、强化学习 (可验证奖励) 校准证据依赖。
Result: 在购买预测、难负样本判别、购物篮完成、促销响应及跨域券兑换五个零售任务上，LBM 全面超越 GPT-4 等前沿通用模型，零样本和微调均表现出强跨域泛化。消融显示持续预训练贡献最大，检索在训练和推理阶段同时使用最佳，RL 减少对语言模型先验的依赖而增加对行为证据的引用。
Conclusion: 交易历史中的行为知识可被语言模型有效学习，为构建可扩展的客户数字孪生和行为模拟提供了实证基础。当前聚焦零售领域，未涉足天气等外部环境建模。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WAM-TTT: Steering World-Action Models by Watching Human Play at Test Time
papers.abstract_en: Steering robot foundation models (RFMs) toward new task variants or user-preferred behaviors remains challenging, often requiring additional robot demonstrations, task-specific fine-tuning, or long-context conditioning. We present WAM-TTT, a test-time training framework for steering world action models from raw human videos. Rather than treating human videos as trajectories to imitate, WAM-TTT absorbs them into a lightweight adaptive memory inside a frozen WAM through self-supervised video prediction. To make this memory useful for control, we introduce a meta-training stage that aligns human demonstrations with robot behaviors using paired human-robot data and a key--value memory reconstruction objective. At test time, only unlabeled human videos are required to adapt the memory, while the pretrained WAM remains frozen. This enables efficient and reusable steering without robot actions, human-side annotations, or task-specific fine-tuning, while preserving the generalization ability of the foundation model. Extensive experiments show that WAM-TTT consistently outperforms in-context human-video conditioning baselines across diverse manipulation tasks and generalization settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WAM-TTT，一种测试时训练框架，通过自监督视频预测将原始人类视频吸收到冻结的世界动作模型（WAM）的轻量级自适应记忆中，从而引导机器人行为。元训练阶段利用配对的人-机器人数据和键值记忆重构目标对齐人与机器人行为，测试时仅需未标注人类视频即可适应记忆。实验表明该方法在多种操作任务和泛化设置中优于内上下文人类视频调节基线。
Motivation: 现有的机器人基础模型（RFM）在引导至新任务变体或用户偏好行为时，通常需要额外的机器人演示、任务特定微调或长上下文条件，成本高且泛化受限。
Method: WAM-TTT 框架包含两个阶段：元训练阶段使用配对的人-机器人数据通过键值记忆重构目标训练自适应记忆，使人类演示与机器人行为对齐；测试时仅利用未标注人类视频通过自监督视频预测更新该记忆，而预训练 WAM 保持冻结，无需机器人动作或人类标注。
Result: 摘要报告在多种操作任务和泛化设置中，WAM-TTT 一致优于内上下文人类视频调节基线。
Conclusion: WAM-TTT 提供了一种高效且可复用的引导方法，无需机器人动作、人类标注或任务特定微调，同时保持基础模型的泛化能力。

papers.title: UP: Unbounded Positive Asymmetric Optimization for Breaking the Exploration-Stability Dilemma
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become the standard paradigm for enhancing the complex reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). To achieve sample efficiency, modern RL frameworks rely on importance sampling (IS). However, these algorithms suffer from an exploration-stability dilemma. Pure IS often leads to catastrophic training instability, while standard clipping mechanisms used to mitigate this instability strictly constrain the policy update budget. By formalizing the concept of Probability Capacity (Cap), we reveal that conservative clipping structurally stifles exploration by prematurely truncating the update budget for correct but low-confidence reasoning paths. To break free from these constraints, we propose Unbounded Positive Asymmetric Optimization (UP), a universal and plug-and-play objective. UP theoretically restructures the optimization process by anchoring the policy to its current state via the stop-gradient operator. This asymmetric design unleashes unclipped, stable gradients for positive advantages to maximize exploration, while maintaining standard clipping safeguards for negative advantages to prevent training instability. Furthermore, our formulation readily extends across different optimization granularities, including token-level (GRPO, DAPO) and sequence-level (GSPO) frameworks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UP enhances exploration capacity and achieves superior reasoning accuracy across diverse RL algorithms (DAPO, GSPO, and GRPO), model architectures (Dense, MoE, and vision-language), and training modalities (language and multimodal), validating UP as a truly universal plug-and-play enhancement for RL-based training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习（RL）在训练大语言模型（LLM）时面临的探索-稳定性困境，提出了无界正不对称优化（UP）方法。UP通过停梯度算子锚定策略到当前状态，实现对正优势的无界稳定梯度以最大化探索，同时保持负优势的标准裁剪以防止训练不稳定。该方法可推广到token级和序列级框架，实验表明UP能增强探索能力并提升推理准确率。
Motivation: 现有RL算法在LLM训练中依赖重要性采样（IS），但面临探索-稳定性困境：纯IS导致训练不稳定，而标准裁剪机制严格约束策略更新预算，过早截断正确但低置信度推理路径的更新，结构性抑制探索。
Method: 提出无界正不对称优化（UP），通过停梯度算子将策略锚定在当前状态，对正优势提供无裁剪的稳定梯度以最大化探索，对负优势保留标准裁剪以防止不稳定。UP可扩展到token级（GRPO、DAPO）和序列级（GSPO）框架。
Result: 实验表明UP在多种RL算法（DAPO、GSPO、GRPO）、模型架构（Dense、MoE、视觉语言）和训练模式（语言、多模态）上均能增强探索能力并提升推理准确率。
Conclusion: UP是一种通用的即插即用优化目标，可有效解决RL训练中的探索-稳定性困境，提升LLM推理能力。

papers.title: EdgeCompress: Coupling Multidimensional Model Compression and Dynamic Inference for EdgeAI
papers.abstract_en: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have demonstrated encouraging results in image classification tasks. However, the prohibitive computational cost of CNNs hinders the deployment of CNNs onto resource-constrained embedded devices. To address this issue, we propose EdgeCompress, a comprehensive compression framework to reduce the computational overhead of CNNs. In EdgeCompress, we first introduce dynamic image cropping (DIC), where we design a lightweight foreground predictor to accurately crop the most informative foreground object of input images for inference, which avoids redundant computation on background regions. Subsequently, we present compound shrinking (CS) to collaboratively compress the three dimensions (depth, width, and resolution) of CNNs according to their contribution to accuracy and model computation. DIC and CS together constitute a multidimensional CNN compression framework, which is able to comprehensively reduce the computational redundancy in both input images and neural network architectures, thereby improving the inference efficiency of CNNs. Further, we present a dynamic inference framework to efficiently process input images with different recognition difficulties, where we cascade multiple models with different complexities from our compression framework and dynamically adopt different models for different input images, which further compresses the computational redundancy and improves the inference efficiency of CNNs, facilitating the deployment of advanced CNNs onto embedded hardware. Experiments on ImageNet-1K demonstrate that EdgeCompress reduces the computation of ResNet-50 by 48.8% while improving the top-1 accuracy by 0.8%. Meanwhile, we improve the accuracy by 4.1% with similar computation compared to HRank, the state-of-the-art compression framework. The source code and models are available at https://github.com/ntuliuteam/edge-compress
papers.comment: Author's accepted version. Published in IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems (TCAD)
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems, vol. 42, no. 12, pp. 4657-4670, Dec. 2023
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EdgeCompress 是一个面向嵌入式设备的 CNN 多维压缩框架，结合动态图像裁剪（DIC）和复合收缩（CS）来减少计算冗余，并通过级联多复杂度模型实现动态推理。在 ImageNet-1K 上，ResNet-50 的计算量减少 48.8% 的同时 top-1 准确率提升 0.8%；与先进方法 HRank 相比，在相似计算量下准确率提升 4.1%。
Motivation: CNN 在图像分类中表现优异，但高昂的计算成本阻碍了其在资源受限的嵌入式设备上部署，需要有效的压缩方法来降低计算开销。
Method: 提出 EdgeCompress 框架，包含动态图像裁剪（DIC）使用轻量级前景预测器裁剪最信息丰富的前景区域，以及复合收缩（CS）协同压缩深度、宽度和分辨率三个维度，再通过级联多复杂度模型实现动态推理。
Result: 实验表明，在 ImageNet-1K 上，EdgeCompress 使 ResNet-50 计算量减少 48.8%，top-1 准确率提升 0.8%；与 HRank 相比，相似计算量下准确率提升 4.1%。
Conclusion: EdgeCompress 通过多维压缩和动态推理有效降低 CNN 计算冗余，提升推理效率，有利于在嵌入式硬件上部署先进 CNN 模型。

papers.title: Robust Federated Learning Under Real-World Client Churn
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) enables training shared models on private, on-device data, but production deployments remain constrained to slow, multi-day refresh cycles due to the complexity of coordinating massive client populations. For applications such as feed ranking, ad targeting, and personalized recommendation, model freshness: the ability to rapidly adapt to new user-local data is critical for maximizing objectives like click-through rate. This lag leaves models stale and unresponsive to volatile data distributions driven by viral trends and shifting user intent. Bridging this gap requires addressing three challenges overlooked by existing FL systems: transient client availability, dynamic data heterogeneity, and delays between model predictions and observable outcomes. We present FeLiX, an FL orchestration framework that minimizes wall-clock time-to-target accuracy on live interaction streams. FeLiX introduces three primitives: (i) streaming-aware availability tiers that leverage lightweight telemetry to identify ready clients at scale; (ii) fresh-utility selection, a dual-tier mechanism that prioritizes statistically valuable updates from devices able to meet tight refresh deadlines; and (iii) informativeness-aware, delay-robust aggregation that incorporates late, high-value updates containing ground-truth outcomes without biasing the global model toward stale distributions. Unlike prior systems that rely on unrealistic oracular knowledge of client availability, FeLiX achieves near-oracular performance in real-world settings. Across CIFAR-10, Google Speech, and realistic low-availability traces, FeLiX reduces wall-clock time-to-target accuracy by up to 2.37X while reducing communication bandwidth by 1.30X compared to state-of-the-art synchronous and asynchronous FL baselines.

papers.title: Hybrid Least Squares/Gradient Descent Methods for MIONets
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose an efficient hybrid least squares/gradient descent (LSGD) method for MIONets to accelerate training. This method generalizes the LSGD method for DeepONets. Since MIONet is the sum of the entrywise product of multiple branch networks and a trunk network, it can be viewed as a multilinear function with respect to the last layer parameters of each branch network. These sets of parameters can be optimized using the alternating least squares method, where we solve the LS system for a single branch network in turn. To handle the large-sized system matrix, we introduce Kronecker and Khatri-Rao products and tensor permutation matrices to factor the large matrix into small ones. Our method is compatible with a general type of $L^2$ loss with regularization terms for the last layer parameters of each branch, where linear operators can be applied to the MIONet output in each loss term.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于 MIONets 的高效混合最小二乘/梯度下降 (LSGD) 方法，以加速训练。该方法将 DeepONets 的 LSGD 方法推广到 MIONets，通过交替最小二乘法优化各分支网络的最后一层参数，并利用 Kronecker 和 Khatri-Rao 积分解大矩阵分解问题。方法兼容带正则项的 L2 损失。
Motivation: MIONet 训练速度慢，现有 LSGD 方法仅适用于 DeepONets，需要推广到多分支结构的 MIONets。
Method: 提出将 MIONet 视为多线性函数，对每个分支网络的最后一层参数采用交替最小二乘优化；引入 Kronecker 积、Khatri-Rao 积和张量置换矩阵来分解大型系统矩阵，降低计算复杂度。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称方法可以加速训练，并兼容多种 L2 损失与正则项。
Conclusion: 该方法为 MIONets 提供了一种高效的参数优化策略，适用于带线性算子的正则化损失。

papers.title: MILES: Modular Instruction Memory with Learnable Selection for Self-Improving LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly improve their reasoning at test time via additional computation, yet most existing works treat each problem in isolation. When problems arrive sequentially, accumulating reusable experience across them can further improve performance. Existing memory-based methods either store whole-solution templates that generalize poorly to novel problems or use heuristic step-level selection that is not optimized for final-answer correctness. Learning selection policies requires large-scale training data and fixed action spaces, making such approaches unsuitable for test-time settings where memory expands incrementally and only limited supervision is available. We propose MILES (Modular Instruction Memory with LEarnable Selection for self-improving LLM reasoning), a framework that dynamically expands step-wise memory and applies correctness-optimized memory composition under realistic test-time constraints. MILES maintains modular memory units consisting of asymmetric pairs of sub-goal embeddings and sub-instructions, each associated with a learnable selection head. This memory structure enables a coarse-to-fine retrieval mechanism: The coarse level enables memory expansion and collects supervision for training selection heads from confident samples, while the fine stage applies learned selection heads to rerank coarse-level candidates and guide reasoning for uncertain samples. MILES consistently matches or outperforms prior methods while achieving superior accuracy-efficiency tradeoffs. Extensive experiments demonstrate its effectiveness, robustness, and transferability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MILES框架，通过模块化指令记忆和可学习选择机制，使大语言模型在测试时动态积累经验并优化推理。该方法在多个推理任务上匹配或超越现有方法，并取得更好的准确率-效率权衡。
Motivation: 现有方法要么存储完整模板泛化能力差，要么使用启发式步骤选择未针对最终答案正确性优化。学习选择策略需要大规模训练数据和固定动作空间，不适合测试时内存动态扩展且监督有限的场景。
Method: MILES维护由子目标嵌入和子指令非对称对组成的模块化记忆单元，每个单元关联可学习的选择头。采用粗到细检索：粗级实现记忆扩展并从置信样本收集监督信号训练选择头，细级利用训练好的选择头对粗级候选重新排序，指导不确定样本的推理。
Result: 实验表明MILES在多个推理基准上一致匹配或超越先前方法，并实现更优的准确率-效率权衡。
Conclusion: MILES框架通过可学习的记忆选择和粗到细检索，在测试时有效增强LLM推理能力，且具有鲁棒性和可迁移性。

papers.title: Rethinking Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a new context-enriched, multimodal time series forecasting benchmark, TimesX. TimesX contains a wide selection of high-quality real-world time series with diverse domains and textual contexts obtained from an automated data generation pipeline, which helps address three main issues of existing multimodal forecasting benchmarks: (1) poor generalization due to the small scale and synthetic nature of benchmark data, (2) very limited types of textual contexts in the benchmarks, and (3) an inability to mitigate data leakage in evaluation. We conduct a thorough empirical study of zero-shot multimodal forecasting approaches on TimesX. Our results suggest that many approaches that perform well on existing benchmarks may fail on TimesX. In contrast, simple ensemble methods that leverage rich textual context accompanying time-series can outperform strong baselines on TimesX.
papers.journal_ref: Published in ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多模态时间序列预测基准TimesX，包含真实世界时间序列和文本上下文，旨在解决现有基准数据规模小、合成数据泛化差、文本上下文类型有限及评估数据泄露等问题。实验表明，许多在现有基准上表现好的方法在TimesX上失败，而利用丰富文本上下文的简单集成方法可超越强基线。
Motivation: 现有多模态时间序列预测基准存在数据规模小、合成数据泛化差、文本上下文类型有限及评估数据泄露等问题，亟需更真实、全面的基准来推动方法发展。
Method: 构建TimesX基准，通过自动数据生成管道收集高质量真实时间序列及多样化文本上下文，并对多种零样本多模态预测方法进行实证研究。
Result: 许多在现有基准上表现好的方法在TimesX上失败，而简单集成方法（利用丰富文本上下文）能超越强基线。
Conclusion: 当前多模态时间序列预测方法在更真实、多样的基准上表现不佳，简单集成方法利用文本上下文更具潜力，未来需关注数据质量与评估公平性。

papers.title: HPR-SAM: Hierarchical Probabilistic Representation Learning for Prompt-free SAM-based Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Prompt-free adaptation of the Segment Anything Model (SAM) has emerged as a promising paradigm for automatic medical image segmentation. Existing methods mainly focus on prompt generation, while overlooking that prompt quality is fundamentally constrained by the expressiveness of anatomical representations. However, deterministic prototypes or semantic tokens are insufficient to jointly capture global anatomical priors, intra-structure diversity, and local structural reliability. To address this limitation, we propose the Hierarchical Probabilistic Representation (HPR) framework, which learns complementary anatomical representations through Distributional Anatomical Representation (DAR), Multi-component Anatomical Representation (MAR), and Local Reliability Representation (LRR), and integrates their predictions via Hierarchical Prediction Fusion (HPF) while remaining compatible with the original SAM decoder. Experiments on the Synapse, LA, and PROMISE12 datasets demonstrate that HPR-SAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on Synapse and the best performance under few-shot settings on LA and PROMISE12, validating the effectiveness of the proposed hierarchical probabilistic representation learning framework for prompt-free medical image segmentation. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HPR-SAM-E4AF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于SAM的自动医学图像分割中提示质量受限于解剖表示表达能力的问题，提出层次概率表示（HPR）框架，通过分布解剖表示、多分量解剖表示和局部可靠性表示学习互补的解剖表示，并利用层次预测融合集成其预测。在Synapse、LA和PROMISE12数据集上，HPR-SAM在Synapse上取得最优性能，在LA和PROMISE12的少样本设置下表现最佳，验证了该方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有基于SAM的免提示医学图像分割方法专注于提示生成，却忽略了提示质量根本上受限于解剖表示的表达能力。确定性原型或语义标记难以共同捕捉全局解剖先验、结构内多样性和局部结构可靠性。
Method: 提出层次概率表示（HPR）框架，包含分布解剖表示（DAR）、多分量解剖表示（MAR）和局部可靠性表示（LRR），并通过层次预测融合（HPF）集成三者预测，与原始SAM解码器兼容。
Result: 在Synapse、LA和PROMISE12数据集上的实验显示，HPR-SAM在Synapse上达到最优性能，在LA和PROMISE12的少样本设置下取得最佳结果。
Conclusion: 摘要验证了层次概率表示学习框架在免提示医学图像分割中的有效性，但未讨论泛化到其他模态或局限性。
