papers.title: RWGBench: Evaluating Scholarly Positioning in Related Work Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have shown strong fluency in scientific writing, yet the evaluation of related work generation (RWG) remains limited. Existing RWG evaluations largely inherit summarization-oriented metrics, using lexical or semantic similarity to reference sections as proxies for quality. However, related work writing is fundamentally a citation-level scholarly positioning task: it requires selecting, organizing, and framing prior work to clarify how a target paper relates to, differs from, and contributes beyond existing research.As a result, models may generate coherent and semantically-relevant text while exhibiting academically critical failures, such as inappropriate citation selection or misplaced references, that conventional metrics do not capture.To this end, we introduce \textbf{RWGBench}, a benchmark that evaluates RWG from the perspective of citation decision-making rather than text similarity. RWGBench is constructed from a large-scale collection of 40,108 computer science papers and a retrieval corpus of 1.09 million documents, with a carefully curated test set comprising 100 papers and their corresponding published related work sections.We propose a multi-dimensional evaluation framework that assesses citation selection, contextual appropriateness, organization, and discourse structure.Experiments reveal systematic limitations in current systems that are obscured by standard evaluations, while Oracle studies further disentangle retrieval-level and generation-level bottlenecks. Human evaluation further shows that our citation-centric metrics align substantially better with expert judgment than surface-level text metrics. RWGBench offers a citation-centric testbed for developing and evaluating related work generation systems that are better aligned with scholarly writing practices.
papers.comment: 9 pages, code and data available at https://github.com/BFTree/RWGBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有相关工作总结生成（RWG）评估过度依赖摘要式文本相似度指标的问题，提出了一个从引用决策角度评估的基准 RWGBench。该基准包含40,108篇计算机科学论文和109万文档的检索语料库，并构建了多维评估框架，涵盖引用选择、上下文适宜性、组织结构和话语结构。实验表明，标准评估掩盖了系统的系统性局限，而引用中心指标与专家判断的一致性显著优于表面文本指标。
Motivation: 现有RWG评估继承摘要式指标，仅衡量与参考章节的词汇或语义相似度，无法捕捉学术写作中关键的引用决策失败，如不恰当的引用选择或位置错误。
Method: 构建RWGBench基准：从大规模论文集合中筛选100篇论文及其已发表的相关工作部分，提出多维评估框架，分别评估引用选择、上下文适宜性、组织结构和话语结构。
Result: 实验揭示当前系统存在标准评估不能发现的系统性局限；Oracle研究分离了检索级和生成级瓶颈；人类评估表明引用中心指标比表面文本指标与专家判断更一致。
Conclusion: RWGBench提供了一个以引用为中心的测试平台，用于开发更符合学术写作规范的相关工作总结生成系统。

papers.title: Unveiling the Visual Counting Bottleneck in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: While Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at interpolation, they suffer catastrophic failures in systematic generalization, most notably in visual counting. In this work, we investigate this extrapolation bottleneck by deconstructing visual counting into three cognitive stages: visual individuation, magnitude awareness, and symbolic mapping. Using synthetic Go boards and linear probes, we demonstrate that visual backbones maintain robust, linearly separable representations of quantity well into the extrapolation regime, ruling out perceptual failure. Furthermore, models retain latent magnitude awareness, successfully performing comparative reasoning on quantities they fail to enumerate. We pinpoint the collapse to the symbolic mapping stage, where the model fails to project valid visual magnitudes onto symbolic tokens. Our findings support a frac tured magnitude hypothesis: VLMs fail to acquire a universal number space, instead learning disjoint, modality-specific statistical manifolds that prevent cross-modal grounding for unseen quantities. Validated on the state-of-the-art foundation model, our results suggest that bridging this gap requires inductive priors enforcing unified representations, as data scaling alone is insufficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探究视觉语言模型（VLM）在视觉计数任务上系统性泛化失败的原因。通过将计数分解为视觉个体化、幅度感知和符号映射三个阶段，并使用合成Go棋盘和线性探针分析，发现视觉主干在外推范围内仍能保持数量特征的线性可分表示，模型也保留了幅度感知能力，但符号映射阶段出现崩溃，无法将有效视觉幅度投影为符号标记。作者提出分裂幅度假说：VLM未能习得统一的数量空间，而是学习了分离的、模态特定的统计流形，阻碍了对未见过数量的跨模态对齐。实验在最先进的基础模型上验证，表明需要归纳偏置强制统一表示，仅靠数据扩展不足。
Motivation: 现有VLM在插值任务上表现优异，但在系统泛化（尤其是视觉计数）上出现灾难性失败，此前缺乏对这一瓶颈的深入解构。
Method: 将视觉计数解构为视觉个体化、幅度感知和符号映射三个阶段，采用合成Go棋盘和线性探针工具，分别诊断各阶段的表示能力。
Result: 视觉主干在数量外推范围内仍能保持线性可分的数量表示，模型也能进行相对大小比较（幅度感知），但符号映射阶段失败，无法将有效幅度映射为正确符号计数。
Conclusion: 作者提出分裂幅度假说，认为模型未学到统一数量空间，而是分离的模态特定流形；仅靠数据扩展无法解决，需要引入强制统一表示的归纳偏置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cast a Wider Net: Coordinated Pass@K Policy Optimization for Code Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Repeated sampling with a verifier is the standard way to allocate test-time compute for code generation, with pass@$K$ as the canonical metric. Yet the standard policy class draws $K$ independent samples from a single answer distribution, so attempts often collapse onto near-duplicate reasoning paths and waste the budget on redundant rollouts. This failure is costly in competitive programming, where many problems admit multiple distinct algorithmic strategies and pass@$K$ requires only one correct attempt. We propose Coordinated Pass@$K$ Policy Optimization (CPPO), which turns pass@$K$ generation into joint exploration over strategies: a planner emits a tuple of $K{=}4$ alternative high-level methods, and a shared solver attempts one solution per method. CPPO trains this joint policy with a multiplicative planner reward, $R_{\mathrm{plan}} = J_ψ\cdot R_{\mathrm{out}}$, assigning credit only to valid strategy tuples that lead to verifier-confirmed pass@$K$ success. Across APPS, CodeContests, and LiveCodeBench-v6, CPPO improves pass@$4$ over direct sampling, planning baselines, planner-only SFT, and pass@$K$-oriented RL under the same $K{=}4$ solver-attempt budget, with statistically significant gains on six of nine model--benchmark cells. The largest single gain is $+0.16$ on Qwen3.5-9B LiveCodeBench-v6 over the strongest baseline, PKPO ($0.588 \rightarrow 0.748$; paired bootstrap, $p < 0.05$).
papers.comment: Code reasoning; pass@K optimization; coordinated planning; verifiable rewards; strategy diversity

papers.title: Chebyshev Policies and the Mountain Car Problem: Reinforcement Learning for Low-Dimensional Control Tasks
papers.abstract_en: We analytically solve the Mountain Car problem, a canonical benchmark in RL, and derive an optimal control solution, closing a gap after 36 years. This enables us to reveal two surprising insights: The optimal control is quite simple, yet modern RL agents display a large gap to optimality. Motivated by the analysis of the optimal control, we introduce Chebyshev policies as a universal (i.e. dense) class of RL policies from first principles. They can be trained as drop-in replacements of neural nets, reducing the regret by a factor of 6.18, while requiring 277 times fewer parameters, fostering sample efficiency, explainability and realtime capability. Chebyshev policies are evaluated on further RL tasks, including a real-world nonlinear motion control testbed. They consistently improve performance over neural nets with PPO, ARS and REINFORCE. Our results demonstrate how Chebyshev policies offer a compelling and lightweight alternative or addition to neural nets for low-dimensional control tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文解析求解了经典强化学习基准Mountain Car问题，得到最优控制解，揭示了现代RL agent与最优解之间存在显著差距。受此启发，从第一性原理提出Chebyshev策略，作为通用的策略函数类，可在低维控制任务中替代神经网络。实验表明，Chebyshev策略将regret降低6.18倍，参数减少277倍，且在PPO、ARS、REINFORCE等算法上一致优于神经网络。
Motivation: Mountain Car问题提出36年来尚未有解析最优解，使得现有RL agent的性能评估缺乏绝对基准。同时，神经网络策略在低维控制任务中参数冗余、可解释性差。
Method: 从最优控制的分析中推导出Chebyshev策略，这是一种基于切比雪夫多项式的密集函数类，可直接替换神经网络作为策略函数，用于任何RL算法（如PPO、ARS、REINFORCE）。
Result: 在Mountain Car任务上，Chebyshev策略将regret降低6.18倍，参数减少277倍。在多个低维控制任务（包括真实世界非线性运动控制平台）上，一致优于神经网络。
Conclusion: Chebyshev策略为低维控制任务提供了一种轻量级、可解释、实时性强的替代方案，有助于缩小RL agent与最优控制之间的差距。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Van Trees Lower Bound for Fully Interactive Differentially Private Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated differentially private protocols can communicate over many adaptive rounds and reuse each client's local samples. Existing lower bound arguments for federated DP are often restricted to noninteractive protocols or fresh batch decompositions, so the fundamental information-theoretic limit of estimation under fully interactive protocols remains unknown. We establish a federated van Trees inequality for parameter estimation under squared \ell_2 loss from any complete public transcript satisfying a clientwise zCDP constraint at the sample level. A scalar trace form covers homogeneous experiments, while a matrix form preserves directional Fisher geometry in heterogeneous experiments where different clients are informative in different subspaces. Together with existing upper bounds for the corresponding problems, these results identify the minimax rates for various statistical problems including mean estimation, linear regression, nonparametric regression, and functional mean estimation over the full class of interactive public-transcript protocols. For these problems, arbitrary public interaction and repeated sample reuse do not improve the rate over simpler restricted protocols. The key technical ingredient in our paper is a contraction inequality for the Fisher information in the transcript: each client's contribution is bounded both by the Fisher information in its local experiment and by its total privacy budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对完全交互式差分隐私联邦学习建立了Van Trees下界，证明在平方ℓ₂损失下的参数估计中，任意公共交互和重复样本使用不能改善受限协议的率。该下界覆盖标量和矩阵Fisher信息形式，结合已有上界确定了均值估计、线性回归等问题的极小极大率。
Motivation: 现有联邦差分隐私下界大多限于非交互协议或新鲜批次分解，完全交互协议下的信息论极限未知。
Method: 建立联邦Van Trees不等式，适用于满足客户端级zCDP约束的完全公共转录，包含标量迹形式和保持Fisher几何的矩阵形式。
Result: 确定了均值估计、线性回归、非参数回归等问题的极小极大率，表明完全交互不提高率。
Conclusion: 任意公共交互和重复样本使用不能改善联邦差分隐私估计的率，关键技巧是转录中Fisher信息的收缩不等式。

papers.title: Causal Inference with Categorical Unobserved Confounder via Mixture Learning
papers.abstract_en: Unobserved confounding is a fundamental challenge for estimating causal effects. To address unobserved confounding, recent literature has turned to two different approaches -- proxy variables and the use of multiple treatments. The first approach, commonly referred to as proximal causal inference, requires proxies to be assigned to specific asymmetric roles: treatment-inducing proxies (negative control exposures), variables that act as common causes of the treatment and outcome, and outcome-inducing proxies (negative control outcomes). In practice, however, identifying variables that satisfy these asymmetric roles can be difficult depending on the application domain. The second approach, commonly referred to as the ``Deconfounder," deals with multiple conditionally independent treatments. There has been limited progress towards developing a consistent estimation method for this setting. As the primary contribution of this work, we establish that causal effects are identifiable in both settings when the unobserved confounder is categorical under suitable conditions. Our approach builds on a mixture learning perspective: we show that the underlying confounding structure can be recovered by identifying the corresponding mixture distribution. We propose an estimation procedure based on tensor decomposition, which allows consistent recovery of the latent structure and comes with non-asymptotic guarantees. Simulation studies and real data experiments demonstrate that the proposed method performs well even with limited data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究未观测混杂（unobserved confounder）下的因果效应识别问题。作者从混合学习（mixture learning）视角出发，证明当未观测混杂变量是分类变量时，在代理变量（proximal causal inference）和多治疗（Deconfounder）两种设置下因果效应均可识别。提出基于张量分解（tensor decomposition）的估计方法，具有非渐近保证，模拟和真实数据实验表明方法在有限样本下表现良好。
Motivation: 未观测混杂是因果效应估计的根本挑战。现有两类方法——代理变量法和多治疗法——各有局限：代理变量需指定非对称角色变量，实践中难以辨识；多治疗法缺乏一致估计方法。本文旨在建立分类未观测混杂下因果效应的可识别性并提供一致估计。
Method: 采用混合学习视角，将未观测混杂结构视为混合分布，通过识别混合分布恢复混杂结构。估计过程基于张量分解，实现潜在结构的无偏恢复并给出非渐近误差界。
Result: 模拟研究和真实数据实验表明，所提方法在有限数据下表现良好。
Conclusion: 本文为分类未观测混杂下的因果推断提供了可识别性理论及实用估计方法，但未涉及连续混杂或更复杂场景。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: EgoExoMem: Cross-View Memory Reasoning over Synchronized Egocentric and Exocentric Videos
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric memory is widely used in embodied intelligence, but it may be insufficient for comprehensive spatial-temporal reasoning. Inspired by human recall from both field and observer perspectives, we introduce EgoExoMem, the first benchmark for cross-view memory reasoning over synchronized egocentric and exocentric videos. EgoExoMem contains $2.6K$ high-quality MCQs across eight temporal, spatial, and cross-view QA types. To support dual-view retrieval, we propose E$^2$-Select, a training-free frame selection method for synchronized ego-exo videos. It combines relevance-based budget allocation with per-view k-DPP sampling to handle view asymmetry and cross-view temporal consistency. Experiments show that ego and exo views provide complementary memory cues, while existing MLLMs remain far from solving the benchmark: the best model reaches only $55.3\%$. E$^2$-Select achieves state-of-the-art performance of $58.2\%$ over frame-selection and RAG-based memory baselines. Further analysis reveals systematic view-preference conflicts between question framing and answer grounding, underscoring the novelty and challenge of cross-view memory reasoning.
papers.comment: The source code and dataset can be found at https://github.com/RuipingL/EgoExoMem

papers.title: SNLP: Layer-Parallel Inference via Structured Newton Corrections
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive language models execute Transformer layers sequentially, creating a latency bottleneck that is not removed by conventional tensor or pipeline parallelism. We study whether this layerwise dependency can be relaxed by treating the hidden-state trace across layers as the solution of a nonlinear residual equation and solving it with parallel Newton-style updates. While this view is principled, exact Newton corrections require expensive Jacobian-vector products and naive fixed-point iterations are unstable on trained Transformers. We introduce Structured Newton Layer Parallelism (SNLP), a training and inference framework that replaces exact layer Jacobians with cheap architecture-induced surrogate dynamics. In residual Transformers, this yields Identity Newton (IDN), where the correction reduces to a prefix-sum-like update; in mHC-style architectures, HC Newton (HCN) uses the model's residual mixing matrix. We also study SNLP-aware training, including pretraining regularization and direct SNLP-forward SFT. Experiments on Nanochat-scale Transformers show that SNLP exposes a practical speed-quality frontier: on 0.5B models, it reaches up to 2.58x wall-clock speedup, and a less aggressive configuration reaches 1.40x speedup without increasing PPL. The useful tradeoff comes from the biased finite-iteration computation induced by IDN/HCN rather than exact recovery of the sequential trace. We further show that SNLP-forward SFT can preserve downstream task accuracy, and that SNLP can serve as a drafter for self-speculative decoding while a sequential verifier preserves output correctness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出结构化牛顿层并行（SNLP）框架，通过将Transformer层间隐藏状态轨迹视为非线性残差方程的解，并用并行牛顿风格更新替代顺序执行。在残差Transformer中推出恒等牛顿（IDN）方法，在mHC架构中推出HC牛顿（HCN）方法。实验表明，在0.5B模型上可实现2.58倍加速，且通过SNLP前向SFT可保持下游任务精度，并可作为自推测解码的草稿模型。
Motivation: 自回归语言模型按序执行Transformer层造成延迟瓶颈，传统张量或流水线并行无法消除。需要研究是否可以通过并行计算打破层间依赖。
Method: 将层间隐藏状态轨迹视为非线性残差方程的解，使用并行牛顿迭代求解。利用架构诱导的替代动力学近似精确雅可比，残差Transformer中简化为前缀和形式的IDN，mHC架构中利用残差混合矩阵得到HCN。并设计SNLP感知训练（预训练正则化和SNLP前向SFT）。
Result: 在0.5B Nanochat模型上，SNLP达到最高2.58倍墙钟加速；较温和配置在困惑度不增加下实现1.40倍加速。SNLP前向SFT保持下游任务准确率，并可作为自推测解码的草稿模型。
Conclusion: SNLP通过结构化牛顿校正实现了Transformer层并行推理，在速度-质量前沿上提供了实用权衡，且偏差来源于有限迭代的IDN/HCN近似而非精确恢复顺序轨迹。

papers.title: Structured Belief State and the First Precision-Aware Benchmark for LLM Memory Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Current LLM memory benchmarks evaluate answer quality rather than retrieval accuracy. Consequently, a system that dumps its entire belief store can achieve perfect recall and mask severe precision failures. We show this evaluation gap persists across multiple embedding models where similarity-based retrieval over domain-specific corpora inherently struggles to isolate target beliefs from semantically proximate ones. Furthermore, multi-turn topic drift compounds this retrieval noise while driving up latency and operational costs. To decouple retrieval quality from generative performance, we introduce PrecisionMemBench, an 89-case benchmark measuring precision, noise isolation, session latency, and belief mutability. We also present Tenure, a structured belief-store proxy that resolves scope and retrieval before inference and injects typed belief state as ambient instruction before the model sees the prompt, removing model-side discretion over whether memory is consulted. Evaluated across 13 providers, Tenure achieves perfect retrieval passes across all active, non-session, and session test cases. In contrast, the baseline configurations fail to reach even half of the active passes, with precision scores clustering at 0.22 and below. Our results demonstrate that while current memory systems successfully store information, they fail to retrieve it cleanly; a structural vulnerability that traditional answer-quality benchmarks conceal.
papers.comment: v3 expands systems evaluated, evidence to make the claim falsifiable and the benchmark reusable
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出现有 LLM 记忆基准评测的是答案质量而非检索准确率，导致系统可以倾倒全部信念存储来掩盖精度失败。作者引入 PrecisionMemBench（89用例基准）来测量精度、噪声隔离、会话延迟和信念可变性，并提出 Tenure 结构化的信念存储代理，在推理前解决范围和检索，将类型化信念状态作为环境指令注入，消除模型对是否使用记忆的自主决定。在13个提供商上的评估显示 Tenure 在所有测试用例上达到完美检索通过，而基线配置的精度分数低于0.22。
Motivation: 当前 LLM 记忆基准只评测答案质量，无法发现检索精度失败，且多轮话题漂移会加剧检索噪声并增加延迟和成本。
Method: 提出 PrecisionMemBench 基准和 Tenure 结构化信念存储代理，后者在推理前将信念状态作为环境指令注入，消除模型自主决定是否使用记忆。
Result: 在13个提供商上，Tenure 在所有测试用例上达到完美检索通过，而基线配置的精度分数低于0.22。
Conclusion: 结果表明当前记忆系统能成功存储信息但无法干净检索，而传统答案质量基准掩盖了这一结构性漏洞。

papers.title: MARGIN: Margin-Aware Regularized Geometry for Imbalanced Vulnerability Detection
papers.abstract_en: Software vulnerability detection is critical for ensuring software security and reliability. Despite recent advances in deep learning, real-world vulnerability datasets suffer from two severe challenges: frequency imbalance and difficulty imbalance. We reinterpret these challenges from an embedding geometry perspective, observing that such imbalances induce geometric distortions in hyperspherical representation space. To address this issue, we propose MARGIN, a metric-based framework that learns discriminative vulnerability representations through adaptive margin metric learning and hyperspherical prototype modeling. MARGIN dynamically adjusts geometric regularization according to the distribution structure estimated by the von Mises-Fisher concentration, aligning the probability mass of embedding distributions with their corresponding Voronoi cells, thereby reducing geometric distortion and yielding more stable decision boundaries. Extensive experiments on public vulnerability datasets show that MARGIN consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving notable improvements in classification and detection, especially on challenging, imbalanced datasets. Further analysis demonstrates that MARGIN produces more structured embedding geometries, improving robustness, interpretability, and generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对软件漏洞检测中数据集的频率不平衡和难度不平衡问题，从嵌入几何角度重新解释，并提出MARGIN框架。该框架通过自适应边际度量学习和超球面原型建模，动态调整几何正则化，减少几何畸变并稳定决策边界。在公共漏洞数据集上的实验表明，MARGIN在分类和检测任务上显著优于强基线，尤其在挑战性的不平衡数据集上表现突出。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法在真实漏洞数据集上面对频率不平衡和难度不平衡挑战，导致嵌入空间出现几何畸变，影响模型性能。
Method: 提出基于度量的MARGIN框架，利用von Mises-Fisher浓度估计分布结构，动态调整几何正则化，使嵌入分布的概率质量与对应Voronoi单元对齐，从而学习判别性表示。
Result: 在公共漏洞数据集上，MARGIN持续优于多个强基线，特别在困难和不平衡数据集上取得显著提升，并生成更结构化的嵌入几何，提高了鲁棒性、可解释性和泛化性。
Conclusion: MARGIN通过自适应边际学习和超球面原型建模有效缓解了不平衡问题，为软件漏洞检测提供了更稳定和鲁棒的几何表示。

papers.title: Nectar: Neural Estimation of Cached-Token Attention via Regression
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating softmax attention over a fixed long context requires reading every cached key-value pair for each new query token. For a given context (a book, a manual, a legal corpus) the attention output is a deterministic function of the query. We propose Nectar, which fits a compact neural network to this function for queries drawn from a task-relevant distribution. Nectar fits two networks per layer and KV-head: a target network that predicts the attention output and a score network that predicts the log-normalizer. The pair plugs into the standard masked self-attention at inference time, replacing the $O(n)$ attention over the cache with a forward pass whose cost does not depend on $n$. Each module carries on the order of $|θ|$ parameters per layer and KV-head, typically much smaller than the $2nd$ KV-cache footprint at the same granularity. We report experiments on models from 1.7B to 8B parameters across five long-context datasets. The approximation error tracks the next-token accuracy gap to full attention, and allocating capacity non-uniformly across layers reduces that gap in our ablation. Beyond this analysis of metrics, we check that the text generations (following a question prompt) of a model equipped with a Nectar module match in semantic content those obtained by giving the same model access to the full cache.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Nectar，一种通过训练紧凑神经网络替代 softmax 注意力中 O(n) 缓存读取的方法。它使用两个网络（目标网络和分数网络）预测注意力输出，推理时成本与缓存大小无关。在 1.7B-8B 参数模型上的实验表明，近似误差接近完整注意力的 next-token 准确率差距，且不同层非均匀分配容量可缩小差距。生成文本的语义内容也与完整缓存匹配。
Motivation: 评估固定长上下文的 softmax 注意力需要为每个查询读取所有缓存的 key-value 对，成本 O(n)，效率低。
Method: 提出 Nectar，为每层每头拟合两个网络：目标网络预测注意力输出，分数网络预测对数归一化因子。推理时替代标准掩码自注意力中的 O(n) 操作，前向传播成本与 n 无关。
Result: 在 1.7B-8B 参数的五个长上下文数据集上，近似误差接近完整注意力的 next-token 准确率差距；非均匀层间容量分配进一步缩小差距；生成文本的语义内容与完整缓存一致。
Conclusion: Nectar 能有效以低计算成本近似长上下文注意力，代价是可控的准确率损失，且生成质量保持。

papers.title: M$^3$: Reframing Training Measures for Discretized Physical Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Neural surrogate models for physical simulations are trained on discretized samples of continuous domains, where the induced empirical measure leads to uneven supervision, biasing optimization and causing spatial inconsistencies in physical fidelity. To mitigate this measure-induced bias, we propose M$^3$ (Multi-scale Morton Measure), a scalable framework that balances training measures by partitioning space according to physical variation and allocating supervision across multiple scales. Applied to three industrial-scale datasets with diverse discretizations, M$^3$ consistently improves predictions in the continuous physical domain, achieving up to 4.7$\times$ lower error in large-scale volumetric cases. These gains persist under aggressive subsampling (160M $\rightarrow$ 16M $\rightarrow$ 1.6M points), where M$^3$-trained models outperform those trained on higher-resolution data, reducing physics-weighted relative $L_2$ error by 3--4$\times$ and the corresponding MSE by up to 13$\times$. These results highlight data distribution as a key factor in operator learning and position M$^3$ as a scalable, data-efficient approach for physically consistent modeling. Code is available at https://github.com/PhysDataRefine/M3.

papers.title: From Beats to Breaches:How Offensive AI Infers Sensitive User Information from Playlists
papers.abstract_en: The pervasive integration of AI has enabled Offensive AI: the exploitation of AI for malicious ends across the cyber-kill chain. A critical manifestation is the user attribute inference attack, where AI infers sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII) from innocuous public data. We explore how music streaming ecosystems, where users routinely release public playlists, can be exploited for Offensive AI. To quantify this threat, we developed musicPIIrate. This novel tool leverages deep learning architectures that utilize both standalone data representations and the structural information embedded in a user's playlist collection. Our design explores set-based approaches (e.g., Deep Sets) and methodologies modeling relationships between playlists (e.g., Graph Neural Networks), which we also combine to leverage both perspectives. Our approach addresses feature extraction from unordered, variable-length set data, enabling accurate PII prediction. Empirical evaluation demonstrates that musicPIIrate achieves state-of-the-art inference accuracy. The tool successfully infers a wide array of attributes, including: Demographics (Age, Country, Gender), Habits (Alcohol, Smoke, Sport), and Personality Traits (OCEAN scores). musicPIIrate outperforms existing methods, beating baselines in 9 out of 15 attribute inference tasks. To counter this vulnerability, we propose JamShield, a lightweight defensive framework. JamShield strategically injects dummy playlists into an account to dilute the PII-carrying signal. Our analysis indicates that JamShield represents a promising defense, lowering inference F1-scores by an average of 10%. This work provides an initial Offensive-AI benchmark for playlist-based PII inference using architectures that leverage set- and graph-structured data and introduces a defense showing encouraging mitigation effects.
papers.comment: This paper is accepted at IEEE EuroS&P 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了如何利用AI从音乐流媒体平台的公开播放列表中推断用户的敏感个人信息（如年龄、国家、性别、生活习惯、人格特质等），提出了一种名为musicPIIrate的工具，采用基于集合和图神经网络的方法从无序、变长的播放列表数据中提取特征并实现高精度推断。同时，提出了轻量级防御框架JamShield，通过注入虚假播放列表来稀释个人信息信号，使推断F1分数平均降低10%。该工作为基于播放列表的个人信息推断提供了基准测试，并展示了初步的防御效果。
Motivation: 现有研究关注AI在恶意场景下的应用（Offensive AI），但音乐播放列表这类公开数据是否会被用于推断敏感个人信息尚未得到充分量化。本文旨在揭示这一隐私泄露风险。
Method: 提出musicPIIrate工具，利用深度学习方法处理无序、变长的播放列表集，探索基于集合的方法（如Deep Sets）和建模播放列表间关系的方法（如图神经网络），并将二者结合以同时利用独立数据表示和结构信息。防御部分提出JamShield，通过向用户账户中注入虚假播放列表来稀释特征信号。
Result: musicPIIrate在15个属性推断任务中9个超过基线，达到最先进的推断准确率；JamShield防御使推断F1分数平均降低10%。
Conclusion: 本文首次为基于播放列表的个人信息推断提供了Offensive-AI基准，并验证了利用集合和图结构数据架构的有效性；提出的JamShield防御显示出有希望的缓解效果。

papers.title: TeamTR: Trust-Region Fine-Tuning for Multi-Agent LLM Coordination
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems have shown promise for complex reasoning, yet recent evaluations reveal they often underperform single-model baselines. We identify a structural failure mode in sequential fine-tuning of shared-context teams: updating one agent shifts the team's context distribution, and when subsequent updates are evaluated on cached rollouts, this mismatch compounds. We formalize this as the compounding occupancy shift and prove that stale-occupancy evaluation incurs a penalty that scales quadratically with the number of agents. In contrast, intermediate-occupancy evaluation reduces this to linear scaling. We propose TeamTR, a trust-region framework that resamples trajectories after each component update and enforces per-agent divergence control, yielding rigorous per-update and per-stage improvement lower bounds. Experiments show that TeamTR outperforms single-agent and sequential baselines with 7.1% on average, mitigates coordination regressions, and supports plug-and-play component replacement. Code is available at https://github.com/Yydc/TeamTR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了多智能体LLM系统在序列微调中因上下文分布偏移导致的性能退化问题，形式化为复合占位偏移（compounding occupancy shift），并证明了基于过期轨迹的评估惩罚随智能体数量二次增长。提出信任区域框架TeamTR，通过重采样轨迹和每智能体散度控制，实现了每更新和每阶段的严格改进下界，平均性能提升7.1%。
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统在复杂推理任务中常表现不如单模型基线，现有序列微调方法因上下文分布偏移导致性能退化，缺乏严格的训练保证。
Method: 提出TeamTR信任区域微调框架：在每个组件更新后重新采样轨迹，并施加每智能体的散度控制，从而得到严格的每更新和每阶段改进下界。
Result: 实验表明，TeamTR平均比单智能体和序列基线提升7.1%，减轻了协调退化，并支持即插即用的组件替换。
Conclusion: 复合占位偏移是多智能体LLM微调的关键障碍，所提信任区域方法能有效缓解，为多智能体协调提供了理论保证和实践优势。

papers.title: Health System Scale Semantic Search Across Unstructured Clinical Notes
papers.abstract_en: Introduction: Semantic search, which retrieves documents based on conceptual similarity rather than keywords, offers advantages for retrieval of clinical information. However, deploying semantic search across health systems, comprising hundreds of millions of clinical notes, presents formidable engineering, cost, and governance challenges that have prevented institutional adoption. Methods: We deployed a semantic search system at a large children's hospital indexing 166 million clinical notes (484 million embedding vectors) from 1.68 million patients. The system uses instruction-tuned qwen3-embedding-0.6B embeddings, stores vectors with storage-optimized indexing, maintains full-text metadata in a low-latency key-value store, and operates within a HIPAA-compliant governance framework. We evaluated the system by optimizing the model and chunking strategy using a physician-authored benchmark, characterizing full-scale performance (cost, latency, retrieval quality), and assessing clinical utility via chart abstraction efficiency and comparison to ICD-10 cohort generation. Results: The system delivers sub-second query latency with monthly operational costs of ~USD 4,000. Qwen3 embeddings with 300-token chunk size achieved 94.6% accuracy on the benchmark. In clinical utility evaluation across three abstraction tasks, semantic search reduced time-to-completion by 24 to 89% versus chart review while maintaining inter-rater agreement where assessable. During system-wide retrieval, semantic search recovered 98% of patients with molecularly confirmed genetic diseases, versus at most 75% by diagnosis codes. Conclusion: Health-system-scale semantic search is technically and operationally feasible. The system provides institutional infrastructure supporting interactive search, cohort generation, and downstream LLM-powered clinical applications without requiring specialized informatics expertise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在大型儿童医院部署了语义搜索系统，索引了1.66亿份临床笔记（4.84亿嵌入向量），基于指令微调的qwen3-embedding-0.6B模型和存储优化索引，在HIPAA合规框架下运行。系统实现亚秒级查询延迟，月运营成本约4000美元，在临床基准上达到94.6%准确率，并在图表抽象任务中将完成时间减少24%至89%，比诊断编码更有效地检索遗传病患者。
Motivation: 语义搜索在临床信息检索中具有概念相似性匹配的优势，但跨健康系统部署面临工程、成本和治理挑战，尚无机构大规模采用。
Method: 部署系统使用指令微调的qwen3-embedding-0.6B嵌入模型，采用300词块大小，结合存储优化索引和低延迟键值存储，在HIPAA合规框架下运行。
Result: 系统实现亚秒级查询延迟，月成本约4000美元；在医生编写的基准上达到94.6%准确率；在三个抽象任务中，语义搜索将完成时间减少24%至89%，并恢复了98%的经分子确认的遗传病患者（诊断编码最多75%）。
Conclusion: 健康系统规模的语义搜索在技术和操作上可行，为交互式搜索、队列生成和下游LLM临床应用提供基础架构，无需专门信息学专业知识。

papers.title: Participatory provenance as representational auditing for AI-mediated public consultation
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence is increasingly deployed to synthesize large-scale public input in policy consultations and participatory processes. Yet no formal framework exists for auditing whether these summaries faithfully represent the source population, an accountability gap that existing approaches to AI explainability, grounding and hallucination detection do not address because they focus on output quality rather than input fidelity. Here, participatory provenance is introduced: a measurement framework grounded in optimal transport theory, causal inference and semantic analysis that tracks how individual public submissions are transformed, filtered or lost through AI-mediated summarization. Applied to Canada's 2025-2026 national AI Strategy consultation ($n = 5{,}253$ respondents across two independent policy topics), the framework reveals that both official government summaries underperform a random-participant baseline ($-9.1\%$ and $-8.0\%$ coverage degradation), with $16.9\%$ and $15.3\%$ of participants effectively excluded. Exclusion concentrates in clusters expressing dissent, scepticism and critique of AI ($33$-$88\%$ exclusion rates). Brevity, semantic isolation and rhetorical register independently predict representational outcome. An accompanying open-source interactive tool, the Co-creation Provenance Lab, enables policymakers to audit and iteratively improve summaries, establishing genuine human-in-the-loop oversight at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出参与式溯源（participatory provenance）作为衡量AI媒介总结是否忠实代表公众意见的审计框架，基于最优传输、因果推断和语义分析追踪个体意见在AI总结中的转换、过滤或丢失。应用于加拿大2025-2026年国家AI战略咨询（n=5,253）发现，官方总结在覆盖率上比随机参与者基线低9.1%和8.0%，16.9%和15.3%的参与者被有效排除，且排除集中在表达异议、怀疑和批评AI的群体。
Motivation: AI被用于综合大规模公众意见，但缺乏审计这些总结是否忠实代表源人群的形式化框架，现有可解释性、基础性和幻觉检测方法关注输出质量而非输入忠实度，无法填补这一问责空白。
Method: 引入参与式溯源框架，结合最优传输理论、因果推断和语义分析，量化AI媒介总结中个体意见的变换、过滤或丢失过程。
Result: 在加拿大国家AI战略咨询数据上，官方总结覆盖率比随机参与者基线低9.1%和8.0%，16.9%和15.3%的参与者被有效排除，异议、怀疑和批评AI群体的排除率高达33%-88%。
Conclusion: 参与式溯源为AI媒介的公众咨询提供了可操作的审计工具，并开源了Co-creation Provenance Lab，使政策制定者能够审计和迭代改进总结，实现规模化的真正人类参与监督。

papers.title: Allo{SR}$^2$: Rectifying One-Step Super-Resolution to Stay Real via Allomorphic Generative Flows
papers.abstract_en: Real-world image super-resolution (Real-SR) has been revolutionized by leveraging the powerful generative priors from Diffusion Models (DMs) and Flow Matching (FM). However, existing one-step methods typically replace Gaussian noise with degraded low-resolution (LR) latents at initialization, introducing a substantial distribution shift that further leads to trajectory deviation and prior collapse under extreme acceleration. To overcome these limitations, we propose Allo{SR}$^2$, a novel FM-based framework that rectifies one-step SR flows via allomorphic generative flows to maintain high-fidelity generative realism. Specifically, we utilize SNR-Guided Trajectory Initialization to identify a statistically aligned intermediate state along the pre-trained path to integrate LR representations into the generative flow. To ensure a stable, low-curvature path for one-step inference, we propose Flow-Anchored Trajectory Consistency (FATC), which explicitly regularizes the velocity field of the underlying probability flow. Furthermore, we develop Allomorphic Trajectory Matching (ATM), a self-adversarial distillation strategy that jointly models the SR flow and the generative flow within a unified velocity field, enabling one-step Real-SR while preserving the generative prior. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that Allo{SR}$^2$ achieves state-of-the-art performance in one-step Real-SR, offering a superior balance between fidelity and realism while maintaining extreme efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Allo{SR}$^2$，一种基于流匹配（Flow Matching）的框架，用于单步真实图像超分辨率（Real-SR）。通过信噪比引导的轨迹初始化（SNR-Guided Trajectory Initialization）、流锚定轨迹一致性（FATC）和同态轨迹匹配（ATM）自对抗蒸馏策略，纠正单步SR流中的分布偏移和轨迹偏差，在合成和真实基准上实现保真度与真实感的最佳平衡。
Motivation: 现有单步超分辨率方法通常用退化低分辨率隐变量替换高斯噪声初始化，导致分布偏移、轨迹偏离和先验崩溃，限制了生成真实感和效率。
Method: 提出三部分：SNR-Guided Trajectory Initialization 定位统计对齐的中间状态；Flow-Anchored Trajectory Consistency (FATC) 正则化速度场以实现低曲率路径；Allomorphic Trajectory Matching (ATM) 自对抗蒸馏联合建模SR流与生成流，实现单步推理。
Result: 在合成和真实世界基准上达到单步Real-SR的最先进性能，在保真度与真实感之间取得优越平衡，同时保持极高效率。
Conclusion: 该框架通过纠正流轨迹和保持生成先验，为单步真实图像超分辨率提供了高效且高质量的解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AnyPoC: Universal Proof-of-Concept Test Generation for Scalable LLM-Based Bug Detection
papers.abstract_en: While recent LLM-based agents can identify many candidate bugs in source code, their reports remain static hypotheses that require manual validation, limiting the practicality of automated bug detection. We frame this challenge as a test generation task: given a candidate report, synthesizing an executable proof-of-concept (PoC) - such as a script, command sequence, or crafted input - to trigger the suspected defect. Automated PoC generation can act as a scalable validation oracle, enabling end-to-end autonomous bug detection by providing concrete execution evidence. However, naive LLM agents are unreliable validators: they are biased toward "success" and may reward-hack by producing plausible but non-functional PoCs or even hallucinated traces. To address this, we present ANYPoC, a general multi-agent framework that (1) analyzes and fact-checks a candidate bug report, (2) iteratively synthesizes and executes a PoC while collecting execution traces, and (3) independently re-executes and scrutinizes the PoC to mitigate hallucination and reward hacking. In addition, ANYPoC also continuously extracts and evolves a PoC knowledge base to handle heterogeneous tasks. ANYPoC operates on candidate bug reports regardless of their source and can be paired with different bug reporters. To demonstrate practicality and generality, we apply ANYPoC, together with a simple agentic bug reporter, on 12 large-scale, critical software systems, including Firefox, Chromium, LLVM, OpenSSL, SQLite, FFmpeg, and Redis. Compared to the state-of-the-art coding agents, e.g., Claude Code and Codex, ANYPoC produces 37% more valid PoCs for true-positive bug reports and rejects 9.7x more false-positive bug reports. ANYPoC also enables the discovery of 121 new bugs from over two thousand noisy bug reports, with 108 confirmed by developers and 92 fixed. 46 PoCs have also been adopted as official regression tests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个通用多智能体框架 AnyPoC，用于基于 LLM 的漏洞检测中自动生成可执行的概念验证 (PoC)，以替代人工验证。该框架通过迭代合成、执行和独立复核 PoC 来减少幻觉和奖励黑客问题，并在 Firefox、Chromium 等 12 个大型软件系统上验证，相比 Claude Code 和 Codex 产生 37% 更多有效 PoC，拒绝 9.7 倍更多假阳性报告，发现 121 个新漏洞，其中 108 个被开发者确认。
Motivation: 当前基于 LLM 的漏洞检测智能体只能报告候选漏洞，但缺乏自动验证手段，需要人工验证，限制了实用性。现有 LLM 作为验证器不可靠，倾向于虚假成功或产生无功能的 PoC。
Method: 提出 AnyPoC 多智能体框架，包含三个模块：(1) 分析并事实核查候选漏洞报告；(2) 迭代合成并执行 PoC，收集执行轨迹；(3) 独立重新执行并审查 PoC 以减轻幻觉和奖励黑客。此外，持续提取和演化 PoC 知识库以适应异构任务。
Result: 在 12 个大型软件系统上，AnyPoC 相比 Claude Code 和 Codex 产生 37% 更多有效 PoC（针对真阳性报告），拒绝 9.7 倍更多假阳性报告。从超过两千个噪声报告中发现了 121 个新漏洞，其中 108 个被开发者确认，92 个已修复，46 个 PoC 被采纳为官方回归测试。
Conclusion: AnyPoC 可作为一个可扩展的验证 oracle，实现端到端的自动漏洞检测，并且其通用性允许与不同的漏洞报告器配合使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diversity Without Fidelity: A Solver-Sampler Mismatch in Multi-Agent LLM Negotiation Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Language models are increasingly used to simulate people: survey respondents, negotiators, stakeholders in policy exercises. In that role a model should reproduce how people plausibly behave, hesitating, conceding late, and settling for imperfect deals, rather than playing the best move. We call this the sampler role, in contrast to the solver role of finding the best move, and we test how the reasoning modes providers ship to strengthen models as solvers affect it. Our testbed is multi-party negotiation: five agents bargain over a regulation for fifteen turns, and unresolved issues are decided by an authority. Agents without a structured memory of the negotiation almost never reach agreement, whether reasoning is on or off: 314 of 315 such runs end with the authority deciding. What reasoning changes is how the failure looks. With reasoning enabled, one model family negotiates visibly, with varied moves, concessions in most runs, and a different path every time, yet still ends without agreement in fifteen runs of fifteen. Diversity checks would pass a model whose endings never change. Two further results show the task permits agreement: when agents write their own short running notes on the negotiation, agreement becomes the norm, while the same notes supplied ready-made change nothing; and hand-coded agents following textbook concession strategies agree in most runs under identical rules. Simulation pipelines should therefore vet models as samplers, on the distributions of outcomes they produce. Fidelity as a sampler must be tested on its own: solver strength is no guide to it, and switching on reasoning leaves it where it was.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 2 figures. Substantially revised. Formerly titled "When Reasoning Models Hurt Behavioral Simulation: A Solver-Sampler Mismatch in Multi-Agent LLM Negotiation"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体LLM在谈判模拟中作为“采样器”（再现人类行为）与“求解器”（最优行动）的错配问题。实验表明，即使推理模式增强，无结构化记忆的智能体几乎无法达成协议（315次中314次由权威决定），且推理虽增加行为多样性但不改变结果分布；而智能体自行记录谈判笔记可达成协议。结论是模拟管线需单独测试模型作为采样器的保真度，求解器能力不能预测采样器性能。
Motivation: LLM越来越多用于模拟人类行为（如谈判），但模型通常被训练为求解器（最优行动），而作为采样器需要再现人类不完美行为（犹豫、让步等）。现有方法未区分这两种角色，且推理模式对采样器保真度的影响未知。
Method: 设计五方谈判模拟（15轮），智能体为LLM（推理开/关），测试是否达成协议；对比有无结构化记忆、自写笔记和预写笔记的影响；并用手工编码智能体作为基线。
Result: 无结构化记忆时，315次中314次由权威决定（无论推理是否开启）；推理增加行为多样性和让步，但15次实验均未达成协议。自写笔记使协议成为常态，预写笔记无效；手工编码智能体大多达成协议。
Conclusion: 模拟管线应专门测试模型作为采样器的分布保真度，因为求解器能力不能指导采样器性能，且推理模式不改变采样器保真度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Transferable FB-GNN-MBE Framework for Potential Energy Surfaces: Data-Adaptive Transfer Learning in Deep Learned Many-Body Expansion Theory
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic understanding and rational design of complex chemical systems depend on fast and accurate predictions of electronic structures beyond individual building blocks. However, if the system exceeds hundreds of atoms, first-principles quantum mechanical (QM) modeling becomes impractical. In this study, we developed FB-GNN-MBE by integrating a fragment-based graph neural network (FB-GNN) into the many-body expansion (MBE) theory and demonstrated its capacity to reproduce first-principles potential energy surfaces (PES) for hierarchically structured systems with manageable accuracy, complexity, and interpretability. Specifically, we divided the entire system into basic building blocks (fragments), evaluated their one-fragment energies using a QM model, and addressed many-fragment interactions using the structure-property relationships trained by FB-GNNs. Our investigation shows that FB-GNN-MBE achieves chemical accuracy in predicting two-body (2B) and three-body (3B) energies across water, phenol, and mixture benchmarks, as well as the one-dimensional dissociation curves of water and phenol dimers. To transfer the success of FB-GNN-MBE across various systems with minimal computational costs and data demands, we developed and validated a teacher-student learning protocol. A heavy-weight FB-GNN trained on a mixed-density water cluster ensemble (teacher) distills its learned knowledge and passes it to a light-weight GNN (student), which is later fine-tuned on a uniform-density (H2O)21 cluster ensemble. This transfer learning strategy resulted in efficient and accurate prediction of 2B and 3B energies for variously sized water clusters without retraining. Our transferable FB-GNN-MBE framework outperformed conventional non-FB-GNN-based models and provided a scalable and accurate route toward interaction energies of large molecular assemblies.
papers.comment: Under review with The Journal of Chemical Physics. Main text: 23 pages, 11 figures, and 1 table. Supplementary Materials: 29 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables, 4 pseudo-algorithms
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FB-GNN-MBE 框架，将基于片段的图神经网络 (FB-GNN) 嵌入多体展开 (MBE) 理论中，用于预测层次结构体系的势能面 (PES)。该方法将体系划分为基本片段，用 QM 模型计算单片段能量，并用 FB-GNN 学习多片段相互作用。在水分、苯酚及其混合物基准上，FB-GNN-MBE 实现了两体和三体能量的化学精度，并复现了一维解离曲线。为迁移到其他体系，开发了教师-学生蒸馏协议：重型 FB-GNN（教师）在混合密度水团簇上训练，蒸馏知识给轻量 GNN（学生），然后在均匀密度 (H2O)21 团簇上微调，无需重新训练即可准确预测不同大小水团簇的多体能量。
Motivation: 复杂化学体系中，当原子数超过数百时，第一性原理量子力学 (QM) 建模计算成本过高。现有方法在精度、可解释性和计算量之间难以平衡。
Method: 将体系分解为片段，用 QM 计算单片段能量，用 FB-GNN 学习多片段相互作用（两体、三体）。迁移学习采用教师-学生蒸馏：重型 FB-GNN 教师（混合密度水团簇）训练后，将知识蒸馏给轻量 GNN 学生，再在均匀密度水团簇上微调。
Result: FB-GNN-MBE 在水分、苯酚及混合基准上实现化学精度（两体和三体能量），并准确预测水和苯酚二聚体的一维解离曲线。迁移学习后，学生模型能高效准确预测不同大小水团簇的多体能量，无需重新训练，优于非 FB-GNN 模型。
Conclusion: FB-GNN-MBE 框架为大规模分子组装体的相互作用能提供了可扩展且准确的途径，兼具可解释性和低计算需求。迁移学习策略进一步降低了数据需求。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Are GUI Agents Focused Enough? Automated Distraction via Semantic-level UI Element Injection
papers.abstract_en: Existing red-teaming studies on GUI agents face two fundamental limitations: adversarial perturbations require white-box access unavailable in commercial deployments, while prompt injection is increasingly neutralized by stronger safety alignment. To study robustness under a more practical threat model, we propose Semantic-level UI Element Injection, a black-box red-teaming paradigm that overlays safety-aligned and harmless UI elements onto screenshots to misdirect the agent's visual grounding. Our method couples a modular Editor--Overlapper--Victim pipeline with iterative search that samples multiple candidate edits, keeps the best cumulative overlay, and adapts future prompt strategies based on previous failures. Experiments across 19 victim models spanning 8 model families show that strategic optimization substantially outperforms random injection (3.5-6.9x on the most robust victims) and transfers near-perfectly across architectures, confirming model-agnostic visual-semantic vulnerabilities. After the first successful attack, the victim still clicks the attacker-controlled icon in over 15\% of subsequent independent trials versus below 1% for random injection, establishing that strategically placed icons act as persistent attractors that causally redirect grounding rather than introducing incidental clutter.
papers.comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026, public code at https://github.com/HashTAG00002/UI-Injection
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出语义级UI元素注入（Semantic-level UI Element Injection），一种黑盒红队测试范式，通过在截图上覆盖安全对齐且无害的UI元素来误导GUI智能体的视觉定位。方法采用编辑器-覆盖器-受害者管线结合迭代搜索，实验表明策略优化比随机注入效果提升3.5-6.9倍，且攻击跨模型架构近乎完美迁移，揭示模型无关的视觉语义漏洞。首次攻击成功后，后续独立试验中受害者仍点击攻击者控制图标超过15%，而随机注入低于1%。
Motivation: 现有红队测试研究存在两个根本局限：对抗扰动需要白盒访问（商业部署中不可行），而提示注入被更强的安全对齐逐步削弱。需要更实际威胁模型下的鲁棒性研究。
Method: 提出语义级UI元素注入方法，采用模块化编辑器-覆盖器-受害者管线，结合迭代搜索：采样多个候选编辑，保留最佳累积覆盖，并根据先前失败调整未来提示策略。
Result: 在19个受害人模型（覆盖8个模型家族）上，策略优化显著优于随机注入（最强健受害人上3.5-6.9倍），且攻击跨架构近乎完美转移。首次攻击后，超过15%的后续独立试验中受害者仍点击攻击者控制图标（随机注入低于1%）。
Conclusion: 策略放置的图标并非偶然干扰，而是作为持久吸引物，因果性地重定向GUI智能体的视觉定位。

papers.title: Event-Centric World Modeling with Memory-Augmented Retrieval for Embodied Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents operating in dynamic environments increasingly demand decision-making systems that are both efficient and interpretable. Hence we propose the Event-Retrieve-Action (ERA) framework, an alternative formulation for embodied decision-making that bridges the gap between black-box imitation and interpretable memory retrieval while enabling online refinement without retraining. The environment is represented as structured semantic events encoded into an interpretable latent representation, and decisions are generated by retrieving relevant prior experiences from a knowledge bank of event-action pairs. Final actions are produced through weighted aggregation of retrieved maneuvers, enabling transparent and physically consistent decision-making. Experiments in UAV navigation demonstrate real-time performance and adaptive behavior in dynamic environments as a representative embodied decision-making application scenario.

papers.title: ML-based approach to classification and generation of structured light propagation in turbulent media
papers.abstract_en: We study the classification task of structured-light beams after propagation through a random turbulent medium. The received speckle patterns are generated by numerical simulation of a stochastic paraxial propagation model, and the classification task is formulated over a finite alphabet of 15 OAM source classes. We benchmark intensity and autocorrelation inputs using SimpleCNN and ResNet-18 as classifiers. We also quantify the effect of training-set size and receiver-window misalignment. Since additional propagated samples may be costly to obtain, we develop a class-conditioned diffusion model for generative augmentation of turbulence-degraded intensity images. The main contribution is a spectrum-aware diffusion objective: a pixel-domain loss combined with a Fourier-domain Bregman regularizer designed to preserve high-frequency speckle statistics. We prove that this hybrid objective is consistent with the posterior-mean regression target of the diffusion model and show that generated samples substantially improve low-data classification.
papers.journal_ref: Journal of the Optical Society of America A (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究结构化光束在随机湍流介质中传播后的分类问题。通过随机近轴传播模型数值模拟生成散斑图，对15个OAM源类进行分类，使用SimpleCNN和ResNet-18基准测试强度图和自相关输入。主要贡献是提出一种频谱感知扩散目标，结合像素域损失和傅里叶域Bregman正则化，以保留高频散斑统计特性，并证明该目标与扩散模型的后验均值回归一致，生成的样本显著改善了低数据分类性能。
Motivation: 湍流介质中结构化光束的传播会导致散斑图退化，而获取大量传播样本成本高昂，因此需要生成式增强方法来提升小样本下的分类性能。
Method: 提出一种类条件扩散模型，用于生成湍流退化强度图像的增强样本。训练目标为频谱感知扩散目标：像素域损失加上傅里叶域Bregman正则化，以保留高频散斑统计，并通过理论证明其与后验均值回归的一致性。
Result: 生成的样本显著改善了低数据场景下的分类性能，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Conclusion: 频谱感知扩散目标能有效保持散斑的高频统计特性，为湍流介质中结构化光束传播的少样本分类提供了一种可行的数据增强方法。

papers.title: GP-4DGS: Probabilistic 4D Gaussian Splatting from Monocular Video via Variational Gaussian Processes
papers.abstract_en: We present GP-4DGS, a novel framework that integrates Gaussian Processes (GPs) into 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) for principled probabilistic modeling of dynamic scenes. While existing 4DGS methods focus on deterministic reconstruction, they are inherently limited in capturing motion ambiguity and lack mechanisms to assess prediction reliability. By leveraging the kernel-based probabilistic nature of GPs, our approach introduces three key capabilities: (i) uncertainty quantification for motion predictions, (ii) motion estimation for unobserved or sparsely sampled regions, and (iii) temporal extrapolation beyond observed training frames. To scale GPs to the large number of Gaussian primitives in 4DGS, we design spatio-temporal kernels that capture the correlation structure of deformation fields and adopt variational Gaussian Processes with inducing points for tractable inference. Our experiments show that GP-4DGS enhances reconstruction quality while providing reliable uncertainty estimates that effectively identify regions of high motion ambiguity. By addressing these challenges, our work takes a meaningful step toward bridging probabilistic modeling and neural graphics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GP-4DGS，将高斯过程（GP）融入 4D 高斯泼溅（4DGS），实现动态场景的概率建模。现有 4DGS 方法仅做确定性重建，无法处理运动模糊和预测可靠性评估。GP-4DGS 利用 GP 的核概率特性，提供运动预测的不确定性量化、未观测区域运动估计以及时间外推。通过设计时空核捕捉变形场的相关结构，并采用变分高斯过程与诱导点实现可扩展推断。实验表明，GP-4DGS 提升重建质量并提供可靠的不确定性估计，有效识别高运动模糊区域。
Motivation: 现有 4DGS 方法仅做确定性重建，难以捕捉运动模糊，缺乏预测可靠性评估机制。
Method: 将高斯过程集成到 4DGS 中，设计时空核捕捉变形场相关结构，采用变分高斯过程与诱导点实现可扩展推断，从而实现运动不确定性量化、未观测区域运动估计和时间外推。
Result: 摘要报告 GP-4DGS 提升了重建质量，并提供可靠的不确定性估计，有效识别高运动模糊区域。
Conclusion: 本文旨在弥合概率建模与神经图形学之间的差距，为动态场景的概率建模提供了有意义的步骤。

papers.title: Exploration of Fast-Slow Latent Recurrence for Train-Short, Test-Long Generalization
papers.abstract_en: We study out of distribution generalization in streaming tasks where models are trained on short sequences but must operate over much longer, unknown horizons under bounded memory. Our focus is on a persistent fast slow recurrent formulation in which a latent state is maintained across observations rather than reset at each stream step. For each incoming observation, the model performs multiple weight-shared latent updates with a recurrent core and then carries the resulting state forward to the next observation. This allows the model to maintain and refine a compact stream-level state without reprocessing a growing context. We evaluate this formulation across symbolic sequence prediction, supervised navigation, and partially observable reinforcement learning tasks. Across these settings, persistent latent recurrence improves OOD generalization over recurrent, state-space, and Transformer baselines. Through recurrent-core ablations, we identify architectural ingredients that are consistently associated with strong OOD performance, including state-dependent transitions and feature-wise nonlinear mixing. Together, these results highlight the value of revisiting persistent recurrence as an architectural bias for more generalizable sequence prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究流式任务中训练短序列、测试长序列的分布外泛化问题，提出一种持久快慢潜在循环（persistent fast-slow latent recurrence）架构，其中隐藏状态跨观测步骤持续更新而非重置。在符号序列预测、监督导航和部分可观测强化学习任务上，该方法优于RNN、状态空间模型和Transformer基线，并识别出状态依赖转换和特征级非线性混合等有利于OOD泛化的架构要素。
Motivation: 现有序列模型在训练时序列短、测试时序列长的场景下泛化能力不足，且受限于固定记忆容量，需要一种能维护紧凑流状态而不重放历史的机制。
Method: 提出持久快慢潜在循环：对每个新观测，模型在记忆核心内执行多次共享权重的潜在状态更新，然后将最终状态传递到下一观测，从而在不增长上下文的情况下持续精炼流级状态。
Result: 在符号序列预测、监督导航和部分可观测RL任务中，该方法在OOD泛化上全面超越RNN、状态空间模型和Transformer基线；消融实验表明状态依赖转换和特征级非线性混合是关键架构成分。
Conclusion: 强调重访持久循环作为序列建模的架构偏置有助于提升泛化能力，但方法仅在模拟任务验证，未涉及实际流式应用如天气预报。

papers.title: Toward Robust Open-set Adaptation: Synapse Consolidation Inspired by Rac1/MAPK Pathways
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) generalize across tasks through reusable representations and flexible reasoning, yet remain brittle in real deployment when faced with evolving tasks and continual distribution shift. While test-time adaptation addresses this by updating models with unsupervised objectives on test data, prevailing methods are fundamentally limited by their neglect of source knowledge preservation and adaptation signal reliability. Inspired by how Drosophila orchestrates memory update by balancing retroactive and proactive interference via Rac1 and MAPK pathways, we design Synapse Consolidation (SyCo) with two core components: a Rac1-inspired plasticity confiner and a MAPK-inspired update controller. The former dynamically confines plasticity to a tail-gradient subspace that is less critical for source knowledge, enabling rapid specialization while preserving source representations. The latter uses a tiered controller to suppress noisy updates and consolidate useful adaptations under non-stationary streams. To further model real deployments with multiple sources and continually emerging tasks, we introduce Multi-source Open-set Adaptation (MOA) setting, where a model is trained on multiple labeled source tasks and then adapts on open, non-stationary unlabeled test streams mixing seen and unseen tasks with partial overlap in label and intent space. Across 18 NLP datasets under the MOA setting, SyCo consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving 78.31\% on unseen-task adaptation and 85.37\% versus unseen-data shifts, setting a new state-of-the-art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受果蝇Rac1/MAPK通路启发，提出突触巩固（SyCo）方法，用于大语言模型在开放、非平稳测试流上的适应，包括多源开放集适应（MOA）设定。SyCo包含两个核心组件：基于Rac1的可塑性限制器和基于MAPK的更新控制器，分别保护源知识和抑制噪声更新。在18个NLP数据集上，SyCo在未见任务和未见数据偏移上都达到新的最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有测试时适应方法忽视了源知识保留和适应信号可靠性，在连续分布偏移下表现脆弱。
Method: 设计SyCo方法，包含Rac1-inspired plasticity confiner（将可塑性限制在尾梯度子空间，保护源知识）和MAPK-inspired update controller（分级控制器抑制噪声更新并巩固有用适应），并引入多源开放集适应（MOA）设定。
Result: 在18个NLP数据集上的MOA设定中，SyCo在未见任务适应上达到78.31%，在未见数据偏移适应上达到85.37%，超越强基线。
Conclusion: SyCo通过生物学启发的突触巩固机制有效平衡了源知识保留和适应能力，在开放集适应中取得优异性能。

papers.title: Measuring the metacognition of AI
papers.abstract_en: A robust decision-making process must take into account uncertainty, especially when the choice involves inherent risks. Because artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly integrated into decision-making workflows, managing uncertainty relies more and more on the metacognitive capabilities of these systems; i.e, their ability to assess the reliability of and regulate their own decisions. Hence, it is crucial to employ robust methods to measure the metacognitive abilities of AI. This paper is primarily a methodological contribution arguing for the adoption of the meta-d' framework as the gold standard for assessing the metacognitive sensitivity of AIs--the ability to generate confidence ratings that distinguish correct from incorrect responses. Moreover, we propose to leverage signal detection theory (SDT) to measure the ability of AIs to spontaneously regulate their decisions based on uncertainty and risk. To demonstrate the practical utility of these psychophysical frameworks, we conduct two series of experiments on three large language models (LLMs)--GPT-5, DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp, and Mistral-Medium-2508.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文主张采用元-d' (meta-d') 框架作为评估AI元认知敏感性的金标准，并利用信号检测理论（SDT）测量AI基于不确定性和风险自发调节决策的能力。通过GPT-5、DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp和Mistral-Medium-2508三个大语言模型的两组实验展示了该心理物理学框架的实用性。
Motivation: 随着AI系统越来越多地融入决策流程，管理不确定性依赖于AI的元认知能力，即评估自身决策可靠性并自我调节的能力。因此需要稳健的方法来测量AI的元认知能力。
Method: 提出采用meta-d'框架作为评估AI元认知敏感性的标准方法，并利用信号检测理论（SDT）测量AI基于不确定性和风险自发调节决策的能力。在三个LLM上进行了两组实验。

papers.title: TIR-Agent: Training an Explorative and Efficient Agent for Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language agents that orchestrate specialized tools for image restoration (IR) have emerged as a promising method, yet most existing frameworks operate in a training-free manner. They rely on heuristic task scheduling and exhaustive tool traversal, resulting in sub-optimal restoration paths and prohibitive computational cost. We argue that the core bottleneck lies in the absence of a learned policy to make decision, as a vision-language model cannot efficiently handle degradation-aware task ordering and tool composition. To this end, we propose TIR-Agent, a trainable image restoration agent that performs a direct tool-calling policy through a two-stage training pipeline of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by reinforcement learning (RL). Two key designs underpin effective RL training: (i) a random perturbation strategy applied to the SFT data, which broadens the policy's exploration over task schedules and tool compositions, and (ii) a multi-dimensional adaptive reward mechanism that dynamically re-weights heterogeneous image quality metrics to mitigate reward hacking. To support high-throughput, asynchronous GPU-based tool invocation during training, we further develop a globally shared model-call pool. Experiments on both in-domain and out-of-domain degradations show that TIR-Agent outperforms 12 baselines, including 6 all-in-one models, 3 training-free agents, and 3 proprietary models, and achieves over 2.5$\times$ inference speedup by eliminating redundant tool executions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TIR-Agent，一个可训练的图像恢复智能体，通过监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）两阶段训练学习直接的工具调用策略，替代无训练方法中的启发式调度和穷举工具遍历。关键设计包括对SFT数据施加随机扰动以扩大探索范围，以及多维度自适应奖励机制防止奖励欺骗。在域内和域外退化上，TIR-Agent超越了12个基线（含6个全能模型、3个无训练智能体和3个专有模型），并实现超过2.5倍的推理加速。
Motivation: 现有无训练图像恢复智能体依赖启发式任务调度和穷举工具遍历，导致次优恢复路径和高计算成本，核心瓶颈在于缺乏学习到的策略来高效处理退化感知的任务排序和工具组合。
Method: 两阶段训练：先进行监督微调（SFT），再使用强化学习（RL）微调策略。RL阶段采用两个关键设计：对SFT数据施加随机扰动以拓宽策略对任务调度和工具组合的探索；以及多维度自适应奖励机制动态重加权异构图像质量指标以缓解奖励欺骗。同时开发全局共享模型调用池支持异步GPU工具调用。
Result: 在域内和域外退化实验上，TIR-Agent优于12个基线（包括6个全能模型、3个无训练智能体和3个专有模型），并实现超过2.5倍的推理加速，通过消除冗余工具执行。
Conclusion: 可训练的策略学习能够有效提升图像恢复智能体的性能和效率，避免无训练方法的瓶颈。

papers.title: Gaussian mixtures and non-parametric likelihoods through the lens of statistical mechanics
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we investigate Gaussian Mixture Models ({\it abbrv} GMM) and the related problem of non parametric maximum likelihood estimation ({\it abbrv} NPMLE) from the perspective of statistical mechanics. In particular, we establish stability guarantees for the NPMLE procedure that extend well beyond the state of the art. Crucially, we obtain guarantees on the Kullback-Leibler divergence between NPMLE estimators and the ground truth, a type of result which has been known to be challenging in the literature on this problem. In particular, we provide high probability upper bounds on the KL divergence between the NPMLE and the true density that are of the order of $\min\big\{\frac{(\log n)^{d+2}}{n} , \frac{\log n}{\sqrt n}\big\}$, which cover a wide range of scenarios for the comparative sizes of $n$ and $d$. We obtain similar guarantees for approximate solutions to the NPMLE problem, addressing realistic situations wherein optimization algorithms need to be stopped in finite time, allowing access only to approximations to the true NPMLE. A cornerstone of our approach is an analysis of the function class complexity of logarithms of gaussian mixture densities, which is able to handle their unboundedness, and could be of wider interest. Our methods lead to novel confidence-interval guarantees for entropy estimation in Gaussian mixtures, demonstrating their wider impact. We also establish correspondences between stability phenomena in the NPMLE problem and concepts such as chaos and multiple valleys in random energy landscapes of statistical mechanics models. While these correspondences are largely of a conceptual nature at this point, we believe that these connections, especially those with concentration phenomena and Langevin dynamics, may be developed into a toolbox for studying a wide variety of random optimization problems in statistics and machine learning.

TL;DR: 本文从统计力学角度研究高斯混合模型和非参数最大似然估计，建立了超出当前水平的高概率KL散度上界，并扩展到近似解。方法基于高斯混合密度对数函数类复杂度分析，还建立了与统计力学中混沌和多重谷等概念的对应关系。

Method: 使用统计力学工具分析函数类复杂度，提供高概率KL散度上界，并处理近似解。
Result: 获得KL散度的上界为min{ (log n)^{d+2}/n, log n/√n }，覆盖广泛n和d的场景。
Conclusion: 方法也适用于熵估计的置信区间，并建立了与统计力学概念的关联，可能发展为工具包。

papers.title: Effective Strategies for Asynchronous Software Engineering Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents have become increasingly capable at isolated software engineering (SWE) tasks such as resolving issues on Github. Yet long-horizon tasks involving multiple interdependent subtasks still pose challenges both with respect to accuracy, and with respect to timely completion. A natural approach to solving these long-horizon tasks in a timely manner is asynchronous multi-agent collaboration, where multiple agents work on different parts of the task at the same time. But effective application of multi-agent systems has proven surprisingly difficult: concurrent edits by multiple agents interfere with each other, dependencies are difficult to synchronize, and combining partial progress into a coherent whole is challenging. On the other hand, human developers have long relied on mature collaboration infrastructure to manage these challenges in large software projects. Inspired by these collaboration primitives, we introduce Centralized Asynchronous Isolated Delegation (CAID), a structured multi-agent coordination paradigm grounded in three core SWE primitives: centralized task delegation, asynchronous execution, and isolated workspaces. CAID constructs dependency-aware task plans through a central manager, executes subtasks concurrently in isolated workspaces, and consolidates progress via structured integration with executable test-based verification. In empirical evaluation, we find that CAID improves accuracy over single-agent baselines by 25.6% absolute on paper reproduction tasks (PaperBench) and 14.7% on Python library development tasks (Commit0). Through systematic analysis, we find that branch-and-merge is a central coordination mechanism for multi-agent collaboration, and that SWE primitives such as git worktree, git commit, and git merge enable it to be realized in a reliable and executable manner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为CAID的异步多智能体协作范式，通过集中任务委派、异步执行和隔离工作区来协调多个AI智能体完成长周期软件工程任务。实验表明，在论文复现任务（PaperBench）上，CAID相比单智能体基线提升了25.6%的绝对准确率，在Python库开发任务（Commit0）上提升了14.7%。
Motivation: 长周期软件工程任务涉及多个相互依赖的子任务，单智能体系统在准确性和及时性方面存在挑战；而多智能体协作时，并发编辑相互干扰、依赖难以同步、部分进度整合困难，现有方法效果不佳。
Method: 提出Centralized Asynchronous Isolated Delegation (CAID) 范式，基于三个核心原语：集中式任务委派（centralized task delegation）、异步执行（asynchronous execution）和隔离工作区（isolated workspaces）。中央管理器构建依赖感知的任务计划，子任务在隔离工作区中并发执行，并通过基于可执行测试验证的结构化集成来合并进度。
Result: 在PaperBench（论文复现任务）上，CAID比单智能体基线提升25.6%绝对准确率；在Commit0（Python库开发任务）上提升14.7%。
Conclusion: 分支-合并（branch-and-merge）是多智能体协作的关键协调机制，而git worktree、git commit、git merge等软件工程原语可可靠地实现该机制。

papers.title: Dual Path Attribution: Efficient Attribution for SwiGLU-Transformers through Layer-Wise Target Propagation
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the internal mechanisms of transformer-based large language models (LLMs) is crucial for their reliable deployment and effective operation. While recent efforts have yielded a plethora of attribution methods attempting to balance faithfulness and computational efficiency, dense component attribution remains prohibitively expensive. In this work, we introduce Dual Path Attribution (DPA), a novel framework that faithfully traces information flow on the frozen transformer in one forward and one backward pass without requiring counterfactual examples. DPA analytically decomposes and linearizes the computational structure of the SwiGLU Transformers into distinct pathways along which it propagates a targeted unembedding vector to receive the effective representation at each residual position. This target-centric propagation achieves O(1) time complexity with respect to the number of model components, scaling to long input sequences and dense component attribution. Extensive experiments on standard interpretability benchmarks demonstrate that DPA achieves state-of-the-art faithfulness and unprecedented efficiency compared to existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dual Path Attribution (DPA) 框架，用于高效且忠实地追踪 SwiGLU-Transformers 的信息流。该方法通过一次前向和一次反向传播，无需反事实示例，实现 O(1) 时间复杂度。在标准可解释性基准上，DPA 达到了最先进的忠实度和前所未有的效率。
Motivation: 现有归因方法在密度组件归因上计算成本高昂，难以同时满足忠实度和效率的要求。
Method: DPA 通过分析分解和线性化 SwiGLU Transformers 的计算结构，将其划分为不同路径，沿这些路径传播目标解嵌入向量，从而获得每个残差位置的有效表示。该方法仅需一次前向和一次反向传播，无需反事实示例。
Result: 实验结果表明，DPA 在标准可解释性基准上达到了最先进的忠实度和效率，时间复杂度与模型组件数量无关，可扩展至长输入序列和密集组件归因。
Conclusion: DPA 为 SwiGLU-Transformers 提供了一种高效且忠实的归因方法，显著降低了计算成本。

papers.title: FMMC: Harnessing the Power of Foundation Models for Accurate Material Classification
papers.abstract_en: Material classification has emerged as a critical task in computer vision and graphics, supporting the assignment of accurate material properties to a wide range of digital and real-world applications. While traditionally framed as an image classification task, this domain faces significant challenges due to the scarcity of annotated data, limiting the accuracy and generalizability of trained models. Recent advances in vision-language foundation models (VLMs) offer promising avenues to address these issues, yet existing solutions leveraging these models still exhibit unsatisfying results in material recognition tasks. In this work, we propose a novel framework that effectively harnesses foundation models to overcome data limitations and enhance classification accuracy. Our method integrates two key innovations: (a) a robust image generation and auto-labeling pipeline that creates a diverse and high-quality training dataset with material-centric images, and automatically assigns labels by fusing object semantics and material attributes in text prompts; (b) a prior incorporation strategy to distill information from VLMs, combined with a joint fine-tuning method that optimizes a pre-trained vision foundation model alongside VLM-derived priors, preserving broad generalizability while adapting to material-specific features. Extensive experiments demonstrate significant improvements on multiple datasets. We show that our synthetic dataset effectively captures the characteristics of real world materials, and the integration of priors from vision-language models significantly enhances the final performance. The source code and dataset will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个利用预训练基础模型（包括视觉-语言模型）进行材料分类的框架。框架包含两个关键创新：一是通过图像生成和自动标注pipeline创建高质量、多样化的材料中心训练数据集；二是先验整合策略，联合微调视觉基础模型和VLM先验，提升分类准确性。实验在多个数据集上显示显著改进。
Motivation: 材料分类面临标注数据稀缺的挑战，现有基于视觉-语言模型的方法在材料识别任务上表现不佳。
Method: 提出包含两个核心组件的框架：(a) 稳健的图像生成与自动标注pipeline，通过融合对象语义和材料属性的文本提示生成图像并自动标注；(b) 先验整合策略，从VLM中提取先验信息，并与预训练视觉基础模型联合微调，在保持泛化性的同时适应材料特定特征。
Result: 在多个数据集上取得显著改进；合成数据集能够有效捕捉真实材料特性；整合VLM先验显著提升最终性能。
Conclusion: 作者将性能提升归因于合成数据生成与先验整合策略，并计划开源代码和数据集。

papers.title: Optimization-Embedded Active Multi-Fidelity Surrogate Learning for Multi-Condition Airfoil Shape Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Active multi-fidelity surrogate modeling is developed for multi-condition airfoil shape optimization to reduce high-fidelity CFD cost while retaining RANS-consistent aerodynamic metrics. The framework couples a low-fidelity-informed Gaussian process regression transfer model with uncertainty-triggered sampling and a synchronized elitism rule embedded in a hybrid genetic algorithm. Low-fidelity XFOIL evaluations provide inexpensive features, while sparse RANS simulations are adaptively allocated when predictive uncertainty exceeds a threshold; elite candidates are mandatorily validated at high fidelity, and the population is re-evaluated to prevent evolutionary selection based on outdated fitness values produced by earlier surrogate states. The method is demonstrated for a two-point problem at $Re=6\times10^6$ with cruise at $α=2^\circ$ (maximize $E=L/D$) and take-off at $α=10^\circ$ (maximize $C_L$) using a 12-parameter CST representation. Independent multi-fidelity surrogates per flight condition enable decoupled refinement. The optimized design improves cruise efficiency by 41.05% and take-off lift by 20.75% relative to the best first-generation individual. Over the full campaign, RANS evaluations were required for only 14.78% and 9.5% of the condition-specific candidate evaluations at cruise and take-off, respectively. These percentages quantify the reduction in high-fidelity usage relative to the fixed automated RANS workflow adopted as the high-fidelity reference in this study.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种主动多保真代理建模方法用于多工况翼型形状优化，通过低保真XFOIL与稀疏RANS仿真结合，在保持RANS一致性的同时大幅降低高保真计算成本。在巡航（最大化升阻比）和起飞（最大化升力系数）双点优化中，相对第一代个体分别提升41.05%和20.75%，仅需14.78%和9.5%的高保真评估。
Motivation: 多工况翼型优化中高保真CFD计算成本高昂，现有多保真方法难以同时保证RANS精度和优化效率。
Method: 构建低保真指导的高斯过程回归传递模型，结合不确定性触发的自适应采样与同步精英规则嵌入混合遗传算法；每个飞行条件独立训练多保真代理，实现解耦细化。
Result: 优化设计在巡航效率提升41.05%、起飞升力提升20.75%；高保真评估仅占候选评估的14.78%（巡航）和9.5%（起飞）。
Conclusion: 主动多保真代理能显著减少高保真调用次数，适用于翼型多工况优化。

papers.title: CompDiff: Hierarchical Compositional Diffusion for Fair and Zero-Shot Intersectional Medical Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generative models are increasingly used to augment medical imaging datasets for fairer AI, yet a key assumption often goes unexamined: that generators produce equally high-quality images across demographic groups. Models trained on imbalanced data inherit these imbalances, degrading synthesis for rare subgroups and struggling with intersections absent from training: the imbalanced generator problem. Remedies such as loss reweighting operate at the optimization level and provide limited benefit when training signal is scarce or absent. We propose CompDiff, a hierarchical compositional diffusion framework that addresses this at the representation level. A dedicated Hierarchical Conditioner Network (HCN) decomposes demographic conditioning into single-attribute, pairwise, and composed representations, producing a demographic token concatenated with CLIP embeddings as cross-attention context. This structured factorization encourages parameter sharing across subgroups and supports compositional generalization to rare or unseen intersections. On chest X-rays (MIMIC-CXR) and fundus images (FairGenMed), CompDiff compares favorably against standard fine-tuning and FairDiffusion across image quality (FID 64.3 vs. 75.1), subgroup equity (ES-FID), and zero-shot intersectional generalization (up to 21% FID improvement on held-out intersections). Downstream classifiers trained on CompDiff data show improved AUROC and reduced demographic bias, suggesting that the architectural design of demographic conditioning is an important and underexplored factor in fair medical image generation. Code: https://github.com/mahmoudibrahim98/CompDiff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CompDiff，一种分层组合扩散框架，用于解决医疗图像生成中因训练数据不平衡导致的罕见子组和未见交叉组生成质量低下的问题。通过分层条件网络（HCN）将人口统计条件分解为单属性、成对和组合表示，实现参数共享和组合泛化。在胸部X光和眼底图像数据集上，CompDiff在图像质量、子组公平性和零样本交叉泛化方面优于标准微调和FairDiffusion。
Motivation: 现有生成模型在医学影像增广中假设跨人口统计组生成质量一致，但实际中训练数据不平衡导致罕见子组和未见交叉组生成质量差，即不平衡生成器问题。损失重加权等优化层面方法在训练信号稀缺时效果有限。
Method: 提出分层组合扩散框架CompDiff，核心是分层条件网络（HCN），将人口统计条件分解为单属性、两两组合和组合表示，生成人口统计令牌与CLIP嵌入拼接作为交叉注意力上下文。这种结构化分解促进子组间参数共享，支持对罕见或未见交叉组的组合泛化。
Result: 在MIMIC-CXR和FairGenMed数据集上，CompDiff在FID（64.3 vs 75.1）、子组公平性（ES-FID）和零样本交叉泛化（在留出交叉组上FID提升最高21%）方面优于对比方法。下游分类器AUROC提升，人口统计偏差降低。
Conclusion: 人口统计条件的架构设计是公平医疗图像生成中重要但未充分探索的因素，CompDiff通过表示级别的分解有效解决了不平衡生成问题。

papers.title: Unified Removal of Raindrops and Reflections: A New Benchmark and A Novel Pipeline
papers.abstract_en: When capturing images through glass surfaces or windshields on rainy days, raindrops and reflections frequently co-occur to significantly reduce the visibility of captured images. This practical problem lacks attention and needs to be resolved urgently. Prior de-raindrop, de-reflection, and all-in-one models have failed to address this composite degradation. To this end, we first formally define the unified removal of raindrops and reflections (UR$^3$) task for the first time and construct a real-shot dataset, namely RainDrop and ReFlection (RDRF), which provides a new benchmark with substantial, high-quality, diverse image pairs. Then, we propose a novel diffusion-based framework (i.e., DiffUR$^3$) with several target designs to address this challenging task. By leveraging the powerful generative prior, DiffUR$^3$ successfully removes both types of degradations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on our benchmark and on challenging in-the-wild images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文首次定义了统一去除雨滴和反射（UR^3）任务，并构建了真实拍摄数据集RDRF，提供了新的基准。提出了基于扩散的框架DiffUR^3，利用生成先验同时去除两种退化。实验表明在基准和真实图像上达到SOTA。
Motivation: 雨天透过玻璃或挡风玻璃拍摄时，雨滴和反射经常同时出现，严重降低能见度，但现有去雨滴、去反射或通用模型都无法解决这种复合退化。
Method: 提出扩散模型框架DiffUR^3，采用多个针对性设计，利用强大的生成先验来处理雨滴和反射的联合去除。
Result: 在RDRF基准和具有挑战性的真实图像上实现了最先进的性能。
Conclusion: 本文为UR^3任务提供了基准和有效方法，但未在摘要中明确讨论限制。

papers.title: DASH: Dynamic Audio-Driven Semantic Chunking for Efficient Omnimodal Token Compression
papers.abstract_en: Omnimodal large language models (OmniLLMs) jointly process audio and visual streams, but the resulting long multimodal token sequences make inference prohibitively expensive. Existing compression methods typically rely on fixed window partitioning and attention-based pruning, which overlook the piecewise semantic structure of audio-visual signals and become fragile under aggressive token reduction. We propose Dynamic Audio-driven Semantic cHunking (DASH), a training-free framework that aligns token compression with semantic structure. DASH treats audio embeddings as a semantic anchor and detects boundary candidates via cosine-similarity discontinuities, inducing dynamic, variable-length segments that approximate the underlying piecewise-coherent organization of the sequence. These boundaries are projected onto video tokens as a soft temporally co-registered segmentation prior. Within each segment, token retention is determined by a tri-signal importance estimator that fuses structural boundary cues, representational distinctiveness, and attention-based salience, mitigating the sparsity bias of attention-only selection. This structure-aware allocation preserves transition-critical tokens while reducing redundant regions. Extensive experiments on AVUT, VideoMME, and WorldSense demonstrate that DASH maintains competitive or superior accuracy while achieving higher compression ratios compared to prior methods. Code is available at: https://github.com/laychou666/DASH.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DASH，一种无需训练的动态音频驱动语义分块框架，用于全模态大语言模型（OmniLLMs）中音频和视觉序列的token压缩。DASH利用音频embedding为语义锚点，通过余弦相似度不连续性检测边界，生成可变长度分块，并将边界投影到视频token上作为软先验。在每个分块内，使用三信号重要性估计器（结构边界、表征独特性、注意力显著性）决定token保留，在保持竞争性精度的同时实现更高压缩比。在AVUT、VideoMME和WorldSense数据集上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有全模态大语言模型处理长音频-视觉序列时推理成本高昂，而现有压缩方法（固定窗口分割、注意力剪枝）忽略信号的片段语义结构，在激进压缩下表现脆弱。
Method: 提出DASH：1) 以音频embedding为语义锚点，检测余弦相似度不连续性作为动态边界候选，形成可变长度分块；2) 将边界投影到视频token上作为软时间对齐分割先验；3) 每个分块内用三信号重要性估计器（结构边界线索、表征独特性、注意力显著性）决定token保留，减少冗余区域。
Result: 在AVUT、VideoMME和WorldSense上，DASH在达到更高压缩比的同时保持与以往方法相当或更优的准确率。
Conclusion: 结构感知的token分配能够保留过渡关键token并减少冗余，在无需训练的情况下改善压缩效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: G-ZAP: A Generalizable Zero-Shot Framework for Arbitrary-Scale Pansharpening
papers.abstract_en: Pansharpening aims to fuse a high-resolution panchromatic (PAN) image and a low-resolution multispectral (LRMS) image to produce a high-resolution multispectral (HRMS) image. Recent deep models have achieved strong performance, yet they typically rely on large-scale pretraining and often generalize poorly to unseen real-world image pairs. Prior zero-shot approaches improve real-scene generalization but require per-image optimization, hindering weight reuse, and the above methods are usually limited to a fixed scale. To address this issue, we propose G-ZAP, a generalizable zero-shot framework for arbitrary-scale pansharpening, designed to handle cross-resolution, cross-scene, and cross-sensor generalization. G-ZAP adopts a feature-based implicit neural representation (INR) fusion network as the backbone and introduces a multi-scale, semi-supervised training scheme to enable robust generalization. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets show that G-ZAP achieves state-of-the-art results under PAN-scale fusion in both visual quality and quantitative metrics. Notably, G-ZAP supports weight reuse across image pairs while maintaining competitiveness with per-pair retraining, demonstrating strong potential for efficient real-world deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出G-ZAP，一个可泛化的零样本全色锐化框架，支持任意尺度融合，能处理跨分辨率、跨场景、跨传感器的泛化。采用基于特征隐式神经表示（INR）融合网络作为主干，并引入多尺度半监督训练方案。在多个真实数据集上，G-ZAP在PAN尺度融合中达到最先进结果，且支持权重重用，无需每对图像重新训练。
Motivation: 现有深度全色锐化模型依赖大规模预训练，泛化到未见过的真实图像对时性能差；零样本方法需每张图像优化，无法重用权重，且通常限于固定尺度。本文目标是设计一个可泛化、支持任意尺度且权重可重用的零样本框架。
Method: 提出G-ZAP框架，基于特征隐式神经表示（INR）融合网络作为主干，采用多尺度半监督训练方案，实现跨分辨率、跨场景、跨传感器的泛化。
Result: 在多个真实数据集上，G-ZAP在PAN尺度融合中在视觉质量和定量指标上达到最先进结果。支持权重重用，且性能与每对图像重新训练的方法竞争力相当。
Conclusion: G-ZAP展示了在真实世界高效部署的潜力，通过零样本和权重重用避免了per-pair重训练的成本。

papers.title: VFM-Loc: Training-Free Cross-View Geo-Localization via Aligning Discriminative Visual Hierarchies
papers.abstract_en: Cross-View Geo-Localization (CVGL) in remote sensing aims to locate a drone-view query by matching it to geo-tagged satellite images. Although supervised methods have achieved strong results on close-set benchmarks, they often fail to generalize to unconstrained, real-world scenarios due to severe viewpoint differences and dataset bias. To overcome these limitations, we present VFM-Loc, a training-free CVGL framework that leverages the generalizable visual representations from vision foundational models (VFMs). VFM-Loc identifies and matches discriminative visual clues across different viewpoints through a progressive alignment strategy. First, we design a hierarchical clue extraction mechanism using Generalized Mean pooling and Scale-Weighted R-MAC to preserve distinctive visual clues across scales while maintaining hierarchical confidence. Second, we introduce a statistical manifold alignment pipeline based on domain-wise PCA and Orthogonal Procrustes analysis, linearly aligning heterogeneous feature distributions in a shared metric space. Experiments demonstrate that VFM-Loc exhibits high accuracy on standard benchmarks and surpasses supervised methods by over 20\% in Recall@1 on the challenging LO-UCV dataset with large oblique angles. This work highlights that principled alignment of pre-trained features can effectively bridge the cross-view gap, establishing a robust and training-free paradigm for real-world CVGL. The relevant code is made available at: github.com/DingLei14/VFM-Loc.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VFM-Loc，一种无需训练的跨视角地理定位（CVGL）框架，利用视觉基础模型（VFM）的通用表示，通过分层线索提取和统计流形对齐，在标准基准上表现高精度，并在大倾斜角度的LO-UCV数据集上超过监督方法Recall@1超20%。
Motivation: 现有监督方法在封闭基准上表现良好，但难以泛化到无约束的真实场景，受限于视角差异和数据集偏差。
Method: 提出分层线索提取机制（结合Generalized Mean Pooling和Scale-Weighted R-MAC）保留多尺度判别性视觉线索，以及基于逐域PCA和正交Procrustes分析的统计流形对齐管道，线性对齐异构特征分布。
Result: 在标准基准上表现高精度，在挑战性LO-UCV数据集上Recall@1超过监督方法20%以上。
Conclusion: 通过对齐预训练特征可有效弥合跨视角差距，建立鲁棒且无需训练的真实CVGL范式。
