papers.title: Anomaly detection in time-series via inductive biases in the latent space of conditional normalizing flows
papers.abstract_en: Deep generative models for anomaly detection in multivariate time-series are typically trained by maximizing observed data likelihood. However, likelihood in observation space measures marginal density rather than conformity to structured temporal dynamics, and therefore can assign high probability to anomalous or out-of-distribution samples. We address this structural limitation by relocating the notion of anomaly to a prescribed latent space. We introduce explicit inductive biases in conditional normalizing flows, modeling time-series observations within a discrete-time state-space framework that constrains latent representations to evolve according to prescribed temporal dynamics. Under this formulation, expected behavior corresponds to compliance with a specified distribution over latent trajectories, while anomalies are defined as violations of these dynamics. Anomaly detection is consequently reformulated as a statistically grounded compliance test, such that observations are mapped to latent space and evaluated via goodness-of-fit tests against the prescribed latent evolution. This yields a principled decision rule that remains effective even in regions of high observation likelihood. Experiments on synthetic and real-world time-series demonstrate reliable detection of anomalies in frequency, amplitude, and observation noise, while providing interpretable diagnostics of model compliance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在条件归一化流（conditional normalizing flows）的潜空间中引入显式归纳偏置，将时间序列异常检测重新定义为对潜动态的符合性检验。通过离散时间状态空间框架约束潜表示遵循预设的时间动态，异常被定义为对这些动态的违反。实验证明该方法在频率、幅度和观测噪声异常上有效检测，并在高观测似然区域仍保持可靠。
Motivation: 基于似然的深度生成模型在时间序列异常检测中可能会给异常样本分配高概率，因为似然衡量的是边际密度而非结构性时间动态的一致性。本文旨在解决这一结构性局限。
Method: 将异常的概念转移到预设的潜空间，在条件归一化流中引入显式归纳偏置，使用离散时间状态空间框架约束潜表示按指定时间动态演化。异常检测转化为基于统计的符合性检验：观测映射到潜空间后，通过拟合优度检验评估是否符合预设的潜动态。
Result: 在合成和真实世界时间序列上，该方法可靠地检测频率、幅度和观测噪声异常，并提供可解释的模型符合性诊断。在高观测似然区域仍保持有效。
Conclusion: 通过将异常检测重构为潜动态的符合性检验，提供了原则性的决策规则，并在高似然区域保持有效性。

papers.title: EventVGGT: Exploring Cross-Modal Distillation for Consistent Event-based Depth Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras offer superior sensitivity to high-speed motion and extreme lighting, making event-based monocular depth estimation a promising approach for robust 3D perception in challenging conditions. However, progress is severely hindered by the scarcity of dense depth annotations. While recent annotation-free approaches mitigate this by distilling knowledge from Vision Foundation Models (VFMs), a critical limitation persists: they process event streams as independent frames. By neglecting the inherent temporal continuity of event data, these methods fail to leverage the rich temporal priors encoded in VFMs, ultimately yielding temporally inconsistent and less accurate depth predictions. To address this, we introduce EventVGGT, a novel framework that explicitly models the event stream as a coherent video sequence. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to distill spatio-temporal and multi-view geometric priors from the Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) into the event domain. We achieve this via a comprehensive tri-level distillation strategy: (i) Cross-Modal Feature Mixture (CMFM) bridges the modality gap at the output level by fusing RGB and event features to generate auxiliary depth predictions; (ii) Spatio-Temporal Feature Distillation (STFD) distills VGGT's powerful spatio-temporal representations at the feature level; and (iii) Temporal Consistency Distillation (TCD) enforces cross-frame coherence at the temporal level by aligning inter-frame depth changes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EventVGGT consistently outperforms existing methods -- reducing the absolute mean depth error at 30m by over 53\% on EventScape (from 2.30 to 1.06) -- while exhibiting robust zero-shot generalization on the unseen DENSE and MVSEC datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/yinruiRen/EventVGGT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EventVGGT 框架，通过跨模态蒸馏将视觉几何基础模型 VGGT 的时空和多视图几何先验迁移到事件域，解决事件相机深度估计中缺乏密集标注和时序不一致的问题。摘要报告在 EventScape 数据集上 30m 处平均深度误差降低超过 53%，并在未见过的 DENSE 和 MVSEC 数据集上展现出鲁棒的零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 事件相机深度估计缺乏密集深度标注，现有无监督方法将事件流视为独立帧，忽略其时间连续性，导致预测在时间上不一致且精度不足。
Method: 提出三层次蒸馏策略：(i) 跨模态特征混合 (CMFM) 融合 RGB 和事件特征生成辅助深度；(ii) 时空特征蒸馏 (STFD) 在特征层面提取 VGGT 的时空表示；(iii) 时序一致性蒸馏 (TCD) 通过对齐帧间深度变化增强跨帧一致性。
Result: 在 EventScape 上 30m 处平均绝对深度误差从 2.30 降至 1.06（降低 53%），在未训练过的 DENSE 和 MVSEC 数据集上表现零样本泛化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 EventVGGT 通过显式建模事件流为视频序列并蒸馏多层级先验，显著提升了事件深度估计的精度与时间一致性，代码已开源。

papers.title: What if? Emulative Simulation with World Models for Situated Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Situated reasoning often relies on active exploration, yet in many real-world scenarios such exploration is infeasible due to physical constraints of robots or safety concerns of visually impaired users. Given only a limited observation, can an agent mentally simulate a future trajectory toward a target situation and answer spatial what-if questions? We introduce WanderDream, the first large-scale dataset designed for the emulative simulation of mental exploration, enabling models to reason without active exploration. WanderDream-Gen comprises 15.8K panoramic videos across 1,088 real scenes from HM3D, ScanNet++, and real-world captures, depicting imagined trajectories from current viewpoints to target situations. WanderDream-QA contains 158K question-answer pairs, covering starting states, paths, and end states along each trajectory to comprehensively evaluate exploration-based reasoning. Extensive experiments with world models and MLLMs demonstrate (1) that mental exploration is essential for situated reasoning, (2) that world models achieve compelling performance on WanderDream-Gen, (3) that imagination substantially facilitates reasoning on WanderDream-QA, and (4) that WanderDream data exhibit remarkable transferability to real-world scenarios.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. The data and code are available at: https://github.com/RuipingL/WanderDream
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WanderDream 数据集，用于情境推理中的心理模拟（emulative simulation），使模型无需主动探索即可推理空间“what-if”问题。数据集包含15.8K全景视频和158K问答对，实验证明世界模型在生成和推理任务上表现良好，且数据可迁移到真实场景。
Motivation: 现实场景中，机器人或视障用户因物理约束或安全考量无法进行主动探索，需一种方法让代理仅凭有限观测就能心理模拟未来轨迹并回答空间问题。
Method: 构建 WanderDream 数据集，包括 WanderDream-Gen（15.8K全景视频，覆盖1,088个真实场景）和 WanderDream-QA（158K问答对，涵盖起始状态、路径和结束状态），并利用世界模型和多模态大语言模型进行评估。
Result: 世界模型在 WanderDream-Gen 上表现优异，心理模拟显著提升 WanderDream-QA 上的推理性能，且数据在真实场景中表现出良好的迁移性。
Conclusion: 心理模拟是情境推理的关键，世界模型能有效模拟未来轨迹，为该领域提供了大规模基准。

papers.title: Latent Policy Steering through One-Step Flow Policies
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) allows robots to learn from offline datasets without risky exploration. Yet, offline RL's performance often hinges on a brittle trade-off between (1) return maximization, which can push policies outside the dataset support, and (2) behavioral constraints, which typically require sensitive hyperparameter tuning. Latent steering offers a structural way to stay within the dataset support during RL, but existing offline adaptations commonly approximate action values using latent-space critics learned via indirect distillation, which can lose information and hinder convergence. We propose Latent Policy Steering (LPS), which enables high-fidelity latent policy improvement by backpropagating original-action-space Q-gradients through a differentiable one-step MeanFlow policy to update a latent-action-space actor. By eliminating proxy latent critics, LPS allows an original-action-space critic to guide end-to-end latent-space optimization, while the one-step MeanFlow policy serves as a behavior-constrained generative prior. This decoupling yields a robust method that works out-of-the-box with minimal tuning. Across OGBench and real-world robotic tasks, LPS achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently outperforms behavioral cloning and strong latent steering baselines.
papers.comment: Accepted to RSS 2026, Project Webpage : https://jellyho.github.io/LPS/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent Policy Steering (LPS)，一种用于离线强化学习的潜在策略引导方法。LPS 通过可微分的 one-step MeanFlow 策略反向传播原始动作空间的 Q 梯度，直接更新潜在动作空间的 actor，避免了使用潜在评论家代理带来的信息损失。在 OGBench 和真实机器人任务上，LPS 达到新最优性能，且无需繁琐超参数调优。
Motivation: 现有离线强化学习方法在回报最大化与行为约束之间存在脆弱的权衡，而潜在引导方法通过潜在空间评论家进行间接蒸馏，导致信息损失和收敛困难。
Method: LPS 通过可微分的 one-step MeanFlow 策略将原始动作空间的 Q 梯度反向传播到潜在动作空间，直接优化潜在 actor；原始动作空间评论家指导端到端潜在空间优化，同时 one-step MeanFlow 作为行为约束生成先验。
Result: 在 OGBench 和真实机器人任务中，LPS 达到新最优性能，一致优于行为克隆和现有强潜在引导基线。
Conclusion: LPS 通过解耦回报优化与行为约束，实现了稳健的离线强化学习，可在最小调优下直接使用。

papers.title: Named-Entity Recognition in the Crime Domain (CrimeNER): Case Study and Dataset
papers.abstract_en: The extraction of critical information from crime-related documents is a crucial task for law enforcement agencies. The extraction of this information can be interpreted as a Named-Entity Recognition (NER) task. However, there is a considerable lack of adequately annotated data on general real-world crime scenarios. To address this issue, we present CrimeNER, a case study of crime-related NER, and a general crime-related Named-Entity Recognition database (CrimeNER-db), consisting of more than 1.5K annotated documents extracted from public reports of terrorist attacks and the US Department of Justice's press notes. We define 4 coarse types of crime entity and 21 fine-grained entity types. We address the quality of the presented database with experiments using fully supervised finetuned general NER models and zero- and few-shot experiments to address the generalization capabilities. The database is available on GitHub.

papers.title: Decentralized Federated Learning by Partial Message Exchange
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized federated learning (DFL) has emerged as a transformative server-free paradigm that enables collaborative learning over large-scale heterogeneous networks. However, it continues to face fundamental challenges, including data heterogeneity, restrictive assumptions for theoretical analysis, and degraded convergence when standard communication- or privacyenhancing techniques are applied. To overcome these drawbacks, this paper develops a novel algorithm, PaME (DFL by Partial Message Exchange). The central principle is to allow only randomly selected sparse coordinates to be exchanged between two neighbor nodes. Consequently, PaME achieves substantial reductions in communication costs while still preserving a high level of privacy, without sacrificing accuracy. Moreover, grounded in rigorous analysis, the algorithm is shown to converge at a linear rate under the gradient to be locally Lipschitz continuous and the communication matrix to be doubly stochastic. These two mild assumptions not only dispense with many restrictive conditions commonly imposed by existing DFL methods but also enables PaME to effectively address data heterogeneity. Furthermore, comprehensive numerical experiments demonstrate its superior performance compared with several representative decentralized learning algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种去中心化联邦学习算法PaME，通过节点间仅交换随机选择的稀疏坐标来降低通信成本并保护隐私，同时在梯度局部Lipschitz连续和通信矩阵双随机的温和假设下证明线性收敛，实验表明优于多种代表性算法。
Motivation: 现有去中心化联邦学习面临数据异构、理论假设严格以及标准通信/隐私技术导致收敛变差等根本挑战。
Method: 提出PaME算法，核心是相邻节点之间只交换随机选择的稀疏坐标，从而大幅降低通信开销并保持高隐私性，同时不牺牲精度。
Result: 在梯度局部Lipschitz连续和通信矩阵双随机两个温和假设下，算法以线性速率收敛；综合数值实验表明性能优于多种代表性去中心化学习算法。
Conclusion: PaME通过部分消息交换有效解决数据异构问题，其收敛分析去除了许多限制性假设，并实验验证了算法在通信和隐私方面的优势。

papers.title: EMO-R3: Reflective Reinforcement Learning for Emotional Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown remarkable progress in visual reasoning and understanding tasks but still struggle to capture the complexity and subjectivity of human emotions. Existing approaches based on supervised fine-tuning often suffer from limited generalization and poor interpretability, while reinforcement learning methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization fail to align with the intrinsic characteristics of emotional cognition. To address these challenges, we propose Reflective Reinforcement Learning for Emotional Reasoning (EMO-R3), a framework designed to enhance the emotional reasoning ability of MLLMs. Specifically, we introduce Structured Emotional Thinking to guide the model to perform step-by-step emotional reasoning in a structured and interpretable manner, and design a Reflective Emotional Reward that enables the model to re-evaluate its reasoning based on visual-text consistency and emotional coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EMO-R3 significantly improves both the interpretability and emotional intelligence of MLLMs, achieving superior performance across multiple visual emotional understanding benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 EMO-R3 框架，通过结构化情感推理（Structured Emotional Thinking）和反思性情感奖励（Reflective Emotional Reward）增强多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的情感推理能力，使模型能进行逐步、可解释的推理，并基于视觉-文本一致性与情感连贯性重新评估推理结果。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 在情感理解上泛化性差、可解释性弱，且强化学习方法（如 GRPO）与情感认知特性不匹配。
Method: 引入结构化情感推理指导模型逐步推理，并设计反思性情感奖励机制，通过视觉-文本一致性与情感连贯性对推理结果进行再评估。
Result: 在多个视觉情感理解基准上，EMO-R3 显著提升了可解释性与情感智能，性能优于已有方法。
Conclusion: EMO-R3 通过反射式强化学习有效提升了 MLLM 的情感推理能力，但未讨论在非情感任务上的泛化性。

papers.title: HART: High-Resolution Annotation-Free Reasoning Technique through a Closed-loop Framework
papers.abstract_en: Current Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) struggle with high-resolution visual inputs during the reasoning process, as the number of image tokens increases quadratically with resolution, introducing substantial redundancy and irrelevant information. A common practice is to identify key image regions and refer to their high-resolution counterparts during reasoning, typically trained with external visual supervision. However, such visual supervision cues require costly grounding labels from human annotators. Meanwhile, it remains an open question how to enhance a model's grounding abilities to support reasoning without relying on additional annotations. In this paper, we propose High-resolution Annotation-free Reasoning Technique (HART), a closed-loop framework that enables LMMs to focus on and self-verify key regions of high-resolution visual inputs. HART incorporates a post-training paradigm in which we design Advantage Preference Group Relative Policy Optimization (AP-GRPO) to encourage accurate localization of key regions without external visual annotations. Notably, HART provides explainable reasoning pathways and enables efficient optimization of localization. Extensive experiments on MME-RealWorld-Lite, TreeBench, V* Bench, HR-Bench-4K/8K, and MMStar demonstrate that HART improves performance across a wide range of high-resolution visual tasks, consistently outperforming strong baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HART，一个无需外部视觉标注的闭环框架，通过后训练范式中的 Advantage Preference Group Relative Policy Optimization (AP-GRPO) 提升大多模态模型在高分辨率视觉输入中的推理能力，使模型能够自我定位和验证关键区域。实验在 MME-RealWorld-Lite、TreeBench、V* Bench、HR-Bench-4K/8K 和 MMStar 上显示性能提升。
Motivation: 当前大视觉语言模型在处理高分辨率输入时，图像令牌数随分辨率平方增长，带来大量冗余和无关信息。现有方法依赖昂贵的人工标注来定位关键区域，缺乏自动化的无监督方法。
Method: 提出 HART 闭环框架，包含后训练范式 AP-GRPO，通过偏好比较鼓励模型准确定位关键区域，无需外部视觉标注，并实现可解释的推理路径。
Result: 在 MME-RealWorld-Lite、TreeBench、V* Bench、HR-Bench-4K/8K 和 MMStar 等基准上，HART 在多项高分辨率视觉任务中显著优于强基线。
Conclusion: HART 有效减少了高分辨率视觉推理中的冗余，提升了模型定位和推理能力，且无需额外标注，但本文未涉及实时性或计算效率。

papers.title: Power and Limitations of Aggregation in Compound AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: When designing compound AI systems, a common approach is to query multiple copies of the same model and aggregate the responses to produce a synthesized output. Given the homogeneity of these models, this raises the question of whether aggregation unlocks access to a greater set of outputs than querying a single model. In this work, we investigate the power and limitations of aggregation within a stylized principal-agent framework. This framework models how the system designer can partially steer each agent's output through its reward function specification, but still faces limitations due to prompt engineering ability and model capabilities. Our analysis uncovers three natural mechanisms -- feasibility expansion, support expansion, and binding set contraction -- through which aggregation expands the set of outputs that are elicitable by the system designer. We prove that any aggregation operation must implement one of these mechanisms in order to be elicitability-expanding, and that strengthened versions of these mechanisms provide necessary and sufficient conditions that fully characterize elicitability-expansion. Finally, we provide an empirical illustration of our findings for LLMs deployed in a toy reference-generation task. Altogether, our results take a step towards characterizing when compound AI systems can overcome limitations in model capabilities and in prompt engineering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在委托人-代理人框架下研究了复合AI系统中聚合多个同质模型响应的能力与局限性。作者揭示了三种自然机制——可行性扩展、支持扩展和绑定集收缩——通过它们聚合可以扩展可诱导的输出集合，并证明了任何聚合操作要成为可诱导性扩展必须实现这些机制之一。最后在参考生成任务上对LLM进行了实证说明。
Motivation: 复合AI系统常通过聚合多个相同模型的输出来提升性能，但聚合是否能突破单模型输出集合的限制尚不明确。本文旨在从理论上刻画聚合的边界条件。
Method: 采用委托人-代理人框架，其中系统设计者通过奖励函数规范部分引导每个代理输出，但受限于提示工程能力和模型能力。分析了聚合操作对可诱导输出集合的影响，给出了必要充分条件。
Result: 识别出可行性扩展、支持扩展和绑定集收缩三种机制，证明聚合实现可诱导性扩展必须运用其一，且加强版机制提供了完整刻画。
Conclusion: 结果有助于理解复合AI系统何时能克服模型能力和提示工程的局限性，为系统设计提供理论指导。

papers.title: Segmenting Low-Contrast XCTs of Concrete: An Unsupervised Approach
papers.abstract_en: X-Ray Computed Tomography (XCT) is a compelling tool in experimental mechanics, capable of non-destructively extracting information pertaining to the internal morphology of materials. For materials with random heterogeneous morphology such as concrete, such information is of particular relevance since it allows for studies of morphology-related behaviour and for predictive modelling. Nevertheless, XCT images require semantic segmentation for practical usage. Here, concrete poses a unique challenge due to the similar X-ray attenuation coefficients of aggregates and mortar, which result in low contrast between the two phases in the ensuing XCT images. As such, purely intensity-dependent semantic segmentation tools remain unfeasible. While vision transformers (ViTs) and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are proven techniques for semantic segmentation in such challenging cases, they typically require labelled training data, which is often unavailable for concrete or resource-intensive to obtain, thereby limiting their relevance. To address this challenge, a self-annotation technique is presented here that leverages superpixel algorithms to identify perceptually similar local regions in an image and relates them to the global context by utilizing the receptive field of a CNN-based model. This enables the model to learn a global-local relationship in the images and facilitates the identification of semantically similar structures. When evaluated against manually annotated ground truth on out-of-distribution data, the proposed methodology consistently outperformed direct greyscale thresholding across all pertinent metrics, demonstrating improved discernibility between aggregates and mortar, and providing the most favourable balance of sensitivity and precision for aggregate-phase identification.
papers.comment: Revised abstract, introduction, and conclusion. Added a summary table to results with accompanying text; updated bibliography. Core model, data, training methodology and findings remain unchanged. Minor edits throughout to improve readability
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对混凝土XCT图像中骨料与砂浆对比度低导致语义分割困难的问题，提出一种无监督自标注方法。该方法利用超像素算法识别局部相似区域，并通过CNN模型的感受野建立全局-局部关系，从而无需标注数据即可学习语义相似结构。在分布外数据上，该方法在所有相关指标上优于直接灰度阈值分割，实现了骨料相更优的识别精度与灵敏度-精确度平衡。
Motivation: 混凝土XCT图像中骨料与砂浆的X射线衰减系数相似，导致图像对比度低，传统基于强度的分割方法不可行；而监督学习方法需要大量标注数据，在混凝土领域难以获取或成本高昂。
Method: 提出自标注技术：先使用超像素算法获取局部感知相似区域，然后利用CNN模型感受野将局部区域与全局上下文关联，学习全局-局部关系，从而识别语义相似结构。
Result: 在分布外数据上，该方法在所有相关指标上持续优于直接灰度阈值分割，提升了骨料与砂浆的可区分性，并在骨料相识别中取得了最佳的灵敏度与精确度平衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法无需标注数据即可有效分割低对比度混凝土XCT图像，为缺乏标注的资源受限场景提供了可行方案。

papers.title: SOMtime the World Ain$'$t Fair: Violating Fairness Using Self-Organizing Maps
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised representations are widely assumed to be neutral with respect to sensitive attributes when those attributes are withheld from training. We show that this assumption is false. Using SOMtime, a topology-preserving representation method based on high-capacity Self-Organizing Maps, we demonstrate that sensitive attributes such as age and income emerge as dominant latent axes in purely unsupervised embeddings, even when explicitly excluded from the input. On two large-scale real-world datasets (the World Values Survey across five countries and the Census-Income dataset), SOMtime recovers monotonic orderings aligned with withheld sensitive attributes, achieving Spearman correlations of up to 0.85, whereas PCA and UMAP typically remain below 0.23 (with a single exception reaching 0.31), and against t-SNE and autoencoders which achieve at most 0.34. Furthermore, unsupervised segmentation of SOMtime embeddings produces demographically skewed clusters, demonstrating downstream fairness risks without any supervised task. These findings establish that \textit{fairness through unawareness} fails at the representation level for ordinal sensitive attributes and that fairness auditing must extend to unsupervised components of machine learning pipelines. We have made the code available at~ https://github.com/JosephBingham/SOMtime
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文证明无监督表示学习（如基于自组织映射的SOMtime方法）会从数据中自动提取敏感属性（如年龄、收入）作为潜在轴，即使这些属性在训练时被排除。在世界价值观调查和人口普查收入数据集上，SOMtime恢复的排序与隐藏敏感属性的Spearman相关性高达0.85，远超PCA、UMAP、t-SNE和自编码器。这种表示的无监督分割会产生人口统计学偏斜的聚类，表明“通过 unawareness 实现公平”在表示层面失败。
Motivation: 现有观点认为无监督表示对敏感属性是中立的，但该论文挑战这一假设，指出即使在无监督场景下，敏感属性仍可被自动编码为潜在维度，对下游公平性构成风险。
Method: 提出SOMtime方法，基于高容量自组织映射（Self-Organizing Maps）进行拓扑保持表示学习，并在无监督设置下评估其对隐藏敏感属性的编码能力。
Result: 在两大真实世界数据集上，SOMtime恢复的排序与隐藏敏感属性的Spearman相关性高达0.85，而PCA/UMAP一般低于0.23，t-SNE和自编码器最多0.34；其无监督分割产生人口统计学偏斜的聚类。
Conclusion: 研究表明“通过 unawareness 实现公平”在表示层面对于有序敏感属性失效，公平性审计必须扩展到机器学习流程中的无监督组件。

papers.title: The Appeal and Reality of Recycling LoRAs with Adaptive Merging
papers.abstract_en: The widespread availability of fine-tuned LoRA modules for open pre-trained models has led to an interest in methods that can adaptively merge LoRAs to improve performance. These methods typically include some way of selecting LoRAs from a pool and tune merging coefficients based on a task-specific dataset. While adaptive merging methods have demonstrated improvements in some settings, no past work has attempted to recycle LoRAs found "in the wild" on model repositories like the Hugging Face Hub. To address this gap, we consider recycling from a pool of nearly 1,000 user-contributed LoRAs trained from the Llama 3.1 8B-Instruct language model. Our empirical study includes a range of adaptive and non-adaptive merging methods in addition to a new method designed via a wide search over the methodological design space. We demonstrate that adaptive merging methods can improve performance over the base model but provide limited benefit over training a new LoRA on the same data used to set merging coefficients. We additionally find not only that the specific choice of LoRAs to merge has little importance, but that using LoRAs with randomly initialized parameter values yields similar performance. This raises the possibility that adaptive merging from recycled LoRAs primarily works via some kind of regularization effect, rather than by enabling positive cross-task transfer. To better understand why past work has proven successful, we confirm that positive transfer is indeed possible when there are highly relevant LoRAs in the pool. We release the model checkpoints and code online.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了从公开模型库回收LoRA模块进行自适应合并的方法，基于近1000个用户贡献的LoRA进行实验。研究表明，自适应合并能提升基础模型性能，但其效果与在合并系数设置所用数据上训练一个新LoRA相比并无显著优势，且合并具体LoRA的选择影响甚微，甚至随机参数也能达到类似性能，暗示其主要机制是正则化而非跨任务正迁移。当池中存在高度相关LoRA时，正迁移才可能发生。
Motivation: 现有自适应合并LoRA的方法显示出一些改进，但尚未有工作尝试从模型仓库（如Hugging Face Hub）回收用户贡献的LoRA模块进行评估。论文旨在填补这一空白并探究回收LoRA的实际效果和机制。
Method: 论文从Llama 3.1 8B-Instruct模型出发，收集近1000个用户贡献的LoRA模块作为池子，采用多种自适应和非自适应合并方法，并通过广泛的搜索设计了一个新方法。实验比较了不同合并策略的性能，并分析了LoRA选择的重要性以及参数初始化对结果的影响。
Result: 自适应合并方法能提升基础模型性能，但与使用相同数据训练新LoRA相比没有显著优势；合并的具体LoRA选择不重要，甚至使用随机初始化参数的LoRA也能得到类似性能，表明主要收益来自正则化效应而非跨任务正迁移。当池中包含高度相关的LoRA时，正迁移是可能发生的。
Conclusion: 论文强调回收LoRA进行自适应合并的实际收益可能有限，其主要作用机制是正则化而不是正迁移，这为未来设计更有效的LoRA重用策略提供了参考。代码和模型已公开。

papers.title: VTC: DNN Compilation with Virtual Tensors for Data Movement Elimination
papers.abstract_en: With the widening gap between compute and memory operation latencies, data movement optimizations have become increasingly important for DNN compilation. Current optimizations such as layout transformations and operator fusion only target a subset of tensor operators and consequently miss important opportunities for reducing data movement in contemporary DNN workloads, including large language models. We introduce VTC, a novel tensor compilation framework that for the first time eliminates all unnecessary data movement by targeting the full spectrum of data movement operators. VTC proposes the concept of virtual tensors to track data movement between compute operators via index mappings rather than expensive physical data transfers to and from global memory, which can seamlessly interoperate with existing computation kernels and handle arbitrary tensor operator compositions. We also introduce a novel data movement elimination algorithm to automatically identify a profitable virtual tensor creation strategy. Evaluation on a variety of DNNs shows that VTC can outperform existing ML compilers by up to 1.93x (1.28x on average) on NVIDIA GPUs with up to 60% (17.5% on average) inference memory savings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VTC，一个张量编译框架，通过虚拟张量（virtual tensors）概念消除所有不必要的数据移动。虚拟张量利用索引映射而非物理内存传输来跟踪数据移动，可与现有计算内核互操作并处理任意算子组合。引入自动数据移动消除算法来选择最佳虚拟张量创建策略。在多种 DNN 上评估，在 NVIDIA GPU 上性能比现有编译器提升最高 1.93x（平均 1.28x），推理内存节省最高 60%（平均 17.5%）。
Motivation: 计算与内存操作延迟差距扩大，数据移动优化日益重要。现有优化（布局变换、算子融合）只针对部分算子，在大语言模型等现代 DNN 中遗漏重要数据移动消除机会。
Method: 提出虚拟张量概念，通过索引映射追踪计算算子间的数据移动，避免全局内存的物理传输。设计自动数据移动消除算法，识别并应用有利的虚拟张量创建策略，与现有计算内核无缝集成。
Result: 在多种 DNN 上，VTC 在 NVIDIA GPU 上比现有 ML 编译器性能提升最高 1.93x（平均 1.28x），推理内存节省最高 60%（平均 17.5%）。
Conclusion: VTC 首次针对全谱数据移动算子消除所有不必要的数据移动，且与现有计算内核兼容，适用于任意张量算子组合，显著提升性能并降低内存消耗。

papers.title: Can We Really Learn One Representation to Optimize All Rewards?
papers.abstract_en: As unsupervised pretraining becomes increasingly ubiquitous in reinforcement learning, a more thorough theoretical understanding of these methods becomes of equal importance to their empirical success. We focus on the setting of unsupervised learning via interaction, where the forward-backward (FB) representation learning serves as a prototypical and popular example. In this paper, we shed light on FB by formally contextualizing the method within a broader class of recent methods that use regression to obtain a low-rank approximation of a successor measure ratio. Our analysis clarifies when FB representations can exist and how the low-rank approximation converges in practice. Building upon the theory, we propose a variant of FB that is both more amenable to theoretical understanding and simpler to optimize in practice. Experiments in didactic settings, as well as in $10$ state-based and image-based continuous control domains, demonstrate that our method converges to desired representations with $10^5 \times$ smaller errors than FB, achieving $+24\%$ improved zero-shot performance on average. We also demonstrate that zero-shot policies inferred by our algorithm provide an efficient initialization if the user prefers further fine-tuning on downstream tasks. Our project website is available at https://chongyi-zheng.github.io/onestep-fb.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上分析了前向-后向（FB）表征学习在无监督强化学习中的性质，指出FB属于一类通过回归获得后继测度比低秩逼近的方法。作者提出了一个理论更清晰、优化更简单的FB变体。在10个基于状态和图像的连续控制领域实验中，该方法相比FB错误率降低了10^5倍，零样本性能平均提升24%，且零样本策略可作为下游任务微调的高效初始化。
Motivation: 无监督预训练在强化学习中日益普遍，但对其理论理解滞后于实证成功。需要厘清FB表征存在的条件以及低秩逼近的收敛性。
Method: 将FB表征重新形式化为一种通过回归获得后继测度比低秩逼近的方法，在此基础上提出一个理论更简洁且优化更简单的变体，并分析了其存在性和收敛性。
Result: 在10个连续控制基准（状态和图像输入）上，所提方法相比FB将表征错误率降低了10^5倍，零样本性能平均提升24%，且零样本策略可作为下游任务微调的良好初始化。
Conclusion: 理论分析揭示了FB表征的本质，提出的简化变体在效率和性能上显著优于原方法，为无监督强化学习提供了更坚实的理论基础和实用工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Predicting integers from continuous parameters
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of predicting numeric labels that are constrained to the integers or to a subrange of the integers. For example, the number of up-votes on social media posts, or the number of bicycles available at a public rental station. While it is possible to model these as continuous values, and to apply traditional regression, this approach changes the underlying distribution on the labels from discrete to continuous. Discrete distributions have certain benefits, which leads us to the question whether such integer labels can be modeled directly by a discrete distribution, whose parameters are predicted from the features of a given instance. Moreover, we focus on the use case of output distributions of neural networks, which adds the requirement that the parameters of the distribution be continuous so that backpropagation and gradient descent may be used to learn the weights of the network. We investigate several options for such distributions, some existing and some novel, and test them on a range of tasks, including tabular learning, sequential prediction and image generation. We find that overall the best performance comes from two distributions: Bitwise, which represents the target integer in bits and places a Bernoulli distribution on each, and a discrete analogue of the Laplace distribution, which uses a distribution with exponentially decaying tails around a continuous mean.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从连续特征预测整数标签的问题，提出使用离散分布（如按位伯努利分布和离散拉普拉斯分布）直接建模整数，并通过神经网络学习连续参数。实验涵盖表格、序列和图像生成任务，发现Bitwise分布和离散Laplace分布整体表现最佳。
Motivation: 传统回归将整数标签视为连续值会改变离散分布特性，而离散分布（如泊松）参数可能不连续，无法直接用于神经网络梯度下降。本文旨在寻找参数连续且能保留离散性质的分布，以改进整数预测。
Method: 比较多种离散分布（包括已有的和新提出的），其中Bitwise分布将整数分解为位并施加伯努利分布，离散Laplace分布以连续均值为中心、指数衰减尾部。这些分布的参数均为连续，适合反向传播。
Result: 在表格学习、序列预测和图像生成任务上，Bitwise和离散Laplace分布整体优于其他备选分布。
Conclusion: 离散分布可以有效地直接建模整数标签，且Bitwise和离散Laplace是实用选择。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: An Adaptive Differentially Private Federated Learning Framework
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning enables collaborative model training across distributed clients while preserving data privacy. However, in practical deployments, device heterogeneity and non-independent and identically distributed (Non-IID) data often lead to unstable and biased gradient. When differential privacy is enforced, conventional fixed gradient clipping and Gaussian noise injection may further amplify gradient perturbations, resulting in training oscillation and degraded model performance. To address these challenges, we propose an adaptive differentially private federated learning framework that explicitly targets model efficiency under heterogeneous and privacy-constrained settings. On the client side, a lightweight local dimensionality reduction module is introduced to learn reduced-dimensional intermediate representations and produce more structured gradients during backpropagation, thereby mitigating noise amplification during local optimization. On the server side, an adaptive gradient clipping strategy dynamically adjusts clipping thresholds based on historical update statistics to avoid over-clipping and noise domination. Furthermore, a constraint-aware robust aggregation mechanism is designed to suppress unreliable or noise-dominated client updates and stabilize global optimization. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10, SVHN, and STL-10 demonstrate that the proposed method consistently improves convergence stability and classification performance under differential privacy.
papers.comment: Accepted in International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对差分隐私联邦学习中设备异构和非独立同分布数据导致的梯度扰动问题，提出自适应差分隐私联邦学习框架。客户端引入轻量级降维模块生成结构化梯度，服务端采用自适应梯度裁剪和约束感知鲁棒聚合机制。在CIFAR-10、SVHN和STL-10上的实验表明，该方法一致提升了差分隐私下的收敛稳定性和分类性能。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习在设备异构和非独立同分布数据下梯度不稳定，差分隐私强制固定裁剪和噪声注入进一步加剧扰动，导致训练振荡和性能下降。
Method: 提出自适应差分隐私联邦学习框架，包含：1) 客户端轻量级局部降维模块，学习低维中间表示并产生结构化梯度；2) 服务端自适应梯度裁剪策略，基于历史更新统计动态调整裁剪阈值；3) 约束感知鲁棒聚合机制，抑制不可靠或噪声主导的客户端更新。
Result: 在CIFAR-10、SVHN和STL-10数据集上的实验表明，该方法在差分隐私约束下一致提升了收敛稳定性和分类性能。
Conclusion: 该自适应框架针对异构和隐私约束场景提升了模型效率，有效抑制噪声放大并稳定全局优化。

papers.title: MMEarth-Bench: Global Model Adaptation via Multimodal Test-Time Training
papers.abstract_en: Recent research in geospatial machine learning demonstrates that models pretrained with self-supervised learning on Earth observation data can perform well on downstream tasks with limited labeled data. However, most benchmark datasets have few data modalities and poor global representation, limiting the ability to evaluate multimodal pretrained models at global scales. In order to fill this gap, we introduce MMEarth-Bench, a collection of five new environmental tasks with 12 modalities, globally distributed data, and both random and geographic test splits. We benchmark a diverse set of pretrained models and find that while (multimodal) pretraining tends to improve model robustness in limited data settings, geographic generalization abilities remain poor. Moreover, a simple randomly initialized multimodal model is competitive given enough labeled data. Although data is abundant, models can currently only make use of the modalities on which they were pretrained. To solve this problem, we propose using all the modalities available at test time as auxiliary tasks for test-time adaptation. Our model-agnostic method for test-time training with multimodal reconstruction (TTT-MMR) can improve performance across all models and tasks on both test splits. Furthermore, geographic batching leads to a good trade-off between regularization and specialization during TTT, which is especially beneficial for long-tail distributions. Our dataset, code, and visualization tool are linked on the project page: lgordon99.github.io/mmearth-bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MMEarth-Bench 是一个包含 5 个新环境任务、12 种模态、全球分布数据及随机/地理测试集的多模态基准。实验表明，多模态预训练在有限数据下提升鲁棒性，但地理泛化能力仍差；简单随机初始化模型在数据充足时有竞争力。提出基于测试时训练的模型无关方法 TTT-MMR，利用所有可用模态作为辅助任务进行适应，地理分批在长尾分布上有优势。
Motivation: 现有地球观测基准数据集模态少、全球代表性不足，难以评估多模态预训练模型在全球尺度上的性能。
Method: 提出 MMEarth-Bench 基准及测试时训练方法 TTT-MMR，利用所有测试时可用模态作为辅助任务进行多模态重建，模型无关，并采用地理分批平衡正则化与专门化。
Result: 基准测试显示多模态预训练提升有限数据下的鲁棒性，但地理泛化仍差；TTT-MMR 在所有模型和任务上提升性能，地理分批对长尾分布尤其有益。

papers.title: Sharp Inequalities between Total Variation and Hellinger Distances for Gaussian Mixtures
papers.abstract_en: We study the relation between the total variation (TV) and Hellinger distances between two Gaussian location mixtures. Our first result establishes a general upper bound: for any two mixing distributions supported on a compact set, the Hellinger distance between the two mixtures is controlled by the TV distance raised to a power $1-o(1)$, where the $o(1)$ term is of order $1/\log\log(1/\mathrm{TV})$. We also construct two sequences of mixing distributions that demonstrate the sharpness of this bound. Taken together, our results resolve an open problem raised in Jia et al. (2023) and thus lead to an entropic characterization of learning Gaussian mixtures in total variation. Our inequality also yields optimal robust estimation of Gaussian mixtures in Hellinger distance, which has a direct implication for bounding the minimax regret of empirical Bayes under Huber contamination.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文建立了高斯位置混合之间总变差距离与Hellinger距离的尖锐不等式，证明Hellinger距离被TV距离的1-o(1)次幂控制，并构造序列证明最优性，解决了Jia等人(2023)的开放问题，进而给出了学习高斯混合的TV的熵特征以及Hellinger距离下的最优鲁棒估计。
Motivation: 理解高斯混合之间不同距离度量的关系，特别是解决Jia等人(2023)提出的开放问题，以获取学习高斯混合的TV的熵特征。
Method: 通过分析在紧集上支持的混合分布，建立一般上界；并构造两个序列的混合分布证明该上界的尖锐性。
Result: 证明了Hellinger距离被TV距离的1-o(1)次幂控制，其中o(1)项为1/loglog(1/TV)；该界是尖锐的。这解决了开放问题，并得到了学习高斯混合的TV的熵特征，以及Hellinger距离下的最优鲁棒估计。
Conclusion: 该不等式对高斯混合的TV学习提供了熵特征，并直接用于经验Bayes的极小极大遗憾界。

papers.title: Towards Understanding Steering Strength
papers.abstract_en: A popular approach to post-training control of large language models (LLMs) is the steering of intermediate latent representations. Namely, identify a well-chosen direction depending on the task at hand and perturbs representations along this direction at inference time. While many propositions exist to pick this direction, considerably less is understood about how to choose the magnitude of the move, whereas its importance is clear: too little and the intended behavior does not emerge, too much and the model's performance degrades beyond repair. In this work, we propose the first theoretical analysis of steering strength. We characterize its effect on next token probability, presence of a concept, and cross-entropy, deriving precise qualitative laws governing these quantities. Our analysis reveals surprising behaviors, including non-monotonic effects of steering strength. We validate our theoretical predictions empirically on eleven language models, ranging from a small GPT architecture to modern models.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at ICML 2026 (50 pages)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对大型语言模型（LLM）中引导强度（steering strength）进行理论分析，揭示其对下一个词概率、概念存在性及交叉熵的影响规律，包括非单调效应，并在11个模型上验证了理论预测。
Motivation: 尽管已有许多方法选择引导方向，但如何选择引导强度（移动幅度）的理论理解不足，强度过小或过大会分别导致行为未出现或性能严重下降。
Method: 提出引导强度的理论分析，推导了其对下一个词概率、概念存在性和交叉熵的精确定性规律，并在多个语言模型上进行了实验验证。
Result: 揭示了非单调效应等令人惊讶的行为，并在从小型GPT到现代模型的11个语言模型上验证了理论预测。
Conclusion: 作者强调该工作为引导强度提供了理论解释，揭示了非单调性，有助于更合理地选择引导强度。

papers.title: Framing Instability in LLM Ethical Stance: Auditing Negation Sensitivity in Moral Dilemmas
papers.abstract_en: Language models are increasingly consulted on ethically consequential questions, yet the stance a model expresses may not survive a change in framing. We audit 16 models across 14 ethically fraught dilemmas using polarity-paired proposals ("They should X" / "They should not X"). A model's judgment of the underlying action should not reverse merely because the question is phrased as a prohibition rather than a prescription and yet, we find systematic deviations from this invariance including wholesale endorsement flips, indicating that ethical decisions are vulnerable to framing instability. Small open-weight models (1-4B parameters) endorse a proposed action 24% of the time under affirmative framing but up to 100% under negated framings, a swing of as much as 76 percentage points. Human coding of a response sample confirms the instability is genuine while showing that binary agree/disagree proxies over-state its magnitude, suggesting that an LLM judge cannot replace human coders because it silently collapses abstentions and mirrors the very forced-choice bias under study. Commercial models are for the most part more stable but still shift substantially, with cross-model agreement dropping from 73% on the bare affirmative framing to 59% under simple negation. We argue that because binary agree/disagree formats both inflate apparent endorsement and mask polarity-dependence, single-phrasing audits can misreport a model's ethical stance, and we propose the Negation Sensitivity Index (NSI) as a complement that measures stance stability directly. A model whose stance flips with phrasing cannot be relied upon in any high-stakes decision scenario.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures (added gold labeled human datasets and additional statistical tests)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计了16个语言模型在14个道德困境中对肯定和否定框架的立场稳定性，发现模型对同一行为的判断在否定表述下可能发生反转，小模型（1-4B参数）的立场翻转幅度可达76个百分点。商业模型虽更稳定，但跨模型一致性从73%降至59%。作者提出否定敏感性指数（NSI）来衡量立场稳定性，并指出二值同意/不同意格式会夸大认可率并掩盖框架依赖。
Motivation: 语言模型越来越多地被用于伦理决策，但模型的立场可能因问题框架（肯定/否定）而改变，这种不稳定性在高风险场景中不可忽视。
Method: 使用极性配对提案（They should X / They should not X）审计16个模型在14个道德困境上的判断，结合人工编码统计，并提出否定敏感性指数（NSI）直接测量立场稳定性。
Result: 小模型在肯定框架下认可率24%，在否定框架下最高达100%，翻转幅度最大76个百分点；商业模型跨模型一致性从73%降至59%。人工编码显示二值代理夸大了不稳定性。
Conclusion: 二值同意/不同意格式既膨胀了认可率又掩盖了框架依赖，单短语审计可能误报模型伦理立场，NSI可补充测量立场稳定性，模型立场随框架翻转则不可在高风险场景中信赖。

papers.title: Spectral Diffusion Models on the Sphere
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models provide a principled framework for generative modeling via stochastic differential equations and time-reversed dynamics. However, extension of spectral diffusion approaches to spherical data raises nontrivial geometric and stochastic issues that are absent in the Euclidean setting. In this work, we develop a diffusion modeling framework defined directly on finite-dimensional spherical harmonic representations of real-valued functions on the sphere. We show that the spherical discrete Fourier transform maps spatial Brownian motion to a constrained Gaussian process in the frequency domain with deterministic, generally non-isotropic covariance. This induces modified forward- and reverse-time stochastic differential equations in the spectral domain. As a consequence, spatial and spectral score matching objectives are generally no longer equivalent, even in the band-limited setting. We establish a quantitative relationship between the two objectives, showing that the geometry-induced covariance of the spectral noise gives rise to a distinct, geometry-dependent inductive bias. We also derive the corresponding forward and reverse diffusion equations and characterize the induced noise covariance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在球面上发展了一种基于有限维球谐表示的谱扩散模型，证明了球面离散傅里叶变换将空间布朗运动映射到频域中的约束高斯过程，其协方差是确定性的且通常非各向同性。这导致空间和谱得分匹配目标在频带受限下也不等价，并建立了二者之间的定量关系，说明了几何诱导的协方差产生了独特的几何依赖归纳偏置。
Motivation: 将谱扩散方法扩展到球面数据时，会遇到欧几里得空间中没有的几何和随机问题，现有工作未充分处理这些挑战。
Method: 直接在球面实值函数的有限维球谐表示上定义扩散模型框架，推导了谱域中修正的前向和反向随机微分方程，并分析了得分匹配目标的关系。
Result: 球面离散傅里叶变换导致谱噪声具有几何诱导的确定性非各向同性协方差；空间和谱得分匹配目标在频带受限下不等价，且协方差引入了不同的归纳偏置。
Conclusion: 该工作为球面数据的谱扩散建模提供了理论基础，明确了几何效应带来的建模差异，但未涉及实际应用。

papers.title: Parametric and Generative Forecasts of EPEX Day\char45 Ahead Energy Market Curves
papers.abstract_en: We propose two methodologies for modelling aggregated supply and demand curves in the EPEX SPOT Day\char45 Ahead market, emphasizing generative models as a way to recover distributional variability. The first is a low\char45 dimensional parametric representation that yields deterministic point forecasts; the second is a high\char45 dimensional order\char45 level representation that samples from a conditional distribution of plausible curves. Both model the full curve structure, enabling the analysis of price sensitivity, volume sensitivity, and price impact. The parametric representation uses plateau levels, elastic\char45 region boundaries, and polynomial coefficients, forecast with eXtreme Gradient Boosting. The main contribution is the generative representation, which uses price arrivals and volume\char45 increment marks and is implemented with conditional Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models. Using French EPEX data from 2021 to 2024, we evaluate both approaches through curve reconstruction and a price\char45 maker storage optimization problem. The parametric implementation provides a deterministic reference, while the diffusion\char45 based implementation produces distributions of plausible curves and achieves higher realized profits and smaller gaps to an oracle benchmark in the storage application.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对EPEX日前电力市场的聚合供需曲线建模，提出了两种方法：低维参数化表示用于确定性点预测，以及高维订单级表示利用条件去噪扩散概率模型（conditional Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models）生成合理曲线的分布。基于2021-2024年法国EPEX数据评估，扩散模型在存储优化问题中实现了更高的已实现利润并缩小了与oracle基准的差距。
Motivation: 电力市场供需曲线建模对于价格敏感性分析和储能优化至关重要，但现有方法难以捕捉曲线的完整结构及分布变异性。
Method: 参数化方法使用平台水平、弹性区域边界和多项式系数，通过极端梯度提升（XGBoost）预测；生成式方法基于价格到达和增量体积标记，采用条件去噪扩散概率模型。
Result: 在法国EPEX数据上，扩散模型在曲线重建和储能优化任务中优于参数化基准，获得更高利润并缩小与oracle的差距。
Conclusion: 生成式方法能够恢复供需曲线的分布变异性，在储能等下游应用中具有优势。

papers.title: Counterfactual Modeling with Fine-Tuned LLMs for Health Intervention Design and Sensor Data Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual explanations (CFEs) provide human-centric interpretability by identifying the minimal, actionable changes required to alter a machine learning model's prediction. Therefore, CFs can be used as (i) interventions for abnormality prevention and (ii) augmented data for training robust models. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of CF generation using large language models (LLMs), including GPT-4 (zero-shot and few-shot) and two open-source models-BioMistral-7B and LLaMA-3.1-8B, in both pretrained and fine-tuned configurations. Using the multimodal AI-READI clinical dataset, we assess CFs across three dimensions: intervention quality, feature diversity, and augmentation effectiveness. Fine-tuned LLMs, particularly LLaMA-3.1-8B, produce CFs with high plausibility (up to 99%), strong validity (up to 0.99), and realistic, behaviorally modifiable feature adjustments. When used for data augmentation under controlled label-scarcity settings, LLM-generated CFs substantially restore classifier performance, yielding an average 20% F1 recovery across three scarcity scenarios. Compared with optimization-based baselines such as DiCE, CFNOW, and NICE, LLMs offer a flexible, model-agnostic approach that generates more clinically actionable and semantically coherent counterfactuals. Overall, this work demonstrates the promise of LLM-driven counterfactuals for both interpretable intervention design and data-efficient model training in sensor-based digital health. Impact: SenseCF fine-tunes an LLM to generate valid, representative counterfactual explanations and supplement minority class in an imbalanced dataset for improving model training and boosting model robustness and predictive performance

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了使用大语言模型（LLMs）生成反事实解释（CFEs）用于健康干预设计和传感器数据增强。微调后的LLaMA-3.1-8B生成的CFEs具有高可接受性（99%）和高有效性（0.99），在标签稀缺场景下平均F1恢复20%。与优化基线相比，LLMs提供了更灵活、模型无关的方法。
Motivation: 反事实解释可以提供可解释性，用于干预和数据增强，但传统优化方法可能产生不切实际或不可操作的CFE。需要评估LLMs在生成临床可操作反事实方面的能力。
Method: 使用GPT-4（零样本和少样本）、BioMistral-7B和LLaMA-3.1-8B（预训练和微调）在AI-READI多模态临床数据集上生成CFEs，并评估干预质量、特征多样性和增强效果。
Result: 微调后的LLaMA-3.1-8B生成的反事实具有高达99%的可接受性和0.99的有效性，作为数据增强在三种标签稀缺场景下平均恢复20%的F1分数。
Conclusion: 论文展示了LLM驱动的反事实在可解释干预设计和数据高效模型训练方面的潜力，特别是在传感器数字健康领域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ButterflyMoE: Compression-Scalable Ternary Experts via Structured Butterfly Orbits
papers.abstract_en: In current Mixture of Experts (MoE) architectures, linear memory scaling is present, the memory grows as the number of experts increases. $N$ independent expert weight matrices require $\mathcal{O}(N \cdot d^2)$ memory which exceeds the memory budget of edge devices. Current compression methods like quantization, pruning, and low-rank factorization reduce constant factors, but the scaling bottleneck is still unresolved. We introduce ButterflyMoE, a method which treats experts not as independent matrices but as geometric reorientations of a shared quantized substrate. Diversity amongst the experts arises from viewing different angles of the shared capacity and not from redundant storage. Learned rotations are applied to a shared ternary prototype. With this, each expert yields $\mathcal{O}(d^2 + N \cdot d \log d)$ memory-reducing per-expert cost from $\mathcal{O}(d^2)$ to $\mathcal{O}(d \log d)$. The key insight is that training these rotations with quantization reduces activation outliers and stabilizes extreme low-bit training where other static methods collapse. Across language modeling benchmarks, ButterflyMoE achieves 80$\times$ memory reduction at 8 experts with a highly favorable memory-accuracy tradeoff.At this 80x compression ButterflyMoE outperforms an equal memory dense baseline, showing that orbital parameterization extracts fundamentally more utility per byte. When scaled up to 256 experts, ButterflyMoE asymptotically compresses the memory by 150 $\times$. ButterflyMoE reduces the constant factor of linear scaling with compression ratio growing with the expert count.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ButterflyMoE，一种通过结构化蝴蝶轨道将专家参数化为共享三元原型的旋转视图的方法，实现内存压缩。与传统独立专家矩阵O(N·d^2)不同，每个专家仅需O(d log d)内存。实验表明，在8专家时达到80倍内存压缩，且性能优于等内存密集基线；256专家时压缩150倍。
Motivation: 当前MoE内存随专家数线性增长，现有压缩方法只减少常数因子，不能解决缩放瓶颈，难以部署在边缘设备。
Method: 专家不再作为独立矩阵，而是共享量化原型（三元权重）经过学习到的旋转（蝴蝶轨道）得到，每个专家成本从O(d^2)降到O(d log d)。训练中量化旋转减少了激活异常值，稳定极低比特训练。
Result: 在语言建模基准上，8专家实现80倍内存压缩且性能优于等内存密集基线；256专家时压缩150倍，压缩比随专家数增加。
Conclusion: ButterflyMoE通过轨道参数化在每字节上提取更多效用，显著降低了MoE的内存缩放常数因子，且压缩比随专家数增长。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Approximate full conformal prediction in an RKHS
papers.abstract_en: Full conformal prediction is a framework that implicitly formulates distribution-free confidence prediction regions for a wide range of estimators. However, a classical limitation of the full conformal framework is the computation of the confidence prediction regions, which is usually impossible since it requires training infinitely many estimators (for real-valued prediction for instance). The main purpose of the present work is to describe a generic strategy for designing a tight approximation to the full conformal prediction region that can be efficiently computed. Along with this approximate confidence region, a theoretical quantification of the tightness of this approximation is developed, depending on the smoothness assumptions on the loss and score functions. The new notion of thickness is introduced for quantifying the discrepancy between the approximate confidence region and the full conformal one.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对全共形预测（full conformal prediction）在RKHS中计算困难的问题，提出一种可高效计算的紧近似方法。作者引入“厚度”（thickness）概念来量化近似置信区域与真实全共形区域之间的差异，并在损失函数和得分函数的平滑性假设下给出理论保障。
Motivation: 全共形预测框架理论上能产生分布自由的置信预测区域，但实际计算需要训练无穷多个估计器，无法直接应用。
Method: 提出一种通用策略，在RKHS中构造全共形预测区域的紧近似，并利用新定义的“厚度”度量近似精度。
Result: 理论上证明了近似区域的紧致性依赖于损失和得分函数的平滑性假设。
Conclusion: 该方法为全共形预测提供了可计算的近似方案，并给出了近似质量的定量保证。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: High-Dimensional Analysis of Gradient Flow for Extensive-Width Quadratic Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We study the high-dimensional training dynamics of a shallow neural network with quadratic activation in a teacher-student setup. We focus on the extensive-width regime, where the teacher and student network widths scale proportionally with the input dimension, and the sample size grows quadratically. This scaling aims to describe overparameterized neural networks in which feature learning still plays a central role. In the high-dimensional limit, we derive a dynamical characterization of the gradient flow, in the spirit of dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT). Under l2-regularization, we analyze these equations at long times and characterize the performance and spectral properties of the resulting estimator. This result provides a quantitative understanding of the effect of overparameterization on learning and generalization, and reveals a double descent phenomenon in the presence of label noise, where generalization improves beyond interpolation. In the small regularization limit, we obtain an exact expression for the perfect recovery threshold as a function of the network widths, providing a precise characterization of how overparameterization influences recovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究深度二次激活浅层网络在高维教师-学生设置下的训练动力学，关注宽度与输入维度成比例的宽宽度机制，样本量二次增长。在高维极限下，使用动力平均场理论推导梯度流的动力学特征，分析l2正则化下的长时行为，刻画估计器的性能和谱性质，揭示存在标签噪声时的双重下降现象，并在小正则化极限下给出精确的完美恢复阈值。
Motivation: 理解过参数化对学习和泛化的影响，特别是特征学习仍起重要作用时的过参数化神经网络。
Method: 在教师-学生设置中，考虑深度二次激活的浅层网络，使用动力平均场理论在高维极限下推导梯度流的动力学方程，并分析l2正则化下的长期行为。
Result: 揭示了存在标签噪声时的双重下降现象，泛化能力在插值点之后改善；在小正则化极限下，给出了精确的完美恢复阈值，量化了网络宽度对恢复的影响。
Conclusion: 提供了对过参数化影响学习和泛化的定量理解，精确刻画了过参数化如何影响恢复。

papers.title: HiDVFS: Hierarchical Multi-Agent DVFS for Real-Time OpenMP DAG Workloads
papers.abstract_en: Leakage power in multicore embedded systems now rivals dynamic power, so DVFS schedulers must respect deadlines and thermal limits, not just average makespan. Existing heuristics lack per-core, temperature-aware control and overlook the irregular execution of OpenMP DAGs. We propose HiDVFS, a general, extensible hierarchical multi-agent DVFS scheduler: a profiler agent selects cores and frequencies, a thermal agent groups cores by temperature, and a priority agent orders tasks under contention, all trained with a makespan-focused reward using short-horizon future-state shaping for sample efficiency. Deadlines are soft, derived from a measured reference cost; a federated schedulability gate keeps operating points feasible, and a calibrated split-conformal shield bounds each action's predicted response time. On Jetson TX2 with multi-seed validation, HiDVFS attains a 4.16+/-0.58 s L10 makespan, a 2.83x speedup and 32.9% energy reduction over a fairness-corrected GearDVFS port, and a 4.62x average speedup with 55.7% energy reduction across all 12 BOTS benchmarks. Cross-platform results on TX2, Orin NX, and RubikPi show deadline-aware DVFS cuts energy 15 to 18% versus pinning the maximum frequency, and a measured mixed-criticality study shows cluster-aware reservation is required to keep a high-criticality task's deadline-miss ratio at zero.
papers.comment: 52 pages, 24 figures, 32 tables (supplement included as appendices). Under review at IEEE TPDS. v2: fairness-corrected GearDVFS baseline with fair-port study, multi-seed same-window re-measurement and full number audit, 12-benchmark BOTS evaluation, real-time evaluation (feasibility gate, conformal shield, mixed-criticality). Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21212162
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiDVFS，一种面向实时 OpenMP DAG 工作负载的分层多智能体 DVFS 调度器。它通过 profiler agent 选择核与频率、thermal agent 按温度分组核、priority agent 处理任务竞争，结合短期未来状态塑造的 makespan 奖励进行训练。在 Jetson TX2 上实现 4.16±0.58 秒的 L10 makespan，相对于公平修正的 GearDVFS 获得 2.83 倍加速和 32.9% 能耗降低，在 12 个 BOTS 基准上平均加速 4.62 倍，能耗降低 55.7%。跨平台实验显示 deadline-aware DVFS 比固定最高频率节能 15-18%，混合关键性研究证明簇感知保留对关键任务零错过截止时间不可或缺。
Motivation: 现有 DVFS 启发式方法缺乏每核温度感知控制，且忽略 OpenMP DAG 的不规则执行模式，导致能效与实时性难以兼顾。
Method: 提出分层多智能体 DVFS 调度器 HiDVFS，包括 profiler agent（选择核与频率）、thermal agent（按温度分组核）和 priority agent（排序竞争任务），使用 makespan 导向奖励和短期未来状态塑造提高样本效率；结合 federated schedulability gate 确保操作点可行，calibrated split-conformal shield 约束响应时间预测。
Result: 在 Jetson TX2 上达到 4.16±0.58 秒 L10 makespan，比公平修正的 GearDVFS 加速 2.83 倍并节能 32.9%；12 个 BOTS 基准平均加速 4.62 倍，节能 55.7%。跨平台（TX2, Orin NX, RubikPi）实验显示 deadline-aware DVFS 比固定最高频率节能 15-18%，混合关键性分析中簇感知保留使高关键性任务截止时间错过率为零。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分层多智能体方法能有效管理核级温度与任务竞争，在实时 OpenMP DAG 场景下显著提升性能与能效；混合关键性场景必须引入簇感知保留才能保证关键任务实时性。

papers.title: Neutral Substrates: A Design Constraint for Shared Records Under Persistent Interpretive Disagreement
papers.abstract_en: Shared accountability records are often used by parties who may never agree about causation, responsibility, or normative interpretation. For such records, neutrality cannot be achieved by omitting contested information, because accountability requires preserving the claims parties made, with their sources and provenance. Nor can neutrality be achieved by asserting one contested interpretation as the shared base. This paper defines a neutral substrate as a shared representational layer that provides stable reference while making no object-level substrate-layer commitments to causal or normative propositions. The central design constraint is that, when causal and normative propositions are contestable across admissible frameworks and the substrate's referential commitments are common ground, the substrate's neutrality is guaranteed at design time if and only if its foundational layer is restricted to those referential commitments and attribution propositions whose attributional basis is fixed by them. Causal and normative content may still be represented, but not as object-level foundational-layer commitments: it may appear there only as the content of attributed assertions with provenance, made by some identified framework, source, agent, institution, record, or document. The representational machinery used here is standard: reification, attribution, and provenance. The contribution is the constraint: a checkable condition on the foundational layer of a shared record, stated together with the assumptions it depends on and the boundary condition under which the constraint does not apply. A neutral substrate says enough to preserve accountability, but it does not turn one party's interpretation into an object-level substrate-layer commitment. The constraint does not apply at that layer when the referential regime or attributional basis is contested among the frameworks in play.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“中性底基”（neutral substrate）概念，作为共享记录在持续解释性分歧下保持中立性的设计约束。该约束要求基础层仅包含指称性承诺和归因命题，因果与规范内容只能作为有来源的归属断言出现，从而在不排除争议信息的前提下保证可问责性。
Motivation: 在多方案件中，共享问责记录的使用者可能就因果、责任或规范性解释存在持久分歧，现有方法（省略争议信息或强加单一解释）无法同时满足中立性和可问责性。
Method: 定义中性底基为共享表征层，通过严格限制基础层至指称承诺和固定归因基础的命题，并允许因果/规范内容作为带来源的归属断言出现，借助具体化、归因和来源机制实现设计时中立性保证。
Result: 摘要未提供实验性结果，而是给出形式化约束条件及其依赖假设与边界条件，声称该约束在指称体制或归因基础未被争议时保证设计时中立性。
Conclusion: 中性底基提供充分的信息以维护可问责性，但不将任何一方的解释转化为对象层基础承诺。该约束在参与框架间指称体制或归因基础存在争议时不适用。

summary_sections.motivation: 在多方案件中，共享问责记录的使用者可能就因果、责任或规范性解释存在持久分歧，现有方法（省略争议信息或强加单一解释）无法同时满足中立性和可问责性。
summary_sections.method: 定义中性底基为共享表征层，通过严格限制基础层至指称承诺和固定归因基础的命题，并允许因果/规范内容作为带来源的归属断言出现，借助具体化、归因和来源机制实现设计时中立性保证。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未提供实验性结果，而是给出形式化约束条件及其依赖假设与边界条件，声称该约束在指称体制或归因基础未被争议时保证设计时中立性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 中性底基提供充分的信息以维护可问责性，但不将任何一方的解释转化为对象层基础承诺。该约束在参与框架间指称体制或归因基础存在争议时不适用。

papers.title: Attention in Geometry: Scalable Spatial Modeling via Adaptive Density Fields and FAISS-Accelerated Kernels
papers.abstract_en: Spatial computation in geographic systems increasingly requires query-conditioned, local, interpretable aggregation under metric constraints. Many classical approaches rely on global summation and treat approximation as an implementation concern, limiting interpretability and scalability at large scales. We propose the Adaptive Density Field (ADF), a geometric attention framework that formulates spatial aggregation as a query-conditioned, metric-induced attention operator in continuous space. Given a set of labelled spatial points with associated scalar scores, ADF defines a continuous intensity field over space. For a given query location, the field value is obtained via a local adaptive Gaussian kernel mixture centered on the query's nearest neighbors, where kernel bandwidths are modulated by point-specific scores to evaluate local aggregated influence. Additionally, approximate nearest-neighbor search is introduced, enabling scalable execution while preserving locality. The proposed ADF bridges concepts from adaptive kernel methods, classical GIS methods, and attention mechanisms by reinterpreting spatial influence as geometry-embedded attention, grounded in physical distance rather than learned latent projections. The proposed framework is formulation-level rather than algorithm-specific, allowing flexible kernel choices, score-to-bandwidth mappings, and approximation parameters. This approach provides a unifying perspective on spatial influence modeling that emphasizes structure, scalability, and geometric interpretability, with relevance to geographic information systems and spatial machine learning.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应密度场（ADF），一种将空间聚合形式化为查询条件、度量诱导的连续空间注意力算子的几何注意力框架。ADF通过查询点最近邻的自适应高斯核混合估计局部强度，核带宽由点特定分数调制，并引入近似最近邻搜索实现可扩展执行。该框架将自适应核方法、经典GIS方法和注意力机制统一在几何嵌入的注意力视角下，强调结构、可扩展性和几何可解释性。
Motivation: 地理系统中的空间计算需要查询条件化、局部、可解释的聚合，但经典方法依赖全局求和，将近似视为实现问题，限制了大规模下的可解释性和可扩展性。
Method: 提出ADF框架，定义基于查询位置的连续强度场，场值由查询点最近邻的局部自适应高斯核混合获得，核带宽由点特定分数调制。采用FAISS加速的近似最近邻搜索实现可扩展执行，支持灵活的内核选择、分数到带宽映射和近似参数。
Result: 论文在公式层面提出统一视角，未报告具体数值结果，但强调框架的结构化、可扩展性和几何可解释性，与地理信息系统和空间机器学习相关。
Conclusion: ADF为空间影响建模提供了统一视角，强调结构、可扩展性和几何可解释性，适用于地理信息系统和空间机器学习，允许灵活的内核和参数选择。

papers.title: Diffusion Models in Simulation-Based Inference: A Tutorial Review
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have recently emerged as powerful learners for simulation-based inference (SBI), enabling fast and accurate estimation of latent parameters from simulated and real data. Their score-based formulation offers a flexible way to learn conditional or joint distributions over parameters and observations, thereby providing a versatile solution to various modeling problems. In this tutorial review, we synthesize recent developments on diffusion models for SBI, covering design choices for training, inference, and evaluation. We highlight opportunities created by various concepts such as guidance, score composition, flow matching, consistency models, and joint modeling. Furthermore, we discuss how efficiency and statistical accuracy are affected by noise schedules, parameterizations, and samplers. Finally, we illustrate these concepts with case studies across parameter dimensionalities, simulation budgets, and model types, and outline open questions for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于扩散模型在基于模拟的推断（SBI）中的教程综述，系统总结了扩散模型用于学习参数与观测的联合分布或条件分布的方法，涵盖训练、推断和评估的设计选择，并探讨了指导、分数组合、流匹配、一致性模型和联合建模等概念。
Motivation: 扩散模型在SBI中展现出强大能力，但缺乏系统性的综述来指导设计选择，包括噪声调度、参数化和采样器对效率和统计准确性的影响。
Method: 通过综述形式，整合扩散模型在SBI中的最新进展，列举关键设计维度（如训练目标、推断策略、评估指标），并通过案例研究展示不同参数维度、模拟预算和模型类型下的表现。
Result: 文章未提供新的实验结果，而是通过案例研究说明扩散模型在不同设置下的适用性，并指出了开放问题。
Conclusion: 扩散模型为SBI提供了灵活且高效的解决方案，但仍存在需要进一步探索的开放问题，如高维参数空间和有限模拟预算下的性能提升。

papers.title: HiMoE-VLA: Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts for Generalist Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Generalist vision--language--action (VLA) policies are typically trained on heterogeneous mixtures of robot demonstrations spanning diverse embodiments, action spaces, and observation configurations. Modeling such heterogeneity with a shared dense action module can induce negative transfer, particularly when action spaces or visual observations differ across data sources. We address this issue with HiMoE-VLA, a VLA framework built around a Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts (HiMoE) action module. HiMoE uses Action-Space MoE layers at the input/output boundaries to specialize computation for distinct action spaces, Heterogeneity-Balancing MoE layers in neighboring layers to provide balanced capacity for residual variation in observations, scenes, and embodiments, and dense Transformer blocks in the middle to integrate shared representations. Two auxiliary objectives further guide this hierarchy: a contrastive Action-Space Regularization objective for boundary specialization and a load-balancing objective for stable expert utilization. HiMoE-VLA reaches 3.98 on CALVIN, 98.0\% on LIBERO, and 75.0\% and 63.7\% average success on real xArm7 and ALOHA tasks; under controlled heterogeneous co-training, it turns the negative transfer observed in strong baselines into positive transfer. The code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/ZhiyingDu/HiMoE-VLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HiMoE-VLA 提出了一种基于层次化混合专家（HiMoE）的动作模块，用于通用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，以解决异构机器人演示数据中的负迁移问题。在多个基准（CALVIN、LIBERO）和真实机器人（xArm7、ALOHA）上取得了先进结果，并通过辅助目标实现专家专业化与负载均衡。
Motivation: 通用VLA策略通常训练于包含多种机器人形态、动作空间和观测配置的异构数据，使用共享的密集动作模块可能导致负迁移，尤其是在动作空间或视觉观测差异较大时。
Method: 提出HiMoE-VLA框架，其核心是层次化混合专家（HiMoE）动作模块：在输入/输出边界使用Action-Space MoE层专门处理不同动作空间，邻近层使用Heterogeneity-Balancing MoE层平衡观测、场景和形态的残差变化，中间使用密集Transformer块学习共享表征。辅助目标包括对比式Action-Space正则化和负载均衡损失。
Result: HiMoE-VLA在CALVIN上达到3.98，LIBERO上98.0%，真实xArm7和ALOHA任务平均成功率分别为75.0%和63.7%。在受控异构协同训练中，将强基线观察到的负迁移转化为正迁移。
Conclusion: 通过层次化混合专家架构和辅助目标，HiMoE-VLA能够有效处理VLA训练中的异构性，实现正迁移并提升性能。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Single-Image 4D Synthesis via Dense Trajectory Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating interactive and dynamic 4D scenes from a single static image remains a core challenge. Most existing generate-then-reconstruct and reconstruct-then-generate methods decouple geometry from motion, causing spatiotemporal inconsistencies and poor generalization. To address these, we present MoGe4D (Motion and Geometry-Aware image-to-4D Synthesis), a geometry-conditioned framework for single-image 4D synthesis that models a scene as dense 4D point trajectories. Instead of treating geometry and dynamics as two disconnected stages, our method starts from an initial geometric prior inferred from the input image and predicts future time-varying trajectories in a diffusion process, improving spatiotemporal coherence while preserving structural stability. To support this task, we first introduce TrajScene-60K, a large-scale dataset of 60,000 video samples with dense 4D point trajectories, addressing the scarcity of high-quality training data for scene-level 4D generation. Built on this, our diffusion-based 4D Scene Trajectory Generator (4D-STraG) predicts geometry-consistent and motion-plausible trajectory fields conditioned on the input image, with a depth-guided motion normalization strategy to reduce scale ambiguity and a Motion Perception Module (MPM) to inject motion-aware priors. We further propose a 4D View Synthesis Module (4D-ViSM) to render the generated 4D representation into videos under arbitrary camera trajectories. Experiments show that MoGe4D produces high-quality 4D scenes with strong temporal coherence, favorable geometry-aware consistency, and compelling novel-view synthesis from a single image. Code: https://github.com/Zhangyr2022/MoGe4D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MoGe4D，一种基于几何条件的单图像4D合成框架，通过将场景建模为密集4D点轨迹来同时生成几何与运动，避免了传统方法中几何与运动解耦导致的时空不一致。方法包括大规模数据集 TrajScene-60K、扩散模型 4D-STraG、深度引导运动归一化以及运动感知模块，能够从单张图像生成高质量4D场景并支持任意相机轨迹渲染。
Motivation: 现有单图像4D合成方法通常将几何与运动解耦为两个独立阶段，导致时空不一致和泛化能力差。该工作旨在联合建模几何与运动，提高时空连贯性和几何一致性。
Method: 提出 MoGe4D，包含三个关键组件：大规模4D轨迹数据集 TrajScene-60K；基于扩散的4D场景轨迹生成器 4D-STraG，使用深度引导运动归一化减少尺度模糊性并引入运动感知模块（MPM）；4D视图合成模块（4D-ViSM）用于在任意相机轨迹下渲染4D表示。
Result: 实验表明 MoGe4D 能够生成高质量4D场景，具有较强的时空连贯性、几何一致性和令人信服的新视图合成效果。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了通过密集轨迹场联合建模几何与运动可以显著提升单图像4D合成质量，数据集和代码已开源。

papers.title: FDRMFL: Multimodal Federated Feature Extraction Model Based on Information Maximization and Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract_en: We propose FDRMFL, a task-driven multimodal feature extraction framework for federated regression under non-IID data distributions. Extracting predictive features from high-dimensional multimodal inputs is particularly challenging in this setting: data cannot leave each client, local samples are scarce and heterogeneously distributed, and unsupervised dimensionality reduction discards task-relevant information while federated training introduces representation drift across communication rounds. FDRMFL addresses these challenges through a unified four-term local objective: MSE prediction loss, a correlation-based mutual information surrogate that preserves dependence between the fused representation and the continuous target, a symmetric KL penalty that aligns cross-modal latent distributions before fusion, and an InfoNCE-style contrastive loss that anchors local representations to the global consensus. Experiments on three synthetic and two real-world near-infrared spectroscopy datasets under non-IID federated partitions, with comprehensive ablation and sensitivity analyses, demonstrate that each component contributes to the framework's effectiveness. FDRMFL reduces mean MSE by 33.8% relative to the best traditional baseline (PCA) and by 43.0% relative to VAE in simulation, and attains the lowest overall mean MSE among six federated algorithms including FedAvg, FedProx, MOON, SCAFFOLD, and FedBN.
papers.comment: Accepted author manuscript; published version DOI: 10.1016/j.asoc.2026.115874
papers.journal_ref: Applied Soft Computing 202 (2026) 115874
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FDRMFL，一个面向非独立同分布 (non-IID) 联邦回归的任务驱动多模态特征提取框架。它通过结合均方误差损失、基于相关性的互信息代理、对称 KL 散度以及 InfoNCE 对比损失来联合优化，避免表示漂移并保留任务相关信息。在合成数据和真实近红外光谱数据集上的实验表明，FDRMFL 在均方误差上比传统基线方法（如 PCA）降低 33.8%，比 VAE 降低 43.0%，并在与 FedAvg、FedProx、MOON、SCAFFOLD 和 FedBN 等六种联邦算法的比较中取得最低平均均方误差。
Motivation: 在高维多模态输入的联邦回归中，数据无法离开客户端、本地样本稀少且分布异构，无监督降维会丢弃任务相关信息，联邦训练还会引入表示漂移，现有方法难以提取预测特征。
Method: 提出基于四项目标损失的本地目标函数：MSE 预测损失、基于相关性的互信息代理保持融合表示与连续目标之间的依赖、对称 KL 散度对齐融合前的跨模态潜在分布、以及 InfoNCE 对比损失将本地表示锚定到全局共识。
Result: 在三个合成数据集和两个真实近红外光谱数据集上，FDRMFL 的均方误差相比传统基线 PCA 降低 33.8%，相比 VAE 降低 43.0%，并在六种联邦算法中取得最低平均均方误差。
Conclusion: 通过消融和敏感性分析验证了每个组件对框架有效性的贡献，表明联合优化任务损失、信息保持和分布对齐能够有效解决非 IID 联邦回归中的特征提取问题。

summary_sections.motivation: 在高维多模态输入的联邦回归中，数据无法离开客户端、本地样本稀少且分布异构，无监督降维会丢弃任务相关信息，联邦训练还会引入表示漂移，现有方法难以提取预测特征。
summary_sections.method: 提出基于四项目标损失的本地目标函数：MSE 预测损失、基于相关性的互信息代理保持融合表示与连续目标之间的依赖、对称 KL 散度对齐融合前的跨模态潜在分布、以及 InfoNCE 对比损失将本地表示锚定到全局共识。
summary_sections.result: 在三个合成数据集和两个真实近红外光谱数据集上，FDRMFL 的均方误差相比传统基线 PCA 降低 33.8%，相比 VAE 降低 43.0%，并在六种联邦算法中取得最低平均均方误差。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通过消融和敏感性分析验证了每个组件对框架有效性的贡献，表明联合优化任务损失、信息保持和分布对齐能够有效解决非 IID 联邦回归中的特征提取问题。

papers.title: Thinking Ahead: Foresight Intelligence in MLLMs and World Model
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we define Foresight Intelligence as the capability to anticipate and interpret future events-an ability essential for applications such as autonomous driving, yet largely overlooked by existing research. To bridge this gap, we introduce FSU-QA, a new Visual Question-Answering (VQA) dataset specifically designed to elicit and evaluate Foresight Intelligence. Using FSU-QA, we conduct the first comprehensive study of state-of-the-art Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under foresight-oriented tasks, revealing that current models still struggle to reason about future situations. Beyond serving as a benchmark, FSU-QA also enables the assessment of world models by measuring the semantic coherence of their generated predictions, quantified through performance gains when VLMs are augmented with such outputs. Our experiments further demonstrate that FSU-QA can effectively enhance foresight reasoning: even small VLMs fine-tuned on FSU-QA surpass much larger, advanced models by a substantial margin. Together, these findings position FSU-QA as a principled foundation for developing next-generation models capable of truly anticipating and understanding future events. Furthermore, beyond model performance, we examine whether WM-generated predictions remain semantically consistent by using VLM-based proxy judges, and validate this evaluation protocol through shuffled control experiments. Fine-tuning models on FSU-QA leads to substantial improvements in foresight understanding, demonstrating the dataset's effectiveness and offering a principled foundation for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文定义Foresight Intelligence（前瞻智能）为预测和解读未来事件的能力，并引入FSU-QA视觉问答数据集来评估多模态大语言模型（VLM）的前瞻能力。实验发现当前VLM在未来情景推理上表现不足，但小模型在FSU-QA上微调后能大幅超越更先进的模型。FSU-QA还可用于评估世界模型生成预测的语义连贯性。
Motivation: 现有研究忽视了前瞻智能，而它在自动驾驶等关键应用中不可或缺。缺乏专门的数据集和评估方法。
Method: 构建FSU-QA数据集，包含前瞻导向的视觉问答任务，用于激发和评估VLM的前瞻智能；同时设计基于VLM代理的世界模型语义一致性评估协议。
Result: 当前VLM在前瞻任务上表现不佳；小模型在FSU-QA上微调后显著超越大模型（如GPT-4V）；FSU-QA结合VLM代理可有效评估世界模型预测的语义一致性。
Conclusion: FSU-QA为发展具有真正未来事件预测能力的下一代模型提供了原则性基础，并证明该数据集能有效提升前瞻理解。

papers.title: Zero-Human Demonstration End-to-end Autonomous Driving with Trajectory Scorer
papers.abstract_en: Human demonstrations are widely considered the cornerstone of end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving despite human demonstration's scarcity for long-tail and safety-critical scenarios. Nonetheless, current E2E autonomous driving (AD) training paradigms continue to rely on human demonstrations. Imitation learning (IL) requires human demonstrations for training, whereas reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising alternative to reduce this dependency. However, most existing RL methods for E2E AD still rely implicitly on human demonstrations. A pure rewards-based RL method can overcome the need for human demonstrations, but general RL policy gradient methods suffer from the cold-start problem. In this paper, we propose ZTRS (Zero-human demonstration end-to-end autonomous driving with TRajectory Scorer) - a complete RL-based E2E planning paradigm trained solely on real-world images and rule-based rewards, entirely without human demonstration. Through our proposed Exhaustive Policy Optimization (EPO), a policy gradient variant tailored for enumerable trajectory actions and dense supervision, ZTRS enables the model to generalize better to long-tail driving scenarios. We demonstrate this generalization through our SOTA performance against IL approaches on both long-tail Navhard and closed-loop HUGSIM datasets. Project page: https://zhenxinli.net/ZTRS/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ZTRS，一种完全基于强化学习的端到端自动驾驶规划框架，无需任何人类演示即可训练。通过Exhaustive Policy Optimization (EPO)策略梯度变体，模型在长尾驾驶场景中取得SOTA性能，在两个数据集上超过模仿学习方法。
Motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶依赖人类演示，但长尾和安全性关键场景的演示数据稀缺。纯强化学习可摆脱演示依赖，但面临冷启动问题。
Method: 提出ZTRS框架，结合基于规则的奖励和EPO策略梯度算法，处理可枚举的轨迹动作空间并提供密集监督信号，完全无需人类演示数据。
Result: 在长尾Navhard和闭环HUGSIM数据集上，ZTRS超越现有模仿学习方法的性能，展示了更好的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 纯基于强化学习的范式可以完全消除对人类演示的需求，并且在长尾场景中表现更优，为端到端自动驾驶提供了新的训练方向。

papers.title: Refine Thought: A Test-Time Inference Method for Embedding Model Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We propose RT (Refine Thought), a method that can enhance the semantic reasoning ability of text embedding models. The method obtains the final semantic representation by running multiple forward passes of the text embedding model. Experiments show that RT achieves significant improvements on semantic reasoning tasks in BRIGHT and the person-job matching benchmark PJBenchmark, while maintaining consistent performance on general-purpose semantic understanding tasks such as C-MTEB. Our results indicate that RT is effective because it further activates the semantic reasoning ability learned during pretraining by decoder-only text embedding models (e.g., Qwen3-Embedding-8B). RT can be seen as a test-time inference method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Refine Thought (RT)方法，通过在解码器-only文本嵌入模型（如Qwen3-Embedding-8B）上运行多次前向传播来获得更好的语义表示。实验表明RT在语义推理任务BRIGHT和人才匹配基准PJBenchmark上取得显著改进，同时在通用语义理解任务C-MTEB上保持一致性能。该方法被视为一种测试时推理技巧。
Motivation: 现有文本嵌入模型在语义推理任务上表现不足，RT旨在不改变模型参数的情况下增强其推理能力。
Method: RT通过对文本嵌入模型进行多次前向传播，将中间或最终表示进行融合或精炼，以获得最终的语义表示。
Result: RT在BRIGHT和PJBenchmark上取得显著改进，同时在C-MTEB上保持性能不变。
Conclusion: RT能激活解码器-only文本嵌入模型在预训练中学到的语义推理能力，可作为测试时推理方法有效提升推理任务表现。

papers.title: LiveOIBench: Can Large Language Models Outperform Human Contestants in Informatics Olympiads?
papers.abstract_en: Competitive programming problems are increasingly used to evaluate the coding capabilities of large language models (LLMs) due to their complexity and ease of verification. Yet, current coding benchmarks face limitations such as a lack of exceptionally challenging problems, insufficient test case coverage, and reliance on online platform APIs that limit accessibility. To address these issues, we introduce LiveOIBench, a large-scale competitive programming benchmark featuring 403 expert-curated problems, averaging 60 official test cases each, drawn from 72 contests across 14 Informatics Olympiads held between 2023 and 2025. LiveOIBench has four key features: (1) expert-designed tasks with detailed subtask rubrics and extensive test cases; (2) direct comparison to elite human contestants; (3) continuous updates to reduce contamination risk; and (4) a fully offline, reproducible evaluation system. Benchmarking 34 popular general-purpose and reasoning LLMs, we find that GPT-5 achieves an 81.76th percentile, still falling short of top human contestants, while among the open-weight models, GPT-OSS-120B reaches only the 60th percentile. Reasoning-trace analyses indicate that robust reasoning models prioritize precise problem analysis over excessive exploration. Finally, analyses across release dates, task familiarity, and code similarity find minimal evidence of data contamination in our benchmark. Our leaderboard, code, and data are available at: https://liveoibench.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LiveOIBench，一个大规模信息学奥林匹克竞赛编程基准，包含 403 道专家精选题目（平均 60 个官方测试用例），覆盖 2023–2025 年 14 个竞赛。在 34 个 LLM 上评测发现：GPT-5 达到 81.76 百分位但仍落后于顶尖人类选手，开源模型 GPT-OSS-120B 仅 60 百分位。推理轨迹分析表明稳健模型更注重精确分析而非过度探索，且数据污染检查未发现明显证据。
Motivation: 现有编程基准存在挑战性不足、测试用例覆盖差、依赖在线平台等问题，难以准确评估 LLM 在复杂竞赛场景下的真实能力。
Method: 构建 LiveOIBench，收集 403 道专家设计题目，每个题目含多个子任务评分标准和平均 60 个测试用例，支持完全离线可重复评估，并与人类选手直接对比。
Result: GPT-5 达到 81.76 百分位，仍低于顶尖人类选手；开源模型 GPT-OSS-120B 仅 60 百分位。推理轨迹分析显示稳健模型优先精确问题分析而非过度探索，未发现明显数据污染。
Conclusion: LiveOIBench 提供了一个高难度、低污染的评估平台，但当前最佳 LLM 仍不及人类精英，表明在复杂编程推理任务上存在显著差距。

papers.title: Provable Affine Identifiability of Nonlinear CCA under Latent Distributional Priors
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we establish the sufficient conditions under which nonlinear Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) recovers ground-truth latent factors up to an affine transformation. By transporting the analysis from the observation space to the source space, we extend classical statistical results on orthogonal polynomial expansions of bivariate distributions to representation learning, proving affine identifiability under specific distributional priors. We formally demonstrate that whitening is strictly necessary to ensure the boundedness and well-conditioning of the learned mappings. Furthermore, we bridge the gap between theory and practice by proving that ridge-regularized empirical CCA converges to its population counterpart in the finite-sample regime. Finally, our findings provide a rigorous theoretical foundation explaining the empirical success of recent correlation-based non-contrastive learning methods. Experiments on synthetic and rendered image datasets, alongside systematic ablations, validate the predicted recovery behavior and illustrate the failure modes that arise when the assumptions are violated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了非线性典型相关分析（CCA）在特定潜在分布先验下能够恢复真实潜在因子至仿射变换。通过将分析从观测空间转移到源空间，作者扩展了双变量分布的正交多项式展开结果，建立了仿射可识别性。理论分析表明白化是确保学习映射有界和良态的必要条件，并证明了岭正则化经验CCA在有限样本下收敛到总体CCA。实验验证了理论预测的恢复行为及假设违反时的失败模式。
Motivation: 非线性CCA的潜在因子可识别性缺乏理论保证，尤其是仿射变换下的唯一性。
Method: 将观测空间的CCA分析转移到源空间，利用双变量分布的广义正交多项式展开，结合白化和岭正则化理论分析。
Result: 严格证明了仿射可识别性的充分条件，白化的必要性，以及经验CCA的有限样本收敛性。实验验证了理论预测。
Conclusion: 为基于相关的非对比学习方法提供了理论基础，但可识别性依赖于特定的分布先验假设。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Activation Quantization of Vision Encoders Needs Prefixing Registers
papers.abstract_en: Large pretrained vision encoders are central to multimodal intelligence, powering applications from on-device vision processing to vision-language models. Since these applications often demand real-time processing of massive visual data, reducing the inference cost of vision encoders is critical. Quantization offers a practical path, but it remains challenging even at 8-bit precision due to so-called outliers. In this work, we propose $\textit{RegCache}$, a training-free algorithm that mitigates outliers in large-scale pretrained vision encoders and serves as a plug-in module that can be applied on top of other quantization methods. RegCache introduces outlier-prone yet semantically meaningless prefix tokens to the vision encoder, which prevent other tokens from having outliers. Notably, we observe that outliers in vision encoders behave differently from those in language models, motivating two technical innovations: middle-layer prefixing and token deletion. Experimental results show that our method consistently improves quantized model performance across various vision encoders, particularly in extremely low-bit regimes (e.g., 4-bit).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RegCache，一种无需训练的方法，通过在视觉编码器中添加前缀标记来缓解激活值中的异常值，从而提升量化性能。实验表明该方法在多种视觉编码器上均有效，尤其在 4-bit 极低比特量化场景下表现突出。
Motivation: 大规模预训练视觉编码器在量化时即使 8-bit 精度也会因异常值而性能下降，影响多模态应用的推理效率。
Method: 提出 RegCache 作为即插即用模块，在编码器中间层添加易产生异常值但语义无意义的前缀标记，并配合标记删除操作，避免其他标记出现异常值。
Result: 在多种视觉编码器上一致提升量化模型性能，尤其在 4-bit 极低比特量化下效果显著。
Conclusion: 研究表明视觉编码器中的异常值行为与语言模型不同，因此需要中间层前缀和标记删除的创新设计。
Relevance: 0
