summary_sections.result: 在数学推理基准上，GeoSD相比基线模型在多个模型家族（1.7B-32B）上平均分布外准确率提升5.7-8.6个百分点，且保持分布内增益。分析表明，标准匹配通过在高熵状态牺牲替代选项来达成教师一致，导致错误答案上的自信一致，而GeoSD保留了替代选项。
summary_sections.conclusion: GeoSD通过几何正则化有效抑制自蒸馏中的预测漂移，提升推理泛化能力，尤其改善分布外性能。论文强调，标准蒸馏失败的根源在于高熵状态下过度压缩概率质量，而GeoSD的几何视角提供了更稳健的优化方向。

papers.title: A Gold-Standard Study of What Makes a Lightweight Game-Playing Agent Strong
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning agents for imperfect-information card games are only as strong as the opponents they train against, and they are hard to grade, since they beat a random opponent over 99 percent of the time and only tie copies of themselves. So we build a strong, fixed, rule-based expert for Gin Rummy and use it only as a yardstick, never for training. It beats every agent we trained 70 to 99 percent of the time. Across more than a hundred runs, we isolate what makes a lightweight agent stronger. Trust region updates, a well-aimed reward, a curriculum of tougher opponents, warm starting, and keeping the best checkpoint all help, and stacking them lifts a self-play champion from about 30 to 36 percent against the expert. Several ideas did not pay off. Short-term and longer-term reward shaping, learned state embeddings, imitation and DAgger, and a live large language model opponent were each unhelpful, too slow, or too heavy to train at scale. Comparing MLP, convolutional, set-based, attention, and recurrent encoders shows that extra capacity does little to break the ceiling, suggesting the limit is information rather than network size. We add standard baselines (neural fictitious self-play and information set Monte Carlo search) and confirm the approach carries over to Leduc Hold'em, where the optimum is computable. The result is a lightweight, game-agnostic recipe that trains competitive agents without training on the expert, for any game a small model can handle, reported with robust statistics and released as a reusable package.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Code and models: https://github.com/Nikelroid/adversarial-coevolution
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于 Gin Rummy 游戏构建了一个强固定规则专家作为衡量基准，通过超过100次实验系统研究了提升轻量级游戏智能体性能的关键因素。研究发现信任区域更新、精心设计的奖励、难度递进的课程学习、热启动和保留最佳检查点等技巧可以累积提升效果，而奖励塑形、学习状态嵌入、模仿学习和大型语言模型对手等方法效果不佳。作者还在 Leduc Hold'em 上验证了方法的通用性，并提供了可复现的代码包。
Motivation: 不完美信息纸牌游戏中的强化学习智能体性能受限于对手强度，且难以评估（随机对手胜率超99%，自对弈仅平局），因此需要一种可靠的基准来系统分析影响轻量级智能体强度的关键因素。
Method: 构建一个强固定规则专家（仅作为评估基准，不用于训练），通过大量实验（超过100次运行）对比不同训练技巧（信任区域更新、奖励设计、课程学习、热启动、检查点选择等）和不同网络架构（MLP、卷积、集合、注意力、循环编码器）的效果，并在 Leduc Hold'em 上验证通用性。
Result: 信任区域更新、精心设计的奖励、课程学习、热启动和保留最佳检查点等技巧可将自对弈冠军对专家的胜率从约30%提升至36%；而奖励塑形、学习状态嵌入、模仿学习和大型语言模型对手效果不佳或不可行；网络容量增加未能突破性能上限，表明信息而非网络大小是瓶颈。
Conclusion: 该研究提供了一种轻量级、游戏无关的配方，能够在不依赖专家训练的情况下训练出有竞争力的智能体，适用于任何小模型可处理的游戏，并以稳健统计和可复现包的形式发布。

papers.title: Retrieving and Refining Winning Noise Tickets for Diffusion-Based Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based text-to-motion models synthesize realistic human motions but often exhibit semantic drift from the input text. Motion is inherently temporal, especially in compositional and long-duration sequences that require semantic consistency across multiple action segments and smooth kinematic transitions throughout the trajectory. We posit that the initial noise is central to this consistency: within the Gaussian noise space, certain instances, i.e. winning noise tickets, carry latent structure that biases denoising toward particular motion semantics, even under null prompts. We propose WInning Noise Retrieval and Optimization (WINRO), a training-free, model-agnostic framework that improves text-motion alignment by selecting and refining such tickets before diffusion sampling. WINRO maps random noises to motion features generated under null prompts, retrieves the best-aligned noise for a given text, and refines it via a KL-regularized objective that reduces the residual semantic gap while preserving the Gaussian prior. An optional LoRA-based adapter amortizes this refinement into a single forward pass. WINRO consistently improves text-motion fidelity across different base models, MDM and MotionLCM, on HumanML3D without retraining, improves temporal robustness on the MTT benchmark, and generalizes to applications such as motion stylization and spatial constraint satisfaction.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026, Project page: https://sinc865.github.io/winro/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WINRO框架，通过检索和优化高斯噪声空间中的"获胜噪声票"（winning noise tickets），在无需训练的范式下提升扩散模型文本到人体运动生成的语义对齐性。该方法在HumanML3D数据集上对MDM和MotionLCM模型一致提升文本-运动保真度，并在MTT基准上改进时间鲁棒性，还能推广到运动风格化和空间约束满足等应用。
Motivation: 扩散文本-运动模型易出现语义漂移，尤其是在组合性和长持续时间序列中，需要跨多个动作段保持语义一致和平滑运动学过渡。作者认为初始噪声对一致性至关重要，噪声空间中某些实例（获胜噪声票）即使使用空提示也携带偏向特定运动语义的潜在结构。
Method: WINRO包含三个步骤：将随机噪声映射到空提示下生成的运动特征；检索与给定文本最对齐的噪声；通过KL正则化目标细化该噪声，减少残余语义差距同时保持高斯先验。可选LoRA适配器将细化过程摊销为单次前向传播。
Result: 在HumanML3D上无需重新训练即一致提升MDM和MotionLCM的文本-运动保真度；在MTT基准上改善时间鲁棒性；并泛化到运动风格化和空间约束满足。
Conclusion: 摘要强调WINRO是训练无关、模型无关的框架，通过选择和细化噪声票有效改进文本-运动对齐，并展示了跨模型和跨应用的通用性。

papers.title: Tensor Train Diffusion: Leveraging Low-Rank Structures for High-Dimensional Score-Based Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models offer a powerful framework for sampling from complex probability densities by learning to reverse a noising process. A common approach involves solving for the time-reversed stochastic differential equation (SDE), which requires the score function of the evolving sample distribution. The logarithm of this distribution's density is governed by a Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) type partial differential equation (PDE). However, current methods for solving this PDE, such as PINNs or trajectory-based techniques, often suffer from long training times and significant sensitivity to hyperparameter tuning. In this work, we introduce a novel and efficient solver for the underlying HJB equation based on the functional tensor train (FTT) format. The FTT representation leverages latent low-rank structures to efficiently approximate high-dimensional functions, enabling both model compression and rapid computation. By integrating this efficient representation with a backward-in-time iterative scheme derived from backward stochastic differential equations (BSDEs), we develop a fast, robust and accurate sampling method. Our approach overcomes primary bottlenecks of existing techniques, enabling high-fidelity sampling from challenging target distributions with improved efficiency.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型中求解HJB型偏微分方程（PDE）的训练时间长、超参数敏感等瓶颈，提出基于功能张量列（FTT）格式的高效求解器。FTT利用潜在低秩结构逼近高维函数，结合反向随机微分方程（BSDE）的迭代方案，实现了快速、鲁棒且准确的采样方法。该工作在模型压缩和计算速度上取得提升，能够从复杂目标分布中生成高质量样本。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型求解时间反向SDE需要得分函数，而底层HJB型PDE的求解方法（如PINNs或基于轨迹的技术）存在训练耗时长、对超参数敏感等问题，阻碍了高维采样的效率。
Method: 引入功能张量列（FTT）格式来表示HJB方程的解，利用低秩结构压缩模型并加速计算；结合反向随机微分方程（BSDE）推导的时间逆向迭代方案进行求解。
Result: 该方法在保持高保真度的同时显著提升了采样效率，克服了现有方法的主要计算瓶颈。
Conclusion: FTT表示与BSDE迭代的结合提供了一种快速、鲁棒且准确的高维采样替代方案，有望推动扩散模型在更复杂分布上的应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LEMUR 2: Unlocking Neural Network Diversity for AI
papers.abstract_en: Existing NAS benchmarks (e.g., NAS-Bench, NATS-Bench) cover only narrow, task-specific regions of the architectural design space and lack cross-domain or deployment-aware evaluation. LEMUR 2 introduces a large-scale, extensible framework unifying generative, evaluative, and deployment pipelines to unlock neural-network diversity. It comprises over 14,000 distinct architectures and more than 750,000 structured training records documenting model performance, hyperparameters, and task outcomes. These models were produced through AST-based code mutation, genetic and reinforcement-learning evolution, generation of fractal architectures, and synthesis guided by a Large Language Model (LLM). This includes deep models generated with the retrieval-augmented system NN-RAG, which derived and used architectural motifs from over 900 PyTorch modules extracted from public repositories. LEMUR 2 further employs NN-VR and NN-Lite pipelines for automated deployment and latency benchmarking on heterogeneous mobile and Unity-based VR platforms, providing real-device performance metadata. It spans multimodal tasks, image captioning, text-to-image synthesis, and language modeling, supporting cross-domain analysis of architectural transferability. By linking diverse architectures, tasks, and deployment data, LEMUR 2 provides the data foundation for LLM fine-tuning and coupling diverse architectural origins with large-scale, cross-platform empirical validation. This dataset defines a new basis for reproducible and data-driven AI design, advancing the emerging paradigm of LLM-driven AutoML and architectural generalization across modalities and hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LEMUR 2 是一个大规模可扩展的框架，旨在通过统一的生成、评估和部署管道解锁神经网络多样性。它包含超过 14,000 个不同架构和 750,000 多个结构化训练记录，涵盖多模态任务、图像描述、文本到图像合成和语言建模。架构通过 AST 代码突变、遗传/强化学习、分形架构和 LLM 引导的合成生成，并使用 NN-VR 和 NN-Lite 管道在异构移动和 VR 平台上进行自动部署和延迟基准测试。该数据集为 LLM 驱动的 AutoML 和跨模态、硬件的架构泛化提供了数据基础。
Motivation: 现有 NAS 基准（如 NAS-Bench、NATS-Bench）仅覆盖狭窄的任务特定架构设计空间，缺乏跨领域或部署感知的评估能力。
Method: 提出 LEMUR 2 框架，集成基于检索增强系统 NN-RAG 的架构生成、NN-VR 和 NN-Lite 的自动部署和延迟基准测试，以及多种合成策略（AST 突变、遗传/强化学习、分形和 LLM 引导）。
Result: 包含 14,000+ 不同架构和 750,000+ 训练记录，覆盖多模态任务，并在真实设备上提供延迟和部署元数据。
Conclusion: LEMUR 2 为数据驱动的 AI 设计、LLM 微调和 AutoML 建立了新的基准，支持跨模态和硬件的架构泛化与可重复性。

papers.title: WildCity: A Real-World City-Scale Testbed for Rendering, Simulation, and Spatial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Humans can navigate an unfamiliar city and gradually form a coherent spatial mental map spanning tens of square kilometers. Can AI build spatial representations at a comparable scale? Although recent foundation models have advanced scene reconstruction and embodied intelligence, scaling to entire cities remains an open challenge, primarily due to the lack of city-scale data. To bridge the gap, we introduce WildCity, a real-world multimodal dataset collected by autonomous fleets traversing complex urban environments. Our dataset includes 18 trajectories, each averaging 83.7 kilometers in length, and preserves the core challenges of in-the-wild perception, e.g., dynamic objects, lighting variations, and imperfect camera poses. We further establish an urban-tailored reconstruction baseline and convert the reconstructed environments into a closed-loop simulator. Beyond the dataset and baseline, we systematically analyze the key challenges on the path to simulation-ready urban digital twins: scalability, extrapolation, and uncertainty. Ultimately, WildCity aims to catalyze progress not only in city-scale rendering, but more broadly in the pursuit of AI that can perceive, remember, and reason across space at a scale comparable to human cognition. Project page: https://han-xiangyu.github.io/Wild-City/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 WildCity，一个由自动驾驶车队在复杂城市环境中采集的多模态数据集，包含 18 条轨迹，平均长度 83.7 公里，涵盖动态物体、光照变化和不完美相机位姿等真实挑战。作者建立了面向城市的重建基线，并将重建环境转换为闭环模拟器，系统分析了向仿真就绪城市数字孪生迈进的可扩展性、外推和不确定性等关键挑战。目标是推动城市级渲染以及具备类人空间感知、记忆和推理能力的 AI 发展。
Motivation: 现有基础模型在场景重建和具身智能方面取得进展，但扩展到整个城市规模仍面临挑战，主要缺乏城市级数据。WildCity 旨在填补这一空白，提供真实世界的城市尺度多模态数据。
Method: 使用自动驾驶车队采集多模态数据，建立面向城市的 3D 重建基线（具体算法未在摘要中详述），并将重建后的环境转化为闭环仿真器，同时分析可扩展性、外推和不确定性等挑战。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的量化结果，仅指出数据集包含 18 条长轨迹（平均 83.7 公里），并建立了重建基线和仿真器。
Conclusion: WildCity 希望促进城市级渲染和空间智能的研究，特别是让 AI 能够像人类一样在大范围空间中进行感知、记忆和推理。论文强调了朝向仿真就绪城市数字孪生过程中的三大挑战：可扩展性、外推和不确定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generative Diffusion Models of Stochastic Graph Signals
papers.abstract_en: Sampling stochastic signals supported on a graph underlies many graph machine learning tasks, including recommender systems, forecasting in financial markets, and wireless network optimization. In these settings, the target signals are realizations of unknown conditional distributions. However, prevailing approaches rely mostly on intricate, application-tailored designs that often regress to a conditional mean instead of sampling from the conditional law. This paper unifies such problems as conditional graph signal generative modeling and tackles them with a single denoising diffusion framework. We learn a reverse diffusion process, parametrized by graph neural networks (GNNs), that draws graph signals conditioned directly on the graph topology and on node-feature side information. The reverse process is realized by a novel architecture, the U-Graph Neural Network (U-GNN), which generalizes the image-convolutional U-Net to graph-structured signals. The U-GNN performs multi-resolution encoder--decoder processing in which pooling and unpooling reduce to a learned node selection, expressed by nested selection matrices, and a zero-padded lifting of coarse signals back to the full node set. The graph convolutions are carried out on the original graph, with a stride that sets their hop reach, so the U-GNN bypasses explicit graph coarsening at every resolution. We demonstrate our method on two generative tasks: stock price forecasting and optimal wireless resource allocation, with extensive numerical results in both domains.

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一的去噪扩散框架，用于条件图信号生成。通过图神经网络参数化逆扩散过程，并设计了U-GNN架构，在股票价格预测和无线资源分配任务上展示了有效性。
Motivation: 现有图信号采样方法多依赖针对特定应用的定制设计，且常回归到条件均值而非从条件分布采样，缺乏通用性。
Method: 提出条件图信号生成框架，使用去噪扩散模型；逆扩散过程由GNN参数化；设计U-GNN架构，实现多分辨率编解码，通过可学习的节点选择和零填充上采样进行池化和反池化，无需显式图粗化。
Result: 在股票价格预测和无线资源分配两个生成任务上通过大量数值实验验证了方法。
Conclusion: 该统一框架能够处理条件图信号生成问题，但摘要未提及局限性。

papers.title: Gradient-Based Speech-to-Text Alignment for Any ASR Model: From CTC to Speech LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Speech-to-text alignment means finding the temporal boundaries of each word in the audio. Some models provide such an alignment directly and others do not. Connectionist temporal classification (CTC) and transducer models have an alignment by construction, whereas attention-based encoder-decoders (AED) and speech large language models (LLMs) do not, and their word timings are usually read off the attention weights instead. All of these signals live on the encoder frame grid, which bounds their temporal precision. We study a generic gradient-based alignment that applies to any differentiable ASR model. We take the gradient of each teacher-forced token log probability with respect to the input, reduce it to a per-frame saliency, and decode the resulting matrix into word boundaries with a single dynamic-programming pass. The method needs no training, no model modification and no alignment heads, works across all model families including the speech LLMs, and aligns on the input grid rather than on the coarser encoder grid. We evaluate it on sixteen models from four families, on read (TIMIT) and spontaneous (Buckeye) speech, each against the model's own native or attention-based alignment. We find that the gradient yields a usable alignment for every model, that it is usually somewhat behind a strong native aligner but better where the native alignment is weak, as for the streaming models, and that its main disadvantage is the cost of one backward pass per token.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于梯度的通用语音到文本对齐方法，适用于任何可微的ASR模型（包括CTC、Transducer、AED和语音大语言模型）。该方法通过对每个token的对数概率关于输入求梯度，得到每帧的显著性，然后通过动态规划解码得到词边界。不需要训练、模型修改或对齐头，直接在输入网格上对齐。在16个模型和两个数据集上评估，发现梯度方法对每个模型都能产生可用的对齐，通常略弱于强原生对齐器，但在流式模型等原生对齐较弱的场景下表现更好，主要缺点是每个token需要一次反向传播。
Motivation: 现有ASR模型中，CTC和Transducer模型本身具有对齐，而注意力编码器-解码器（AED）和语音大语言模型（LLM）没有直接对齐，通常依赖注意力权重，这些信号位于编码器帧网格上，限制了时间精度。需要一个通用且精度更高的对齐方法。
Method: 提出梯度对齐方法：对每个teacher-forced token的对数概率关于输入求梯度，归约为每帧的显著性，然后通过单次动态规划解码得到词边界。方法无需训练、模型修改或额外对齐头，适用于任何可微ASR模型，并在输入网格上对齐而非粗的编码器网格。
Result: 在四个模型家族共16个模型上，针对朗读语音（TIMIT）和自发言语（Buckeye）进行评估，与模型自身的原生对齐或注意力对齐进行比较。发现梯度方法对所有模型都能产生可用对齐，通常略弱于强原生对齐器，但在原生对齐较弱时（如流式模型）表现更好。主要缺点是每个token需要一次反向传播。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种通用且无需修改模型的语音对齐方式，适用于多种ASR架构，但计算成本较高。

papers.title: Rail Track Extraction from Rasterized Classified Point Clouds Using a Full-Resolution, Fully Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network
papers.abstract_en: Rail track extraction is essential for effective railway asset management and maintenance, especially in automated inspection and mapping workflows. This paper introduces a novel method for extracting rail tracks from classified 3D point clouds using a fully convolutional recurrent neural network that preserves full spatial resolution and is trained exclusively on synthetically generated data. This approach enhances per-pixel quality and is particularly suited for rail track extraction. The proposed method begins by rasterizing points corresponding to railroad tracks, then applies the neural network to reduce noise and yield a cleaner track representation suitable for vectorization [1]. Subsequent morphological operations further refine the resultant data, enabling accurate track centerline extraction. Next, the extracted centerlines undergo smoothing to eliminate residual irregularities [2, 3]. Finally, the algorithm transfers 3D information from lidar points onto 2D polylines and applies additional vertical smoothing. A single centerline for both tracks is found using the Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) algorithm [4]. The final outcome consists of rail top centerlines and track centerlines derived for rail pairs, with minimal manual intervention. Experimental validation confirms the effectiveness of this method in yielding high-quality rail track extraction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种从栅格化分类三维点云中提取铁轨的新方法，使用全分辨率全卷积循环神经网络，仅用合成数据训练。该方法通过栅格化、去噪、形态学操作、中心线提取、平滑及DTW算法，最终得到铁轨顶部中心线和轨道中心线，实验验证了高质量提取效果。
Motivation: 铁轨提取是铁路资产管理的关键环节，尤其在自动化检测和制图流程中，需要高精度的自动提取方法以减少人工干预。
Method: 首先将铁轨点云栅格化，然后应用全分辨率全卷积循环神经网络进行去噪，再经过形态学操作细化，提取轨道中心线并进行平滑，最后利用DTW算法将两股轨道的中心线合并为一条轨道中心线，同时将激光雷达三维信息传递到二维多段线上并附加垂直平滑。
Result: 实验表明该方法能够有效提取高质量的铁轨中心线和轨道中心线，仅需最少人工干预。
Conclusion: 该方法通过合成数据训练和全分辨率网络设计，实现了对栅格化点云中铁轨的精确提取，且泛化能力良好。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CaLiSym: Learning Symplectic Dynamics of Real-World Systems through Structured Canonical Lifts
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed learning promises data-efficient and stable dynamics prediction, yet its strongest geometric guarantees have largely remained confined to closed conservative systems. This excludes many robotic systems of practical interest, where actuation, dissipation, and constraints continuously exchange energy and momentum with the environment. We introduce CaLiSym, a lightweight framework that extends exact symplectic learning to such systems by changing where the geometric prior is imposed. Rather than enforcing symplecticity on the measured physical state, CaLiSym embeds the state and its physical ports into a structured lifted canonical phase space, where the learned dynamics evolve through an exactly symplectic map. The lift is explicit and algebraic, requiring neither recurrent latent states, transformer decoders, implicit optimization, nor inference-time ODE integration. We instantiate the framework with generalized-ridge SympNet predictors and introduce GRB-SympNet, a B-spline variant that combines local approximation with exact symplectic structure. Experiments on a controlled dissipative double pendulum, a real-world quadrotor, and a contact-rich quadruped demonstrate consistent improvements in out-of-distribution autoregressive prediction while using parameter-efficient models. At the same time, the learned lifted dynamics preserve the symplectic form to numerical precision. These results show that symplectic learning can be extended beyond conservative mechanics through structured canonical lifts, enabling geometry-preserving dynamics models for real-world robotic systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CaLiSym 框架，通过结构化典型提升（structured canonical lift）将精确辛学习扩展到带有驱动、耗散和约束的实际机器人系统。该方法使用 GRB-SympNet（一种结合局部逼近与精确辛结构的 B 样条变体）作为预测器，在耗散双摆、真实四旋翼和接触丰富的四足机器人上实现了更好的分布外自回归预测，并保持辛形式数值精确。
Motivation: 现有物理信息学习主要局限于封闭保守系统，无法处理机器人系统中常见的驱动、耗散和约束带来的能量与动量交换，限制了其在实际系统中的应用。
Method: CaLiSym 将物理状态及其端口嵌入到结构化的提升典型相空间中，在该空间中学习精确辛映射。实例化为广义脊 SympNet（GRB-SympNet），一种结合局部逼近与精确辛结构的 B 样条预测器，无需循环隐状态或 ODE 积分。
Result: 在耗散双摆、真实四旋翼和四足机器人实验中，该方法在分布外自回归预测上持续优于基线，且参数效率高；学习到的动力学精确保持辛结构至数值精度。
Conclusion: 结果表明，通过结构化典型提升可以将辛学习扩展到保守力学之外，为真实世界机器人系统提供几何保持的动力学模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluating SageMath-Augmented LLM Agents for Computational and Experimental Mathematics
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in AI for Mathematics have focused largely on autoformalization and theorem proving, leaving the role of Computer Algebra Systems (CAS) in agentic LLM workflows underexplored. We propose a ReAct-style agentic setup that combines LLM reasoning with verifiable feedback from SageMath, together with Context7 for the up-to-date documentation. We evaluate this agentic setup across frontier models for solving research-level mathematical problems from the RealMath benchmark in a setting that emulates a computational-mathematics research loop. We also propose a refinement to the RealMath benchmark by introducing a multi-step post-processing procedure and a multi-stage validation pipeline, both of which improve the quality and reliability of the extracted problem set. Our experiments reveal substantial performance gains from SageMath access across all evaluated models on +9.7~pp on average, the gains range from 1.5~pp to 27.8~pp and narrow the gap between open-weight and closed models. Qwen~3.7-Max benefits from SageMath the most, while GPT-5.5 achieves the highest solve rate of $75.2\%$ and the lowest token usage among tool-enabled configurations. Our findings suggest that CAS-augmented agents represent a promising direction for assisting mathematicians in computational exploration, and we believe that this work is a step towards automated conjecture discovery. The project repository is available online.
papers.comment: 37 pages, 16 figures, accepted to 3rd AI for Math Workshop at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于SageMath的ReAct式LLM智能体框架，通过结合SageMath的计算反馈与Context7文档，在RealMath基准上评估前沿模型求解研究级数学问题的能力。实验表明，SageMath访问平均提升9.7个百分点，GPT-5.5达到最高求解率75.2%且token消耗最低。

papers.title: Ad Headline Generation using Self-Critical Masked Language Model
papers.abstract_en: For any E-commerce website it is a nontrivial problem to build enduring advertisements that attract shoppers. It is hard to pass the creative quality bar of the website, especially at a large scale. We thus propose a programmatic solution to generate product advertising headlines using retail content. We propose a state of the art application of Reinforcement Learning (RL) Policy gradient methods on Transformer based Masked Language Models. Our method creates the advertising headline by jointly conditioning on multiple products that a seller wishes to advertise. We demonstrate that our method outperforms existing Transformer and LSTM + RL methods in overlap metrics and quality audits. We also show that our model-generated headlines outperform human submitted headlines in terms of both grammar and creative quality as determined by audits.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于强化学习策略梯度 (Policy Gradient) 和 Transformer 掩码语言模型 (Masked Language Model) 的程序化方法，用于生成电子商务广告标题。该方法联合考虑多个待广告商品，在重叠度指标和人工质量评估上优于现有 Transformer 和 LSTM+RL 方法，甚至超过人工提交的标题。
Motivation: 电子商务网站大规模生成具有创意质量的广告标题是一个困难问题，现有方法难以通过网站的创意质量标准。
Method: 将强化学习策略梯度方法应用于基于 Transformer 的掩码语言模型，通过联合条件化多个商品来生成广告标题。
Result: 在重叠度指标和人工质量审核中，该方法优于现有 Transformer 和 LSTM+RL 方法，且模型生成的标题在语法和创意质量上超过人工提交的标题。
Conclusion: 该方法为大规模程序化广告标题生成提供了有效解决方案，能够自动产生高质量广告标题。

papers.title: When Agents Go Rogue: Activation-Based Detection of Malicious Behaviors in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: While enabling effective collaboration on complex tasks, LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) face critical security challenges due to vulnerabilities at the agent and interaction levels. Most existing MAS security defenses are built upon two core assumptions: semantically-explicit malicious attacks and explicit graph-based modeling of the MAS topology and agent-level interactions. In practice, real-world attacks are becoming more semantically stealthy, while MAS execution is typically asynchronous without the temporal alignment assumed by graph-based propagation models. To address these limitations, we propose AcMAS, an activation-based framework for malicious-behavior detection in MAS. By analyzing internal reasoning states in the activation space of local agents, AcMAS detects even stealthy attacks in a synchronization-robust fashion, without relying on explicit interaction graphs. Moreover, our activation analysis provides critical signals to guide AcMAS in restoring the functionality of compromised agents, rather than the disruptive agent isolation commonly used by the state-of-the-art methods. Comprehensive evaluation demonstrates that AcMAS significantly outperforms graph-based baselines against stealthy attacks, by +0.22 F1 in synchronous settings (0.94 vs. 0.72) and by +0.55 F1 in asynchronous settings (0.93 vs. 0.38), with generalization across diverse open-source LLM backbones, attack intensity, and MAS scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AcMAS，一种基于激活的框架，用于检测多智能体系统中的恶意行为。该方法通过分析本地智能体激活空间中的内部推理状态，同步鲁棒地检测隐蔽攻击，无需依赖显式交互图，并能指导恢复被攻破智能体的功能。实验表明，AcMAS在同步设置下F1为0.94（基线0.72），异步设置下F1为0.93（基线0.38）。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS）的安全防御依赖于两个假设：语义明确的恶意攻击和显式的图模型。实际中攻击越来越隐蔽，且MAS执行通常是异步的，图传播模型难以适用。
Method: 提出AcMAS框架，通过分析本地智能体激活空间中的内部推理状态来检测恶意行为，不依赖显式交互图，同步鲁棒，并能利用激活信号指导恢复被攻破智能体的功能，而非简单隔离。
Result: 全面评估显示，AcMAS在同步设置下F1为0.94（基线0.72），异步设置下F1为0.93（基线0.38），在不同开源LLM骨干、攻击强度和MAS规模下具有泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调AcMAS通过激活分析显著优于基于图的方法，尤其在异步场景下提升明显，且能恢复受损智能体而非隔离。

papers.title: A Multi-Analyst LLM Pipeline for Auditable Rule Discovery Across 68 Public Physiological Corpora
papers.abstract_en: Open physiological corpora are heterogeneous: they use different sensors, labels, sampling rates, recording settings, and clinical endpoints. They can support detector design, but they do not directly specify which detector rules should be built for a new contactless monitoring platform. We report a controlled four-analyst large-language-model (LLM) workflow for converting 68 public physiological corpora, screened for commercial-use compatibility, into an auditable library of candidate rule shapes for prospective validation. Four independent commercial LLM families read the corpus documentation under a controlled prompt and produced 695 candidate rule markers (top-markers). Deduplication retained 649 rule records; a threshold-bounds audit then flagged 51 sanity violations for clamping or curator review. Cross-corpus consolidation produced 436 unique rule shapes. Gate-tagging against two hard invariants, native target-hardware channel availability and no multi-night per-patient personalization, identified 94 build-now detector components across four detector-family buckets. The pipeline does not produce a validated clinical detector. It produces an auditable engineering cascade in which analyst disagreement, threshold checks, curator review, and automated continuous-integration (CI) checks route literature-derived rules toward prospective hardware validation.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables; submitted to IEEE SPMB 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一个受控的四分析师大语言模型（LLM）工作流程，用于将68个公共生理语料库转换为可审计的候选规则库。流程产生695个候选规则标记，去重后保留649条，经阈值审核标记了51个异常，跨语料库合并得到436个唯一规则形状，并识别出94个可直接构建的检测器组件。该管道不产生经过验证的临床检测器，而是产生一个可审计的工程级联。
Motivation: 开放生理语料库存在异质性（不同传感器、标签、采样率等），不支持直接为新接触式监测平台构建检测器规则。
Method: 使用四个独立商业LLM家族在受控提示下读取语料库文档，产生候选规则标记；经去重、阈值审核（标记51个异常）、跨语料库合并和基于两个硬不变量的门控标记，获得最终规则库。
Result: 695个候选规则标记去重后得649条，51个异常被标记；跨语料库合并后得到436个唯一规则形状；通过门控标记识别出94个可直接构建的检测器组件。
Conclusion: 该管道产生一个可审计的工程级联，其中分析师分歧、阈值检查、策展人审查和自动化CI检查将文献衍生的规则引向硬件验证；不产生已验证的临床检测器。

papers.title: What Predicts Correctness in Text-to-SQL? A Selective-Prediction Study
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating uncertainty in AI-generated SQL queries requires estimating whether a query is correct, where correct means it executes to the same result as a human-written reference. We study which signals predict correctness on hard multi-table text-to-SQL, using AUROC to measure how well each ranks correct queries above incorrect ones. On BIRD and Spider, black-box signals such as string, structural, and execution self-consistency, a schema-relevance score, and query executability all fall between about 0.61 and 0.68 AUROC, with string self-consistency strongest at 0.675; white-box log-probability is similar (0.67). The signals that move past this ceiling are verification-based: an LLM judge scores from 0.72 (GPT-4o-mini) to 0.78 (Claude). Judges from different providers make different errors, so a two-provider ensemble reaches 0.82 AUROC with a well-calibrated probability (expected calibration error 0.03) and supports useful abstention frontiers (for example, answering 27% of questions at 24% selective risk) where self-consistency offers no valid low-risk subset. The pattern holds across two benchmarks, two generators, and two judge providers. We also ask whether a verifier can be trained. Fine-tuned verifiers, both encoder and generative, reach about 0.77 to 0.79 AUROC in-distribution but fall to about 0.66 on unseen schemas; scaling to 7B, adding schema diversity, distilling a strong judge's rationales, and cross-benchmark training all fail to close that gap. Cross-schema transfer appears to track model scale and reasoning rather than fine-tuning. In practice, correctness uncertainty for text-to-SQL lives in reasoning-based signals: a fine-tuned verifier is a good in-domain tool, but a verifier that generalizes across schemas currently means a large frozen reasoning model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇论文研究文本到SQL查询正确性的预测信号，发现基于验证的LLM裁判（如Claude）的AUROC可达0.78，双提供商集成可达0.82，而微调验证器在分布外泛化上表现不佳，跨模式迁移依赖于推理模型规模而非微调。
Motivation: 评估AI生成SQL查询的不确定性需要预测查询是否正确，但现有信号（如自一致性）在困难的多表文本到SQL任务中表现有限，AUROC约0.68。
Method: 系统比较多种信号（字符串自一致性、结构自一致性、执行自一致性、模式相关性、可执行性、对数概率、LLM裁判、微调验证器）在BIRD和Spider基准上的正确性预测能力，使用AUROC度量。
Result: LLM裁判（Claude）AUROC 0.78，双提供商集成达到0.82，校准误差0.03，支持27%问题以24%选择性风险回答；自一致性仅0.675。微调验证器在分布内约0.77-0.79，但在未见模式上降至0.66，跨模式迁移主要依赖模型规模而非微调。
Conclusion: 文本到SQL的正确性不确定性依赖于基于推理的信号；微调验证器是良好的领域内工具，但跨模式通用验证器需要大型冻结推理模型。

papers.title: Enhancing deep learning models for time series classification via knowledge distillation
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has achieved remarkable success in various domains including time series analysis, computer vision and natural language processing. However, high computational and memory demands of state-of-the-art architectures pose challenges for deployment in resource-limited environments. Knowledge Distillation (KD) addresses this by transferring knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller, more efficient student model while maintaining competitive performance. In this work, we investigate the effectiveness of KD for Time Series Classification (TSC) across three architectures: the classical Fully Convolutional Network (FCN), the convolutional Inception model and the transformer-based ConvTran model. We evaluate our approach on UCR Archive, the largest benchmark repository of time series datasets, by modifying architectural components such as convolutional filters, Inception modules and attention heads across the three architectures. Our results consistently show that KD most effectively benefits student models of intermediate complexity across all three architectures, with the distilled FCN student reducing parameters by a factor of 38, the distilled Inception student achieving nearly the same performance as the teacher with 42% fewer parameters and the distilled ConvTran student with 2 attention heads showing the most significant improvement through distillation. To encourage further research and reproducibility, we provide our implementation at https://github.com/MSD-IRIMAS/KD-4-TSC.
papers.comment: Published version. Open access under CC BY 4.0. 24 pages, 11 figures
papers.journal_ref: Knowledge and Information Systems, Volume 68, Article 215, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究知识蒸馏（Knowledge Distillation）在时间序列分类（TSC）中的有效性，使用FCN、Inception和ConvTran三种架构在UCR Archive上进行实验。结果表明蒸馏对中等复杂度的学生模型最有益：FCN学生模型参数减少38倍，Inception学生模型参数减少42%且性能接近教师模型，ConvTran学生模型（2个注意力头）通过蒸馏获得最大改进。
Motivation: 深度学习模型的高计算和内存需求限制了其在资源受限环境下的部署，知识蒸馏可缓解该问题，但在时间序列分类中的效果尚未充分研究。
Method: 采用知识蒸馏框架，将大教师模型的知识迁移到小规模学生模型，并通过修改卷积滤波器数、Inception模块数和注意力头数等架构组件，在UCR Archive基准上评估蒸馏效果。
Result: 蒸馏对中等复杂度的学生模型最有效：FCN学生参数减少38倍；Inception学生参数减少42%且性能几乎持平教师；ConvTran学生（2注意力头）改进最显著。
Conclusion: 知识蒸馏能有效降低时间序列分类模型的参数量并保持竞争性能，有利于在资源受限环境中部署。

summary_sections.conclusion: 知识蒸馏能有效降低时间序列分类模型的参数量并保持竞争性能，有利于在资源受限环境中部署。

papers.title: From Agentic to Autogenic Network Management for AI-Native 6G and Beyond: A Standards Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Standards bodies, including TM Forum, 3GPP, and ETSI, are converging on Agentic AI as the foundation for next-generation network management, where Large AI Model (LAM)-based agents autonomously interpret intent, coordinate resources, and adapt operational behaviors at runtime. However, achieving this vision at the scale and complexity of 6G networks requires management systems that can generate and evolve their own automation software during operation. We introduce Autogenic network management, a reference architecture that extends agentic capabilities with self-programming, self reflection, self-orienting, and self-architecting capabilities. The architecture supports practical staged deployment beginning with human-supervised LAM-based agents and progressing toward autonomous operation as confidence builds. We demonstrate the approach through high-priority operator scenarios drawn from TM Forum's autonomous network use cases, showing how autogenic management addresses real operational challenges. We conclude with a research roadmap outlining the technical advances needed to make autogenic network management realistic in future 6G networks.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, Accepted to IEEE Network
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从标准视角出发，提出自生网络管理（autogenic network management）参考架构，扩展了基于大规模AI模型（LAM）的代理能力，增加自我编程、自我反思、自我定向和自我架构能力，以支持AI原生6G及未来网络的自动化管理。文章基于TM Forum的自治网络用例展示了该架构如何解决实际运营挑战，并给出了研究路线图。
Motivation: 现有基于代理AI（Agentic AI）的网络管理方案在6G规模下仍难以实现完全自动化，需要能够自主生成和演化自动化软件的系统。
Method: 提出自生网络管理架构，在LAM代理基础上增加自我编程、自我反思、自我定向和自我架构四种能力，并设计从人类监督到自主运行的分阶段部署路径。
Result: 通过TM Forum的高优先级运营商场景展示了自生管理如何应对实际运营挑战，但未报告定量实验结果。
Conclusion: 自生网络管理有望成为6G网络管理的可行方向，但需要进一步技术突破才能实际部署。

papers.title: G-PROBE: Cross-FOV Place Recognition and Certainty-Coupled Localization for 3D Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: Global localization from 3D point clouds remains challenging under limited or asymmetric fields of view (FOV), which fail to provide the dense, symmetric coverage that place recognition methods assume. We present G-PROBE, a learning-free global localization framework that removes this assumption. A virtual sensor decomposition runs the same pipeline, by design, on configurations ranging from a narrow-FOV sensor to a panoramic or multi-sensor rig. The front-end enumerates cross-FOV branch ensembles that encode heading hypotheses for heading-invariant place recognition. A score-scale-invariant, tuning-free gamma-SGRT suppresses heading aliasing under partial FOV and provably becomes inert at symmetric 360 degrees. The back-end, CG-GICP, refines a coarse full-cloud GICP with a pass restricted to high-certainty co-observed points selected by a bird's-eye-view certainty map (a by-product of front-end scoring). This certainty coupling links descriptor evaluation to 6-DoF metric pose estimation without an external verification module. Evaluated on five LiDAR datasets and three modalities (mechanical, solid-state, FMCW), G-PROBE attains the highest learning-free multi-session F1 on average and is competitive in panoramic single-session settings. Where hand-crafted and zero-shot supervised baselines collapse under wide-to-narrow cross-sensor pairing, it remains usable end-to-end (up to 55.0% vs. no more than 6.8% success), and under FOV asymmetry (360 to 60 degrees) it retains about 54% Recall@1, about 18x the strongest learning-free baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: G-PROBE 是一个无需学习的全局定位框架，旨在解决有限或非对称视场（FOV）下 3D 点云的地点识别问题。通过虚拟传感器分解和跨 FOV 分支集成，它支持从窄视场到全景的多传感器配置，并利用 gamma-SGRT 抑制部分视场下的航向混叠。后端 CG-GICP 结合鸟瞰置信图进行高置信度点选择，将描述子评估与 6-DoF 位姿估计耦合。在五个 LiDAR 数据集和三种传感器模态上，G-PROBE 在无学习方法中平均多会话 F1 最高，在非对称视场下 Recall@1 达到约 54%，远超其他无学习基线。
Motivation: 现有地点识别方法通常假设传感器具有对称且密集的视场覆盖，但实际中常出现有限或非对称视场，导致全局定位失败。
Method: 提出 G-PROBE 框架，含虚拟传感器分解、跨 FOV 分支集成用于航向不变地点识别、score-scale-invariant 的 gamma-SGRT 抑制航向混叠，以及基于鸟瞰置信图的 CG-GICP 后端点云配准。
Result: 在五个 LiDAR 数据集（机械式、固态、FMCW）上，G-PROBE 达到无学习方法中最高平均多会话 F1；在宽窄跨传感器配对下保持可用（成功率 55.0% vs 基线≤6.8%），在 360° 到 60° 非对称视场下 Recall@1 约 54%，为最强无学习基线的 18 倍。
Conclusion: G-PROBE 通过无学习方式有效应对非对称和受限视场下的点云全局定位，无需外部验证模块，性能优于现有无学习基线。

papers.title: On Explicit Super-Expressive Approximation for Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we investigate the fixed-architecture neural network approximation with explicit parameter bounds and elementary activations. While prior work demonstrated super-expressive approximation using fixed-size networks, they lack quantitative and non-asymptotic characterizations of parameter magnitude with respect to the approximation error. We resolve this issue by introducing the Chinese Remainder Theorem as a constructive encoding mechanism. For Lipschitz continuous functions on $[0,1]^D$, we construct a width-$\max\{D,4\}$, depth-$5$ network with explicit parameter-error trade-offs. For Hölder-smooth functions in $C^{r,γ}_A\left([0,1]^D\right)$, our fixed network of width $\max\{2D,\ D+5N+1\}$ and depth $r + 9$ achieves the parameter magnitude $\mathcal{P}$ bounded by $\log_2 \mathcal{P}=\mathcal{O}\bigl(\varepsilon^{-2D/(r+γ)}\log(1/\varepsilon)\bigr)$. This is the dual result compared to those in the parameter-bounded and architecture-unbounded paradigm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究固定架构神经网络在显式参数界和初等激活函数下的超表达能力。通过引入中国剩余定理作为构造性编码机制，作者为Lipschitz连续函数和Hölder光滑函数建立了宽度和深度固定的网络，并给出了参数大小与逼近误差之间的非渐近显式关系。
Motivation: 现有固定尺寸网络的超表达能力缺乏参数大小的定量刻画，无法在逼近误差与参数界之间建立显式权衡。
Method: 利用中国剩余定理构造编码，设计宽度为max{D,4}、深度为5的网络逼近Lipschitz函数，以及宽度为max{2D, D+5N+1}、深度为r+9的网络逼近Hölder光滑函数，并推导参数界的对数阶上界。
Result: 对于Lipschitz函数，网络得到显式的参数-误差权衡；对于Hölder光滑函数，参数大小满足log2 P = O(ε^{-2D/(r+γ)} log(1/ε))。
Conclusion: 该结果与参数有界、架构无界范式下的结论形成对偶，为固定架构网络的显式超表达能力提供了定量理论保证。

papers.title: URS-Stereo: Uncertainty-Guided Residual Search for Real-Time Stereo Matching
papers.abstract_en: Real-time stereo matching is crucial for robotics, autonomous systems, and embedded vision applications, where both computational efficiency and disparity accuracy are required. Recent coarse-to-fine stereo matching methods improve efficiency by progressively refining disparity estimates using local cost volumes at higher resolutions. However, these methods rely heavily on the accuracy of propagated disparity estimates from previous stages. When the propagated disparity is inaccurate, the ground-truth correspondence may fall outside the predefined local search range, leading to unrecoverable matching failures during subsequent refinement. In this paper, we propose URS-Stereo, a real-time coarse-to-fine stereo matching framework that addresses this limitation through uncertainty-guided search adaptation. Specifically, we introduce an Uncertainty-Guided Residual Search Module (UGRSM), which predicts the reliability of propagated disparities together with residual search offsets to adaptively relocate the centers of local cost volumes before disparity refinement. By dynamically adjusting the search region according to the confidence of the propagated disparity, the proposed method significantly improves the robustness of local correspondence estimation while preserving the computational efficiency of coarse-to-fine stereo matching. Extensive experiments on SceneFlow, KITTI 2012, KITTI 2015, Middlebury, and ETH3D demonstrate that URS-Stereo consistently improves disparity estimation while maintaining real-time inference speed, validating the effectiveness of the proposed uncertainty-guided search strategy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 URS-Stereo，一种基于不确定性引导残差搜索的实时立体匹配框架。通过 Uncertainty-Guided Residual Search Module (UGRSM) 预测传播视差的可靠性和残差偏移，自适应调整局部代价体中心，解决粗到细方法中传播视差不准确导致匹配失败的问题。在 SceneFlow、KITTI 2012/2015、Middlebury 和 ETH3D 上验证，提高了视差精度并保持实时速度。
Motivation: 现有粗到细立体匹配方法依赖传播视差的准确性，当传播视差错误时，真实对应点可能超出局部搜索范围，导致不可恢复的匹配失败。
Method: 提出 Uncertainty-Guided Residual Search Module (UGRSM)，预测传播视差的可靠性和残差搜索偏移，自适应调整局部代价体中心，再执行视差精化。
Result: 在 SceneFlow、KITTI 2012/2015、Middlebury 和 ETH3D 上，URS-Stereo 持续提升视差估计精度，同时保持实时推理速度。
Conclusion: 不确定性引导的搜索策略能有效提高局部对应估计的鲁棒性，同时保留粗到细立体匹配的计算效率。

papers.title: Efficient Bayesian Deep Ensembles via Analytic Predictive Inference
papers.abstract_en: We introduce an efficient Bayesian deep ensemble method for predictive regression designed to enhance interpretability while maintaining competitive predictive performance and computational efficiency. Our method combines the statistical rigor of Bayesian inference with the scalability of deep ensembles, providing calibrated uncertainty estimates that enable its use not only for standalone prediction but also as a component within broader learning systems. To achieve these goals, our work relies on three key design components: (i) low-dimensional ensemble representation: predictions are expressed as a combination of a small number of trained neural predictors, enabling scalable inference whose cost depends on ensemble size rather than dataset size; (ii) closed-form Bayesian aggregation: ensemble predictions are combined using Bayesian linear regression, yielding interpretable posterior weights and calibrated uncertainty without approximate inference; and (iii) Independent ensemble training: multiple neural networks are trained separately, producing diverse predictive representations that improve robustness and uncertainty calibration. Empirical results on standard regression benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves competitive predictive performance while maintaining reliable uncertainty estimates across settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种高效的贝叶斯深度集成方法用于预测回归，结合贝叶斯推理的统计严谨性与深度集成的可扩展性，通过低维集成表示、闭式贝叶斯聚合和独立集成训练三个关键组件，提供校准的不确定性估计，并在标准回归基准上取得有竞争力的预测性能。
Motivation: 现有深度集成方法在不确定性校准和计算效率之间难以兼顾，尤其当需要作为更大学习系统组件时，缺乏可解释性和可扩展性。
Method: 采用三个设计组件：(i) 低维集成表示，预测由少量训练好的神经网络组合而成，计算成本取决于集成大小而非数据集大小；(ii) 闭式贝叶斯聚合，使用贝叶斯线性回归组合集成预测，得到可解释的后验权重和校准的不确定性，无需近似推理；(iii) 独立集成训练，多个网络独立训练，产生多样化的预测表示，提升鲁棒性和校准。
Result: 在标准回归基准上，所提方法取得了有竞争力的预测性能，并在不同设置下保持可靠的不确定性估计。
Conclusion: 该方法在保持预测性能的同时提供了校准的不确定性估计，适用于独立预测或作为更广泛学习系统的组件。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Efficient Long-Horizon Learning for Learned Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Learned optimization aims to improve upon hand-designed optimizers (e.g., Adam and Muon) by meta-learning small neural network optimizers over a distribution of tasks. While recent work has greatly advanced the architectural design and inductive biases of learned optimizers (LOs), current meta-training approaches still suffer from two main difficulties: (1) they cannot efficiently scale meta-training to long-horizon inner problems and (2) they often fail to surpass comparable hand-designed optimizers. To address these limitations, we propose Efficient Long-hOrizon (ELO) learning, an efficient meta-training algorithm that (1) reallocates redundant meta-training compute to longer failure regimes, achieving efficient long-horizon learning, and (2) enforces decoupled progressive expert supervision, providing stable meta-learning signals that additionally improve the generalization of LOs. Our empirical study evaluates ELO for meta-training both element-wise and matrix-based LOs. Across downstream language modeling (GPT-2-124M/350M on FineWeb) and image classification (ViT-B/16, ResNet-50 on ImageNet-1K) tasks, ELO substantially improves the long-unroll performance and out-of-distribution generalization of the base LOs. In particular, ELO-Celo2 consistently outperforms well-tuned AdamW across all evaluated tasks, while remaining competitive with Muon on language modeling. \textit{Notably, all ELO baselines require less than 7 H100 GPU-hours for meta-training.}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出高效长视野学习（ELO）算法，用于元训练学习优化器（LO），解决现有方法无法高效扩展到长视野内问题以及常不如手工优化器的局限性。ELO通过重新分配冗余计算到更长失败阶段，并解耦渐进专家监督，显著提升了LO的长展开性能和分布外泛化。在语言建模（GPT-2-124M/350M on FineWeb）和图像分类（ViT-B/16, ResNet-50 on ImageNet-1K）任务上，ELO-Celo2一致超越调优的AdamW，并与Muon竞争力相当，且所有基线元训练成本低于7 H100 GPU-hours。
Motivation: 现有学习优化器元训练方法面临两大困难：无法高效扩展到长视野内问题，以及常不能超越手工设计的优化器。
Method: 提出两阶段元训练算法：一是将冗余计算重新分配到更长失败区域实现高效长视野学习；二是采用解耦渐进专家监督，提供稳定元学习信号并改善泛化。
Result: 在GPT-2-124M/350M语言建模和ViT-B/16、ResNet-50图像分类基准上，ELO显著改善基础LO的长展开性能和分布外泛化，ELO-Celo2在所有任务上优于AdamW，语言建模上与Muon持平，且元训练成本极低。
Conclusion: ELO实现了高效的长视野元训练，并能产生性能优于手工优化器的学习优化器，具有实用价值。

papers.title: AirPASS: Over-the-Air Federated Learning via Pinching Antenna Systems
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates over-the-air federated learning (AirFL) in wireless systems where the access point is equipped with a multi-waveguide pinching antenna system (PASS). We adopt the widely studied learning-oriented AirFL formulation, which seeks to maximize the number of selected devices while keeping the aggregation distortion below a prescribed threshold. The resulting joint optimization of device selection, receive beamforming, and pinching-antenna placement is highly nonconvex due to the intricate coupling among these system variables. To address this challenge, we develop AirPASS, an alternating optimization framework with two main components: a homotopy-Riemannian margin-consolidation method for device selection and receive beamforming under fixed PASS configuration, and a homotopy-assisted geometry optimization method for updating the pinching-antenna positions under fixed selected devices and beamformer. Experiments show that AirPASS consistently outperforms conventional co-located MIMO baselines, remains close to ideal FedAvg, and achieves an attractive performance-complexity tradeoff relative to SDR-DC and matching-pursuit scheduling alternatives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于可捏合天线系统（PASS）的空中联邦学习（AirFL），提出AirPASS框架，通过交替优化设备选择、接收波束赋形和天线位置，在保持聚合失真低于阈值的同时最大化所选设备数量。实验表明AirPASS优于传统的共置MIMO基线，接近理想FedAvg。
Motivation: 现有AirFL方法在设备选择、波束赋形和天线配置的联合优化上存在高度非凸耦合问题，缺乏有效解决方案。
Method: 提出AirPASS交替优化框架，包含同伦-黎曼边际巩固方法用于设备选择和波束赋形，以及同伦辅助几何优化方法用于更新可捏合天线位置。
Result: AirPASS在性能上持续优于传统共置MIMO基线，接近理想FedAvg，并在性能-复杂度权衡上优于SDR-DC和匹配追踪调度方案。
Conclusion: AirPASS通过解耦的交替优化有效解决了AirFL中的联合优化问题，为实现高效无线联邦学习提供了新的天线系统方案。

papers.title: Deployment Risk Assessment Using Diff-Aware Features: A Case Study at Prime Video
papers.abstract_en: At Amazon Prime Video, we face the critical operational challenge of managing code deployments during live events and rapid feature releases without causing service outages. Current change control approaches use blanket deployment freezes that block all changes regardless of risk, creating significant developer toil. While prior research has explored risky change predictors, these rely on developer-specific metadata or extensive historical data, raising privacy concerns and limiting applicability to new projects. We introduce a framework centered on diff-aware features, characteristics derived directly from code modifications. Our key contribution is the systematic identification of which quantitative metrics (code-level and change-level metrics) and qualitative indicators (coding style violations, change type classification) are necessary for risk prediction. We employ LLMs as multi-language feature extractors, demonstrating their effectiveness for code analysis beyond generation tasks and eliminating the need for language-specific tooling. We evaluated our framework on two datasets: Prime Video's production environment and the public ApacheJIT dataset. Our best-performing model achieves an average recall of 0.83 and F1 score of 0.81 across both datasets for detecting risky code changes. Notably, ablation analysis reveals that change-level volume metrics (e.g., lines added/deleted) are noisy predictors, while structural code complexity provides a substantially stronger risk signal. These results demonstrate that thoughtful feature curation enables effective change risk assessment across different programming languages and organizational contexts while avoiding privacy concerns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Amazon Prime Video中代码部署导致服务中断的问题，提出一种基于diff-aware特征的部署风险评估框架。框架利用大语言模型（LLM）作为多语言特征提取器，从代码变更中提取定量的代码级/变更级指标和定性的编码风格违规、变更类型等特征，用于预测风险变更。在Prime Video生产数据集和公开ApacheJIT数据集上，最佳模型平均召回率0.83，F1分数0.81。消融实验表明变更级体积指标（如增删行数）是噪声预测因子，而结构代码复杂度提供更强的风险信号。
Motivation: 现有变更控制方法依赖冻结所有部署，造成开发负担；而先前的风险预测方法依赖开发者元数据或大量历史数据，存在隐私问题且难以适用于新项目。
Method: 提出一个框架，核心是diff-aware特征（直接来自代码修改的定量和定性指标），并利用LLM作为多语言特征提取器，无需特定语言工具。
Result: 在Prime Video生产数据集和ApacheJIT数据集上，最佳模型平均召回率0.83，F1分数0.81；消融实验显示变更级体积指标是噪声，结构复杂度信号更强。
Conclusion: 精心筛选的特征可以在不同编程语言和组织背景下有效评估变更风险，且避免隐私问题。

papers.title: Cost-Effective Agent Harnesses for Abstract Reasoning and Generalization on ARC-AGI-1
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress on ARC-AGI-1 from disclosed architectures has come broadly from two regimes: heavy test-time compute over frontier models (evolutionary search, exhaustive sampling, extended chain-of-thought), or benchmark-specific training in which small models are fine-tuned on ARC data, often with task-specialized architectures. We study a third regime: an open-weight model in non-thinking mode (DeepSeek V3.2) under a strict budget, with no ARC-specific fine-tuning. We study what is recoverable through architecture alone, building agentic harnesses that decompose pattern-discovery and program-synthesis stages explicitly. First, we introduce an Explorer-Definer Pipeline that separates pattern discovery from executable transformation synthesis, implemented as a two-stage agent pipeline. Next, we present the Reflective Orchestrator, which augments the pipeline with autonomous exploration of new transformations when previous hypotheses fail on training pairs. On the ARC-AGI-1 public 400-task evaluation set, the pipeline reaches 57.50% pass@2 at \$0.25 per task, and the orchestrator reaches 67.25% pass@2 at \$0.62 per task. Together these architectures lift a 15.50% one-shot baseline by ~52 points without benchmark-specific training or heavy test-time compute. Furthermore, the orchestrator-driven lift tests a falsifiable diagnostic the pipeline produces; unbiased pass@k analysis suggests the pipeline is generation-bound, not selection-bound (selection via training-pair accuracy captures ~95% of the candidate ceiling) and predicts that significant improvement requires broader generation, not better ranking. The orchestrator implements this prediction via adaptive re-exploration and confirms it (unbiased pass@1 lift +9.81 pp, matching selection-mediated pass@2 lift). An additional pipeline ablation identifies its think tool as a significant component, with removal reducing pass@2 by 5.75 pp.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨第三种ARC-AGI-1解决路线：使用开源权重模型（DeepSeek V3.2）在非思考模式下、严格预算内且无ARC专用微调，仅通过架构设计构建agent harnesses。提出Explorer-Definer Pipeline分离模式发现与程序合成，以及Reflective Orchestrator在假设失败时自主探索新变换。在ARC-AGI-1公共400任务评估集上，pipeline达到57.50% pass@2（$0.25/任务），orchestrator达到67.25% pass@2（$0.62/任务），将15.50%的单次基线提升约52个点。分析表明模型受生成限制而非选择限制，orchestrator通过自适应再探索验证了该预测。
Motivation: 现有ARC-AGI-1成功方法依赖大量测试时计算或基准专用微调，成本高昂或缺乏泛化性。本文旨在探索第三种路线：在严格预算下仅通过架构设计提升性能。
Method: 提出两阶段agent pipeline：Explorer-Definer Pipeline，显式分离模式发现与可执行变换合成；Reflective Orchestrator，在训练对假设失败时自动探索新变换。使用DeepSeek V3.2非思考模式，无ARC微调。
Result: pipeline达57.50% pass@2（$0.25/任务），orchestrator达67.25% pass@2（$0.62/任务），相比15.50%单次基线提升约52个百分点。移除think工具降低pass@2 5.75个百分点。分析表明模型受生成限制，orchestrator自适应再探索带来无偏pass@1提升+9.81个百分点。
Conclusion: 仅通过agent架构设计，无需专用微调或大量测试时计算，即可在ARC-AGI-1上取得显著进展。诊断方法揭示当前瓶颈在生成而非选择，orchestrator验证了该预测。

papers.title: Trees from Marginals: Autoregressive drafting with factorized priors
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding greatly increases the interactivity of autoregressive language models by trading off computation for extra tokens generated in a single forward pass. Factorized draft models are especially efficient because they predict future-token marginals in parallel, but their independence assumption causes acceptance rates to degrade sharply as the speculative budget grows. We analyze this limitation and introduce Weaver, a lightweight autoregressive adapter that constructs proposal trees from the top-K marginals of a factorized drafter. Weaver restores conditional dependencies between proposed tokens while avoiding a full-vocabulary projection. To support fast verification for models with Gated Delta Net layers, we derive a rollback-free tree-verification algorithm and implement optimized CUDA kernels in SGLang. By combining these model and systems contributions we achieve a 4.37-fold speedup over autoregressive decoding, and outperform a highly optimized DFlash baseline by 24.7%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Weaver，一种轻量级自回归适配器，利用因子化草稿模型的Top-K边缘分布构建提案树，恢复条件依赖，并结合无回滚树验证算法和CUDA内核，在投机解码中实现4.37倍加速。
Motivation: 因子化草稿模型因独立性假设导致接受率随投机预算增长下降，限制了投机解码效率。
Method: 提出Weaver适配器，从因子化草稿模型的Top-K边缘分布构建提案树；推导无回滚树验证算法，为Gated Delta Net层实现优化CUDA内核。
Result: 在自回归解码上实现4.37倍加速，比高度优化的DFlash基线提升24.7%。
Conclusion: 结合模型和系统贡献，可以显著提升投机解码速度，尤其适用于Gated Delta Net层。

papers.title: QANTIS: Hardware-Calibrated Sequential POMDP Belief Updates on IBM Heron
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous systems under partial observability act on beliefs, not raw sensor events. QANTIS treats the quantum processor as a calibrated belief-update service in that loop: it receives a prior and an observation model, estimates the rare-event evidence term, and returns an ordinary posterior to a classical planner. This paper asks whether that service can be reused across a sequential Tiger POMDP horizon on present IBM Heron hardware without corrupting the planner-facing posterior. We answer with a controlled hardware case study rather than an end-to-end autonomy or wall-clock speedup claim. The study compares no amplification, guarded Grover amplification, and all-step fixed-point amplification on the same trajectory, then checks whether the returned posterior would change the downstream action. All-step FPAA preserves the Tiger posterior across the reported 8-step and 12-step primary runs, and the 20-step and 32-step controls remain inside the same operating band. In every reported decision check, the hardware posterior and the exact Bayes posterior select the same immediate action. Boundary-aware BIQAE stabilizes amplitude estimation near zero and near one, while a rare-event sweep maps the logical sample-complexity envelope for one-in-a-million evidence. The result is an operating envelope for a hardware-calibrated belief-update primitive, not a standalone hardware-advantage claim.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QANTIS 将量子处理器作为校准的信念更新服务，在 IBM Heron 硬件上验证了部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）中顺序信念更新的可行性。通过老虎机问题（Tiger POMDP）的案例研究，比较了无放大、有保护 Grover 放大和全步固定点放大（FPAA）策略，发现全步 FPAA 在 8 步和 12 步主运行中保持了后验一致性，并在所有决策检查中与精确贝叶斯后验选择了相同动作。
Motivation: 自主系统在部分可观测环境下需要基于信念而非原始传感器事件进行决策，但量子处理器作为信念更新服务的可靠性尚未在实际硬件上得到验证。
Method: 在 IBM Heron 硬件上实现基于幅值估计的信念更新，使用无放大、有保护 Grover 放大和全步固定点放大策略，并通过边界感知 BIQAE 稳定近零和近一的幅值估计。
Result: 全步固定点放大在 8 步和 12 步主运行中保持了老虎机 POMDP 的后验一致性，并在所有决策检查中与精确贝叶斯后验选择了相同动作；20 步和 32 步控制运行仍处于同一工作带内。
Conclusion: 该工作为硬件校准的信念更新原语提供了运行包络，而非声称独立硬件优势；当前结果仅限于老虎机问题，未涉及端到端自主性或时钟速度提升。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 在 IBM Heron 硬件上实现基于幅值估计的信念更新，使用无放大、有保护 Grover 放大和全步固定点放大策略，并通过边界感知 BIQAE 稳定近零和近一的幅值估计。
summary_sections.result: 全步固定点放大在 8 步和 12 步主运行中保持了老虎机 POMDP 的后验一致性，并在所有决策检查中与精确贝叶斯后验选择了相同动作；20 步和 32 步控制运行仍处于同一工作带内。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作为硬件校准的信念更新原语提供了运行包络，而非声称独立硬件优势；当前结果仅限于老虎机问题，未涉及端到端自主性或时钟速度提升。

papers.title: LLM-powered reasoning in agent-based modeling
papers.abstract_en: Agent-based modeling (ABM) has the capability to model millions of individuals and their interactions, which is useful for policy making. However, ABMs have traditionally relied on static prior, which prevents the models from adapting to real-time changes. Our research provides a novel approach to addressing this information gap. Large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities to predict human decision-making. Here, we introduce a scalable Hybrid Agent-based and Language-driven Epidemic (HALE) modeling framework that leverages LLMs to predict human decision-making in an ABM simulation. As a proof-of-concept, we use HALE to simulate COVID-19 and its effects in Salt Lake County, UT.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: SmartHomeSecure: Automated Detection and Repair of Smart Home Configuration Errors Using Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Smart home automation platforms increasingly rely on user-authored YAML configuration files to define device behaviors, but these files are prone to syntax, formatting, and semantic logic errors that can cause automation failures and safety risks. Existing YAML validators, static analysis tools, and general-purpose large language models offer limited support for end-to-end diagnosis and repair because they lack domain-specific understanding and validated correction workflows. This paper presents SmartHomeSecure, a prototype for automated detection and repair of Home Assistant configuration errors using lightweight program analysis and constraint-guided large language model generation. SmartHomeSecure parses YAML files, detects syntactic and common semantic errors, normalizes error context, applies deterministic auto-fixes for routine defects, and constructs constrained prompts that guide LLMs toward minimal and structurally valid repairs. The system is implemented as a modular web application with four layers: UI Shell, Feature Orchestrator, Domain Engine, and Integration Layer. Its repair pipeline was evaluated on 100 real-world Home Assistant YAML files with manually injected errors across five categories: syntax/parsing, indentation, mapping, sequence, and scalar quoting errors. Four models were tested: gpt-oss-20b, gpt-oss-120b, llama-3.1-8b, and llama-3.3-70b. Results show that three models achieved 100% error detection accuracy, with repair success rates ranging from 87% to 93%. Manual verification found no hallucinated or incorrect repairs among successful outputs. These findings suggest that combining domain-aware program analysis with constrained generative AI is a feasible approach for improving the reliability and usability of smart home configuration repair.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SmartHomeSecure原型系统，结合轻量级程序分析与约束引导的大语言模型，自动检测并修复Home Assistant YAML配置中的语法、缩进、映射、序列及标量引用等五类错误。在100个真实YAML文件上的评估中，三个模型实现了100%的错误检测准确率，修复成功率为87%至93%，且所有成功修复经人工验证无幻觉。
Motivation: 现有YAML验证器、静态分析工具和通用大语言模型缺乏领域特定理解和验证修复流程，难以对智能家居配置错误进行端到端诊断与修复。
Method: 系统包含解析YAML、检测语法与常见语义错误、规范化错误上下文、对常规缺陷应用确定性自动修复，以及构造约束提示引导LLM生成最小化且结构有效的修复。架构为四层模块化Web应用：UI Shell、Feature Orchestrator、Domain Engine和Integration Layer。
Result: 在100个真实Home Assistant YAML文件上，测试了gpt-oss-20b、gpt-oss-120b、llama-3.1-8b和llama-3.3-70b四个模型，其中三个模型达到100%错误检测准确率，修复成功率87%-93%，成功输出无幻觉。
Conclusion: 结合领域感知的程序分析与约束生成式AI是提高智能家居配置修复可靠性和可用性的可行途径。

papers.title: A Continual Learning Framework for Adaptive Control of Modular Soft Robots
papers.abstract_en: Soft robots have attracted significant attention in applications such as medical intervention, rehabilitation, and robotic manipulation due to their inherent compliance, flexibility, and high degrees of freedom. Modular soft robots (MSRs), composed of multiple interconnected segments, represent an emerging class of robotic systems with highly deformable and reconfigurable structures capable of performing complex tasks. However, designing controllers for MSRs remains challenging due to their nonlinear dynamics, modeling complexity, and hyper-redundant nature. Existing approaches typically require controllers to be retrained from scratch whenever the robot morphology changes. In this work, we address these challenges through a continual learning inspired control framework capable of incrementally adapting to changes in robot morphology while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Specifically, the proposed framework enables the controller to sequentially learn new MSR configurations without forgetting previously learned ones. In addition, for MSRs with fixed configurations, the same framework can be employed in a distributed manner to learn module-specific dynamics, enabling localized control and improved precision. The proposed approach is validated through closed-loop trajectory tracking experiments in simulation using a tendon-driven soft robot, as well as on a real-world three-module pneumatic soft robotic arm. Furthermore, we demonstrate the adaptive capabilities of the framework through a reaching experiment in which the controller selectively activates only the necessary modules to reach a virtual target position, thereby reducing computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于持续学习（continual learning）的自适应控制框架，用于模块化软机器人（MSR）。该框架能够依次学习新的机器人形态配置而不遗忘旧知识，也可分布式学习模块特有动态以实现局部控制。通过仿真和真实三模块气动软机械臂的闭环轨迹跟踪实验验证了有效性，并通过选择性激活模块的到达实验展示了自适应能力。
Motivation: 模块化软机器人（MSR）因高度变形、可重构结构而难以设计控制器，现有方法在形态变化时需要从头重新训练控制器。本文旨在解决这一痛点，使控制器能增量适应形态变化并保留已学知识。
Method: 提出持续学习（continual learning）启发的控制框架，采用增量学习策略，使控制器顺序学习新MSR配置而不遗忘旧配置。对于固定配置的MSR，以分布式方式学习模块特定动态，实现局部控制。
Result: 在仿真（肌腱驱动软机器人）和真实实验（三模块气动软机械臂）中通过闭环轨迹跟踪验证了框架的有效性。在到达实验中，控制器仅激活必要模块到达虚拟目标，降低了计算开销。
Conclusion: 该持续学习框架为模块化软机器人的自适应控制提供了一种可行方案，能应对形态变化并减少计算负担，但实验限于特定软机器人类型，未见更多形态泛化性讨论。

papers.title: Hardware-aware Graph Neural Networks prunning for embedded event-based vision
papers.abstract_en: Event-based cameras are gaining popularity as the sensor of choice for mobile robotics, due to their high performance in dynamic environments. However, these applications require efficient real-time data processing with low latency and power consumption. One strategy to meet these stringent requirements is hardware acceleration of efficient algorithms that preserve the temporal sparsity of event data. In this work, we propose an optimization strategy for Graph Convolutional Neural Networks models aimed at adapting their architecture to the limited resources of embedded heterogeneous FPGA platforms. Our method incorporates hardware-aware pruning and quantization, taking into account the trade-off between on-chip memory savings and inference accuracy. Strategic exploration of the design space with Fine Grid Search and Greedy layer-wise Iterative Deepening Search methods enables flexible adaptation of the model architecture to the target platform. Our approach was evaluated across various network configurations and multiple datasets, resulting in BRAM memory reductions of 28.8% for CIFAR-10 (with a 1.65% decrease in accuracy), 31.4% for MNIST-DVS (accuracy drop of 3.55%), and 26.5% for N-Caltech101 (with a 5.18% accuracy reduction).
papers.journal_ref: 2025 Signal Processing: Algorithms, Architectures, Arrangements, and Applications (SPA), Poznan, Poland, 2025, pp. 182-187
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向嵌入式事件相机的图卷积神经网络硬件感知剪枝与量化优化策略，通过细粒度网格搜索和贪婪逐层迭代加深搜索方法探索设计空间，在CIFAR-10、MNIST-DVS和N-Caltech101数据集上分别实现28.8%、31.4%和26.5%的BRAM内存节省，同时精度损失可控。
Motivation: 事件相机在移动机器人中应用广泛，但需要低延迟、低功耗的实时处理，现有算法在资源受限的嵌入式FPGA平台上难以高效部署。
Method: 提出结合硬件感知剪枝和量化的优化框架，利用细粒度网格搜索和贪婪逐层迭代加深搜索自动调整模型架构，平衡片上内存节省与推理精度。
Result: 在CIFAR-10、MNIST-DVS和N-Caltech101上分别实现BRAM节省28.8%（精度降1.65%）、31.4%（降3.55%）和26.5%（降5.18%）。
Conclusion: 所提方法能有效将图卷积神经网络适配到嵌入式FPGA平台，为事件相机提供高效的硬件加速方案。

papers.title: A Good Initialization is All You Need for Faithful Visual Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Faithful visual attribution identifies which image regions support a model prediction. Search-based perturbation methods lead the insertion--deletion faithfulness frontier by masking regions and measuring score changes, but they usually output a complete ordering of all regions. Many applications, especially MLLM attribution and repair, only need a compact top-\(k\) evidence mask. We study this mask-first attribution problem. An exactly \(k\)-region mask is combinatorial: useful evidence can depend on interactions among fine regions. Coarse grouping can stabilize early search but aggregates redundant content, whereas one-step scoring can miss high-value combinations. We introduce two forward-only methods. \textsc{CoPAIR} uses a PhaseWin--Greedy gap diagnosis to construct coarse singleton/pair candidates that warm-start full-ordering search. \textsc{TRACE} directly searches fixed-cardinality fine-region masks with cross-entropy sampling, elite retention, and distribution updates, with a finite-budget recovery analysis. The resulting evidence set can be returned as a compact attribution mask or used to initialize Greedy or PhaseWin when a complete ranking is required. Across ImageNet classification with CLIP ViT-L/14, CLIP RN101, and ResNet-101, our initialized search methods establish a new state-of-the-art frontier for faithful full-ordering attribution under inclusive forward-call accounting. On POPE and RePOPE with Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct and LLaVA-v1.5-7B, \textsc{TRACE}+Greedy gives the strongest search-based MLLM attribution results. Direct \textsc{TRACE} masks further achieve single-point RePOPE repair rates of \(94.44\%\) and \(96.00\%\), showing that compact evidence masks can be actionable attribution outputs, not merely prefixes of full rankings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对忠实视觉归因中的“mask-first”问题，即只需紧凑的top-k证据掩码，提出两种前向方法：CoPAIR使用PhaseWin-Greedy间隙诊断构建粗粒度候选，加速全排序搜索；TRACE直接搜索固定基数的细粒度区域掩码，使用交叉熵采样和精英保留。在ImageNet分类（CLIP ViT-L/14等）上，初始化的搜索方法建立了新的忠实全排序归因前沿；在POPE和RePOPE上，TRACE+Greedy给出最强的基于搜索的MLLM归因结果，直接TRACE掩码达到单点RePOPE修复率94.44%和96.00%。
Motivation: 现有基于搜索的扰动方法通常输出所有区域的完整排序，但许多应用（尤其是MLLM归因和修复）只需要紧凑的top-k证据掩码。精确k区域掩码是组合问题，有用证据可能依赖于细粒度区域间的交互；粗粒度分组虽稳定但聚合冗余，一步评分可能遗漏高值组合。
Method: 提出两种前向方法：CoPAIR使用PhaseWin-Greedy间隙诊断来构建粗粒度的单/双元素候选，以热启动全排序搜索；TRACE直接搜索固定基数的细粒度区域掩码，采用交叉熵采样、精英保留和分布更新，并具有有限预算恢复分析。
Result: 在ImageNet分类（CLIP ViT-L/14, CLIP RN101, ResNet-101）上，初始化的搜索方法建立了新的忠实全排序归因前沿；在POPE和RePOPE上（Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct, LLaVA-v1.5-7B），TRACE+Greedy给出最强的基于搜索的MLLM归因结果，直接TRACE掩码达到单点RePOPE修复率94.44%和96.00%。
Conclusion: 紧凑证据掩码可以是有行动力的归因输出，而不仅仅是完整排序的前缀。所提出的初始化方法在全排序和掩码直接输出两种场景下均提升忠实性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Optimization Geometrodynamics: A Framework for Dynamic Geometric Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Most gradient-based optimization methods move parameters through a fixed background geometry, even when their internal states implicitly define changing notions of length, curvature, and preconditioning. We introduce optimization geometrodynamics, a benchmark language in which optimization is a coupled evolution of a parameter trajectory, a transported distribution of particles, and a controlled time-varying Riemannian metric. The language separates invariant obstructions from improvable geometric mismatch: positive metrics preserve critical points and Morse indices, and cannot remove global geodesic-convexity obstructions, but can alter conditioning, distributional transport, and flux away from exact critical points. We introduce dynamic geometric complexity, the minimum geometric cost required to reduce an optimization difficulty observable. In the oracle benchmark model of strongly convex quadratic objectives with full positive-definite metric control, this complexity is exactly the affine-invariant distance from the relative log-spectrum to a low-condition-number set. We also analyze Hessian-matching flows, spectral Onsager relaxation, discrete exponential projection updates, gauge-invariant observables, and fixed-time local Morse-saddle flux. The paper is theory-only: its claims are formal statements with proofs, intended to provide invariants and benchmark costs against which implementable adaptive optimizers can be compared once their admissible metric families, curvature estimates, and discretization errors are specified.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出优化几何动力学（optimization geometrodynamics）这一基准语言，将优化过程建模为参数轨迹、粒子分布传输和时变黎曼度量的耦合演化。该语言区分了不变障碍与可改进的几何失配：正度量保持临界点和莫尔斯指数，但无法消除全局测地凸性障碍，却能改变条件数、分布传输及远离临界点的通量。论文还定义了动态几何复杂度，在强凸二次目标的oracle模型中，该复杂度等于相对对数谱到低条件数集合的仿射不变距离。全文为纯理论推导，包含形式化声明和证明，旨在为可实现的自适应优化器提供比较基准。
Motivation: 现有基于梯度的优化方法大多在固定背景几何下移动参数，忽略了内部状态隐含的长度、曲率和预条件变化，缺乏统一的几何语言来刻画优化过程中的不变障碍与可改进成分。
Method: 提出一个耦合演化框架：参数轨迹、粒子分布和时变黎曼度量协同更新。定义动态几何复杂度作为最小几何成本。在强凸二次目标下，利用oracle模型推导该复杂度的精确表达式，并分析Hessian匹配流、谱Onsager弛豫、离散指数投影更新等变体。
Result: 在强凸二次目标且完全控制正定度量的oracle模型中，动态几何复杂度精确等于相对对数谱到低条件数集合的仿射不变距离。正度量保持临界点和Morse指标，但无法移除全局测地凸性障碍。
Conclusion: 论文强调其贡献是提供理论不变量和基准成本，以便后续研究在指定度量族、曲率估计和离散化误差后，可将实际自适应优化器与这些理论下界进行比较。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Does In-Context Search Help? A Sampling-Complexity Theory of Reflection-Driven Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Training large language models (LLMs) with extended reasoning has enabled in-context search, in which models iteratively generate, critique, and revise solution attempts. We provide a theoretical analysis of in-context search by modeling it as approximate inference over reasoning traces, where the base model defines a prior and self-reflection provides feedback for posterior updates, and study the resulting inference-time sampling complexity - the number of sequential attempts needed to achieve high success probability. We show that when reflections reliably localize early mistakes, in-context search can yield exponential improvements over the base model, solving problems with exponentially small zero-shot pass rates using only a polynomial number of sequential attempts, whereas when this property fails, conditioning on past attempts offers no asymptotic benefit over parallel sampling. We further show that these gains are robust and learnable: approximate posterior updates suffice, and cross-entropy training on search rollouts recovers the required behavior with polynomial sample complexity. Finally, we show that under a stagewise abstraction of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, the optimal policy extension implements the same posterior reweighting rule. We validate key qualitative predictions of the theory on real large reasoning models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对大型语言模型（LLM）中的上下文搜索（in-context search）推理进行了采样复杂度理论分析。将上下文搜索建模为推理轨迹上的近似推断，其中基础模型定义先验，自我反思提供后验更新的反馈。理论表明，当反思能可靠地定位早期错误时，上下文搜索可以指数级提升成功率，仅需多项式数量的尝试；当该条件不满足时，则无渐进优势。还证明了后验更新的鲁棒性和可学习性，并在真实推理模型上验证了关键预测。
Motivation: 大型语言模型通过扩展推理实现了上下文搜索，但缺乏对其采样复杂度的理论理解，即需要多少顺序尝试才能达到高成功概率。
Method: 将上下文搜索建模为推理轨迹上的近似推断，基础模型提供先验，自我反思提供后验更新的反馈，并分析推理时的采样复杂度。
Result: 当反思可靠定位早期错误时，上下文搜索相比基础模型能实现指数级改进，用多项式次顺序尝试解决指数级零样本通过率问题；否则无渐进优势。此外，近似后验更新足够，且在搜索轨迹上进行交叉熵训练能以多项式样本复杂度恢复所需行为。
Conclusion: 上下文搜索在下游推理任务中的有效性取决于反思的质量，且这些增益是鲁棒且可学习的。

papers.title: Macroeconomic Message Passing for Anticipating Foreign Exchange Regime Changes: A Deep Logical Learning Approach using Graph Tsetlin Machines
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces a graph-theoretic approach for predicting market regimes in foreign exchange (FX) currency prices. Specifically, the proposed model incorporates exogenous macroeconomic variables to update localized node features via message-passing operations. Utilizing the Graph Tsetlin Machine (GraphTM) framework, we empirically demonstrate the efficacy of this approach in anticipating market regimes for the US Dollar and Japanese Yen currency pair (USD/JPY). By representing multivariate macroeconomic drivers and technical indicators as hypervectorized directed multigraphs, the GraphTM leverages structured message passing to construct deep, interpretable logical clauses capable of recognizing complex sub-graph patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图的消息传递方法，利用Graph Tsetlin Machine预测美元/日元汇率的市场制度变化。模型将宏观经济变量和技术指标表示为超向量有向多重图，通过结构化消息传递构建可解释的逻辑子句。
Motivation: 现有方法难以捕捉宏观经济变量对外汇市场制度的复杂影响，缺乏可解释性。
Method: 使用GraphTM框架，将多个宏观驱动因子表示为超向量有向多重图，通过消息传递更新节点特征，并利用Tsetlin自动机学习逻辑子句。
Result: 摘要声称在USD/JPY货币对上有效预测市场制度变化。
Conclusion: 该方法能够识别复杂子图模式，具有可解释性。

papers.title: Reliable and Developer-Aligned Evaluation of Agents for Software Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are rapidly moving towards closing the development cycle, transitioning from simple assistive companions to autonomous contributors deeply embedded into collaborative development environments. Despite their accelerated adoption, existing evaluation techniques are limited due to their fragmented nature and distorted projection of true model capabilities, often obtained from hypothetical syntactic scenarios. This research aims to bridge this gap by providing a comprehensive evaluation methodology for LLM-powered agents that is grounded in real-world software development practice. Our evaluation approach focuses on contamination-awareness, in-the-wild agentic behavior assessment, and trajectory-aware benchmarks and metrics capturing realistic coding contexts, human-aligned behavior, and model failure modes.
papers.comment: International Conference on the Foundations of Software Engineering '26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的软件工程智能体提出了一种可靠且与开发者对齐的评估方法，强调污染感知、野外智能体行为评估以及轨迹感知的基准和指标。
Motivation: 现有评估技术因碎片化性质和从假设语法场景中获得的失真能力投影而受限，无法真实反映模型在现实软件开发中的能力。
Method: 提出一种基于真实软件开发实践的评估方法，包括污染感知、野外智能体行为评估和轨迹感知基准与指标，以捕捉真实编码上下文、人类对齐行为和模型故障模式。
Result: 该方法旨在提供更准确和全面的LLM智能体能力评估，但摘要未报告具体实验结果或数值。
Conclusion: 该评估方法论能够弥合现有评估差距，更真实地反映LLM智能体在协作开发环境中的表现。

papers.title: Vision Language Action (VLA) Models for Unmanned Aerial Robotics and Bimanual Manipulation: A Review
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Action (VLA) models unify visual perception, natural-language understanding, and action generation within a single foundation model, allowing a robot to follow instructions such as fold the towel or fly to the red building directly from camera images. Because VLAs inherit world knowledge from internet-scale pre-training, they have become the dominant framework for learning-based manipulation, with bimanual coordination serving as the most demanding testbed: two arms with 7 degrees of freedom each must move in concert to fold, assemble, and reorient objects. Unmanned aerial robotics faces a structurally similar challenge: a drone must coordinate thrust, attitude, and increasingly gripper commands from visual observations under strict latency and payload constraints. This review covers 183 contributions spanning 2017-2026 and organized along seven dimensions: VLA architectures, training recipes, action representations, bimanual coordination (2022-2026), unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) navigation and control (2017-2026), language grounding, and cross-cutting concerns including memory and world models. We show that the coordination strategies, training recipes, and action representations developed for bimanual VLAs transfer to unmanned aerial systems and identify fourteen research directions across both domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在无人机（UAV）和双臂操作中的应用，涵盖2017-2026年的183篇文献，从架构、训练、动作表示、双臂协调、UAV导航与控制、语言接地等七个维度进行分析，并指出双臂VLA中的协调策略可迁移至无人机系统。
Motivation: VLA模型在机器人操作中表现优异，但双臂操作与无人机协调面临类似挑战（如多自由度协同、实时性约束），缺乏跨领域的系统综述。
Method: 采用文献综述方法，按VLA架构、训练方式、动作表示、双臂协调、UAV导航控制、语言接地、交叉问题（记忆与世界模型）七个维度组织文献，并对比迁移性。
Result: 指出双臂VLA中的协调策略、训练方法和动作表示可迁移至无人机系统，并识别出14个未来研究方向。
Conclusion: 该综述为VLA模型在双臂操作与无人机中的统一应用提供了系统视角，强调了跨领域迁移潜力。

papers.title: SPEAR: A Simulator for Photorealistic Embodied AI Research
papers.abstract_en: Interactive simulators have become powerful tools for training embodied agents and generating synthetic visual data, but existing photorealistic simulators suffer from limited generality, programmability, and rendering speed. We address these limitations by introducing SPEAR: A Simulator for Photorealistic Embodied AI Research. At its core, SPEAR is a Python library that can connect to, and programmatically control, any Unreal Engine (UE) application via a modular plugin architecture. SPEAR exposes over 14K unique UE functions to Python, representing an order-of-magnitude increase in programmable functionality over existing UE-based simulators. Additionally, a single SPEAR instance can render 1920x1080 photorealistic beauty images directly into a user's NumPy array at 73 frames per second - an order of magnitude faster than existing UE plugins - while also providing ground truth image modalities that are not available in any existing UE-based simulator (e.g., a non-diffuse intrinsic image decomposition, material IDs, and physically based shading parameters). Finally, SPEAR introduces an expressive high-level programming model that enables users to specify complex graphs of UE work with arbitrary data dependencies among work items, and to execute these graphs deterministically within a single UE frame. We demonstrate the utility of SPEAR through a diverse collection of example applications: controlling multiple embodied agents with distinct action spaces (e.g., humans, cars, and robots) across several in-the-wild UE projects; rendering photorealistic city-scale environments; manipulating UE's procedural content generation systems; rendering synchronized multi-view images of detailed human faces; coordinating an interactive co-simulation with the MuJoCo physics simulator; and editing scenes with natural language via an AI coding assistant.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPEAR 是一个基于虚幻引擎（Unreal Engine）的 Python 库，用于具身 AI 研究。它通过模块化插件架构暴露超过 14,000 个 UE 函数，能以 73 FPS 渲染 1920x1080 的逼真图像，并提供独特的真值图像模态（如非漫反射固有图像分解、材质 ID 和基于物理的着色参数）。SPEAR 还引入了一种高级编程模型，支持在单个 UE 帧内确定性执行复杂的依赖图。
Motivation: 现有逼真模拟器在通用性、可编程性和渲染速度方面存在局限，限制了具身 AI 研究和合成视觉数据的生成。
Method: SPEAR 是一个 Python 库，通过模块化插件架构连接和控制任何虚幻引擎应用程序。它暴露了超过 14,000 个 UE 函数，实现了比现有 UE 模拟器高一个数量级的可编程功能，并以 73 FPS 的速度渲染 1920x1080 图像，同时提供独有的真值模态。
Result: SPEAR 能够以 73 FPS 渲染 1920x1080 的逼真图像，比现有 UE 插件快一个数量级，并提供了其他模拟器无法提供的真值模态。示例应用包括控制多种具身智能体、渲染城市规模环境、操作程序化内容生成、同步多视图人脸渲染、与 MuJoCo 联合仿真以及通过 AI 编码助手进行自然语言场景编辑。
Conclusion: SPEAR 通过 Python 接口、高速渲染、丰富真值模态和高级编程模型，显著提升了逼真具身 AI 模拟器的通用性、可编程性和渲染速度。

summary_sections.method: SPEAR 是一个 Python 库，通过模块化插件架构连接和控制任何虚幻引擎应用程序。它暴露了超过 14,000 个 UE 函数，实现了比现有 UE 模拟器高一个数量级的可编程功能，并以 73 FPS 的速度渲染 1920x1080 图像，同时提供独有的真值模态。
summary_sections.result: SPEAR 能够以 73 FPS 渲染 1920x1080 的逼真图像，比现有 UE 插件快一个数量级，并提供了其他模拟器无法提供的真值模态。示例应用包括控制多种具身智能体、渲染城市规模环境、操作程序化内容生成、同步多视图人脸渲染、与 MuJoCo 联合仿真以及通过 AI 编码助手进行自然语言场景编辑。
summary_sections.conclusion: SPEAR 通过 Python 接口、高速渲染、丰富真值模态和高级编程模型，显著提升了逼真具身 AI 模拟器的通用性、可编程性和渲染速度。

papers.title: Heat-Kernel Entropy Profiles and Geometric Effective Sample Size for Weighted Measures on Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Weighted empirical measures on compact manifolds arise in importance sampling, particle approximations, posterior summaries, quadrature, and representation learning. Standard weight-only summaries, such as ordinary effective sample size, ignore the geometry of the support. We introduce heat-kernel entropy profiles, a multiscale summary that diffuses weighted atoms by intrinsic heat flow and tracks nonuniformity across scales. For order-two Rényi entropy, the profile is computable from pairwise heat-kernel overlaps and yields a geometric effective sample size that discounts nearby or duplicate particles while matching ordinary effective sample size for well-separated particles. We prove monotonicity, small- and large-scale asymptotics, deterministic-weight consistency, and a bounded-ratio self-normalized importance-sampling extension for compact manifolds without boundary. On spheres, the unlogged profile decomposes into spherical-harmonic energies that recover mean-direction, von Mises-Fisher-type, and Bingham-type summaries. Sphere-based experiments show that the profile reveals antipodal, girdle, multimodal, and duplicate-particle structure missed by weight-only and first-moment spherical summaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对紧致流形上的加权经验测度，引入热核熵轮廓的多尺度摘要，通过内禀热流扩散加权原子并追踪不同尺度下的非均匀性。对于二阶Rényi熵，该轮廓可通过成对热核重叠计算，并得到几何有效样本量，能对邻近或重复粒子进行折扣，同时对于分离良好的粒子与普通有效样本量一致。作者证明了单调性、小尺度和大尺度渐近性、确定性权重一致性以及无边界紧致流形上的有界比率自归一化重要性采样扩展。在球面上，未取对数的轮廓可分解为球谐能量，恢复平均方向、von Mises-Fisher型和Bingham型摘要。球面实验表明，该轮廓能揭示对跖、环带、多模态和重复粒子结构，而这些结构被仅权重和第一矩球面摘要所忽略。
Motivation: 加权经验测度在重要性采样、粒子近似、后验摘要、求积和表示学习中广泛应用，但标准的仅权重摘要（如普通有效样本量）忽略了支撑集的几何结构，导致对粒子空间分布信息的丢失。
Method: 提出热核熵轮廓（heat-kernel entropy profiles），将加权原子通过流形上的热核扩散过程进行多尺度平滑，并基于二阶Rényi熵定义几何有效样本量（geometric effective sample size），该量通过成对热核重叠计算，能自动考虑粒子间的几何邻近性。
Result: 理论方面证明了轮廓的单调性、渐近行为、确定性权重一致性以及自归一化重要性采样的有界比率扩展。在球面实验中，轮廓揭示了仅权重和第一矩摘要无法检测的对跖、环带、多模态和重复粒子结构。
Conclusion: 本文提供的几何有效样本量框架为流形上加权样本的质量评估提供了几何感知的工具，尤其适用于重要性采样和粒子滤波等需要评估粒子多样性的场景。
Relevance: 10
