papers.title: CoMind: Understanding Collaborative Human Activity from Multiple Minds and Views
papers.abstract_en: Human-human collaboration is a fundamental aspect of everyday life, essential to success in a wide range of goal-directed activities from household tasks to professional teamwork. While much research has focused on modeling coordination and task execution, the cognitive processes that support such collaboration, particularly Theory of Mind (the ability to infer the mental states of others), remain difficult to study in natural settings. To address this gap, we introduce a novel egocentric and exocentric video dataset capturing real-world collaboration in cooking scenarios. The dataset integrates multi-perspective video, high-quality audio, gaze tracking, and 3D scene and object scans, with annotations for shared attention to objects, social cues and interactions between agents, as well as agent-object interactions. We establish benchmarks for Joint Attention Estimation, Socially Conditioned Object Interaction Anticipation, and Collaborative Handover Prediction, enabling research on multimodal perception, proactive assistance, and collaborative planning. By providing temporally aligned, richly annotated multimodal data, CoMind facilitates the development and evaluation of AI systems capable of modeling complex social interactions and reasoning about human behaviors in collaborative environments. Our dataset and benchmarks are made available at https://comind.ethz.ch/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CoMind数据集，专注于理解人类协作活动中的认知过程，特别是心理理论（Theory of Mind）。数据集包含第一人称和第三人称视频、音频、眼动追踪、3D场景扫描等多模态数据，在烹饪场景中捕捉真实协作。作者建立了三个基准任务：联合注意估计、社会条件对象交互预测与协作移交预测，旨在推动多模态感知和协作规划研究。
Motivation: 现有研究难以在自然环境中分析人类协作中的心理理论，缺乏包含丰富多模态数据的基准数据集。
Method: 构建多视角视频数据集，集成音频、眼动追踪、3D场景扫描，并对共享注意、社交线索、交互进行标注，定义三个评估任务。
Result: 提供了三个基准任务（联合注意估计、社会条件对象交互预测、协作移交预测），为多模态感知和主动辅助研究建立评估标准。
Conclusion: CoMind数据集和基准可促进AI系统在复杂社交交互和协作行为推理方面的发展。

papers.title: tsbootstrap: Distribution-Free Uncertainty Quantification and Conformal Prediction for Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Finance, sensing, and demand streams violate the exchangeability that IID conformal prediction and the IID bootstrap assume, and existing libraries implement either a general resampling engine or conformal calibration without the other. tsbootstrap provides block, residual, sieve, and wild resampling, classical bootstrap confidence intervals, and adaptive conformal calibrators (EnbPI, ACI, NexCP, AgACI) through a single typed API in which a specification object selects each method. In a controlled coverage study the IID bootstrap undercovers sharply under dependence; dependence-aware methods reduce the coverage deficit, the sieve nearest to nominal under short-memory linear dependence. On the shared fixed-statistic path a compiled backend runs several times faster than arch, and a streaming reduce avoids materializing the $O(Bn)$ replicate tensor, limiting peak extra memory to $O(B)$ for the statistic array. The software is MIT licensed (v0.6.1).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: tsbootstrap是一个针对时间序列的分布自由不确定量化和共形预测库，实现了块、残差、筛、wild重采样及多种自适应共形校准器（EnbPI, ACI, NexCP, AgACI）。覆盖实验表明，在依赖数据下IID bootstrap覆盖不足，而依赖感知方法（尤其是筛方法）能减少覆盖偏差。编译后端显著加速计算，并采用流式归约避免内存爆炸。
Motivation: 现有库要么仅实现通用重采样引擎，要么仅实现共形校准，而时间序列的交换性假设常被违反，需要结合依赖感知的不确定量化方法。
Method: 提供统一的类型化API，通过规格对象选择块/残差/筛/wild重采样、经典bootstrap置信区间或自适应共形校准器，并使用编译后端和流式归约提升效率。
Result: 在受控覆盖研究中，IID bootstrap在数据依赖下覆盖严重不足；依赖感知方法减少覆盖缺陷，筛方法在短记忆线性依赖下最接近名义覆盖。编译后端比arch库快数倍，内存开销从O(Bn)降低到O(B)。
Conclusion: tsbootstrap作为一个功能全面的时间序列不确定量化工具，以MIT许可证发布，代码开源。

papers.title: Digital Fragmentation and Generative AI Use Across 103 Million Application Events
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge workers switch between applications thousands of times per day, spending nearly a tenth of the work year transitioning between digital applications in a process called digital fragmentation. Whether this fragmentation reflects who an employee is, where they work, or what kind of day they are having, has remained an open question. We analyzed 103 million application events recorded second-by-second from 1,017 employees across eight organizations that largely employ knowledge workers (e.g., law, financial services). Day-to-day variation in fragmentation within individual employees accounted for 44.6% of the variation in digital fragmentation, slightly exceeding stable individual differences between employees (35.8%), and far exceeding variation between organizations (19.6%). Fragmentation rose over the work week and reset after weekends and holidays. Higher-than-typical use of communication applications coincided with more fragmented work. Generative AI use also occurred on more fragmented days, but the period following AI use was marked by narrower, longer, and more predictable application use. These findings identify the workday as a key level for understanding and intervening on digital fragmentation and suggest that AI may help structure fragmented work rather than merely intensify it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该研究分析了来自8家知识密集型企业的1,017名员工共1.03亿次应用事件，发现数字碎片化（频繁切换应用）的主要变异来源是员工个体内的日常波动（占44.6%），其次是个体间差异（35.8%）和组织间差异（19.6%）。碎片化程度在一周内递增，周末和假期后重置，且与即时通讯工具的高频使用相关。生成式AI使用发生在更碎片化的日子，但使用后应用行为变得更窄、更长、更可预测。
Motivation: 知识工作者每天切换应用数千次，但数字碎片化的主要来源（员工个体、组织还是日常波动）尚未明确，其对生成式AI使用的影响也缺乏实证。
Method: 对8个组织中1,017名员工的1.03亿次应用事件进行秒级分析，量化碎片化在个体内、个体间和组织间的变异比例，并考察其与沟通工具使用、生成式AI使用的关系。
Result: 个体内日常波动解释了44.6%的碎片化变异，个体间差异占35.8%，组织间差异仅19.6%；碎片化在一周内上升，周末后重置；生成式AI使用发生在更碎片化的日子，但之后应用使用更集中、持久和可预测。
Conclusion: 工作日内日常动态是理解数字碎片化的关键层面，生成式AI可能有助于结构化碎片化工作而非单纯加剧碎片化。

papers.title: Robust Human-AI Complementarity under Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models are often intended to augment rather than replace human decision makers, by providing information that is complementary to human judgement. Yet, in practice, human decision makers routinely fail to realize such complementary gains, even when models provide useful signal. In this work, we study how asymmetric information about the quality of information available to a human decision maker vs. an AI impacts the ability of a decision maker to extract complementary value from AI predictions. We show that a key factor is the error correlation structure between human and AI predictions. In particular, when the AI's prediction errors are \textit{negatively correlated} with those of the human, the decision maker can construct robust strategies which guarantee improvements in expected utility. We empirically investigate whether these conditions for complementarity arise in practice, using real-world forecasting benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究不确定性下鲁棒的人机互补性问题，指出人类决策者常无法从AI预测中获得互补增益。通过分析发现，AI与人类预测误差的负相关结构是关键因素，此时决策者可以构建保证期望效用提升的稳健策略。在真实预测基准上进行了实证验证。
Motivation: 人类决策者难以实现人机互补增益，需要理解影响互补性的关键因素。
Method: 理论分析误差相关结构对互补性的影响，并在真实预测基准上实证检验。
Result: 当AI与人类预测误差负相关时，存在稳健策略保证期望效用提升。
Conclusion: 误差相关结构是实现人机互补的关键，真实基准数据支持理论条件。

papers.title: Pelican-VLA 0.5: Attending Before Acting Benefits Generalization
papers.abstract_en: In this report, we present Pelican-VLA 0.5, a unified VLA model that integrates vision-language understanding, future-frame generation, and action prediction within a single architecture. Pelican-VLA 0.5 achieves attention-level generalization: without object annotations, segmentation masks, attention supervision, or task-specific fine-tuning, its action pathway already focuses on the instruction-relevant object and contact region. This behavior persists across unseen scenes and unseen robot embodiments, and is substantially stronger than in other open-source VLA baselines. We verify that this ability originates from the learnable Reasoning Slots inserted between perception and action: by routing task-relevant visual information through a compact bottleneck, the slot interface induces manipulation-centric attention during pre-training and remains effective across different policy structures, including a MoT-style architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Pelican-VLA 0.5，一个统一的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，在单一架构中整合视觉语言理解、未来帧生成和动作预测。该模型实现了注意力级别的泛化：无需对象标注、分割掩码、注意力监督或任务特定微调，其动作路径已能聚焦于与指令相关的对象和接触区域，并在未见场景和未见的机器人实体上保持稳定性，显著优于其他开源VLA基线。这一能力源于插入在感知和动作之间的可学习推理槽（Reasoning Slots），通过在紧凑瓶颈中路由任务相关视觉信息，在预训练期间诱导以操作为中心的注意力，并适用于不同策略结构。

Result: 在未见场景和未见的机器人实体上，Pelican-VLA 0.5的动作路径自动聚焦于指令相关对象和接触区域，注意力泛化能力显著强于其他开源VLA基线。
Conclusion: 推理槽机制是实现注意力层面泛化的关键，无需显式监督即可在预训练中学习到任务相关注意力，并可迁移至不同策略结构。

papers.title: Dual Attention Heads for Personalized Federated Learning in ECG Classification
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across institutions without sharing sensitive patient data. However, the inherent heterogeneity of electrocardiogram (ECG) data across healthcare providers presents significant technical challenges for robust classification. We propose FedDualAtt, a personalized federated learning approach that splits transformer attention heads into global and local branches. Global heads are aggregated via FedAvg to capture shared cross-site patterns, while local heads remain client-specific to adapt to institution-level recording characteristics. Experiments on FedCVD, an FL benchmark for cardiovascular disease detection, demonstrate that FedDualAtt outperforms existing FL and personalized FL methods in ECG classification tasks. Analysis of global-local head ratios reveals that different clients benefit from varying levels of architectural personalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedDualAtt，一种个性化联邦学习方法，将 Transformer 注意力头拆分为全局和本地分支，分别通过 FedAvg 聚合全局模式并保留本地客户端特定特征。在 FedCVD 心电图分类基准上，FedDualAtt 优于现有联邦学习及个性化联邦学习方法，且不同客户端受益于不同程度的架构个性化。
Motivation: 心电图数据跨机构存在固有异质性，给联邦学习中的鲁棒分类带来挑战；现有方法难以同时捕捉共享跨站点模式和机构级特征。
Method: 将 Transformer 注意力头分为全局头（通过 FedAvg 聚合）和本地头（保留客户端特定），提出 FedDualAtt 架构。
Result: 在 FedCVD 基准上，FedDualAtt 在心电图分类任务中优于现有 FL 和个性化 FL 方法；全局-本地头比例分析表明不同客户端需要不同个性化程度。
Conclusion: 分割注意力头为全局和本地分支能有效处理数据异质性，提升个性化联邦学习性能。

papers.title: From Jumps to Signatures: a Generative Method for Temporal Point Processes
papers.abstract_en: Rough path signatures are a universal feature map for continuous paths and, via the expected signature, characterise path distributions. These guarantees do not directly extend to cadlag paths of Temporal Point Processes (TPPs), limiting the use of signature methods for event sequences. Furthermore, neural TPP models, including recent generative approaches, optimise per-event objectives with no global sequence-level loss, while evaluation of variable-length event sequences lacks distributional discrepancy measures. This paper proposes a common pathwise framework for addressing these limitations. We introduce the interarrival embedding, a stable, injective lift from jump paths to continuous paths of bounded variation, extending signature methods to discrete event sequences. Our theoretical contributions give rise to sigTPP, the first signature-based generative model for TPPs, trained using a path-level loss on complete trajectories. We further analyse the space of counting paths and derive three distributional discrepancies, providing mathematically justified tools for evaluating generative TPP models. Across synthetic and real-world datasets, sigTPP achieves the best average rank based on eight complementary metrics, outperforms or is within a standard error of the strongest baseline in 64% of the dataset-metric pairs, and according to a relative score, improves against every baseline by at least 19% on average.
papers.comment: 44 pages. Source code and datasets: https://github.com/Code-Cornelius/sigtpp
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于粗糙路径签名（rough path signatures）的生成方法（sigTPP）用于时间点过程（Temporal Point Processes, TPPs）。通过引入interarrival embedding将跳跃路径连续化，使得签名方法适用于离散事件序列，并使用路径级损失训练生成模型。理论贡献包括三种分布差异度量用于评估变长序列生成模型。实验表明sigTPP在多个合成和真实数据集上超越了现有基线。
Motivation: 现有神经网络TPP模型缺乏全局序列级损失，且评估变长事件序列缺乏分布差异度量。同时，粗糙路径签名的理论保证不直接适用于TPP的cadlag（左极限右连续）路径。
Method: 提出interarrival embedding，将跳跃路径稳定且单射地提升为有界变差的连续路径，从而扩展签名方法。基于此，提出sigTPP，首个基于签名的TPP生成模型，使用路径级损失训练。进一步推导三种分布差异度量用于评估。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，sigTPP基于八个互补指标取得最佳平均排名，在64%的数据集-指标对中超越或达到最强基线的标准误差内，且相对分数平均优于所有基线至少19%。
Conclusion: 本文为时间点过程提供了一种统一的路径级框架，包括嵌入、生成模型和评估度量，实验验证了有效性。

papers.title: Entropy-Guided Tensor Compression for Multimodal Federated Learning on Edge Devices
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) over mobile and edge devices increasingly involves multimodal models in which clients differ in both sensing capability and computational capacity. Existing update compression schemes typically apply uniform policies across layers and devices, without accounting for modality-specific differences in spectral structure and compressibility. We propose MESH-FL, an entropy-guided matrix product state (MPS) update-compression framework for modality-heterogeneous FL on resource-constrained devices. MESH-FL estimates the spectral entropy of each layer-wise update via truncated singular value decomposition and allocates MPS compression ranks adaptively across layers, modalities, and devices under per-client payload budgets. We show that higher spectral entropy necessitates a higher reconstruction rank under the majorization order on singular-value energy distributions. Building on this result, we prove that the proposed entropy-guided allocation solves a convex surrogate rank-allocation problem, preserves monotonicity under the exact payload model, and achieves convergence with an explicit compression-dependent error term. Experiments on a 15-node heterogeneous Raspberry Pi~4/5 cluster with modality-heterogeneous clients show that MESH-FL achieves up to $56.8\times$ compression while surpassing the uncompressed FedAvg baseline in final accuracy by up to 2.01%, and reduces total transmitted data to reach convergence by up to $66\times$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MESH-FL，一种基于熵引导的矩阵乘积态（MPS）更新压缩框架，用于资源受限设备上的模态异构联邦学习。MESH-FL 通过截断奇异值分解估计每层更新的谱熵，并在层、模态和设备间自适应分配 MPS 压缩秩。实验在 15 节点异构 Raspberry Pi 4/5 集群上实现高达 56.8× 压缩，最终准确率超过未压缩的 FedAvg 基线最多 2.01%，总传输数据量减少最多 66×。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习更新压缩方案通常对各层和设备采用统一策略，忽略了模态特定的谱结构和可压缩性差异，导致在模态异构场景下效率低下。
Method: 提出熵引导的 MPS 更新压缩框架 MESH-FL：利用谱熵估计层更新的可压缩性，通过凸替代秩分配问题自适应分配压缩秩，并证明该分配在精确载荷模型下保持单调性并保证收敛。
Result: 在 15 节点异构 Raspberry Pi 4/5 集群上，MESH-FL 实现最高 56.8× 压缩，最终准确率超基线 2.01%，总传输数据量减少 66×。
Conclusion: MESH-FL 通过熵引导的秩分配有效平衡了模态异构联邦学习中的压缩率与模型质量，但摘要未提及对非结构化数据或极端异构性的局限性。

papers.title: POPS: Recovering Unlearned Multi-Modality Knowledge in MLLMs with Prompt-Optimized Parameter Shaking
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance on cross-modal tasks by jointly training on large-scale textual and visual data, where privacy-sensitive examples could be unintentionally encoded, raising concerns about privacy or copyright violation. To this end, Multi-modality Machine Unlearning (MMU) was proposed as a mitigation that can effectively force MLLMs to forget private information. However, the robustness of such unlearning methods is not fully exploited when the model is published and accessible to malicious users. In this paper, we propose a novel adversarial strategy, namely Prompt-Optimized Parameter Shaking (POPS), aiming to recover the supposedly unlearned multi-modality knowledge from the MLLMs. Our method elicits the victim MLLMs to generate potential private examples via prompt-suffix optimization, and then exploits these synthesized outputs to fine-tune the models so they disclose the true private information. The experiments on the different MMU benchmarks reveal substantial weaknesses in the existing MMU algorithms. Our POPS can even achieve a near-complete recovery of supposedly erased sensitive information on the unlearned MLLMs, exposing fundamental vulnerabilities that challenge the foundational robustness of representative MMU-based privacy protections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中的机器遗忘（MMU）安全性问题，提出一种名为POPS的对抗攻击策略。该方法通过提示后缀优化（prompt-suffix optimization）生成潜在私密样本，并利用这些合成输出对模型进行微调，从而恢复已被遗忘的多模态知识。实验表明，POPS能在多个MMU基准上几乎完全恢复被认为已擦除的敏感信息，揭示了现有遗忘算法的根本脆弱性。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型可能无意中编码隐私敏感数据，机器遗忘技术被用于删除这些信息，但现有遗忘方法的鲁棒性在模型公开后并未被充分探索，恶意用户可能试图恢复被遗忘的知识。
Method: 提出POPS攻击策略：首先通过优化提示后缀（prompt-suffix）诱导受害者MLLMs生成潜在的私密样本，然后利用这些合成输出对模型进行微调，迫使模型泄露真实的私密信息。
Result: 在多个MMU基准上，POPS实现几乎完全恢复已被擦除的敏感信息，证明现有遗忘算法存在根本性弱点。
Conclusion: 该工作暴露了当前多模态机器遗忘方法的安全漏洞，挑战了MMU作为隐私保护机制的基础鲁棒性。

papers.title: Final Checkpoints Are Not Enough: Analyzing Latent Reasoning Faithfulness Along Training Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Latent reasoning methods perform multi-step inference entirely in the model's continuous hidden states, promising more compact and efficient reasoning. However, these opaque hidden states raise a question of faithfulness: whether these latent reasoning steps causally drive the final answer. Prior work investigates this question at converged checkpoints and reports several unfaithful behaviors, such as latent reasoning steps that can be replaced without changing the answer, but leaves how these behaviors form during training unexamined. We instead track how faithfulness evolves across saved checkpoints for different latent reasoning paradigms, applying a verifiable counterfactual edit on the input and a noise-ablation activation patch on the latent reasoning steps. We find that (i) at the output level, latent reasoning methods can look similarly unfaithful at convergence under counterfactual edits while following qualitatively divergent trajectories; (ii) at the activation level, the causal contribution of latent reasoning steps to the final answer decays across training for both paradigms, with the examples that flip on the output side in (i) also being the examples on which this contribution decays; and (iii) the activation-level trajectory diverges by answer format, decaying on binary choice and rising on open-ended decoding. These findings highlight that latent reasoning faithfulness depends on training stage and answer format.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究潜在推理方法在训练过程中忠实性的演化。通过在保存的检查点上对输入进行可验证的反事实编辑并对潜在推理步骤施加噪声消融激活补丁，发现忠实性在输出层面和激活层面均呈现出依赖于训练阶段和回答格式的变化趋势。
Motivation: 现有工作仅检查收敛后的检查点，发现潜在推理可能不忠实，但未探究这些行为如何在训练中形成。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 对两类潜在推理范式，在保存的检查点上执行两种干预：一是对输入进行反事实编辑，二是在潜在推理步骤中应用噪声消融激活补丁，从而跟踪忠实性的演化。
Result: 在输出层面，不同范式在收敛时看似相似的不忠实行为却遵循质性不同的轨迹；在激活层面，潜在推理步骤对最终答案的因果贡献随训练衰减，且该衰减在反事实编辑下翻转输出的样本上更为显著；同时，激活轨迹因回答格式而异：在二元选择上衰减，在开放式生成上上升。
Conclusion: 潜在推理的忠实性并非静态，而是依赖于训练阶段和回答格式，提示研究者需在训练动态中评估忠实性。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有工作仅检查收敛后的检查点，发现潜在推理可能不忠实，但未探究这些行为如何在训练中形成。本文旨在填补这一空白。
summary_sections.method: 对两类潜在推理范式，在保存的检查点上执行两种干预：一是对输入进行反事实编辑，二是在潜在推理步骤中应用噪声消融激活补丁，从而跟踪忠实性的演化。
summary_sections.result: 在输出层面，不同范式在收敛时看似相似的不忠实行为却遵循质性不同的轨迹；在激活层面，潜在推理步骤对最终答案的因果贡献随训练衰减，且该衰减在反事实编辑下翻转输出的样本上更为显著；同时，激活轨迹因回答格式而异：在二元选择上衰减，在开放式生成上上升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 潜在推理的忠实性并非静态，而是依赖于训练阶段和回答格式，提示研究者需在训练动态中评估忠实性。

papers.title: ORAN-DEFEND: Subspace Detection and Sanitization of Backdoor DRL xApps in Open RAN
papers.abstract_en: Open Radio Access Networks (O-RAN) increasingly delegate near-real-time control to deep reinforcement learning (DRL) xApps obtained from third-party vendors, creating a new supply-chain attack surface. A backdoor policy behaves optimally until an adversary injects a covert trigger into the observed key performance indicator (KPI) telemetry, at which point it issues harmful control actions that degrade quality of service (QoS). We present ORAN-DEFEND, a retraining-free wrapper that sanitizes a frozen, potentially compromised xApp by projecting each KPI window onto a safe subspace estimated from a small number of trusted clean rollouts via singular value decomposition (SVD). We establish, both analytically and empirically, a precise recovery condition: the defense succeeds if the trigger energy concentrates in the orthogonal complement of the safe subspace, and we quantify this boundary through the trigger's $\Eperp$ energy fraction. On the Colosseum COLORAN dataset, we evaluate four structurally distinct DRL backdoor attacks, like TrojDRL, SleeperNets, BadRL, and Q-Incept, spanning inner-loop and outer-loop poisoning regimes and demonstrate $100\%$ return recovery and $\geq99.5\%$ defense success rate across all four when the subspace assumption holds. A geometry ablation reveals an intrinsic and previously uncharacterized limit of any linear projection defense: when the trigger collocates with the legitimate signal, the $\Eperp$ energy fraction governs recovery monotonically, and the linear residual detector collapses to chance even while a nonlinear classifier retains perfect separability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出了ORAN-DEFEND，一种无需重训练的防御方法，通过SVD将KPI窗口投影到安全子空间，从而清除后门触发。在Colosseum COLORAN数据集上，针对四种DRL后门攻击（TrojDRL、SleeperNets、BadRL、Q-Incept）实现了100%回报恢复和≥99.5%防御成功率，并分析了触发能量分布与防御条件的关系。
Motivation: O-RAN中第三方DRL xApps存在后门攻击风险，现有防御需要重训练或无法有效应对持续监控场景，亟需一种轻量级、无需重训练的方法。
Method: 基于奇异值分解（SVD）从少量可信轨迹估计安全子空间，将每个KPI窗口投影到该子空间以滤除触发信号。
Result: 在Colosseum COLORAN数据集上，四种攻击下均实现100%回报恢复和≥99.5%防御成功率，并验证了触发能量集中在子空间正交补时防御成功的条件。
Conclusion: 线性投影防御在触发与合法信号共定位时存在固有局限性，此时线性检测器失效而非线性分类器仍可保持完美可分离性。

papers.title: Diffusion enabled Optimal Transport distances for graph matching
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces Diffusion Semi-Relaxed Fused Gromov-Wasserstein (DsrFGW), a novel method for graph comparison that unifies node features and structural connectivity through optimal transport. While traditional Gromov-Wasserstein and semi-relaxed variants (srGW, srFGW) capture graph structure, they often struggle with sparse, noisy, or partially observed graphs. Inspired by Graph Diffusion Distance, which posits graphs are similar if they enable similar information transmission patterns, DsrFGW incorporates diffusion processes allowing information propagation across nodes, capturing local and global structural patterns while reducing sensitivity to noise or missing edges. An extensive evaluation on 36 synthetic pairwise graph matching tasks (easy, medium, hard) demonstrates consistent superiority over srFGW, achieving accuracy improvements of 0-20 percentage points and dramatic Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) gains: in medium-difficulty scenarios, srFGW often achieves negative ARI (worse than random) while DsrFGW offers better performance in terms of both internal and external clustering quality measures (i.e., Adjusted Rank Index and Accuracy with respect to the true underlying clusters, respectively). Even under severe noise, DsrFGW improves clustering quality in 92% of the synthetic tasks with optimal diffusion scales adapting to problem difficulty, establishing DsrFGW as a robust framework for graph comparison under structural uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出扩散半松弛融合Gromov-Wasserstein距离（DsrFGW），一种基于最优传输的图匹配方法，通过扩散过程整合节点特征与结构连接，提升对稀疏、含噪或部分观测图的鲁棒性。在36个合成图配对任务上，DsrFGW在准确性和调整兰德指数上显著优于半松弛融合Gromov-Wasserstein（srFGW），尤其在中等难度任务中srFGW出现负ARI而DsrFGW表现良好。
Motivation: 传统Gromov-Wasserstein及其半松弛变体在稀疏、含噪或部分观测图上表现不佳，需要一种更鲁棒的图比较方法。
Method: 引入图扩散距离的思想，在最优运输框架中融合扩散过程，使信息跨节点传播，捕获局部和全局结构模式，降低对噪声或缺失边的敏感度。
Result: 在36个合成图配对任务（易、中、难）上，DsrFGW准确率提升0-20个百分点，中等难度下srFGW的ARI为负（差于随机），而DsrFGW实现了更好的聚类质量；在严重噪声下，92%的任务中聚类质量改善。
Conclusion: DsrFGW作为一种鲁棒的图比较框架，适用于结构不确定的场景，扩散尺度可自适应问题难度。

papers.title: Fast determinantal sampling on general spaces and diffusion geometry
papers.abstract_en: Determinantal point processes have recently emerged as a kernel-based alternative to standard independent sampling for constructing efficient minibatches, coresets, and other compact representations of large-scale datasets. In particular, sampling mechanisms based on DPPs are believed to demonstrate better approximation properties compared to classical i.i.d. samplers, even at the scale of the exponent. One of the key strengths of DPP based samplers is that they can be deployed over very general spaces, in contrast to more classical sampling methods beyond i.i.d. which tend to work in very well-structured settings, principally Euclidean spaces. In this work, we establish explicit rate guarantees for determinantal sampling in spaces that extend far beyond known Euclidean setups, focusing on spectral kernels obtained from eigenspaces of naturally associated Laplacian and other Markov diffusion operators. This includes, in particular, Riemannian manifolds and weighted networks. In determinantal sampling from compact Riemannian manifolds, we establish sampling rates that automatically pick up the intrinsic dimensionality $d_{\text{int}}$ of the underlying manifold. In the setting of networks, we investigate DPP-based samplers on the celebrated k-nearest neighbour graphs, as well as weighted random geometric graphs, and demonstrate a similar improved dependence on the intrinsic dimensionality of the data. Overall, our approach achieves guarantees of $\big(\text{sample size}\big)^{-\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{2d_{\text{int}}}}$ that match known rates on Euclidean spaces of comparable dimension. In terms of techniques, we connect to the celebrated Weyl's Law for manifold spectra, and leverage tools from the theory of Markov diffusions and Dirichlet forms as well as certain ingredients from the theory of pseudodifferential operators, which could be of independent interest in this area.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究确定点过程（DPP）在一般空间上的快速采样，证明了在黎曼流形和加权网络上采样率的显式保证，实现了与欧几里得空间相当的率阶。
Motivation: DPP采样在构建高效小批量、核心集等方面被认为比独立同分布采样有更好的近似性质，但现有理论主要集中在欧几里得空间，缺乏对更一般空间（如流形、网络）的显式率保证。
Method: 利用谱核，结合拉普拉斯算子和其他马尔可夫扩散算子的特征空间，借助Weyl定律、马尔可夫扩散和Dirichlet形式以及伪微分算子理论进行分析。
Result: 在紧黎曼流形上，采样率自动适应内在维度d_int，达到O(样本大小^{-1/2 - 1/(2d_int)})；在k近邻图和加权随机几何图上，也得到类似的内在维度依赖性改善。
Conclusion: 该工作将DPP采样率的理论保障从欧几里得空间推广到更一般的空间，匹配已知欧几里得率阶，所用技术可能具有独立意义。

papers.title: The Power of Backdoor Absorption in Community Training
papers.abstract_en: Backdoor attacks severely threaten large-scale AI models. When model owners delegate training to external compute providers within a decentralized training paradigm, adversaries can craft stealthy, low-frequency triggers to inject malicious behavior while evading standard audits. Traditionally, detecting these attacks requires a full re-computation of the training steps--a prohibitive overhead that directly contradicts the owner's resource constraints. To address this, we investigate the resilience of continuous optimization dynamics under Byzantine perturbations, where adversaries are forced to compete against a continuous influx of honest updates. Under a threat model where an adversary compromises f out of n total trainers, we quantify the minimum auditing overhead required by the model owner to probabilistically bound the attack success rate. We formalize this injection-absorption dynamic as a Discrete-Time Markov Chain (DTMC). Using this framework, we prove that the success probability of any bounded adversary asymptotically collapses to zero under a defense strategy combining natural absorption, a randomized scheduler, and lazy verification oracle. Empirical results demonstrate significant backdoor suppression with zero utility degradation even when invoking the verification oracle on merely 10% of the total training steps. This approach yields a provably sound and computationally efficient defense for safety-critical AI.
papers.comment: Technical Report, CEA-LIST. 15 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在分布式训练中，模型所有者将训练委托给外部计算提供者时面临的后门攻击威胁。提出了一种结合自然吸收、随机调度和惰性验证的防御策略，通过离散时间马尔可夫链建模证明有界对手的成功概率渐近为零，在仅验证10%的训练步骤时实现零效用损失的后门抑制。
Motivation: 后门攻击严重威胁大规模AI模型，而传统检测需要完整重计算训练步骤，开销过高，与模型所有者的资源限制矛盾。
Method: 将后门注入与吸收动态建模为离散时间马尔可夫链（DTMC），提出结合自然吸收、随机调度器和惰性验证的防御策略，量化最小审计开销以概率界限制攻击成功率。
Result: 经验表明，即使在仅10%的训练步骤上调用验证，也能显著抑制后门且零效用损失。
Conclusion: 该方法为安全关键型AI提供了可证明可靠且计算高效的防御。

papers.title: The Approximation Ratio for the Risk of Myopic Bayesian Active Learning for Linear Regression
papers.abstract_en: Active learning studies the fundamental question: what data should we choose to observe? The greedy algorithm in optimal experiment design is a common heuristic and also equivalent to myopic Bayesian active learning for linear regression, the common framework where long-term planning is replaced with the one-step optimal choice. In this work, we prove a first-of-its-kind approximation ratio for the greedy algorithm's risk that is tight up to an absolute constant. The approximation ratio is linear in the maximum initial leverage score (MILS), a newly identified quantity fundamental to the greedy algorithm's performance. Finally, we illustrate the results with simple numerical simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了在线性回归中，我的贝叶斯主动学习（myopic Bayesian active learning）的贪心算法（即最优实验设计中的贪婪策略）的风险近似比。该近似比与最大初始杠杆分数（maximum initial leverage score, MILS）呈线性关系，并且紧到绝对常数。通过数值模拟验证了理论结果。
Motivation: 主动学习中贪心算法是常用启发式，但其风险的理论保证一直缺乏，尤其是近似比未知。
Method: 分析贪心算法在最优实验设计中的风险，识别出最大初始杠杆分数（MILS）作为关键量，并证明近似比与其线性相关且紧。
Result: 首次证明了贪心算法风险的紧近似比（至多一个绝对常数），该比值线性依赖于MILS。
Conclusion: 贪心算法的风险性能由MILS决定，提供了理论保障。

papers.title: Healthier LLMs: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Public Health Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) achieve promising results on medical question answering benchmarks, yet their use in public health is constrained by hallucinations and the rapid evolution of official guidance. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates these risks by grounding responses in an explicitly maintained corpus, but end-to-end performance depends critically on retrieval configuration and on evaluation beyond multiple-choice formats. We extend PubHealthBench, a question answering (QA) benchmark of 7,929 questions derived from UK Government public health guidance, into a retrieval-augmented setting and systematically evaluate retrieval and generation choices. We compare dense, sparse, and hybrid retrieval across multiple embedding models and corpus variants, and show that hybrid retrieval consistently improves recall and ranking quality, with chunk length and topic interacting with ranking performance. Providing retrieved context substantially increases multiple-choice accuracy across a diverse set of LLMs, enabling smaller open-weight models to match or outperform larger models used without retrieval, with gains primarily driven by retrieval quality and careful context selection. To assess realistic free-form answering, we introduce a rubric-based LLM-as-a-judge covering faithfulness, completeness, clarity, and factual consistency, and validate it against dual human annotations. Judge-human agreement is strongest for faithfulness and completeness, while factual consistency and clarity are less reliably reproduced, motivating caution when interpreting those dimensions at scale. Overall, our results highlight retrieval as a primary lever for reliable public health QA and provide practical guidance for building and evaluating RAG systems grounded in official guidance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了检索增强生成（RAG）在公共卫生问答中的应用，通过扩展PubHealthBench基准并系统评估检索和生成配置，发现混合检索能显著提升召回率和排序质量，并且提供检索上下文能大幅提高多选准确性，使小型开源模型超越无检索的大型模型。同时引入基于评分规则的LLM评判器评估自由形式答案，验证了其与人工标注的一致性。
Motivation: 大语言模型在医疗问答中虽有前景，但在公共卫生领域受限于幻觉和官方指南的快速演变，而RAG通过基于明确语料库的响应可以缓解这些问题，但端到端性能严重依赖检索配置和超越选择题的评估方式。
Method: 将PubHealthBench基准扩展到检索增强设置，比较稠密、稀疏和混合检索在多种嵌入模型和语料变体上的表现，并引入基于评分规则的LLM评判器评估自由形式答案的忠实性、完整性、清晰度和事实一致性。
Result: 混合检索一致提升召回率和排序质量，块长度和主题与排序性能相关；提供检索上下文大幅提高多选准确性，使小型开源模型能匹配或超越无检索的大型模型；LLM评判器与人工标注在忠实性和完整性上一致性最强，而在事实一致性和清晰度上可靠性较低。

papers.title: The Rank-One Corner: How Much Value Equivalence Does a Task Need from a World Model?
papers.abstract_en: A learned world model is usually judged by how faithfully it reconstructs its observations or predicts reward, as though quality were something the model simply has or lacks. But what a task actually needs from a model is narrower: the few predictive coordinates its queries depend on, which we call the closure. We show that how much of that closure a latent comes to represent is set not by the model's capacity or its observations but by the dimensionality of the objective it is trained against, and we measure this directly on a DreamerV3 stack in a controlled environment with known ground-truth closure. An aligned scalar value signal -- the objective at the heart of value equivalence -- installs only a one-dimensional projection of a closure that needs several dimensions: read through a single linear probe, the recoverable structure rises from R^2=0.10 to 0.76 as the scalar is replaced by the full objective. Sweeping the objective's dimensionality from one to four installs exactly that many predictive directions through an auxiliary head, and the same staircase appears -- at attenuated magnitude but the same rank -- through the model's own value head, so the dissociation is dimensional rather than an artifact of head form. Capacity-matched comparisons and in-situ pressure checks rule out the obvious alternatives. The law governs a regime, and we measure its boundary: on a companion closed-loop task whose structure is observable frame by frame, reconstruction installs that structure and the scalar objective suffices -- the objective decides what a latent represents exactly where cheaper training signals cannot already recover it. Value equivalence is thus not all-or-nothing but dimensional: the familiar single-reward objective is its rank-one corner, and a model installs as much of a task's structure as the objective it is asked to predict.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究世界模型在任务中实际需要的预测坐标（称为闭包）与模型学习到的潜在表征之间的关系。通过DreamerV3在已知真实闭包的控制环境中实验，发现模型学到的闭包结构取决于训练目标函数的维度，而非模型容量或观测数据。标量奖励信号只安装一维投影，而高维目标能安装更多预测方向，价值等价性本质上是维度性的。
Motivation: 现有方法通常用重建质量或预测奖励来评判世界模型，但任务实际需要的只是少数预测坐标（闭包）。论文旨在探究模型能学到多少闭包结构的关键因素，以及价值等价性是否真的是一个全有或全无的属性。
Method: 使用DreamerV3架构，在具有已知真实闭包的受控环境中，通过改变训练目标的维度（从标量到四维），测量模型线性探针和自身价值头中恢复出的闭包结构量（R^2），并与容量匹配的基线进行比较。
Result: 标量价值信号只安装一维投影（R^2从0.10到0.76）；目标维度从1增加到4时，辅助头中恰好安装相同数量的预测方向，价值头中也出现相同阶梯模式但幅度减弱。容量匹配和原位压力检验排除了其他解释。
Conclusion: 价值等价性不是全有或全无，而是维度性的：常见的单奖励目标只对应秩一角，模型仅能安装任务结构中被要求预测的那部分。

papers.title: At-Grok Is Not Converged:A Measurement-Validity Audit for Grokking Representation Metrics
papers.abstract_en: On modular arithmetic, a network's embedding keeps compressing for tens of thousands of steps after it has already generalized. Reading effective rank at the grokking transition overstates the converged value by 3-5x on an MLP, and by 1.3-1.5x on a transformer trained to convergence; on the MLP it also erases which cells compress at all. Compression lags the accuracy transition by an amount on the order of the time-to-grok, at least 10,000 steps, rather than coinciding with it. A one-variable ablation shows what sets the lag size: adding LayerNorm to an otherwise identical transformer moves the fraction of compression done by the grok step from 0.87 to 0.25, and a pre-registered control rules out scale invariance as the mechanism. We package this as an audit that separates onset from compression, flags censoring, excludes boundary cells that never fully generalize, and checks that the reference floor has plateaued, with an adversarial suite that caught a false-confidence bug in our own branch. A secondary, MLP-specific depth law linking norm budget to converged floor fails a generality test on a transformer and flips sign under free weight decay. Code and the toolkit are released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计了神经网络在模算术任务中grokk现象（突然泛化）的表示度量问题。发现嵌入的压缩在泛化后仍持续数万步，有效秩在grokk时刻高估收敛值3-5倍（MLP）或1.3-1.5倍（Transformer），且压缩滞后精度转变至少10000步。添加LayerNorm可将grokk步的压缩比例从0.87降至0.25。作者提供了一个审计工具包，用于分离压缩起始时间、标记截断、排除边界细胞，并附带对抗测试集。
Motivation: 现有grokk表示度量（如有效秩）在泛化过渡时刻读取时存在系统性偏差，导致对网络表示收敛状态的误判，需要更可靠的审计方法。
Method: 提出一个审计流程，包括分离压缩起始与泛化时间、标记右删失数据、排除未完全泛化的边界细胞、检查参考基线的平稳性，并构建对抗测试集。
Result: 在MLP上，有效秩在grokk时刻高估收敛值3-5倍，在Transformer上为1.3-1.5倍；压缩滞后精度转变至少10000步；LayerNorm将grokk步的压缩比例从0.87降至0.25。
Conclusion: 该审计工具能更准确地评估神经网络的表示压缩动态，并揭示LayerNorm等组件对压缩时间线的影响。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: UASPL: Uncertainty-Aware Self-Paced Learning with Evidential Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Self-paced learning (SPL) is an effective learning paradigm that simulates the human learning process by progressing from easy to difficult samples based on the value of the loss function during the learning process. It has shown great potential in improving model performance and training efficiency. However, the prediction results of samples with smaller loss values are not necessarily reliable, indicating that such samples are not always simple samples for the model. Hence, this article proposes an uncertainty-aware self-paced learning based on evidential neural networks, termed UASPL, which integrates predictive reliability into sample selection through a general loss function within the Subjective Logic framework. This loss function incorporates uncertainty estimation and can be extended to different variants of SPL. Moreover, this loss function couples a sample selection preference, thereby ensuring the interpretability of the sample selection process. Finally, the experimental results on multiple datasets show that UASPL outperforms other SPL methods in terms of classification performance, interpretability, and generality. The source code is available at: https://github.com/treelife979/UASPL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于证据神经网络的不确定性感知自步学习（UASPL），通过主观逻辑框架下的通用损失函数将预测可靠性融入样本选择，提高了分类性能、可解释性和通用性。
Motivation: 传统自步学习仅依赖损失值大小判断样本难易，但小损失样本的预测结果未必可靠，缺乏对不确定性的考量。
Method: 将证据神经网络中的不确定性估计集成到自步学习的损失函数中，在主观逻辑框架下构建通用损失函数，耦合样本选择偏好。
Result: 在多个数据集上，UASPL在分类性能、可解释性和通用性上优于其他自步学习方法。
Conclusion: 该方法通过不确定性感知提升了自步学习的样本选择可靠性，并具有良好的可扩展性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Optimized Instance Alteration for Explaining and Assessing Robustness of Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we propose a unified approach for diagnosing misclassification and assessing the robustness of black-box classifiers. Central to our method is an optimization framework that modifies an instance so that the classifier predicts a specified target label, while ensuring that the modification remains easily explainable. The objective function contains two components: an explainability-aware $L_0$ (XA-$L_0$) penalty that promotes sparse and interpretable modifications, and a classifier loss objective that steers the perturbed instance toward the desired output. This integrated optimization formulation is used both to identify the underlying causes of misclassification and to evaluate robustness by determining how an instance can change within a tolerance region before being reassigned to another class. To quantify robustness, we introduce the Tolerance Region Confusion Matrix (TOR-Confusion Matrix), which measures a classifier's susceptibility by modeling the class-to-class transition probabilities induced by tolerance-bounded perturbations. We validate the proposed method on both image and tabular datasets, demonstrating its ability to jointly deliver interpretability and robustness assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一优化框架，通过修改实例使黑盒分类器预测指定标签，同时利用XA-L0惩罚保证修改稀疏可解释。该方法用于诊断误分类原因，并引入TOR-Confusion Matrix量化分类器对扰动的鲁棒性。在图像和表格数据上验证了其可解释性与鲁棒性评估能力。
Motivation: 现有方法缺乏统一框架同时解释分类器误分类原因和评估其对扰动的鲁棒性，且难以保证修改的可解释性。
Method: 构建优化目标，包含可解释性感知的L0稀疏惩罚（XA-L0）和分类器损失，通过修改实例实现标签转换。提出Tolerance Region Confusion Matrix (TOR-Confusion Matrix) 基于容忍域扰动建模类间转移概率以衡量鲁棒性。
Result: 在图像和表格数据集上实验，表明该方法能同时提供可解释的修改原因和鲁棒性评估，验证了联合框架的有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法统一了误分类解释与鲁棒性评估，并利用稀疏修改保证可解释性。

papers.title: Specification Grounding Drives Test Effectiveness for LLM Code
papers.abstract_en: Large language models frequently generate code that appears correct on typical inputs yet fails on edge cases, invalid inputs, and other specification-defined corner conditions. A popular fix has the model write its own tests and repair until they pass, but the source of the gain is unclear: does it come from the tests merely existing, or from their grounding in a specification of what the code should do? We isolate this factor. Holding the tester, test budget, and repair loop fixed, we change a single prompt line that controls whether the tester receives the spec as a checklist of rules. The baseline is strong: it is already told to probe invalid inputs and edge cases. Grounding the tests in the spec produces correct code +38 percentage points more often than this baseline across three Claude tiers (Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.8), and +36 points on a held-out set. Grounding, not test quantity, is the primary driver: doubling the test budget barely helps, and combining eight independent ungrounded suites plateaus far below grounding. An ablation isolates the spec's content, not its format: given the spec as a plain paragraph the tester recovers 27 of 30 bugs, but asked to plan tests without the spec it recovers only 2 of 30. The effect survives stronger baselines: a property-based generator catches 28 of 30 bugs but invents out-of-spec requirements, and an AlphaCodium-style loop only matches the baseline. It replicates across vendors (GPT-5.3-codex +28, Gemini 3.5 Flash +19), with a task-level sign test over 18 tasks significant at p=0.002. Grounding improves both sensitivity and precision: it catches more real bugs and wrongly rejects far less correct code, cutting the false-alarm rate from 33% (68% against a Python standard-library oracle) to 0%. On well-specified algorithmic problems it neither helps nor hurts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过控制实验探究了LLM代码生成中测试有效性的驱动因素，发现将测试与规范（specification）对齐（grounding）是提升代码正确性的关键，而非测试数量。在多个Claude模型上，基于规范的测试生成比强基线（已提示探索边界情况）正确率提升38个百分点，且假阳性率从33%降至0%。
Motivation: 现有方法让LLM自行编写测试并修复代码，但提升来源不明：是测试存在本身，还是测试与代码规范对齐？本文希望隔离这一因素，明确规范对齐对测试有效性的影响。
Method: 保持测试器、测试预算和修复循环不变，仅改变一行提示词，控制测试器是否接收规范作为规则清单。比较基线（已提示探测无效输入和边界情况）与规范对齐条件下的测试效果。
Result: 规范对齐使正确代码生成率比基线高38个百分点（三个Claude模型），在保留集上高36个百分点。加倍测试预算效果甚微，组合八个无规范测试套件远低于规范对齐。消融实验表明规范内容而非格式是关键：规范作为纯文本段落可恢复27/30个bug，而无规范时仅恢复2/30。在GPT-5.3-codex和Gemini 3.5 Flash上分别提升28和19个百分点。规范对齐同时提高敏感性和精确度，假阳性率从33%降至0%。对于明确规范的算法问题无帮助。
Conclusion: 规范对齐是驱动LLM生成测试有效性的主要因素，而非测试数量或多样化。该方法在多种模型和任务上有效，但对于已良好规范的问题无增益。

summary_sections.method: 保持测试器、测试预算和修复循环不变，仅改变一行提示词，控制测试器是否接收规范作为规则清单。比较基线（已提示探测无效输入和边界情况）与规范对齐条件下的测试效果。
summary_sections.result: 规范对齐使正确代码生成率比基线高38个百分点（三个Claude模型），在保留集上高36个百分点。加倍测试预算效果甚微，组合八个无规范测试套件远低于规范对齐。消融实验表明规范内容而非格式是关键：规范作为纯文本段落可恢复27/30个bug，而无规范时仅恢复2/30。在GPT-5.3-codex和Gemini 3.5 Flash上分别提升28和19个百分点。规范对齐同时提高敏感性和精确度，假阳性率从33%降至0%。对于明确规范的算法问题无帮助。
summary_sections.conclusion: 规范对齐是驱动LLM生成测试有效性的主要因素，而非测试数量或多样化。该方法在多种模型和任务上有效，但对于已良好规范的问题无增益。

papers.title: When Do Geometric Algebra Layers Beat Scalarization? A Controlled Study on SO(3)-Equivariant Vector Laws
papers.abstract_en: Compact networks built from Clifford algebra Cl(3,0) primitives are exactly SO(3)-equivariant and learn synthetic 3D vector laws from few samples. We ask whether the geometric algebra structure itself contributes anything beyond exact equivariance. We compare against a minimal scalarization baseline: invariant dot products fed to a small MLP that outputs coefficients on the equivariant basis {v_i, v_i x v_j}, which is also exactly equivariant. On single-stage laws (rotation by axis-angle, cross product, central force), scalarization matches or beats the Cl(3,0) network at a fraction of the training cost, so the geometric algebra adds nothing there. On compositional targets whose computation graph nests group operations (apply R2 R1 to a point; map a local force through an orientation, then take a torque), the Cl(3,0) network beats scalarization by an order of magnitude in the low-data regime, reaching with 100 samples what the baseline needs 3000 for, and the gap survives strengthening the baseline with the triple-product invariant and 17x more parameters, external Vector Neurons and e3nn baselines, and a multiplicative coefficient network. Ablations show the required network depth tracks the rotation chain length, and scalarization falls below the constant predictor on chains of four rotations. The advantage is not composition per se: on a rotation-free nested cross product, which flattens into polynomial invariant coefficients, scalarization wins by 24x. No tested model, equivariant or not, extrapolates invariant magnitudes: on radius and separation shifts every model is worse than a constant predictor once errors are normalized. We conclude that geometric algebra layers are not a general shortcut for low-data 3D learning, but become useful precisely when the target composes group elements in depth.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/infinition/ga-vs-scalarization
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验比较了基于Clifford代数 Cl(3,0) 的几何代数层与最小标量化基线在SO(3)-等变向量定律学习中的表现。实验表明，对于单阶段定律，标量化匹配或超越了几何代数网络，且训练成本更低；但在深度嵌套群操作（如旋转链）的低数据场景下，几何代数层以100个样本达到基线需要3000个样本的性能，优势显著。消除实验显示，几何代数层的优势源于其对组成群元素深度操作的能力，而非一般性的低数据学习捷径。
Motivation: 现有工作表明紧凑的Clifford代数网络具有精确SO(3)-等变性，但尚不清楚这种等变性是否完全来自几何代数结构本身，抑或仅来自精确等变性。本文旨在分离几何代数层与等变性本身的贡献，探究何时几何代数层真正优于简单的标量化方法。
Method: 构建最小标量化基线：使用不变点积输入MLP，输出等变基 {v_i, v_i × v_j} 上的系数，实现精确等变。对比几何代数 Cl(3,0) 网络，在单阶段定律（轴角旋转、叉积、中心力）和组合目标（嵌套群操作、旋转链等）上系统比较性能和数据效率。
Result: 在单阶段定律上标量化匹配或胜出，训练成本更低；在深度嵌套群操作的低数据场景下，几何代数网络用100样本达到基线3000样本的效果，且即使加强基线（添加三乘积不变量、17倍参数、外部Vector Neurons/e3nn基线等），差距依然存在。消融显示所需网络深度与旋转链长度相关，标量化在四旋转链上低于常数预测器。在无旋转嵌套叉积上，标量化反而领先24倍。所有模型在不变幅度外推上均失败。
Conclusion: 几何代数层并非低数据3D学习的通用捷径，只有在目标涉及深度组合群元素时才有优势。其优势来源于对群操作组合的建模能力，而非单纯的等变性或数据效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ProMoE-FL: Prototype-conditioned Mixture of Experts for Multimodal Federated Learning with Missing Modalities
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we address the problem of multimodal federated learning with missing modality. Existing methods utilize an additional public dataset or perform naive feature synthesis that is based solely on the available modality. To address these limitations, we propose ProMoE-FL, a Prototype-conditioned Mixture-of-Experts framework for robust missing-modality feature synthesis in multimodal federated learning. ProMoE-FL builds a global client-aware prototype bank that captures clinically meaningful modality priors across institutions. Our Mixture of Experts is conditioned on these prototypes and modality indices to enable direction-aware expert routing for dynamically synthesizing missing features. We perform extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations on four public chest X-ray datasets (MIMIC-CXR, NIH Open-I, PadChest, and CheXpert) and demonstrate that ProMoE-FL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both homogeneous as well as the more challenging heterogeneous settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态联邦学习中缺失模态的问题，提出 ProMoE-FL 框架，该框架基于原型条件混合专家（Mixture of Experts）构建全局客户端感知的原型库，利用原型和模态索引进行方向感知的专家路由，动态合成缺失模态特征。在四个公开胸部 X 光数据集（MIMIC-CXR、NIH Open-I、PadChest 和 CheXpert）上的实验表明，该方法在同质和更具挑战性的异质设置中均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法要么依赖额外的公共数据集，要么仅基于可用模态进行简单的特征合成，存在明显局限性。本文旨在解决多模态联邦学习中缺失模态的鲁棒特征合成问题。
Method: 提出 ProMoE-FL 框架，包括一个全局客户端感知的原型库，用于捕获跨机构的临床模态先验；混合专家模型（MoE）以这些原型和模态索引为条件，实现方向感知的专家路由，从而动态合成缺失的模态特征。
Result: 在四个胸部 X 光数据集上的定量和定性评估表明，ProMoE-FL 在齐次和异质联邦学习设置中均一致优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 本文提出的原型条件混合专家框架有效解决了多模态联邦学习中的缺失模态问题，在未来可进一步探索其他模态和更复杂的缺失模式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Does Demand Response Increase Vulnerability to Cyber Attacks by Adversarial Data Modifications?
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial attacks are crafted data manipulations that aim to deteriorate the outcomes of prediction or decision-making algorithms. In the energy systems literature, adversarial attacks have been studied with a focus on problems regarding the electricity grid. Such problems include forecasting and grid state estimation, where adversarial attacks are also known as false data injection attacks. Only few studies have analyzed the potential impact that adversarial attacks have on the demand side. We analyze how manipulated price forecasts impact the decision-making in industrial demand response. To this end, we design adversarial attacks that aim to deteriorate the output of electricity price forecasting models and solve scheduling optimization problems of energy-intensive production processes using the distorted price forecasts. We make use of a generalized process model to investigate the vulnerability to adversarial attacks for a range of production scheduling problems with different levels of process flexibility. We find that adversarial attacks can erode the profits gained from demand response. However, when perturbations are limited in extent (so that they are hard to detect by the human user), demand response preserves about 90\% of its financial advantage compared to steady-state process operation. Further, we find that the impact of adversarial attacks on demand response does not only depend on the magnitude of the perturbations but rather on the orientation of the adversarial perturbations. Therefore, we argue that attack analyses should explicitly incorporate the sensitivities of scheduling optimization models into the attack design to enable more rigorous assessments of decision-making under adversarial attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究对抗性数据修改如何影响工业需求响应（demand response）中的决策。通过设计针对电价预测模型的对抗性攻击，并求解考虑扭曲价格预测的能源密集型生产调度优化问题，作者发现对抗性攻击可以侵蚀需求响应带来的利润，但当扰动幅度有限（难以被人类用户察觉）时，需求响应仍能保留约 90% 相对于稳态运行的财务优势。攻击的影响不仅取决于扰动幅度，还取决于扰动的方向，因此攻击分析应显式结合调度优化模型的敏感性。
Motivation: 现有对抗性攻击研究主要关注电网侧的预测和状态估计（虚假数据注入攻击），而对需求侧受对抗性攻击影响的分析较少。本文旨在填补这一空白，探究需求响应在价格预测被操纵时的脆弱性。
Method: 设计对抗性攻击来恶化电力价格预测模型的输出，然后使用扭曲的价格预测求解能源密集型生产过程的调度优化问题。采用广义过程模型来研究不同流程灵活性水平下的生产调度问题对对抗性攻击的脆弱性。
Result: 对抗性攻击会侵蚀需求响应带来的利润，但当扰动幅度有限时，需求响应仍能保留约 90% 的财务优势。攻击的影响更依赖于扰动的方向而非幅度。
Conclusion: 攻击分析应显式纳入调度优化模型的敏感性，以便更严格地评估对抗性攻击下的决策制定。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Dynamic-in-Few-Step: Unifying Dynamic Computation and Few-Step Distillation for Efficient Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) have demonstrated superior generation quality but suffer from prohibitive computational costs. While recent few-step distillation techniques significantly accelerate inference, they typically enforce a static model architecture across all denoising stages, ignoring the varying computational demands inherent to different noise levels. In this work, we propose a novel post-training acceleration framework that exploits this redundancy by integrating dynamic structural sparsification directly into the distillation process. Unlike conventional post-hoc compression applied to a fixed diffusion pipeline, our approach jointly optimizes the denoising steps and structured model sparsity, transforming a pre-trained VDM into a compact, step-specific Mixture-of-Models (MoM). To address the training instability arising from this joint optimization, we introduce a Progressive Training Strategy coupled with an Output Rollout Mechanism, which ensures the coherent learning of structural decisions across timesteps. Furthermore, we develop a specialized inference engine to deploy the resulting MoM efficiently. Our method is orthogonal to existing acceleration techniques and highly effective: On Wan-14B, it removes 24% of the per-step FLOPs on top of 4-step distillation, adding a 1.2x wall-clock gain and reaching a 30x speedup over the 50-step teacher while preserving competitive generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频扩散模型（VDM）推理成本高的问题，提出一种后训练加速框架，将动态结构稀疏化直接集成到蒸馏过程中，将预训练VDM转化为步长特定的紧凑型混合模型（MoM）。通过渐进式训练策略和输出回滚机制解决联合优化的不稳定性，并在4步蒸馏的Wan-14B模型上减少24%的FLOP，实现1.2倍墙钟加速和相比50步教师模型30倍加速，同时保持生成质量。
Motivation: 现有少步蒸馏加速方法在所有去噪阶段使用静态模型架构，忽略了不同噪声水平下计算需求的差异，导致计算冗余。
Method: 提出联合优化去噪步数和结构化模型稀疏性的后训练加速框架，将预训练VDM转化为步长特定的混合模型（MoM），并引入渐进式训练策略和输出回滚机制保证结构化决策的连贯学习。
Result: 在Wan-14B模型上，该方法在4步蒸馏基础上额外移除24%的每步FLOP，获得1.2倍墙钟加速，相比50步教师模型实现30倍加速，生成质量具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 该方法与现有加速技术正交，能有效结合动态计算和少步蒸馏，为高效视频生成提供新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Certificates Fail: A Unified Safety Framework for Embedded Neural Interface Models
papers.abstract_en: Formal robustness certificates for embedded neural-interface models can pass while task accuracy collapses: at perturbation budget e=0.25, EEGNet classification accuracy drops by 25.7% under projected-gradient attack while the Lipschitz-style certificate remains valid for all 9 tested subjects. We argue that this gap between mathematical certification and operational safety is one instance of a broader alignment failure in neural interfaces, where training objectives diverge from user welfare. We propose a unified empirical audit framework organized around three such failures: verification insufficiency, in which certificates pass while task behavior degrades; proxy-fidelity divergence, in which task-optimized representations damage neural signal structure (a time-domain auxiliary objective reduces reconstruction MSE by 0.1132 while worsening spectral log-MSE); and latent information exfiltration, in which public-task embeddings retain private attributes (subject identity recoverable at 48.1% versus 6.7% chance). We instantiate the framework on BCI Competition IV 2a and SEED-IV using multiple deep and classical EEG decoders, official session-level validation, null controls, and paired statistical tests. The verification gap persists across EEGNet, CSP+LDA, and FBCSP+LDA, and is therefore architecture-independent. Our results establish that operational safety auditing, not certificate verification alone, is necessary for responsible neural-interface deployment.

TL;DR: 本文指出嵌入式神经接口模型的正式鲁棒性证书在任务精度崩溃时仍然有效，例如EEGNet在扰动预算0.25下分类准确率下降25.7%，而Lipschitz证书仍成立。作者提出统一的安全审计框架，涵盖验证不足、代理-保真度分歧和潜在信息泄露三类失效，并在BCI Competition IV 2a和SEED-IV数据集上验证了架构无关的验证差距。
Motivation: 现有的形式化鲁棒性证书与操作安全之间存在差距，任务性能恶化时证书仍可能通过，这可能导致神经接口部署中的安全风险。
Method: 提出一个统一的实证审计框架，围绕三类安全失效：验证不足（证书通过但任务行为退化）、代理-保真度分歧（任务优化表示损害神经信号结构）、潜在信息泄露（公共任务嵌入保留私有属性），并在多个解码器上使用统计检验进行验证。
Result: 摘要报告EEGNet在扰动预算0.25下分类准确率下降25.7%但Lipschitz证书仍有效；时间域辅助目标降低重建MSE 0.1132但恶化频谱log-MSE；主题身份可恢复率达48.1%（对比随机6.7%）。验证差距在EEGNet、CSP+LDA和FBCSP+LDA中均存在。
Conclusion: 仅靠证书验证不足以确保神经接口的安全部署，需要操作安全审计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: STST-JEPA: Shallow-Target Spatio-Temporal Joint Embedding Prediction Architecture For EEG Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Brain age -- the age inferred from a physiological recording -- is an emerging biomarker whose deviation from chronological age tracks neurological and psychiatric burden, and EEG is an attractive substrate for it because it is cheap, portable, and temporally rich. Yet EEG brain-age models must contend with cross-site montage heterogeneity, small labelled cohorts, and dominant subject-level non-stationarity, and few EEG foundation models have been shown to deliver competitive age regression across the full pediatric-to-older-adult range in which such a biomarker would actually be deployed. We introduce STST-JEPA, a self-supervised transformer for resting-state and task EEG, pretrained on 47,703 sessions spanning ages 5-81 from the brain.space and Healthy Brain Network (HBN) corpora. The model combines a latent-prediction objective - predicting masked-token representations against an EMA-of-tokenizer target - with an auxiliary signal-reconstruction term, applied to 30-second multi-channel windows under spatiotemporal block masks. A lightweight attentive probe trained on frozen pretrained embeddings achieves a best held-out-validation mean absolute error of 3.06 years (r = 0.924) for age regression on 3,367 sessions, against a predict-the-mean baseline of approximately 10 years MAE. With light task-specific fine-tuning of the model's final layers, the same pretrained encoder achieves rank-1 placements - with the model's native 30-second windows - on the public NeuralBench x brain.space EEG leaderboard for sex classification (balanced accuracy 0.911), age prediction (r = 0.749), and psychopathology composite regression (r = 0.215). We further show that the model's age-prediction residual is negatively correlated with cognitive efficiency over several tasks we examined.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出STST-JEPA，一种自监督变压器模型，用于静息态和任务态EEG的脑龄预测。模型在47703个会话（年龄5-81岁）上预训练，结合潜在预测和信号重建目标。在3367个会话上达到3.06年MAE（r=0.924）的最佳验证性能，并在NeuralBench EEG排行榜上获得多项任务的排名第一。
Motivation: EEG脑龄模型面临跨站点导联异质性、小标注样本和主体级非平稳性等挑战，且现有EEG基础模型在完整年龄范围内的年龄回归表现有限。
Method: 提出浅层目标时空联合嵌入预测架构（STST-JEPA），使用自监督变压器，预训练目标包括掩码令牌表示预测（针对EMA分词器目标）和辅助信号重建，应用于30秒多通道窗口下的时空块掩码。
Result: 在3367个会话上年龄回归最佳验证MAE为3.06年（r=0.924），远超均值预测基线（约10年MAE）。轻量微调后在NeuralBench EEG排行榜上获得性别分类（平衡准确率0.911）、年龄预测（r=0.749）和精神病理学复合回归（r=0.215）的排名第一。年龄预测残差与认知效率呈负相关。
Conclusion: STST-JEPA在EEG脑龄预测和多项下游任务上表现优异，展示了自监督学习在EEG领域的潜力，但研究局限可能包括对跨站点泛化能力的进一步验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cross-Trajectory Chimera Interventions Reveal Dissociable Roles of Weight Magnitude and Direction in Grokking
papers.abstract_en: Which properties of a partially trained network are causally portable to a different, independently trained network? Single-trajectory interventions show necessity within one run, not portability across runs. We introduce cross-trajectory chimera interventions: given two runs from different seeds, we split each weight vector into a norm and a unit direction, recombine one run's norm with the other's direction, and continue training. On two modular-arithmetic tasks that grok, the components dissociate. Direction carries a transferable, donor-specific circuit identity: implanting a donor's direction at the recipient's norm drives the run to the donor's circuit in 40/40 cases, while an angle-matched random control yields no shift. The transfer is threshold-like, and its location is predicted by the recipient's norm, separating perfectly by norm class over all 20 pairs (joint permutation probability 1.9e-4). Norm carries only a modest, distributed delay effect and no identity signal. An adaptive bisection procedure localizes the threshold to +/-1/64. Direction indexes which solution a trajectory approaches; norm governs how susceptible that identity is to being overwritten.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出跨轨迹嵌合体干预方法，将两个不同随机种子的训练轨迹的权重向量拆分为范数和方向，重组后继续训练。在两类模算术任务（grokking现象）上，方向携带可迁移的、供体特定的电路身份（40/40案例切换到供体电路），而角度匹配的随机对照无变化；范数仅产生微弱的分布式延迟效应，无身份信号。
Motivation: 现有单轨迹干预只能证明同一运行内的必要性，无法检验不同运行间的因果可移植性。需要一种方法探究部分训练网络的哪些属性可以因果性地转移到另一个独立训练的网络。
Method: 跨轨迹嵌合体干预：取两个不同种子的部分训练权重，将一个的范数与另一个的方向重新组合，继续训练直到收敛，观察电路迁移情况。
Result: 在模算术任务上，方向转移导致供体电路身份完全迁移（40/40），阈值位置由受体范数完美预测（20对组合排列概率1.9e-4），阈值定位精度±1/64；范数仅有延迟效应，无身份信号。
Conclusion: 方向索引轨迹趋近的特定解，范数控制该身份被覆盖的易感性。该方法揭示了权重幅度和方向在grokking中的可分离作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reward Valuation in Vision Language Models: Causal Mechanisms Underlying Anhedonia
papers.abstract_en: Recent Vision-Language Models capture increasingly complex aspects of human cognition. Here we ask whether this alignment extends to reward valuation, which we assess in a mechanistic framework built on clinical tests that were developed to evaluate anhedonia and motivational deficits in major depressive disorder. In the brain, anhedonia is frequently linked to dysregulation in the Nucleus Accumbens (NAc) and the broader dopaminergic reward system. While neuroimaging has localized these deficits, establishing a causal link between NAc activity and specific behavioral symptoms remains a challenge. We use these ideas from neuroscience to functionally identify reward-anticipatory units in vision language models, and test their causal role via targeted perturbations. Perturbing NAc-selective units induces behavioral effects that mirror human anhedonia: the model shifts toward low-effort, low-reward options in effort-based decision-making tasks. Crucially, our results reflect a specific deficit in reward valuation and anticipation rather than a loss of task capability: the perturbed model maintains baseline performance when reward-based choice is removed. This induced vulnerability further aligns with clinical anhedonia and motivation scales, including DARS and MAP-SR. Taken together, these results reveal reward valuation circuits in AI models that parallel those in humans.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文借用临床快感缺乏（anhedonia）测试的框架，在视觉语言模型（VLM）中识别出类似人类伏隔核（NAc）功能的奖励预期单元。通过定向扰动这些单元，模型在努力型决策任务中转向低努力、低奖励选项，且不影响非奖励任务的表现，揭示了VLM中与人类平行的奖励估值因果机制。
Motivation: 现有研究关注VLM与人类认知的对齐，但尚未从因果机制层面考察奖励估值这一核心情感维度。临床快感缺乏的神经机制（NAc和多巴胺系统）难以建立因果联系，本文利用AI模型的可干预性来弥补这一缺口。
Method: 基于临床测试（effort-based decision-making）设计行为范式，在VLM中通过激活模式分析定位对奖励预期敏感的单元（NAc-selective units），然后对这些单元进行定向扰动（perturbation），观察行为变化。
Result: 扰动NAc-selective单元后，模型在决策任务中偏好低努力-低奖励选项，而在移除奖励选项后基线能力不受影响。该效应与临床快感缺乏量表（DARS, MAP-SR）得分一致。
Conclusion: VLM中存在与人类奖励估值回路功能平行的因果单元，扰动可复现人类快感缺乏的核心症状，为认知科学和AI可解释性提供交叉验证框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Open-Ended Scenario Reasoning for Specialist Model Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Process industries have accumulated validated specialist models, yet sensor drift, feedstock variation, and regime switching cause these models to degrade systematically in new scenarios. Collecting new labeled data and retraining is costly, while continuing with the original model incurs persistent bias. Existing adaptation methods require modifying model parameters with sufficient labeled data, making rapid response on deployed systems difficult. Using LLMs as direct predictors risks hallucinations and uncontrollable outputs. Such predictors also cannot incorporate unstructured scenario knowledge from the field. To address these limitations, this article proposes Reasoning-Driven Open Adaptation for Specialist Models (ROAM), a framework that uses LLM world knowledge and reasoning to adapt frozen specialist models to unseen scenarios without retraining. ROAM confines all corrections to a low-dimensional, semantically interpretable latent space. LLM-generated scenario judgments and online observations are fused under a unified probabilistic framework. A risk-constrained mechanism suppresses corrections under unreliable LLM evidence or abrupt scenario shifts and falls back to the original frozen model when evidence is insufficient. Experiments on a mineral thickening process and the public IndPenSim penicillin fermentation dataset show that ROAM reduces MAE by over 20\% in major shift settings such as hidden shifts with only 839 additional parameters and under 0.02\,ms per-step overhead. These results indicate that LLM reasoning can be turned into a conservative adaptation signal for industrial models already in service.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ROAM框架，利用LLM的世界知识和推理能力，在不重新训练的情况下，将冻结的专业模型适应到新场景。ROAM在低维可解释的潜在空间中进行修正，融合LLM判断和在线观测，并通过风险约束机制在不可靠时回退到原始模型。在矿物增稠过程和IndPenSim青霉素发酵数据集上，MAE降低超过20%，仅增加839个参数，每步开销低于0.02ms。
Motivation: 传感器漂移、原料变化和工况切换导致已验证的专业模型在新场景中系统性退化。现有自适应方法需要大量标记数据和重新训练，而直接使用LLM作为预测器存在幻觉和输出不可控的风险，且无法融入非结构化的现场知识。
Method: 提出ROAM框架，通过LLM生成场景判断并与在线观测融合，在低维语义可解释的潜在空间中对冻结的专业模型输出进行修正。采用统一概率框架融合信息，并引入风险约束机制，在LLM证据不足或场景剧变时抑制修正，回退到原始模型。
Result: 在矿物增稠过程和IndPenSim青霉素发酵数据集上，面对隐藏移位等主要偏移，MAE降低超过20%，仅增加839个参数，每步附加开销小于0.02ms。
Conclusion: LLM的推理能力可以被转化为一种保守的自适应信号，用于调整已在服役中的工业模型，而无需修改模型参数或重新训练。

papers.title: AgentLens: Production-Assessed Trajectory Reviews for Coding Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: We present AgentLens, a production-assessed benchmark for interactive code agents. Most code-agent benchmarks reduce a run to a single bit -- did the task pass? -- but the people who actually use these agents experience the entire trajectory: how the agent follows instructions, uses its tools, verifies its own work, recovers from mistakes, and talks to them along the way. AgentLens evaluates that whole trajectory. It pairs formal verification, where an objective check exists, with LLM-written trajectory reviews and side-by-side comparisons, so that each run yields a readable explanation of why the score is what it is. This makes AgentLens useful for more than ranking models: we use it to diagnose model behavior, compare successive versions of our own agent, and catch product regressions in a nightly evaluation pipeline. We release the benchmark as open source at https://github.com/agent-lens/agent-lens-bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentLens，一个面向交互式代码智能体的生产环境评估基准。与仅输出通过/失败的传统基准不同，AgentLens 评估智能体的完整轨迹，包括指令遵循、工具使用、自我验证、错误恢复和交互过程。它结合形式验证（存在客观检查时）与 LLM 生成的轨迹评语和并排比较，为每次运行提供可读的分数解释。该基准不仅用于模型排名，还可用于诊断行为、比较版本以及检测产品回归。
Motivation: 现有代码智能体基准通常将一次运行简化为一个二进制结果（是否通过），但实际用户关注的是整个交互轨迹：智能体如何遵循指令、使用工具、验证工作、从错误中恢复以及与人对话。
Method: AgentLens 采用双管齐下的评估方式：对于存在客观检查的任务使用形式验证，同时利用 LLM 生成轨迹评语和并排比较，从而为每次运行输出可解释的评分理由。
Result: 论文报告 AgentLens 不仅能用于模型排名，还能有效诊断模型行为、比较同一智能体的不同版本，并在夜间评估管线中捕获产品回归。
Conclusion: AgentLens 以开源形式发布，旨在提供比传统通过/失败指标更丰富的代码智能体评估。

papers.title: LLM-Guided Task-Semantic Field Factorization for Industrial Process Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Process industries rely on time-series forecasting and soft sensing to estimate quality variables that are hard to measure online. Labeled data are scarce, operating regimes change frequently, and retraining models or rebuilding alignment pipelines for each scenario is costly. Such settings often provide variable tables and process documents that record variable names, units, physical meanings, and process roles. However, standard time-series backbones usually treat inputs as anonymous numerical columns. Existing text-enhanced methods also rarely make the semantic-logical relations between input variables and the prediction target available to the model within each numerical window. To address this problem, this article proposes Task-Semantic Field Factorization (TSF), a large language model (LLM)-guided framework. TSF builds a task-semantic field from task protocols and variable documents before training and uses the LLM only for offline semantic construction. Online training and inference remain with conventional time-series backbones. During training and inference, the current numerical window activates variable semantics, so semantic information participates in each prediction and supports adaptation to different prediction targets and operating shifts. On multiple complex industrial forecasting and soft-sensing tasks, TSF reduces MAE by 6.4\% on average in improved settings, with the largest reduction reaching 25.5\%. It adds only about 1.8--3.0k parameters, with less than 0.008 ms/step of additional online inference overhead. These results show that TSF turns existing process documents into measurable forecasting gains across backbones and semantic generators while remaining lightweight for deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工业过程中时间序列预测和软测量中标签稀缺、操作工况频繁变化的问题，提出任务语义场分解 (TSF) 框架。该框架利用大语言模型离线构建任务语义场，在线预测时通过数值窗口激活变量语义，使语义信息参与每个预测步骤，支持不同预测目标和工况迁移。在多个复杂工业预测任务上，TSF 平均降低 MAE 6.4%，最大降低 25.5%，仅增加约 1.8–3.0k 参数，在线推理额外开销小于 0.008 ms/步。
Motivation: 工业过程预测中标签数据稀缺、工况频繁变化，现有方法将输入视为匿名数值列，未充分利用变量语义信息，且文本增强方法未在数值窗口内建立输入变量与预测目标之间的语义逻辑关系。
Method: 提出任务语义场分解 (TSF)：在训练前利用 LLM 从任务协议和变量文档中构建任务语义场，LLM 仅用于离线语义构建；在线训练和推理仍使用传统时间序列骨干网络，通过当前数值窗口激活变量语义，使语义信息参与每次预测。
Result: 在多个复杂工业预测和软测量任务上，TSF 平均降低 MAE 6.4%，最大降低 25.5%，仅增加约 1.8–3.0k 参数，在线推理额外开销小于 0.008 ms/步。
Conclusion: TSF 能将现有过程文档转化为可量化的预测增益，适用于不同骨干网络和语义生成器，且轻量易部署。

papers.title: Creating Power Distribution Network Layouts Using Generative Adversarial Networks and Image-Based Representations
papers.abstract_en: Utilities increasingly rely on planning and operational tools to cope with the increased penetrations of distributed energy resources, yet the lack of realistic, openly available datasets remains a major barrier for benchmarking and comparison. Traditional test feeders, and recently proposed large-scale synthetic networks alleviate this issue but are typically based on heuristic rules and do not learn directly from data. This paper proposes a generative framework based on Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to create power distribution network layouts using image-based representations. The model is trained on rasterised views of distribution systems and can operate in two modes: an unconditional configuration that learns layout patterns from the training dataset, and conditional configurations that incorporate geographical context such as street maps and the spatial distribution of consumers. The methodology includes dataset preparation from Geographic Information System (GIS) sources, GAN architecture design, and the analysis of training stability and image resolution. Results from three representative cases show that the proposed approach can reproduce the topologies of low (LV), medium (MV) and high voltage (HV) feeders and align generated layouts with underlying geographical structures. At the same time, the study reveals limitations related to training stability, resolution-dependent artefacts and limits, and the absence of explicit electrical constraints. The proposed framework constitutes a data-driven complement to existing synthetic network generation methods, and could be applied to propose distribution network layouts for the electrification of new areas. This would require future extensions towards power flow, electrically validated models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对配电网布局生成中缺少数据驱动方法的问题，本文提出基于生成对抗网络（GAN）的图像表示框架。模型可无条件学习布局模式，或条件化融入街道地图与用户空间分布。在低压、中压、高压馈线案例中能复现拓扑并匹配地理结构，但暴露出训练不稳定、分辨率伪影及缺乏电气约束的局限。
Motivation: 现有配电网测试馈线和合成网络多依赖启发式规则，缺乏从真实数据中学习的能力，且公开真实数据集匮乏，阻碍了基准测试和算法比较。
Method: 提出基于GAN的图像表示生成框架：从GIS数据栅格化配电网视图作为训练数据；无条件配置学习数据集中的布局模式；条件配置融合街道地图和消费者空间分布作为地理上下文。涵盖数据集构建、GAN架构设计及训练稳定性与分辨率分析。
Result: 在三个代表性案例中，方法能生成与真实低压、中压、高压馈线拓扑一致的布局，并可与底层地理结构对齐。同时发现训练稳定性问题、分辨率相关伪影及缺少显式电气约束等局限性。
Conclusion: 本框架为现有合成网络生成方法提供了数据驱动补充，可应用于新区域电气化的布局建议，但需未来扩展至潮流计算和电气验证模型以增强实用性。

papers.title: Fingerprint, Not Blueprint: How Positional Schemes Set the Default Spectral Algebra of Attention
authors: Li Hengyu (Institute for Solid State Physics
papers.abstract_en: The pre-softmax score of an attention head is a bilinear form $score(i,j) = x_i^T M x_j$ in a learned operator $M = W_q^T W_k$. Because M is generally non-symmetric, hence non-normal, it has a complex eigenspectrum and non-orthogonal eigenvectors, the regime where non-Hermitian and random-matrix tools apply. We ask what this spectrum encodes, at three levels for previous-token and induction circuits. Statically, across seven pretrained models spanning three positional schemes, the strongest previous-token heads are spectrally rotational under RoPE and non-rotational, or content-like, where position enters outside QK (learned-absolute and ALiBi); the model-level separation is perfect at every top-k examined (exact permutation $p=0.029$), and zeroing the per-frequency RoPE phase $Im(M_t)$ eliminates induction on a pre-identified previous-token head in all three RoPE models. Dynamically, over public Pythia checkpoints every head originates at the random-matrix (Ginibre) null; the rotational signature emerges with the behavior, not before it, and the population-median suppression that yields the final profile follows circuit formation, so the profile is a consolidated fingerprint, not a precursor. Causally, and at toy scale, no spectral channel is necessary: constrained two-layer training reroutes around every ban with capability intact, albeit at a significant formation delay (four pre-registered contrasts, $q_BH <= 0.016$). The cost structure exposes each scheme's default: imposing symmetry slows learned-absolute models by a factor of 2.9, whereas a RoPE head with a fully symmetric static M still routes directionally via the phase channel, impossible under absolute positions. Within the settings examined, the positional scheme sets the default spectral algebra of an attention head's solution: a fingerprint sculpted after function, not a hard constraint upon it.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/HengyuLi-Ozaki-lab/qk-spectral-fingerprint
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究注意力头中 pre-softmax 分数矩阵 M = W_q^T W_k 的谱性质，探讨位置编码方案（RoPE、learned-absolute、ALiBi）如何影响谱特征。静态分析显示 RoPE 下前词头呈现旋转谱，而其他方案非旋转；动态分析表明谱剖面是功能后的指纹而非先验蓝图；因果实验发现无单一谱通道是必要的，但约束会延迟形成。位置方案设定了注意力头解法的默认谱代数。
Motivation: 注意力头中非对称矩阵 M 的编码内容尚不明确，特别是位置编码如何塑造其谱结构。本文旨在揭示不同位置方案下谱的统计与因果角色。
Method: 在三个层次分析：静态（7 个预训练模型上 top-k 头的谱分离）、动态（Pythia 检查点间谱与行为的时序关系）、因果（玩具两层模型约束特定谱通道后训练）。
Result: 位置方案完美分离谱类型（精确置换检验 p=0.029）；RoPE 下前词头呈旋转谱，零化相位通道消除归纳能力；动态中谱指纹随行为出现；约束任何单一谱通道仍可保留能力，但延迟显著（四项预注册对比 q_BH <= 0.016）。
Conclusion: 位置编码设定了注意力头解法的默认谱代数，谱指纹是功能后形成的印记，而非硬性约束。成本结构显示不同方案对对称性约束的韧性差异。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SpaR3D-MoE: Adaptive 3D Spatial Reasoning from Sparse Views Meets Geometry-Inductive Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle to bridge the representational gap between 2D semantic understanding and 3D spatial geometry. Existing 3D-aware models either rely on costly 3D-specific data or utilize RGB-only inputs with heuristic sampling and monolithic, shallow fusion, which respectively disrupt essential spatiotemporal connectivity and induce modality contention across diverse spatial tasks. To overcome these bottlenecks, we introduce SpaR3D-MoE, an end-to-end framework that enables adaptive spatial reasoning by equipping MLLMs with geometry-aware capabilities from only sparse RGB inputs. First, we propose an adaptive spatiotemporal manifold sampling mechanism that constructs a geometry-aware spatiotemporal graph to extract informative keyframes, effectively mitigating sequence redundancy while preserving the scene's topological connectivity. Second, we introduce the heterogeneous geometry-inductive Mixture-of-Experts driven by an instruction-pose aware router, which adaptively routes multimodal tokens to specialized experts, resolving the cross-modal contention inherent in monolithic fusion. Extensive experiments on VSI-Bench, ScanQA, and SQA3D demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, SpaR3D-MoE achieves the highest average score of 63.5 on VSI-Bench, outperforming the strongest baseline by 7.8 absolute points, alongside relative improvements of 35.4% and 51.4% in Route Plan and Relative Direction tasks, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SpaR3D-MoE，一种端到端框架，使多模态大语言模型仅从稀疏RGB输入即可进行自适应3D空间推理。关键贡献包括自适应时空流形采样机制和异构几何归纳混合专家（MoE），通过指令姿态感知路由器解决跨模态冲突。在VSI-Bench、ScanQA和SQA3D上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有MLLM在2D语义理解和3D空间几何之间存在表示鸿沟，已有工作要么依赖昂贵3D数据，要么使用启发式采样和浅层融合，破坏了时空连接并引发模态冲突。
Method: 提出自适应时空流形采样机制构建几何感知时空图以提取关键帧，并设计异构几何归纳混合专家，由指令姿态感知路由器自适应分配多模态令牌到专用专家。
Result: 在VSI-Bench上平均得分63.5，超过最强基线7.8个绝对点，在Route Plan和Relative Direction任务上分别相对提升35.4%和51.4%。在ScanQA和SQA3D上也达到SOTA。
Conclusion: 论文强调其方法在仅稀疏RGB输入下实现了高效3D空间推理，解决了多模态融合中的关键挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HiFuzz: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Semantic-Aware and Adaptive CPU Fuzzing
papers.abstract_en: Modern processor verification struggles to reach deep architectural states due to the inefficiencies of traditional mutation-based fuzzing. We propose HiFuzz, a novel hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that replaces mutation with a structured, two-layer generation process: a Program Agent for global layout and a Basic Block Agent for precise instruction filling. To overcome reward sparsity, HiFuzz integrates an adaptive coverage reward mechanism and a semantic-aware basic block encoder providing intrinsic feedback. Extensive evaluations on three real-world RISC-V cores demonstrate that HiFuzz significantly outperforms state-of-the-art fuzzers in coverage and bug detection.

TL;DR: 本文提出HiFuzz，一种层次化强化学习框架，用于处理器验证中的语义感知和自适应CPU模糊测试。它用结构化两层生成取代传统变异：程序代理负责全局布局，基本块代理负责精确指令填充。为克服奖励稀疏性，集成自适应覆盖奖励机制和语义感知基本块编码器。在三个真实RISC-V核心上的评估表明，HiFuzz在覆盖率和漏洞检测方面显著优于现有最先进模糊测试工具。
Motivation: 现代处理器验证难以达到深层架构状态，因为传统基于变异的模糊测试效率低下。
Method: 提出层次化强化学习框架HiFuzz，包含程序代理和基本块代理的两层生成过程，并集成自适应覆盖奖励机制和语义感知基本块编码器以提供内在反馈。
Result: 在三个真实RISC-V核心上，HiFuzz在覆盖率和漏洞检测方面显著优于最先进的模糊测试工具。
Conclusion: HiFuzz展示了层次化强化学习在CPU模糊测试中的潜力，可有效提升处理器验证效率。

papers.title: Overview of the NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 1: Difficulty-Aware Multilingual and Multimodal Medical Instructional Video Understanding Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Following the CMIVQA, MMI-VQA, and M4IVQA challenges in NLPCC 2023--2025, we introduce the Difficulty-Aware Medical Instructional Video Question Answering (DA-MIVQA) shared task for NLPCC 2026. DA-MIVQA extends previous multilingual and multimodal medical video benchmarks by explicitly distinguishing questions according to the type and complexity of evidence required for answering. Specifically, simple questions can often be answered from subtitle-based textual cues, whereas complex questions require visual grounding, procedural understanding, and cross-modal evidence integration. The challenge contains three tracks: Difficulty-Aware Temporal Answer Grounding in Single Video (DA-TAGSV), Difficulty-Aware Video Corpus Retrieval (DA-VCR), and Difficulty-Aware Temporal Answer Grounding in Video Corpus (DA-TAGVC). The dataset is collected from public medical instructional channels, covers diverse scenarios such as first aid, emergency response, rehabilitation, nursing, and general medical education, and is manually verified with difficulty annotations. This paper presents the task motivation, dataset construction, evaluation protocol, participation overview, competition results, and representative systems of DA-MIVQA. DA-MIVQA provides a practical benchmark for evaluating medical instructional video question answering systems under varying textual, visual, temporal, and procedural reasoning requirements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了NLPCC 2026的难度感知医疗教学视频问答共享任务（DA-MIVQA），该任务在以往多语言多模态医疗视频基准的基础上，根据回答所需证据类型显式区分简单和复杂问题。任务包含三个赛道：单视频时间答案定位（DA-TAGSV）、视频语料库检索（DA-VCR）和视频语料库时间答案定位（DA-TAGVC）。数据集来自公共医疗教学频道，涵盖急救、应急响应、康复、护理和普通医学教育等场景，并带有人工验证的难度标注。论文总结了任务动机、数据集构建、评估协议、参赛结果和代表性系统。
Motivation: 现有医疗视频问答基准未根据问题所需推理类型和复杂度进行区分，缺乏对视觉、时间、过程推理能力的细粒度评估。
Method: 提出DA-MIVQA共享任务，构建带难度标注的多语言多模态医疗教学视频数据集，并设计三个赛道（DA-TAGSV、DA-VCR、DA-TAGVC），分别评估单视频时间答案定位、视频语料库检索和视频语料库时间答案定位在简单和复杂问题上的表现。
Result: 通过NLPCC 2026共享任务，提供了参赛系统的总体结果和代表性系统分析，展示了当前方法在简单问题（依赖字幕）和复杂问题（需视觉、时间、跨模态推理）上的性能差异。
Conclusion: DA-MIVQA为医疗教学视频问答提供了一个实用的、难度感知的基准，有助于推动该领域在细粒度推理能力评估上的发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Inertia-1: An Open Exploration of Wearable Motion Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Wearable motion sensing provides a continuous and scalable window into human behavior and health, making it a natural fit for foundation models, yet its pretraining and scaling principles remain poorly understood. Prior work studies isolated design choices, such as sensor placement or sampling frequency, often under fixed settings and narrow downstream tasks that fail to capture real-world sensing diversity. We introduce Inertia-1, a fully open exploration of wearable motion foundation models. Using massive corpora of accelerometer data from global sources spanning more than 18.2M hours, we build a controlled framework for studying the full lifecycle of wearable motion foundation models, covering data choices such as sensor modality, device placement, sampling rate, window length; model choices such as architectures and model size; and training choices such as pretraining objective and data scale. Extensive evaluations across 15 datasets spanning human activity recognition, freezing-of-gait detection, and disease prediction reveal intriguing findings for building motion foundation models that generalize across tasks and sensing conditions. Collectively, Inertia-1 not only presents state-of-the-art recipes for diverse downstream tasks, but also serves as a comprehensive, practical, and open cookbook for wearable motion representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 Inertia-1，一个全开放的可穿戴运动基础模型研究框架。利用来自全球的超过1820万小时加速度计数据，系统研究了数据选择（传感器模态、设备位置、采样率、窗口长度）、模型选择（架构、大小）和训练选择（预训练目标、数据规模）对下游任务的影响。在15个数据集（包括人类活动识别、步态冻结检测和疾病预测）上的评估揭示了构建通用运动基础模型的关键发现。
Motivation: 可穿戴运动感知为人类行为和健康提供了连续、可扩展的窗口，适合基础模型，但其预训练和扩展原理尚不明确。现有工作孤立研究设计选择，缺乏对真实世界传感多样性的覆盖。
Method: 提出了一个可控的实验框架，涵盖数据、模型和训练三个维度的选择。使用大规模加速度计数据（超过1820万小时），在三个下游任务（人类活动识别、步态冻结检测、疾病预测）上进行系统评估。
Result: 在15个数据集上的评估表明，通过优化数据、模型和训练选择，可以在多个下游任务上取得最优性能，并揭示了构建通用运动基础模型的经验规则。
Conclusion: Inertia-1 不仅为各种下游任务提供了最先进的配方，还作为可穿戴运动表示学习的实用、全面、开放指南。
Relevance: 5
