papers.title: WHERE to Generate Matters: Budget-Aware Synthetic Augmentation for Label Skewed Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Label skew in federated learning (FL) causes client drift and degrades global accuracy. Synthetic data augmentation can reduce this imbalance; however, full class balancing requires substantial computation cost. We propose FedEAS, a policy that assigns each client an entropy-adaptive per-class generation budget computed from its local label distribution. The budget jointly decides \emph{how much} each client generates and \emph{WHERE} the samples go. Accordingly, the total generation budget follows from the per-client budgets rather than being fixed in advance. FedEAS recovers most of the accuracy gain of full class balancing while reducing the generation budget by 94.1\%. At the same total generation budget, it outperforms Uniform allocation by up to 18.82\% across CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FedEAS，一种预算感知的合成数据增强策略，用于解决联邦学习中的标签偏斜问题。FedEAS基于客户端的标签分布为其分配熵自适应的每类生成预算，并决定生成样本的去向。在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上，FedEAS以94.1%的预算减少恢复了全类平衡的大部分精度收益，并在相同总预算下比均匀分配方法提升高达18.82%。
Motivation: 联邦学习中的标签偏斜导致客户端漂移并降低全局精度。全类平衡的合成数据增强虽能缓解此问题，但计算成本过高。
Method: 提出FedEAS策略，根据客户端本地标签分布的熵自适应地分配每类生成预算，同时决定生成样本的分配去向。总预算由各客户端预算动态决定，而非预设固定值。
Result: 在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上，FedEAS减少了94.1%的生成预算，同时恢复了全类平衡的大部分精度收益；在相同总预算下，相比均匀分配方法，精度提升高达18.82%。
Conclusion: FedEAS通过预算感知的合成数据增强有效平衡了精度与计算成本，说明合理分配生成预算比全类平衡更高效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Format-Controlled Multi-Scale JPEG Compression Response Analysis for Image-Level Forgery Screening
papers.abstract_en: Image forgery detection is a critical task in digital forensics, yet many deep-learning localization approaches are typically GPU-accelerated and computationally heavier than handcrafted screening methods. We propose a lightweight, interpretable feature engineering pipeline for image-level forgery screening using only CPU computation and gradient boosted trees. Our method introduces \emph{multi-scale Error Level Analysis} (ELA) computed at seven JPEG quality levels, combined with novel \emph{cross-quality ELA ratio} features that capture double-compression artifacts characteristic of spliced regions, augmented by spatial entropy, FFT energy bands, edge density, SRM residuals, and DCT blockiness, yielding a 405-dimensional feature vector. CASIA v2.0 contains a format confound (60\% of tampered images are TIFF while authentic images are JPEG/BMP and contain no TIFF samples), enabling a trivial \texttt{is\_tiff} classifier to reach 0.80 AUC. We address this through rigorous format-controlled evaluation: on the JPEG-only subset (9,501 images, eliminating the TIFF/JPEG container confound), our method achieves AUC~=~0.990 [95\% CI: 0.988--0.991] and F1~=~0.905 using 5-fold stratified cross-validation. Under a conservative source-aware group split (preventing related images from appearing in both train and test), AUC remains 0.976. An ablation study reveals that multi-scale ELA provides the dominant gain (+0.180 AUC over single-quality on the format-controlled subset), while cross-quality ratios provide complementary double-compression detection. These results support that the method detects compression-history inconsistencies rather than file-format shortcuts -- while offering feature-level interpretability, CPU-only deployment, and sub-second inference.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级、可解释的图像级伪造筛查流水线，基于CPU计算和梯度提升树，不需要GPU加速。方法引入多尺度错误级别分析（ELA），在7个JPEG质量级别上计算，并结合跨质量ELA比率等特征，生成405维特征向量。在CASIA v2.0数据集上，通过严格格式控制评价（仅JPEG子集），AUC达到0.990，F1为0.905，并在保守的源感知分组下AUC保持0.976，表明方法检测的是压缩历史不一致而非格式捷径。
Motivation: 现有深度学习伪造定位方法通常依赖GPU加速且计算量较大，缺少轻量级、可解释的筛查方法。同时，CASIA v2.0数据集中存在格式混淆（60%篡改图像为TIFF，而真实图像为JPEG/BMP），使得简单判断文件格式即可达到较高AUC，因此需要严格的格式控制评估来验证方法的真实有效性。
Method: 提出基于CPU计算的特征工程流水线，包括多尺度错误级别分析（ELA）在7个JPEG质量级别上的计算、跨质量ELA比率特征、空间熵、FFT能量带、边缘密度、SRM残差和DCT块效应等，最终得到405维特征向量，并使用梯度提升树进行分类。
Result: 在CASIA v2.0的JPEG-only子集（9,501张图像）上，通过5折分层交叉验证，AUC=0.990 [95% CI: 0.988-0.991]，F1=0.905；在保守的源感知分组下，AUC仍为0.976。消融实验表明，多尺度ELA相比单质量ELA带来+0.180 AUC的提升。
Conclusion: 该方法检测压缩历史不一致而非文件格式捷径，具有特征可解释性、仅需CPU部署且推理时间低于1秒，适用于轻量级图像伪造筛查。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: STAGformer: A Spatio-temporal Agent Graph Transformer for Micro Mobility Demand Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate station-level demand forecasting is essential for the efficient operation of bike-sharing systems, yet it remains challenging due to complex spatio-temporal dependencies and the large scale of urban networks. This paper presents STAGformer, a Spatio-Temporal Agent Graph Transformer that achieves efficient global modeling with linear computational complexity. The model introduces a two-step agent attention mechanism, where a small set of learnable spatial and temporal agent tokens first aggregate global information and then broadcast it back to individual stations and time steps, effectively capturing long-range interactions while reducing the quadratic cost of standard self-attention to O(NT). STAGformer integrates four core modules: a spatio-temporal encoder that fuses dynamic node features with external contextual factors (weather, time, points of interest), a graph propagation module for spatial neighbor aggregation, a temporal convolution module for local pattern extraction, and the agent attention module for global dependency modeling. Extensive experiments on two real-world datasets -- NYC Citi-Bike and Chicago Divvy-Bike -- demonstrate that STAGformer consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across multiple prediction horizons, achieving significant improvements in both RMSE and MAE. Ablation studies validate the contribution of each component, with the agent attention mechanism proving critical for modeling global spatio-temporal dependencies.

Motivation: 自行车共享系统中站点级需求预测面临复杂的时空依赖和大规模城市网络挑战，现有方法难以高效捕捉全局交互。
Method: 提出STAGformer，引入两阶段智能体注意力机制：首先使用少量可学习的空间和时间智能体令牌聚合全局信息，再广播回各个站点和时间步，将标准自注意力的二次复杂度降至线性。模型集成四个核心模块：融合动态节点特征与外部上下文（天气、时间、兴趣点）的时空编码器、空间邻居聚合的图传播模块、局部模式提取的时间卷积模块、以及全局依赖建模的智能体注意力模块。
Result: 在纽约Citi-Bike和芝加哥Divvy-Bike两个真实数据集上，STAGformer在多个预测时域上一致超越现有基线，在RMSE和MAE指标上取得显著改进。消融实验验证了各组件贡献，尤其智能体注意力机制对全局时空依赖建模至关重要。
Conclusion: STAGformer通过线性复杂度的智能体注意力机制有效建模全局时空依赖，为大规模城市级需求预测提供了高效解决方案。

papers.title: PRoVeFL: Private Robust and Verifiable Aggregation in Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) enables multiple clients to collaboratively train machine learning models while retaining data locality, thereby enhancing user privacy. However, traditional FL frameworks rely on a centralized aggregation server and assume honest-but-curious clients, making them susceptible to both server-side inference and client-side poisoning attacks. Although recent work has explored secure and Byzantine-resilient FL protocols, they face a fundamental trade-off among privacy, integrity, and verifiability, and incur substantial computational and communication overhead due to the heavy use of cryptographic primitives. In this work, we propose PRoVeFL-a novel, modular FL framework that is Privacy-preserving, Byzantine-Robust, and ensures Verifiable aggregation. PRoVeFL employs multiple servers leveraging multi-key fully homomorphic encryption. Each client encrypts its local model updates and distributes encrypted shares to all servers. This design enables a hybrid computation model in which ciphertext operations are carefully offloaded to the plaintext domain under strict privacy constraints to efficiently evaluate complex statistical aggregation rules. PRoVeFL is compatible with a wide range of state-of-the-art Byzantine-robust aggregation algorithms (e.g., Krum, Trimmed Mean, FLTrust, norm clipping, MESAS, and more) and further enhances them with verifiability mechanisms that require minimal trust in at least one honest server. We evaluate it across different settings and demonstrate its scalability with varying numbers of parameters and participants. PRoVeFL improves runtime over the prior works, Prio and ELSA, based on distributed trust with comparable security guarantees, up to 100x and 10x, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PRoVeFL，一个模块化的联邦学习框架，兼具隐私保护、拜占庭鲁棒性和可验证聚合。它使用多密钥全同态加密，将密文操作在严格隐私约束下卸载到明文域，以高效评估复杂统计聚合规则。与现有工作相比，运行时间提升可达100倍。
Motivation: 传统联邦学习依赖中心化聚合服务器并假设客户端诚实但好奇，易受服务器端推理和客户端投毒攻击。现有安全协议的隐私、完整性和可验证性之间存在根本性权衡，且因大量使用密码原语而计算通信开销大。
Method: PRoVeFL采用多服务器架构，利用多密钥全同态加密。每个客户端加密本地模型更新并将加密分享分发到所有服务器，实现混合计算模型，在严格隐私约束下将密文操作卸载到明文域。
Result: 与基于分布式信任的先前工作Prio和ELSA相比，PRoVeFL在相当安全保证下分别提升运行时间最高100倍和10倍。
Conclusion: 框架与多种拜占庭鲁棒聚合算法兼容，并具有可验证性，但摘要未明确总结局限性。

papers.title: Audio Sentiment Analysis via Distillation and Cross-Modal Integration of Generated Multilingual Transcripts
papers.abstract_en: Automatically recognizing the sentiment, positive or negative, from speech is a challenging task, requiring both the analysis of vocal inflections and the interpretation of uttered words. Recent solutions rely on audio foundation models to solve the task, but it remains unclear if such models can take all aspects into account. To this end, we propose a multimodal solution that integrates audio and text information via cross-modal transformers, where text transcripts are automatically generated via an automatic speech recognition (ASR) tool. Moreover, we create multiple text modalities by automatically translating the transcripts into multiple languages via machine translation tools. Audio and multilingual text features are combined via a cascaded architecture comprising cross-modal transformer blocks that integrate modalities one by one. We further distill knowledge from the multimodal model, called teacher, into a unimodal (audio only) model, called student. We conduct experiments on a large-scale dataset, demonstrating that the automatically generated textual information can bring significant performance boosts in multimodal sentiment polarity classification. Our ablation study confirms that both automatic transcripts and automatic translations are helpful. Moreover, we show that the audio-only model can be enhanced via distillation, boosting performance without any computational overhead during inference. To reproduce the reported results, we publicly release our code at https://github.com/andreidurdun/cross-modal-audio-sentiment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种通过跨模态变压器整合音频和自动生成的多语言文本的情感分析方案。利用ASR生成文本转录，并通过机器翻译生成多语言版本，采用级联跨模态变压器逐步融合模态。进一步通过知识蒸馏将多模态教师模型的知识传递到纯音频学生模型，在大型数据集上显示性能提升，且推理时无额外开销。
Motivation: 自动语音情感识别需同时分析声调变化和词语意义，现有音频基础模型可能无法全面捕捉这些信息，因此需要融合文本模态来增强情感极性分类。
Method: 使用ASR工具生成音频转录文本，再通过机器翻译将转录文本自动翻译成多种语言，形成多语言文本模态。设计级联跨模态变压器结构，逐步整合音频与多语言文本特征。最后通过知识蒸馏，将多模态教师模型的知识迁移至纯音频学生模型。
Result: 在大规模数据集上的实验表明，自动生成的文本信息显著提升了多模态情感极性分类性能。消融研究证实自动转录和自动翻译均有帮助，且蒸馏后的纯音频模型性能提升且推理无额外计算开销。
Conclusion: 跨模态融合自动生成的多语言文本能有效提升音频情感分析性能，知识蒸馏可在不增加推理成本的前提下增强纯音频模型。

papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Reliability Based Bi-Objective Portfolio Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Portfolio optimization under uncertainty is inherently a multi-objective decision problem involving complex interactions among return, risk, market dynamics, and practical investment constraints. Existing reliability based portfolio optimization approaches primarily rely on static optimization frameworks and often fail to capture sequential decision making, tail risk, and market frictions such as transaction costs. To address these limitations, we propose a deep reinforcement learning framework for multi-objective reliability based portfolio optimization (MORP-DRL). The proposed framework jointly optimizes expected return and downside risk using three complementary risk measures: variance, Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR), and Entropic Value-at-Risk (EVaR). To model uncertainty and heavy-tailed market behavior, asset returns are represented using GARCH(1,1), Extreme Value Theory, and a t-copula dependence structure, while realistic scenarios are generated through quasi-Monte Carlo simulation. A Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) based strategy is developed under practical constraints including transaction costs and portfolio bounds, and is benchmarked against NSGA-II. Experiments on ten global equity indices across pre-COVID, COVID, and post-COVID market regimes demonstrate that MORP-DRL achieves competitive risk-return performance, reduced downside risk during periods of market stress, and scalability to high-dimensional portfolio settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于可靠性的双目标投资组合优化问题，提出一个深度强化学习框架（MORP-DRL），该框架联合优化期望收益与下行风险，采用方差、条件风险价值（CVaR）和熵风险价值（EVaR）三种互补风险度量，并结合GARCH(1,1)、极值理论和t-copula建模资产收益，通过拟蒙特卡洛模拟生成情景。基于近端策略优化（PPO）的策略在考虑交易成本和投资组合边界等实际约束下，与NSGA-II进行基准比较。在十只全球股票指数上的实验（覆盖前COVID、COVID和COVID后市场阶段）表明，MORP-DRL实现了有竞争力的风险-收益表现，在市场压力期间降低了下行风险，并具有扩展到高维投资组合的能力。
Motivation: 现有的基于可靠性的投资组合优化方法主要依赖静态优化框架，无法捕捉顺序决策、尾部风险以及交易成本等市场摩擦。
Method: 提出MORP-DRL框架，采用PPO算法，使用GARCH(1,1)、极值理论和t-copula对资产收益进行建模，并通过拟蒙特卡洛模拟生成现实情景；在交易成本和投资组合边界约束下联合优化期望收益与下行风险（方差、CVaR、EVaR）。
Result: 在十只全球股票指数（前COVID、COVID和COVID后市场阶段）上，MORP-DRL取得了有竞争力的风险-收益表现，在市场压力期间显著降低了下行风险，并展示了在高维投资组合设置中的可扩展性。
Conclusion: 本文证明深度强化学习能有效处理多目标可靠性投资组合优化问题，特别是在动态决策和尾部风险方面优于传统静态方法。

papers.title: D2PO: Optimizing Diffusion Samplers via Dynamic Preference
papers.abstract_en: We propose D2PO (Dynamic Direct Preference Optimization), a principled framework for optimizing diffusion sampling policies with respect to timestep schedules and classifier-free guidance (CFG) weights. Our work is motivated by a fundamental limitation of existing student-teacher regression frameworks; low-NFE student samplers are trained to mimic high-NFEteachers, often sacrificing high-frequency texture fidelity while preserving coarse global structures, thereby misaligning the sampler with perceptual quality. D2PO addresses this challenge by reformulating sampler optimization as a preference-based alignment problem, leveraging the Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) framework. To make DPO applicable to diffusion samplers, we model the sampling policy as an energy-based model (EBM), transforming preference comparisons into tractable energy differences. We further introduce a novel energy formulation derived directly from the pretrained score network, enabling preference evaluation in perturbed spaces that jointly capture structural consistency and fine-grained details. Moreover, we introduce dynamic preferences, where the preferred samples used for alignment progressively improve as the sampling policies are learned. This self-improving mechanism replaces rigid static teacher supervision with an iterative, preference-guided refinement process, providing progressively stronger alignment signals. Extensive experiments demonstrate that D2PO aligns diffusion samplers with perceptual quality more faithfully, unlocking the full potential of high-quality teachers and consistently outperforming conventional regression-based schedulers under low-NFE constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出D2PO框架，通过动态偏好优化扩散采样策略（时间步调度和分类器无引导权重），将采样器优化重新表述为基于偏好的对齐问题，利用能量模型使DPO适用于扩散采样器，并引入动态偏好机制逐步改进对齐信号。实验表明D2PO在低NFE条件下优于传统回归方法。
Motivation: 现有学生-教师回归框架中，低NFE学生采样器模仿高NFE教师，牺牲高频纹理保真度，导致采样器与感知质量不对齐。
Method: 将采样策略建模为能量模型，使偏好比较转化为能量差；从预训练分数网络推导能量公式，在扰动空间中联合捕捉结构一致性和细节；引入动态偏好，偏好样本随策略学习逐步改进。
Result: 实验表明D2PO与感知质量对齐更忠实，在低NFE约束下持续优于传统回归调度器。
Conclusion: D2PO通过偏好引导的迭代精炼代替静态教师监督，释放高质量教师潜力，提升采样器性能。

papers.title: Security and Privacy in Agentic AI: Grand Challenges and Future Directions
papers.abstract_en: We present key challenges and future research directions in the security and privacy of agentic AI, based on a horizon-scanning exercise that brought together thirty leading international experts from academia, industry, and government to engage in focused discussions and collaborative exercises on the emerging risks associated with the growing agency of AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于一次汇集三十位国际专家的地平线扫描活动，系统梳理了智能体人工智能（agentic AI）在安全与隐私方面面临的重大挑战和未来研究方向。文章识别了因AI自主性增强而涌现的新型风险，并提出了需要学术界、产业界和政府协同应对的研究议程。
Motivation: 随着AI系统自主决策能力的提升，其带来的安全与隐私风险日益突出，但目前缺乏系统性的风险识别和研究方向规划。
Conclusion: 文章强调应对智能体AI的安全与隐私挑战需要跨学科合作，并呼吁建立新的治理框架和技术解决方案。

papers.title: NEST: Tackling Dataset-Level Distribution Shifts via Regime-Oriented Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Accurate long-term forecasting in complex systems is frequently compromised by dataset-level distribution shifts, where diverse underlying behavioral modes and evolving system states drive the dynamic multivariate time-series. While existing methods predominantly focus on local temporal shifts, they fail to explicitly model the global structural challenge where datasets are composites of distinct operational regimes. In this paper, we propose NEST, a specialized framework designed to model and recompose these evolving structures through a two-phase dense MoE architecture. NEST first facilitates structural specialization by partitioning the dataset into distinct operational regimes through unsupervised clustering in a principled moment-entropy space. We introduce a regime-oriented router mechanism that generates initial expert weights based on temporal content, subsequently refined through geometric modulation to regime centroids. Crucially, rather than acting as monolithic predictors, individual experts function as specialized kernels that capture regime-specific dynamics by evolving unique variate-attention patterns. Extensive evaluations on diverse benchmarks, including heterogeneous network traffic and physical phenomena, demonstrate that NEST consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our code and datasets are available at https://github.com/Aaralshin/NEST
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NEST 框架，用于解决复杂系统长期预测中数据集级别的分布偏移问题。NEST 采用两阶段密集 MoE 架构：首先在矩熵空间通过无监督聚类将数据集划分为不同的操作体制，然后通过体制导向路由器生成专家权重并经几何调制精炼。每个专家作为专门核捕获体制特定的动态。实验在异构网络流量和物理现象基准上取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有方法主要关注局部时间偏移，未能显式建模数据集由不同操作体制组成的全局结构挑战，导致长期预测精度受限。
Method: 两阶段密集 MoE：第一阶段在矩熵空间进行无监督聚类，将数据集划分为多个操作体制；第二阶段引入体制导向路由器，根据时间内容生成初始专家权重，并通过几何调制向体制中心精炼。每个专家作为专门核，学习体制特定的变体-注意力模式。
Result: 在异构网络流量和物理现象等多种基准上，NEST 一致取得最先进性能。
Conclusion: NEST 通过显式建模和重组数据集中的操作体制结构，有效改善长期预测任务中的分布偏移问题。代码和数据集已开源。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: A Quiet Failure in Calibrated Virtual Screening: Marginal Conformal Prediction Under-Covers the Minority Class, and a Class-Conditional Fix Recovers It
authors: Mustafojon Tursunbadalov (1) ((1) School of Science and Technology
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction is being adopted in drug discovery to put an honest number on model reliability: pick an error rate alpha, and the method returns prediction sets containing the true label with probability at least 1 - alpha. We show this guarantee can be dangerous on imbalanced datasets. Across four datasets, standard (marginal) conformal prediction hits its global 90% coverage target while leaving the minority class badly exposed: realized minority coverage falls to 64.8% on blood-brain-barrier penetration and to 4.2% on clinical-trial toxicity, where the rare class is nearly abandoned. The failure is not tied to one model: a random forest, a graph network, and a frozen chemical language model all reproduce it (p < 0.001 in every case), with severity tracking baseline calibration on rare labels rather than architecture. A conservation identity explains the effect: the minority's shortfall equals the majority's surplus amplified by the imbalance ratio, predicting the measured gap to within one point and ordering severity across datasets. The failure survives realistic scaffold splits and a second conformal score, while aggregate accuracy and overall coverage stay reassuringly high, which is exactly why it is easy to miss. Class-conditional (Mondrian) conformal prediction closes the gap on every dataset, restoring minority coverage to target for a modest increase in prediction-set size. We localize the failures to generic molecular scaffolds - plain benzene and pyridine cores occurring in both classes - propose a one-number diagnostic, and show with a cost model that abstaining on affected compounds flips a screening campaign from net-negative to net-positive utility. Our contribution is demonstrating on real chemistry how severe and invisible this known conformal-theory gap becomes under imbalance, and laying out a practical protocol restoring per-class reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究共形预测在虚拟筛选中的失效问题。标准（边缘）共形预测在全局覆盖率达到90%的情况下，对少数类覆盖率严重不足，如在血脑屏障渗透数据中降至64.8%，在临床试验毒性数据中仅剩4.2%。该现象与模型无关，由不平衡比率放大保守恒恒等式解释。类别条件（Mondrian）共形预测能恢复每类覆盖到目标水平，同时预测集合大小仅适度增加。
Motivation: 共形预测被用于药物发现以提供模型可靠性保证，但在不平衡数据集上该保证可能具有欺骗性：全局覆盖率掩盖了少数类的低覆盖率，导致模型在稀有类别上近乎失效。
Method: 通过跨四个数据集、三种模型（随机森林、图网络、冻结化学语言模型）验证标准共形预测的失效，并引入类别条件（Mondrian）共形预测作为修复方案。
Result: 标准共形预测全局覆盖率达90%，但少数类覆盖率在血脑屏障数据中降至64.8%，在临床试验毒性数据中仅4.2%；失效严重性由基线校准程度和不平衡比率决定。类别条件共形预测恢复了每类覆盖率，代价是预测集合大小适度增加。
Conclusion: 该工作揭示了真实化学数据中类别不平衡下共形预测的理论空白，并提供了恢复每类可靠性的实用协议。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Counterfactually Fair Image Classifiers Satisfy Group Fairness? -- A Theoretical and Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: The notion of algorithmic fairness has been actively explored from various aspects of fairness, such as counterfactual fairness (CF) and group fairness (GF). However, the exact relationship between CF and GF remains to be unclear, especially in image classification tasks; the reason is because we often cannot collect counterfactual samples regarding a sensitive attribute, essential for evaluating CF, from the existing images (\eg, a photo of the same person but with different secondary sex characteristics). In this paper, we construct new image datasets for evaluating CF by using a high-quality image editing method and carefully labeling with human annotators. Our datasets, \oursceleb and \ourslfw, build upon the popular image GF benchmarks; hence, we can evaluate CF and GF simultaneously. We empirically observe that CF does not imply GF in image classification, whereas previous studies on tabular datasets observed the opposite. We theoretically show that it could be due to the existence of a latent attribute $G$ that is correlated with, but not caused by, the sensitive attribute (\eg, secondary sex characteristics are highly correlated with hair length). From this observation, we propose a simple baseline, Counterfactual Knowledge Distillation (CKD), to mitigate such correlation with the sensitive attributes. Extensive experimental results on \oursceleb and \ourslfw demonstrate that CF-achieving models satisfy GF if we successfully reduce the reliance on $G$ (\eg, using CKD).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过构建新的图像数据集（CelebA-CF和LFW-CF）来评估反事实公平（CF）和群体公平（GF），发现图像分类中CF并不蕴含GF，这与表格数据中的结论相反。理论分析表明，这是由于存在与敏感属性相关但非其因果的潜在属性G（如性征与头发长度），并提出反事实知识蒸馏（CKD）来减少对G的依赖，从而使CF模型满足GF。
Motivation: 反事实公平和群体公平之间的关系在图像分类中尚未明确，因为难以从现有图像中收集反事实样本。本文旨在构建可同时评估两者的基准，并厘清CF与GF的关系。
Method: 使用高质量图像编辑方法生成反事实样本，并经过人工标注构建CelebA-CF和LFW-CF数据集；提出反事实知识蒸馏（CKD）作为基线，通过蒸馏减少模型对与敏感属性相关但非因果的潜在属性G的依赖。
Result: 实验表明，在图像分类中，满足CF的模型不一定满足GF；但通过CKD减少对G的依赖后，CF模型能够满足GF。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了图像分类中CF与GF的不一致性，并提供了缓解方法（CKD），为公平性研究提供了新的基准和理论见解。

papers.title: TriRoute: Unified Learned Routing for Joint Adaptive Attention, Experts, and KV-Cache Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Conditional computation can decouple language model quality from per-token inference cost, yet leading techniques act on a single axis in isolation: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) sparsifies the FFN, Mixture-of-Depths (MoD) skips whole transformer blocks, and KV-cache quantization compresses attention memory. We argue these three decisions (attention resolution, expert selection, and cache bit-width) are strongly coupled and should be made jointly: a token rare enough to warrant full attention may also need high-precision caching regardless of which expert processes it. We introduce TriRoute, a single lightweight controller shared across all three axes that, for every token at every layer, emits a coordinated policy: (i) an attention mode (skip/local/full), (ii) a sparse set of FFN experts (with a null expert recovering MoD), and (iii) a KV-cache bit-width. The controller trains end-to-end via a heterogeneous relaxation (Gumbel-Softmax with straight-through estimation for categorical decisions and load-balanced top-k gating for experts) under a Lagrangian budget constraint that turns the average compute and memory cost into a controllable knob. We identify a cross-axis routing-collapse cascade in naive joint training, where collapse on one axis propagates to the others, and address it with per-axis normalization and a coupling-aware balancing loss. On decoder-only models from 160M to 1.3B parameters at compute-optimal token counts, TriRoute Pareto-dominates the best independent MoD+MoE+KV-quantization combination at matched inference FLOPs and memory, while better preserving tail-case robustness on rare entities, code, and arithmetic that pure perplexity optimization erodes. Post-hoc analysis reveals interpretable structure: the controller allocates full attention and high-precision cache to sentence-initial positions, rare subwords, and named entities, while cheaply routing function words.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TriRoute，一个轻量级控制器，联合决定每个 token 在每个层的注意力模式（跳过/局部/全局）、FFN 专家选择（含空专家恢复 MoD）和 KV 缓存位宽。通过 Gumbel-Softmax 和直通估计进行端到端训练，并引入拉格朗日预算约束控制计算和内存成本。在 160M 到 1.3B 参数的 decoder-only 模型上，TriRoute 在匹配推理 FLOPs 和内存下帕累托优于独立的 MoD+MoE+KV 量化组合，且更好地保持对罕见实体、代码和算术的尾部鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有的条件计算技术（MoE、MoD、KV缓存量化）各自独立优化单一维度，但注意力分辨率、专家选择和缓存位宽三个决策高度耦合，需要联合优化。
Method: 设计一个共享轻量控制器，对每个 token 每层输出协调策略：注意力模式、稀疏专家集（含空专家）、KV 缓存位宽。使用异构松弛（Gumbel-Softmax 与直通估计、负载均衡 top-k 门控）端到端训练，并在拉格朗日预算约束下优化。针对跨轴路由崩塌级联问题，提出逐轴归一化和耦合感知平衡损失。
Result: 在 160M 到 1.3B 参数模型上，TriRoute 在匹配推理 FLOPs 和内存下帕累托优于独立 MoD+MoE+KV 量化组合，并更好地保持对罕见实体、代码和算术的尾部鲁棒性。分析显示控制器将全注意力和高精度缓存分配给句首位置、稀有子词和命名实体。
Conclusion: TriRoute 证明了联合学习路由策略的有效性，并揭示了可解释的分配模式。

papers.title: MiLSD: A Micro Line-Segment Detector for Resource-Constrained Devices
papers.abstract_en: Line segment detection is a key building block in visual SLAM, 3D reconstruction, and industrial inspection. Recent deep learning methods have greatly improved accuracy, yet even the smallest models require several megabytes of memory, exceeding low-cost MCU capacity. This work investigates the maximum achievable accuracy under a sub-megabyte budget. We propose MiLSD, a detector tailored for MCU-level constraints, and systematically compare three output representations within a compact fully-convolutional backbone. Our study shows that the proposed F-Clip center-with-length-and-angle formulation learns most effectively at small model sizes. We find that 8-bit quantization preserves full-precision performance, while 4-bit quantization causes significant degradation, particularly in angle regression, with quantization-aware training recovering only part of the loss. With a one-megabyte activation budget and inference enhancements including sub-pixel decoding, test-time augmentation, and a lightweight verifier, MiLSD improves sAP10 on ShanghaiTech Wireframe from 10.6 (25k parameters, 0.25 MB) to 24.1 within 1 MB. Rather than competing with GPU-scale parsers, we map the accuracy memory trade-off across representations, bit-widths, capacities, and post-processing strategies for embedded vision systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索在低于1兆字节内存约束下实现高精度线检测的可能性，提出MiLSD，一种面向微控制器（MCU）的紧凑型线检测器。通过系统比较三种输出表示（其中F-Clip中心+长度+角度公式对小模型最有效），并采用8-bit量化、亚像素解码、测试时增强和轻量验证器等推理优化，在ShanghaiTech Wireframe数据集上将sAP10从10.6（25k参数，0.25 MB）提升至24.1（1 MB内）。研究同时揭示了4-bit量化导致的精度下降，尤其是角度回归的退化。
Motivation: 现有深度学习线检测方法即使最小模型也需数兆字节内存，超出低成本MCU容量。本文旨在探究亚MB内存预算下可达到的最大精度，填补嵌入式视觉系统中高精度线检测的空白。
Method: 提出MiLSD，基于紧凑全卷积骨干网络，比较三种输出表示（F-Clip中心+长度+角度、坐标回归等）；采用8-bit量化、亚像素解码、测试时增强和轻量验证器；研究量化感知训练对4-bit量化的恢复效果。
Result: 在1 MB激活预算下，MiLSD将ShanghaiTech Wireframe的sAP10从10.6（0.25 MB）提升至24.1。8-bit量化保持全精度性能，4-bit量化导致严重退化（尤其角度回归），量化感知训练仅部分恢复损失。
Conclusion: 本文系统映射了不同表示、位宽、容量和后处理策略下的精度-内存权衡，为嵌入式视觉系统的线检测提供了实用指导。

papers.title: Can Reinforcement Learning Efficiently Discover Price Manipulation?
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate whether a model-free RL agent can identify and exploit price manipulation opportunities more effectively than a traditional model-based approach that assumes correct specification of the data-generating process but relies on noisy parameter estimates. We consider a single-asset market in which prices evolve according to an Almgren-Chriss framework with non-linear permanent impact and linear temporary impact. We first establish the existence of price-manipulative strategies in discrete time and compute the optimal benchmark strategy using Sequential Least Squares Quadratic Programming under full information. We then compare two finite-sample learning approaches: a model-based procedure that estimates impact parameters from simulated execution data and an agnostic RL approach based on Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient, trained directly on the same amount of data. For intermediate volatility, the RL agent successfully discovers profitable manipulative strategies without explicit knowledge of the underlying model, even when training data are quite limited. More importantly, RL consistently outperforms the model-based approach when parameter estimates are affected by sampling error, despite the latter benefiting from the correct model specification. For large volatility, all methods are unable to identify manipulation opportunities, while for small volatility, the model based approach outperforms RL. These findings highlight both the effectiveness of RL in complex control problems and the risks associated with deploying learning algorithms in financial markets without appropriate safeguards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无模型强化学习（RL）代理能否比传统基于模型的方法更有效地发现和利用价格操纵机会。作者在Almgren-Chriss框架下证明了离散时间价格操纵策略的存在，并比较了基于模型的参数估计方法和基于深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）的RL方法。在中等波动率下，RL代理成功发现了有利可图的操纵策略，且优于受采样误差影响的模型方法。
Motivation: 现有研究通常假设市场模型正确指定，但参数估计存在噪声。本文旨在探索RL是否能在模型未知且数据有限的情况下，更有效地发现价格操纵策略。
Method: 采用Almgren-Chriss框架，建立非线性永久冲击和线性临时冲击的离散时间模型。基于全信息使用SLSQP计算最优基准策略，并比较两种有限样本学习方法：基于模型的参数估计方法和基于DDPG的无模型RL方法。
Result: 在中等波动率下，RL代理成功发现盈利操纵策略，且优于受采样误差影响的模型方法；高波动率下所有方法均失败；低波动率下模型方法优于RL。
Conclusion: 研究展示了RL在复杂控制问题中的有效性，但也警示了在金融市场部署学习算法时缺乏适当保障的风险。

papers.title: MTEB-BR: A Text Embedding Benchmark for Brazilian Portuguese
papers.abstract_en: Text embeddings for Portuguese have no dedicated benchmark: evaluation rests on translated corpora such as English MS MARCO or on thin multilingual coverage, with native tasks scattered and unconsolidated. We introduce MTEB-BR, a benchmark of 22 native Brazilian-Portuguese tasks across seven categories (classification, multilabel classification, pair classification, semantic textual similarity, clustering, retrieval, and reranking), admitting only data created or found in Portuguese and excluding translations by construction. We evaluate 93 models spanning 23M to 27B parameters: 73 open-weight and 20 closed commercial APIs. Alongside the leaderboard we report a statistical layer for every headline comparison: per-task bootstrap confidence intervals, paired-bootstrap significance, a task- and instance-level discrimination analysis (how sharply each task separates models) adapted from Item Response Theory, and a cross-leaderboard correlation. Three findings stand out. The benchmark cleanly separates about a dozen tiers of models, though the top six are statistically too close to order. An openly licensed, self-hostable model reaches that leading tier, so strong Portuguese embedding quality does not require a commercial API. And a model's rank on the global multilingual leaderboard predicts its Portuguese rank only moderately (Spearman rho = 0.75 over 55 shared models; one model ranks 3rd there and 49th here), so a native benchmark measures something the multilingual boards do not. We release every task, our code, and a public leaderboard, so practitioners can choose Portuguese embedding models on native evidence.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对葡萄牙语文本嵌入缺乏专用基准的问题，提出了MTEB-BR，一个包含22个原生巴西葡萄牙语任务（涵盖分类、检索等7个类别）的基准，仅使用葡萄牙语原生数据，排除翻译语料。评估了93个模型（73个开源、20个商业API），发现基准能清晰区分约十几个模型层级，但前六名统计上难以排序；一个开源可自托管模型进入顶级梯队，表明无需商业API即可获得优质葡萄牙语嵌入；模型在全局多语言排行榜上的排名仅中等程度预测其在葡萄牙语上的排名（斯皮尔曼相关系数0.75），说明原生基准能测量多语言排行榜无法捕捉的信息。
Motivation: 葡萄牙语文本嵌入缺乏专用基准，现有评估依赖翻译语料（如英文MS MARCO）或稀薄的多语言覆盖，原生任务分散且未整合。
Method: 构建MTEB-BR基准，包含22个原生巴西葡萄牙语任务（分类、多标签分类、对分类、语义文本相似度、聚类、检索、重排序），仅使用葡萄牙语原生数据，排除翻译。评估93个模型（23M到27B参数），并报告每任务的bootstrap置信区间、配对bootstrap显著性、基于项目反应理论的任务区分度分析以及跨排行榜相关性。
Result: 基准清晰区分约十几个模型层级，但前六名统计上过于接近无法排序；一个开源可自托管模型达到顶级梯队；模型在全局多语言排行榜上的排名仅中等程度预测其葡萄牙语排名（斯皮尔曼相关系数0.75），其中一个模型在全局排名第3，在葡萄牙语排名第49。
Conclusion: MTEB-BR提供了首个葡萄牙语文本嵌入原生基准，表明原生基准可测量多语言排行榜无法捕捉的信息，并证明开源模型能达到商业API水平。

papers.title: Phase-Preserving Trimodal Transformer for Tropical Forest Biomass Estimation Using Optical and PolInSAR Data
authors: Rosiane Rodrigues de Freitas (1) ((1) Instituto de Computação
(2) Instituto de Pesquisas do Exército na Amazônia (IPEAM)
papers.abstract_en: The accurate estimation of Above-Ground Biomass (AGB) in mature tropical forests remains a critical challenge in remote sensing, primarily due to the saturation of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) signals in high-density areas and persistent cloud cover affecting optical imagery. To overcome these physical limitations, we propose the Trimodal Coherent Co-attention Transformer (TCCT), a physics-informed deep learning architecture. The TCCT natively fuses optical surface reflectance (Landsat-5) with complex-valued Polarimetric SAR Interferometry (PolInSAR) data from both P and L bands. Unlike traditional fusion methods, our architecture employs complex-valued encoders to preserve spatial phase coherence, coupled with a dynamic co-attention mechanism that acts as an adaptive gating module, reducing the weight of cloud-corrupted optical pixels and shifting reliance to microwave phase data. We also derived a localized spatial allometric calibration model via Levenberg-Marquardt optimization, tailored to the specific wood density of the Paracou region in the Amazon basin. Evaluated using a two-stage protocol, the TCCT first underwent a rigorous 5-fold cross-validation to establish robust global weights (achieving a global RMSE of 4.19 m). Subsequently, following a localized spatial fine-tuning phase over 200 epochs, the model attained an absolute RMSE of 3.78 m and an $R^2$ of 0.33 for Canopy Height Models (CHM), outperforming standard Random Forest, CNN, and Vision Transformer baselines. Our ablation study confirms that preserving phase coherence mitigates deep-canopy signal saturation. When converted to AGB, the fine-tuned TCCT map yielded a Relative RMSE (rRMSE) of 4.51% in dense forest areas above 50 Mg/ha. By meeting the European Space Agency (ESA) BIOMASS mission requirement of less than 20% error, the TCCT provides a robust framework for continuous carbon stock mapping in tropical biomes.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出三模态共注意力Transformer (TCCT)，融合Landsat-5光学反射率与P/L波段极化干涉SAR (PolInSAR)数据，用于热带森林地上生物量 (AGB) 估计。通过复数编码器保持相位相干性，动态共注意力机制降低云污染光学像素权重。在亚马逊Paracou区域，两阶段评估达到AGB相对RMSE 4.51%，满足ESA BIOMASS任务要求。
Motivation: 热带森林AGB估计面临SAR信号饱和和云层遮挡问题，现有方法未能有效融合光学与PolInSAR复数数据。
Method: 提出TCCT架构，包含复数编码器、动态共注意力机制以及基于Levenberg-Marquardt优化的局部空间异速校准模型。
Result: 在Paracou区域，全局RMSE 4.19 m (CHM)，局部微调后CHM RMSE 3.78 m，R² 0.33；AGB相对RMSE 4.51% (>50 Mg/ha)，优于随机森林、CNN和Vision Transformer基线。
Conclusion: 保持相位相干性可缓解深层冠层信号饱和，TCCT为热带生物群连续碳储量制图提供稳健框架，满足ESA BIOMASS误差要求。

papers.title: Vision Non-Causal Trapezoidal Mamba: Eliminating Directional Scanning in Vision SSMs with Second-Order Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: State Space Models (SSMs) have emerged as an alternative to Vision Transformers, yet most vision SSMs inherit directional token scanning from causal sequence modeling. While effective for sequential data, directional scanning introduces spatial bias and orientation-sensitive representations. We present Vision Non-Causal Trapezoidal Mamba (VNCT), a second-order non-causal vision SSM that enables all image tokens to interact in a single pass, eliminating direSctional scanning and achieving low single-image inference latency. VNCT exhibits more orientation-robust representations, showing reduced performance degradation under image rotations and flips, while improving Boundary IoU by up to 3.7 points, leading to more accurate boundary preservation and object localization. Across ImageNet-1K classification, COCO object detection and instance segmentation, and ADE20K semantic segmentation, VNCT consistently outperforms both directional-scanning vision SSMs and first-order non-causal SSMs. These results show that directional scanning is unnecessary for high-performance vision SSMs and that second-order non-causal state-space modeling offers a simple, efficient, and robust alternative for visual recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Vision Non-Causal Trapezoidal Mamba (VNCT)，一种二阶非因果状态空间模型，用于视觉识别。VNCT 摒弃了传统视觉 SSM 中的方向扫描，允许所有图像令牌在单次前向中交互，从而消除空间偏置并提升对旋转和翻转的鲁棒性。在 ImageNet-1K 分类、COCO 检测分割和 ADE20K 语义分割上，VNCT 超越了有方向扫描的 SSM 和一阶非因果 SSM，边界 IoU 提升高达 3.7 点。结果表明方向扫描并非高性能视觉 SSM 的必要条件，二阶非因果建模提供了一种简单高效的替代方案。
Motivation: 现有视觉 SSM 从因果序列建模继承方向扫描，导致空间偏置和方向敏感表示，限制了模型对图像变换的鲁棒性。
Method: 提出 VNCT，一种二阶非因果视觉 SSM，通过梯形状态空间结构使所有图像令牌在单次前向中全局交互，完全消除方向扫描。
Result: 在 ImageNet-1K 上分类准确率提升，COCO 和 ADE20K 上边界 IoU 最高提升 3.7 点，且对图像旋转和翻转的退化更小。
Conclusion: 方向扫描对于高性能视觉 SSM 并非必需，二阶非因果状态空间建模是一种简单、高效且鲁棒的替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Doubly cross-fit debiased machine learning of heterogeneous treatment effects under principal stratification
papers.abstract_en: Principal stratification provides a foundational framework for causal inference with intermediate outcomes by defining causal effects within subpopulations, yet existing work has largely focused on average effects across strata rather than treatment effect heterogeneity within strata. Such within-stratum heterogeneity informs individualized treatment decisions but the associated methods are sparse. We address this gap by studying the identification and estimation of the conditional principal causal effects under principal ignorability combined with an odds ratio sensitivity parameterization, which relaxes the monotonicity assumption. To efficiently learn these estimands, we propose a novel doubly cross-fit doubly robust machine learner that resolves the nested nuisance structure inherent to principal stratification. Leveraging sequential orthogonal debiased machine learning with regularized least-squares sieves, we derive $\mathcal{L}^2$ and uniform limit theory, establish oracle efficiency, and construct uniform confidence bands for the proposed estimator. We use simulations to demonstrate the finite-sample performance of our estimator, and provide an empirical analysis of a randomized trial in acute lung injury, revealing informative patterns of treatment effect heterogeneity within the always-survivor subpopulation.

papers.title: VLM-Aware Meta-Optic Front-End Design for Frozen Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Conventional machine-vision pipelines typically rely on high-quality optics that produce clean, human-interpretable images, and optical design has therefore been driven by image-level criteria such as resolution, aberration correction, and pixel fidelity. However, such optics are often impractical for size-, cost-, or form-factor-constrained applications, where compact meta-optics offer an attractive alternative but operate under strict physical efficiency limits. We propose CODA, a co-design framework that optimizes a continuous-density meta-optic front-end for frozen-model recognition using differentiable image formation and adjoint-gradient updates of Maxwell-based simulations. CODA directly optimizes the cross-entropy loss of a fixed zero-shot CLIP classifier without learned reconstruction, image signal processing, or image-fidelity auxiliary objectives. In a two-dimensional simulated imaging benchmark on ImageNet-100, CODA improves CLIP ViT-L/14 zero-shot accuracy from 53.75 $\pm$ 3.57$\%$ with a focal-concentration baseline to 65.41 $\pm$ 3.99$\%$. The optimized optics further transfer without re-optimization across CLIP, SigLIP, and DINOv2 on ImageNet-100, CIFAR-100, and Food-101. These results demonstrate that, under constrained meta-optic imaging, downstream recognition can be improved by aligning optical design with frozen vision-model objectives rather than conventional image-formation criteria.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CODA，一种协同设计框架，通过可微图像形成和基于Maxwell仿真的伴随梯度更新，为冻结的视觉语言模型（如CLIP）优化连续密度元光学前端。在ImageNet-100模拟基准上，CODA将CLIP ViT-L/14的零样本准确率从53.75%提升至65.41%，且优化后的光学器件无需重新优化即可迁移到其他模型和数据集。结果表明，在受限元光学成像下，通过使光学设计对齐冻结视觉模型的目标而非传统图像形成准则，可以提升下游识别性能。
Motivation: 传统光学设计以人类可解释的图像质量为目标（分辨率、像差校正等），但在尺寸、成本受限的应用中，紧凑元光学虽然可行但受限于物理效率。现有方法未针对下游冻结视觉模型进行前端优化。
Method: CODA采用可微图像形成模型和Maxwell仿真的伴随梯度更新，直接优化固定零样本CLIP分类器的交叉熵损失，无需学习重建、图像信号处理或图像保真度辅助目标。
Result: 在ImageNet-100二维模拟成像基准上，CODA将CLIP ViT-L/14零样本准确率从53.75% ± 3.57%提升至65.41% ± 3.99%。优化后的光学器件无需重新优化即可迁移至CLIP、SigLIP、DINOv2以及ImageNet-100、CIFAR-100、Food-101数据集。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在受限元光学成像下，将光学设计与冻结视觉模型的目标对齐比传统图像形成准则更能提升下游识别性能。

papers.title: Trading Human Curation for Synthetic Augmentation in RLVR
papers.abstract_en: The supply of high-quality training tasks is a central bottleneck for reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) on agentic language models. Each task requires a sandboxed setup, a prompt, and a hand-authored reward function, and only tasks that pass a quality bar produce useful training signal. Hand-curation at this quality bar does not scale economically to the task counts effective RL training requires, and the substitution rate between automatically generated task variants and human-authored ones is not yet established. We investigate using pre-specified, gate-filtered augmentations of a small hand-authored base as a substitute for additional human curation during RLVR. We formalize the cost-adjusted trade rate $ρ_{\text{cost}}$ between augmented and human-authored tasks, measure it through a controlled ablation across training corpora with varying augmentation share, and characterize the end-to-end economics of the augmentation pipeline. Substituting augmented content for additional human-authored tasks retains aggregate held-out generalization on a ten-benchmark suite spanning code, instruction following, reasoning, and multi-turn agentic function-calling. The cost-adjusted trade rate $ρ_{\text{cost}}$ between gated synthetic and human-authored RLVR tasks stays in $[1.4\times, 11.6\times]$ across the plausible $c_{\text{human}}/c_{\text{aug}}$ range.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究在可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，使用门控过滤的合成增强任务替代人工策划任务的可行性。通过定义成本调整的交换率ρ_cost，并在10个基准上评估，发现合成增强可以保持泛化性能，同时成本更低。
Motivation: RLVR训练需要高质量任务，但人工策划成本高且难以规模化；需要确定合成增强在多大程度上可以替代人工任务。
Method: 提出使用预指定的门控过滤增强来自小规模人工基础任务，替代额外的人工策划；形式化成本调整的交换率ρ_cost，并通过受控消融实验测量。
Result: 在涵盖代码、指令遵循、推理和多轮代理函数调用的10个基准套件中，合成增强保持了总体泛化性能。成本调整的交换率ρ_cost在合理范围内为[1.4×, 11.6×]。
Conclusion: 合成增强可以有效替代人工策划任务，且成本更低，为RLVR任务规模化提供了经济可行的途径。

papers.title: Momentum Based Reward Design for Low Emission Traffic Signal Control
papers.abstract_en: Urban traffic congestion is a growing global issue contributing significantly to long commute times and environmental pollution. Traditional traffic signal control systems often fail to adapt to dynamic traffic conditions. Adaptive traffic signal control can improve urban traffic without changing road infrastructure. Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) has shown strong performance for this task, but existing delay and queue-based rewards often produce short-sighted or unstable policies. This paper proposes a Momentum-Based Reward Function (MBRF) that encourages vehicles to keep moving rather than penalizing congestion alone. The method is evaluated in SUMO (Simulation of Urban MObility) using standard traffic metrics such as waiting time, queue length, throughput, and CO2 emissions. Results show that the proposed reward produces better throughput-emission trade-offs and more stable learning behavior than delay or queue-based rewards, as well as classical controllers such as Max Pressure and LQF.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对自适应交通信号控制中延迟和队列奖励导致短视或不稳定策略的问题，本文提出基于动量的奖励函数（MBRF），鼓励车辆持续移动而非仅惩罚拥堵。在SUMO仿真中，MBRF在等待时间、队列长度、吞吐量和CO2排放等指标上优于现有DRL奖励及Max Pressure、LQF等经典控制器，实现更好的吞吐量-排放权衡与更稳定的学习行为。
Motivation: 现有DRL交通信号控制方法多使用延迟或队列奖励，容易产生短视或不稳定策略，且缺乏对排放效率的显式优化。
Method: 提出动量基础奖励函数（Momentum-Based Reward Function, MBRF），通过鼓励车辆保持运动状态来设计奖励信号，避免单纯惩罚拥堵导致的策略震荡。
Result: 在SUMO仿真环境中，MBRF在等待时间、队列长度、吞吐量和CO2排放等指标上均优于延迟奖励、队列奖励以及经典控制器（Max Pressure、LQF）。
Conclusion: 摘要表明所提MBRF能获得更好的吞吐量-排放权衡和更稳定的学习过程，为低排放交通信号控制提供了有效奖励设计方案。

papers.title: X-Foresight: A Joint Vision-Action Causal Forecasting Network via Predictive World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Physical world knowledge resides mainly in videos. Equipping Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models with such knowledge is fundamental for safe and generalizable planning. Predictive world modeling enables VLA to internalize physical dynamics and long-term causality by predicting future video from past observations. However, naive next-frame prediction faces two challenges: 1) unlike semantically distinct text tokens, video tokens are low-entropy and redundant, causing prediction to degenerate into trivial extrapolation. 2) world modeling poses a temporal dilemma: dense prediction captures instantaneous dynamics, but cannot efficiently model long-horizon causality. To learn world knowledge effectively, we introduce X-Foresight, a predictive world model integrated directly into the VLA architecture to jointly learn world modeling and real-time action control. At its core lies a long-horizon chunk-wise auto-regressive strategy that addresses both challenges: by predicting semantically distant chunks rather than adjacent frames, it escapes trivial extrapolation, while preserving dense intra-chunk frames for instantaneous dynamics and sparse inter-chunk transitions for long-term causality. A curriculum learning schedule progressively extends prediction horizons and stabilizes long-horizon training. To capture long-term causality effectively, we present temporal importance sampling, which concentrates supervision on safety-critical chunks identified by ego-motion and behavioral signals. We further delegate photorealistic synthesis to a diffusion-based multi-view renderer, improving photorealistic appearance. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that X-Foresight significantly outperforms VLA baselines in planning performance while maintaining strong generative fidelity, establishing a robust paradigm for world-knowledge-driven autonomous systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出X-Foresight，一种集成在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）架构中的预测世界模型，通过长程块级自回归策略（chunk-wise auto-regressive）联合学习世界建模和实时动作控制。该方法通过预测语义上相距较远的块而非相邻帧来避免平凡外推，同时保留密集帧捕捉瞬时动态和稀疏帧间过渡建模长期因果。结合课程学习逐步扩展预测视野，并使用时序重要性采样聚焦于安全关键块。实验表明，X-Foresight在规划性能上显著优于VLA基线，同时保持强生成保真度。
Motivation: 现有预测世界模型面临视频令牌低熵冗余导致预测退化为平凡外推的挑战，且世界建模存在时间困境：密集预测捕捉瞬时动态但无法高效建模长期因果。
Method: 提出长程块级自回归策略，预测语义上远离的块而非相邻帧；采用课程学习逐步扩展预测视野；引入时序重要性采样，利用自我运动和行为信号识别安全关键块并集中监督；使用扩散多视角渲染器提升逼真度。
Result: 实验显示X-Foresight在规划性能上显著优于VLA基线，并保持强生成保真度。
Conclusion: 该工作为世界知识驱动的自主系统建立了鲁棒范式，但摘要未明确提及局限性。

papers.title: Operationalizing Individual Fairness via Gradient Descent and Bradley-Terry Models
papers.abstract_en: Individual fairness, the notion that "similar individuals should be treated similarly," provides a strong and flexible fairness guarantee for algorithmic decision makers. However, a barrier to implementing individual fairness in practice is the difficulty of learning the similarity metric over individuals. In this work, we present an algorithm for learning a Mahalanobis similarity metric from triplet queries of the form "is individual $i$ more similar to individual $j$ or $k$?" We work in the standard Bradley-Terry model for pairwise comparisons. Our algorithm consists of a spectral initialization step followed by gradient descent. We provide extensive theoretical guarantees on our algorithm, showing that it converges quickly to the ground truth metric despite the non-convexity of the loss in our model. Because our focus is on fairness, we also show that individual fairness with respect to an estimated metric is sufficient to achieve similar fairness with respect to the true metric. We also discuss potential applications of our work to AI model tuning. Finally, we present experimental results that demonstrate the convergence of our algorithm and the fairness performance of downstream fair predictors trained on our estimated metric.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对个体公平性中相似性度量难以学习的问题，提出一种基于三元组查询（"个体i与j还是k更相似？"）的算法，在Bradley-Terry模型下学习马氏距离度量。算法包括谱初始化步骤和梯度下降优化，并提供收敛性理论保证。实验表明算法能快速收敛到真实度量，且基于估计度量的下游公平预测器能达到接近真实度量的公平性。
Motivation: 个体公平性要求相似个体得到相似处理，但实际中学习个体间的相似性度量是一个关键障碍，现有方法缺乏理论保证或难以扩展。
Method: 采用三元组查询形式，在Bradley-Terry比较模型下，通过谱初始化获得初始估计，然后使用梯度下降优化非凸损失函数来学习马氏距离度量。
Result: 理论证明算法快速收敛到真实度量，且使用估计度量训练的公平预测器在个体公平性上接近使用真实度量的表现。实验验证了算法的收敛性和下游公平性。

papers.title: CogAdapt: Adapting Clinical ECG Foundation Models for Wearable Cognitive Load Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Assessing cognitive load continuously and at low latency would help adaptive human-computer interaction, but it remains hard because labeled data are scarce and models generalize poorly across subjects. Recent ECG foundation models, pre-trained on millions of clinical diagnostic ECG recordings, yet they do not apply directly to wearable devices when the sensor configuration and the task both differ. We present CogAdapt, a framework that adapts a clinical ECG foundation model to wearable cognitive load assessment. CogAdapt has two parts. LeadBridge is a learnable adapter that maps 3-lead wearable signals to a 12-lead-compatible representation. ProFine is a progressive fine-tuning strategy that unfreezes encoder layers in stages while limiting representational drift in the pre-trained model. On two public datasets (CLARE and CL-Drive) under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation, CogAdapt reaches macro-F1 of 0.626 and 0.768, improving over from-scratch baselines by 11.2 and 16.1 percentage points. The results show that a clinical ECG pretraining can support subject-independent cognitive load assessment from wearable sensors.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to IEEE-EMBS International Conference on Biomedical and Health Informatics (BHI 2026)

TL;DR: 本文提出CogAdapt框架，将临床心电图基础模型适应于可穿戴设备的认知负荷评估。LeadBridge可学习适配器将3导联可穿戴信号映射为12导联兼容表示，ProFine渐进微调策略逐步解冻编码器层并限制表征漂移。在CLARE和CL-Drive数据集上的留一被试交叉验证达到0.626和0.768的宏F1，比从头训练基线提高11.2和16.1个百分点。

Method: 提出CogAdapt框架，包含LeadBridge（可学习适配器，将3导联信号映射为12导联兼容表示）和ProFine（渐进微调策略，分阶段解冻编码器层并限制预训练模型表征漂移）。

papers.title: Optimal FALQON for Quantum Approximate Optimization via Layer-wise Parameter Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Feedback-based adaptive quantum optimization (FALQON) is a promising approach for solving combinatorial problems on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices, requiring only single circuit evaluations per layer. However, standard FALQON relies on fixed hyperparameters that severely limit convergence speed, requiring hundreds to thousands of layers for acceptable solutions. This paper proposes Optimal FALQON, an optimization-based formulation that treats the per-layer time step ($δ_k$) and scaling factor ($M_k$) as decision variables optimized via classical methods. We present a comprehensive empirical study on all 94 non-isomorphic 3-regular graphs with 12 vertices, comparing Optimal FALQON with standard FALQON and multiple QAOA variants. Results demonstrate statistically significant improvements in success probability, evaluation efficiency, and depth-normalized cost across the evaluated benchmarks. Furthermore, initializing QAOA with parameters from Optimal FALQON yields superior warm-start performance compared to fixed initialization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Optimal FALQON，将每层时间步和缩放因子作为优化变量，通过经典优化方法调整。在94个3-正则图（12顶点）上的实验表明，相比标准FALQON和多种QAOA变体，成功率、评估效率和深度归一化成本均有显著提升。同时，Optimal FALQON的参数可作为QAOA的预热启动，取得更好的效果。
Motivation: 标准FALQON依赖固定超参数，导致收敛速度慢，需要数百到数千层才能获得可接受的解，限制了在NISQ设备上的实用性。
Method: 将每层的时间步δ_k和缩放因子M_k作为决策变量，通过经典优化方法进行逐层参数调优，形成优化公式。
Result: 在94个非异构3-正则图（12顶点）上，Optimal FALQON在成功概率、评估效率和深度归一化成本上取得统计显著的改进，并且用作QAOA初始化时优于固定初始化。
Conclusion: Optimal FALQON通过逐层参数优化显著提升了FALQON的性能，并且可以作为QAOA的有效预热启动方法。

papers.title: Informing AI Policy Assessment using Large-Scale Simulation of Interventions
papers.abstract_en: As the rapid proliferation of AI systems and harms spurs efforts in AI governance around the world, prioritizing among competing policy options has become increasingly challenging for policymakers and researchers. We introduce a methodology for identifying viable policy options to mitigate specified AI harms, helping policymakers and researchers target areas that warrant greater time and resource investment. This method combines participatory evaluation of policies, expert assessment of implementation costs, and an LLM-based assessment of perceived harm mitigation under each policy option. We leverage a genetic algorithm-based simulation study to explore a vast solution space of potential policy combinations, and examine how outcomes change under different weightings of cost, participatory input, and harm mitigation. We find that this method enables exploration of different balances between participatory and expert components, allowing policymakers and researchers to assess how much weight to assign to each. We argue that the diversity of viable policy combinations found by the genetic algorithm could be a useful starting point for deliberation. This method operationalizes existing work on participatory AI by integrating it directly into practical policy development pipelines.

papers.journal_ref: In Proceedings of the 2026 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT '26). Association for Computing Machinery, New York, NY, USA, 3942-3978
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于大规模模拟的AI政策评估方法，结合参与式评估、专家成本评估和LLM感知危害缓解评估，利用遗传算法探索政策组合空间。方法有助于在多个竞争性政策选项中识别可行方案，并平衡参与者与专家的权重。
Motivation: 随着AI系统及其危害的快速扩散，政策制定者面临众多竞争性政策选项，缺乏系统性的评估方法来优先投资。
Method: 结合参与式政策评估、专家实施成本评估和LLM感知危害缓解评估，利用遗传算法模拟研究探索大量政策组合，考察不同权重下的结果变化。
Result: 摘要显示该方法能够探索参与式与专家组件之间的不同平衡，遗传算法找到的多样化可行政策组合可作为审议的起点。
Conclusion: 该方法将参与式AI整合到实际政策开发流程中，为AI政策评估提供系统化的模拟工具。

papers.title: MegaFlow: Zero-Shot Large Displacement Optical Flow
papers.abstract_en: Accurate estimation of large displacement optical flow remains a critical challenge. Existing methods typically rely on iterative local search or/and domain-specific fine-tuning, which severely limits their performance in large displacement and zero-shot generalization scenarios. To overcome this, we introduce MegaFlow, a simple yet powerful model for zero-shot large displacement optical flow. Rather than relying on highly complex, task-specific architectural designs, MegaFlow adapts powerful pre-trained vision priors to produce temporally consistent motion fields. In particular, we formulate flow estimation as a global matching problem by leveraging pre-trained global Vision Transformer features, which naturally capture large displacements. This is followed by a few lightweight iterative refinements to further improve the sub-pixel accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MegaFlow achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance across multiple optical flow benchmarks. Moreover, our model also delivers highly competitive zero-shot performance on long-range point tracking benchmarks, demonstrating its robust transferability and suggesting a unified paradigm for generalizable motion estimation. Our project page is at: https://kristen-z.github.io/projects/megaflow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MegaFlow 是一种零样本大位移光流模型，通过利用预训练的全局 Vision Transformer 特征将光流估计转化为全局匹配问题，再辅以轻量迭代细化提高亚像素精度。在多个光流基准上取得最先进的零样本性能，并在长距离点跟踪任务上表现卓越。
Motivation: 现有光流方法在大位移和零样本泛化场景下性能有限，依赖迭代局部搜索或领域微调。
Method: 将光流估计作为全局匹配问题，使用预训练的全局 Vision Transformer 特征捕获大位移，随后通过少量轻量迭代细化提升亚像素精度。
Result: 在多个光流基准上取得零样本 SOTA 性能，并在长距离点跟踪基准上展示强泛化能力。
Conclusion: MegaFlow 表明利用强大预训练视觉先验可实现统一的零样本运动估计，具有跨任务迁移能力。

papers.title: Amortized Inference for Correlated Discrete Choice Models via Equivariant Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Discrete choice models are fundamental tools in management science, economics, and marketing for understanding and predicting decision-making. Logit-based models are dominant in applied work, largely due to their convenient closed-form expressions for choice probabilities. However, these models entail restrictive assumptions on the stochastic utility component, constraining our ability to capture realistic and theoretically grounded choice behavior$-$most notably, substitution patterns. In this work, we propose an amortized inference approach using a neural network emulator to approximate choice probabilities for general error distributions, including those with correlated errors. Our proposal includes a specialized neural network architecture and accompanying training procedures designed to respect the invariance properties of discrete choice models. We provide group-theoretic foundations for the architecture, including a proof of universal approximation given a minimal set of invariant features. Once trained, the emulator enables rapid likelihood evaluation and gradient computation. We use Sobolev training, augmenting the likelihood loss with a gradient-matching penalty so that the emulator learns both choice probabilities and their derivatives. We show that emulator-based maximum likelihood estimators are consistent and asymptotically normal under mild approximation conditions, and we provide sandwich standard errors that remain valid even with imperfect likelihood approximation. Simulations show significant gains over the GHK simulator in accuracy and speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对离散选择模型中logit模型因误差独立假设而限制替代模式刻画的问题，提出一种基于等变神经网络（equivariant neural network）的摊销推断方法，用于逼近一般相关误差分布下的选择概率。架构利用群论保证模型的等变性，并采用Sobolev训练同时学习概率及其梯度。模拟器训练后能快速计算似然和梯度，且基于模拟器的最大似然估计量在温和条件下一致且渐近正态。仿真表明该方法在精度和速度上显著优于传统GHK模拟器。
Motivation: Logit模型因封闭形式便利而广泛应用，但误差独立假设限制了其捕捉现实替代模式（如相关误差导致的不对称替代）的能力；一般离散选择模型的似然函数通常涉及高维积分，计算困难。
Method: 提出一个等变神经网络模拟器，利用离散选择模型的置换不变性（invariance properties）设计架构，并给出群论基础及通用逼近性证明；通过Sobolev训练，在似然损失中加入梯度匹配惩罚，使模拟器同时学习选择概率及其梯度；提供三明治标准误以处理近似误差。
Result: 仿真显示该方法在精度和速度上均优于GHK模拟器；证明了基于模拟器的最大似然估计量的一致性、渐近正态性，并给出了在似然近似不完美时仍有效的标准误公式。
Conclusion: 本文为离散选择模型提供了一种高效且理论上可靠的摊销推断工具，可替代传统模拟方法，特别适用于误差相关结构复杂的情形。

papers.title: Object Search in Partially-Known Environments via LLM-informed Model-based Planning and Prompt Selection
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel LLM-informed model-based planning framework, and a novel prompt selection method, for object search in partially-known environments. Our approach uses an LLM to estimate statistics about the likelihood of finding the target object when searching various locations throughout the scene that, combined with travel costs extracted from the environment map, are used to instantiate a model, thus using the LLM to inform planning and achieve effective search performance. Moreover, the abstraction upon which our approach relies is amenable to deployment-time model selection via the recent offline replay approach, an insight we leverage to enable fast prompt and LLM selection during deployment. Simulation experiments demonstrate that our LLM-informed model-based planning approach outperforms the baseline planning strategy that fully relies on LLM and optimistic strategy with as much as 11.8% and 39.2% improvements respectively, and our bandit-like selection approach enables quick selection of best prompts and LLMs resulting in 6.5% lower average cost and 33.8% lower average cumulative regret over baseline UCB bandit selection. Real-robot experiments in an apartment demonstrate similar improvements and so further validate our approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于LLM的模型规划框架和提示选择方法，用于在部分已知环境中进行物体搜索。LLM估算各位置找到目标物体的可能性，结合地图中的旅行成本实例化模型以指导规划。仿真实验显示该方法相比纯LLM基线和乐观策略分别提升11.8%和39.2%，提示选择方法相比UCB基线平均成本降低6.5%、累积遗憾降低33.8%，真实机器人实验也验证了有效性。
Motivation: 部分已知环境中物体搜索依赖完整先验知识或纯LLM推理效率低下，本文旨在利用LLM先验知识结合模型规划提升搜索性能。
Method: 使用LLM估计各搜索位置的目标物体概率，与环境地图的旅行成本结合构建搜索模型；并基于离线重放（offline replay）提出提示选择方法，在部署时快速选出最佳提示和LLM。
Result: 仿真实验中，相比纯LLM基线和乐观策略分别提升11.8%和39.2%；提示选择方法相比UCB基线平均成本降低6.5%，累积遗憾降低33.8%。
Conclusion: 本文方法在部分已知环境物体搜索中有效，通过LLM信息指导规划并实现快速提示选择，仿真和真实实验均验证了改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Content to Audience: A Multimodal Annotation Framework for Broadcast Television Analytics
papers.abstract_en: Automated semantic annotation of broadcast television content presents distinctive challenges, combining structured audiovisual composition, domain-specific editorial patterns, and strict operational constraints. While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong general-purpose video understanding capabilities, their comparative effectiveness across pipeline architectures and input configurations in broadcast-specific settings remains empirically undercharacterized. This paper presents a systematic evaluation of multimodal annotation pipelines applied to broadcast television news in the Italian setting. We construct a domain-specific benchmark of clips labeled across four semantic dimensions: visual environment classification, topic classification, sensitive content detection, and named entity recognition. Two different pipeline architectures are evaluated across nine frontier models, including Gemini 3.0 Pro, LLaMA 4 Maverick, Qwen-VL variants, and Gemma 3, under progressively enriched input strategies combining visual signals, automatic speech recognition, speaker diarization, and metadata. Experimental results demonstrate that gains from video input are strongly model-dependent: larger models effectively leverage temporal continuity, while smaller models show performance degradation under extended multimodal context, likely due to token overload. Beyond benchmarking, the selected pipeline is deployed on 14 full broadcast episodes, with minute-level annotations integrated with normalized audience measurement data provided by an Italian media company. This integration enables correlational analysis of topic-level audience sensitivity and generational engagement divergence, demonstrating the operational viability of the proposed framework for content-based audience analytics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对广播电视新闻内容提出一个多模态注释框架，系统评估了多种多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉环境分类、主题分类、敏感内容检测和命名实体识别四个语义维度的表现。实验发现视频输入带来的提升强烈依赖于模型规模：大模型能有效利用时间连续性，小模型则在扩展的多模态上下文中性能下降。最后将该框架部署到14个完整广播剧集上，结合观众测量数据进行主题级受众敏感性和代际参与差异的分析。
Motivation: 自动语义注释广播电视内容面临结构化视听组合、领域特有的编辑模式和严格操作约束等挑战，而多模态大模型在广播特定设置下的性能比较尚缺乏系统研究。
Method: 构建领域特定的广播电视新闻短片基准数据集，涵盖四个语义维度；评估两种管道架构和九个前沿模型（包括Gemini 3.0 Pro、LLaMA 4 Maverick、Qwen-VL变体和Gemma 3），采用逐步丰富的输入策略（视觉信号、自动语音识别、说话人日志和元数据）。
Result: 实验表明视频输入的增益强烈依赖于模型：大模型有效利用时间连续性，小模型在扩展多模态上下文中因令牌过载而性能下降。在14个完整剧集上部署后，实现了分钟级注释与观众测量数据的集成，支持主题级受众敏感性和代际参与差异的关联分析。
Conclusion: 提出的多模态注释框架在广播电视新闻分析中具有操作可行性，可用于基于内容的受众分析，但模型选择需根据规模权衡视频输入带来的收益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scaling Quantum Machine Learning without Tricks: Full-Resolution and Diverse Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Quantum generative modeling is a rapidly evolving discipline at the intersection of quantum computing and machine learning. Contemporary quantum machine learning is generally limited to toy examples or heavily restricted datasets with few elements. This is not only due to the current limitations of available quantum hardware but also due to the absence of inductive biases arising from application-agnostic designs. Current quantum solutions must resort to tricks to scale down high-resolution images, such as relying heavily on dimensionality reduction or utilizing multiple quantum models for low-resolution image patches. Building on recent developments in classical image loading to quantum computers, we circumvent these limitations and train quantum Wasserstein GANs on the established classical MNIST and Fashion-MNIST datasets. Using the complete datasets, our system generates full-resolution images across all ten classes and establishes a new state-of-the-art performance with a single end-to-end quantum generator without tricks. As a proof-of-principle, we also demonstrate that our approach can be extended to color images, exemplified on the Street View House Numbers dataset. We analyze how the choice of variational circuit architecture introduces inductive biases, which crucially unlock this performance. Furthermore, enhanced noise input techniques enable highly diverse image generation while maintaining quality. Finally, we show promising results even under quantum shot noise conditions.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 17 figures, 3 tables. Main text: 17 pages, 10 figures. Appendix: 11 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需降维或分块技巧的量子生成建模方法，利用量子Wasserstein GAN在完整MNIST和Fashion-MNIST数据集上生成全分辨率图像，达到新SOTA，并扩展至彩色SVHN数据集。分析了变分电路架构引入的归纳偏置如何提升性能，增强噪声输入技术保证图像多样性，且在量子噪声条件下仍表现良好。
Motivation: 当前量子生成模型受限于玩具示例或极小数据集，常需依赖降维或分块等技巧，缺乏可扩展的通用方案。本文旨在通过改进图像加载和电路设计，实现无技巧的端到端量子生成，覆盖完整数据集和高分辨率。
Method: 利用经典图像到量子计算机的高效加载技术，训练量子Wasserstein GAN，采用单一端到端量子生成器，避免分块或多模型。对比不同变分电路架构以研究归纳偏置的影响，并引入增强噪声输入提高生成多样性。
Result: 在完整MNIST和Fashion-MNIST上生成全部10类全分辨率图像，性能达到SOTA；成功扩展至彩色SVHN数据集；在量子 shot 噪声条件下仍展示出有希望的结果。
Conclusion: 本文表明无需技巧的量子生成建模可以处理完整经典数据集，架构选择和噪声注入至关重要。未来可进一步探索更大规模任务和硬件实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bound to Disagree: Generalization Bounds via Certifiable Surrogates
papers.abstract_en: Generalization bounds for deep learning models are typically vacuous, not computable or restricted to specific model classes. In this paper, we tackle these issues by providing new disagreement-based certificates for the gap between the true risk of any two predictors. We then bound the true risk of the predictor of interest via a surrogate model that enjoys tight generalization guarantees, and by evaluating our disagreement bound on an unlabeled dataset.We empirically demonstrate the tightness of the obtained certificates and showcase the versatility of the approach by training surrogate models leveraging three different frameworks: sample compression, model compression and PAC-Bayes theory. Importantly, such guarantees are achieved without modifying the target model, nor adapting the training procedure to the generalization framework.
papers.comment: Published in the 42nd conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于分歧的证书来估计两个预测器之间真实风险的差距，进而通过代理模型获得目标模型的真实风险界，无需修改目标模型或训练过程。实验展示了证书的紧致性，并利用样本压缩、模型压缩和PAC-Bayes三种框架训练代理模型。
Motivation: 现有深度学习泛化界要么平凡，要么不可计算，要么限于特定模型类，存在根本性缺陷。
Method: 提出新的基于分歧的证书，通过代理模型（享受紧泛化保证）来界目标模型的真实风险，并在无标签数据集上评估分歧界。
Result: 实证展示证书紧致，且方法适用于样本压缩、模型压缩和PAC-Bayes等多种框架。
Conclusion: 该方法在不修改目标模型或调整训练方式的情况下提供了泛化保证，具有通用性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DynamiQ: Accelerating Gradient Synchronization using Compressed Multi-hop All-reduce
papers.abstract_en: Multi-hop all-reduce is the de facto backbone of large model training. As the training scale increases, the network often becomes a bottleneck, motivating the reduction of the volume of transmitted data. Accordingly, recent systems have demonstrated significant acceleration of the training process using gradient quantization. However, these systems are not optimized for multi-hop aggregation, where entries are partially summed multiple times along their aggregation topology. We present DynamiQ, a quantization framework that bridges the gap between quantization best practices and multi-hop aggregation. DynamiQ introduces novel techniques to better represent partial sums, codesigned with a decompress accumulate recompress fused kernel to facilitate fast execution. We extend PyTorch DDP to support DynamiQ over NCCL P2P, and across different LLMs, tasks, and scales, we demonstrate consistent improvement of up to 34.2% over the best among state-of-the-art methods such as Omni-Reduce, THC, and emerging standards such as MXFP4, MXFP6, and MXFP8. Further, DynamiQ is the only evaluated method that consistently reaches near-baseline accuracy (e.g., 99.9\% of the BF16 baseline) and does so while significantly accelerating the training.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 19 figures. Accepted to ACM SIGCOMM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynamiQ 是一个面向多跳聚合（multi-hop all-reduce）的梯度量化框架，通过更优的局部和表示、创新性的解压-累加-压缩融合内核，显著加速分布式训练。实验表明，在多种大语言模型和任务上，DynamiQ 在保持接近基线精度（如 BF16 的 99.9%）的同时，相比 Omni-Reduce、THC 及 MXFP 标准等方法，训练加速最高达 34.2%。
Motivation: 现有梯度量化系统未针对多跳聚合进行优化，导致部分和在多次累加过程中表示效率低下，网络带宽成为大规模训练瓶颈。
Method: 提出 DynamiQ 框架，包含新型局部和表示技术，以及解压-累加-压缩融合内核（decompress-accumulate-recompress fused kernel），并基于 PyTorch DDP 和 NCCL P2P 实现。
Result: 在多种 LLM 和任务上，DynamiQ 相比最优基线（Omni-Reduce、THC、MXFP4/6/8）训练加速最高 34.2%，且是唯一始终达到接近基线精度（BF16 的 99.9%）的方法。
Conclusion: DynamiQ 证明了在多跳聚合场景下专门设计量化策略可以兼顾高压缩比和精度保持，为大规模分布式训练提供了实用方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AI Chatbot Suicide Risk Detection and Response: Human Validation Study of the Open-Source VERA-MH Safety Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Millions of people now use generative AI chatbots for psychological support. Despite their promise, the most pressing question in AI for mental health is whether these tools are safe. The field currently lacks a validated, automated benchmark for evaluating AI chatbot safety, particularly for users at risk of suicide. The Validation of Ethical and Responsible AI in Mental Health (VERA-MH) evaluation was recently proposed to address this need. This human validation study examined the alignment of VERA-MH safety ratings with expert clinician judgments. We simulated conversations between large language model (LLM)-based users spanning a range of suicide risk levels and disclosure styles and general-purpose AI chatbots. Licensed mental health clinicians from Spring Health independently rated chatbot safety using the VERA-MH scoring rubric. An LLM-based evaluator ("judge") applied the same rubric to the same conversations. We examined agreement among clinicians, between clinician consensus and the LLM judge, and across different judge LLMs. Clinicians also rated user-agent realism, suicide risk, and disclosure. Clinicians showed strong agreement in safety ratings (chance-corrected inter-rater reliability [IRR] = 0.77), establishing a reliable clinical consensus reference. The LLM judge was strongly aligned with this consensus (IRR = 0.81), and ratings were stable across judge models and repeated evaluations. Ratings of user-agent realism and fidelity to intended suicide risk and disclosure styles were mixed. These findings support the reliability of VERA-MH as an open-source, fully automated benchmark for evaluating AI chatbot suicide risk detection and response. Because these results reflect an earlier version of the benchmark, future work should validate updated versions, assess generalizability and robustness, and expand VERA-MH to additional domains of AI safety in mental health.
papers.journal_ref: JMIR AI. 2026;5
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文验证了VERA-MH安全评估基准与临床专家判断的一致性。通过模拟不同自杀风险水平和披露风格的LLM用户与通用AI聊天机器人的对话，由临床医生和LLM评估者分别评分。结果显示临床医生间信度（IRR=0.77）高，LLM评估者与临床医生共识一致性（IRR=0.81）高，且在不同评估模型间稳定。支持VERA-MH作为开源、全自动的AI聊天机器人自杀风险检测与响应评估基准。
Motivation: 目前缺乏经过验证的自动化基准来评估AI聊天机器人的安全性，特别是对自杀风险用户的处理。需要验证VERA-MH评估与临床专家判断的一致性。
Method: 模拟了基于LLM的用户与通用AI聊天机器人的对话，涵盖多种自杀风险水平和披露风格；临床医生使用VERA-MH评分规则独立评分；LLM评估者应用相同规则；比较临床医生间、临床医生共识与LLM评估者间的一致性。
Result: 临床医生间信度IRR=0.77；LLM评估者与临床医生共识IRR=0.81；评分在不同LLM评估模型和重复评估中稳定。
Conclusion: VERA-MH作为开源自动化基准具有可靠性，未来需验证更新版本、评估泛化性和鲁棒性，并扩展至更多心理健康安全领域。

papers.title: Synthetic Time Series Generation via Complex Networks
papers.abstract_en: Time series data are essential for a wide range of applications, yet access to high-quality datasets is often constrained by privacy concerns, acquisition costs, and labelling challenges. Synthetic time series generation has emerged as a promising approach to address these limitations. In this work, we investigate the use of complex network mappings for synthetic time series generation, focusing on the Quantile Graph (QG) representation and its inverse. While the inverse QG mapping has been previously proposed, its potential as a general-purpose data generator has not been systematically evaluated. We address this gap through a comprehensive empirical study assessing both the fidelity and utility of synthetic time series generated by the Inverse Quantile Graph (InvQG) framework. The evaluation combines statistical feature analysis, network-based topological characteristics, and performance in downstream clustering and classification tasks, using simulated and real-world datasets. The results show that InvQG effectively preserves marginal distributions and short-term temporal dependencies across a wide range of models, while exhibiting predictable limitations in capturing long-range or higher-order dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了逆分位数图（InvQG）框架作为通用合成时间序列生成器的能力。通过统计特征、网络拓扑特征以及下游聚类与分类任务，在模拟和真实数据集上验证了InvQG能有效保留边际分布和短期依赖，但难以捕捉长期或高阶动态。
Motivation: 高质量时间序列数据获取受隐私、成本等限制，现有合成生成方法缺乏系统评估，本文旨在填补InvQG作为通用数据生成器在保真度与效用方面的实证空白。
Method: 使用分位数图（QG）表示及其逆映射InvQG生成合成时间序列，并在统计特征、网络拓扑和下游任务（聚类、分类）上进行多维度评估。
Result: InvQG在多种模型上有效保留了边际分布和短期时间依赖，但在捕捉长期或高阶动态方面存在可预测的局限性。
Conclusion: InvQG适用于保留局部统计特性的场景，但对于需要长程依赖的应用需谨慎。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Semantic V2X Framework for Cooperative Collision Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) demand real-time collision prediction to ensure road safety and reduce accident severity. Conventional approaches rely on transmitting raw video or high-dimensional sensory data from roadside units (RSUs) to vehicles, which is impractical under vehicular communication bandwidth and latency constraints. In this work, we propose a semantic V2X framework in which RSU-mounted cameras generate spatiotemporal semantic embeddings of future frames using the Video Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA). To evaluate the system, we construct a digital twin of an urban traffic environment enabling the generation of d verse traffic scenarios with both safe and collision events. These embeddings of the future frame, extracted from V-JEPA, capture task-relevant traffic dynamics and are transmitted via V2X links to vehicles, where a lightweight attentive probe and classifier decode them to predict imminent collisions. By transmitting only semantic embeddings instead of raw frames, the proposed system significantly reduces communication overhead while maintaining predictive accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that the framework with an appropriate processing method achieves a 10% F1-score improvement for collision prediction while reducing transmission requirements by four orders of magnitude compared to raw video. This validates the potential of semantic V2X communication to enable cooperative, real-time collision prediction in ITS.
papers.comment: 6 pages 5 figures, accepted to IEEE ICC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向合作碰撞预测的语义V2X框架，利用路边摄像头生成未来帧的时空语义嵌入（V-JEPA），仅传输语义嵌入而非原始视频，在显著降低通信开销的同时保持预测精度。实验显示，与原始视频相比，该方法在碰撞预测F1分数提升10%的同时将传输需求降低四个数量级。
Motivation: 智能交通系统需要实时碰撞预测，但传统方法传输原始视频或高维传感器数据，在车联网带宽和延迟约束下不可行。
Method: 基于V-JEPA的语义V2X框架：路边摄像头使用V-JEPA生成未来帧的时空语义嵌入，通过V2X链路传输至车辆，轻量级注意力探针和分类器解码嵌入以预测碰撞。
Result: 在数字孪生交通场景中，该方法碰撞预测F1分数提升10%，传输需求相比原始视频降低四个数量级。
Conclusion: 语义V2X通信能够支持合作式实时碰撞预测，平衡了通信效率与预测准确性。

papers.title: SycoEval-EM: Sycophancy Evaluation of Large Language Models in Simulated Clinical Encounters for Emergency Care
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) deployed in clinical decision support may acquiesce to patient requests for care that conflicts with evidence-based guidelines. We developed SycoEval-EM, a multi-agent simulation framework to evaluate LLM robustness to adversarial patient persuasion in emergency medicine. Across 19 contemporary LLMs and 1,425 simulated clinical encounters spanning three Choosing Wisely scenarios, acquiescence rates ranged from 0% to 100%, revealing a bimodal distribution. Seven models maintained near-perfect guideline adherence, while six acquiesced in the majority of encounters. Vulnerability varied substantially across clinical scenarios. Acquiescence was highest for CT imaging requests, intermediate for antibiotic prescriptions for sinusitis, and lowest for opioid prescriptions for acute back pain. Model scale, recency, and performance on static medical benchmarks did not consistently predict robustness. All five persuasion tactics produced similar acquiescence rates, with no statistically significant differences after correction for multiple comparisons, suggesting a generalized susceptibility rather than tactic-specific weaknesses. LLM-as-judge evaluation was validated against two independent physician raters across 95 matched conversations and demonstrated near-perfect agreement for the primary outcome of acquiescence (Cohens kappa = 0.957). These findings indicate that static medical benchmarks are insufficient to predict safety performance under sustained social pressure and support incorporating multi-turn adversarial testing into clinical AI evaluation. Notably, two models achieved perfect guideline adherence across all encounters, demonstrating that robustness to patient pressure is attainable without sacrificing effective clinical communication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SycoEval-EM，一个多智能体模拟框架，用于评估大语言模型在急诊医学中对患者说服的鲁棒性。在19个现代LLM和1425个模拟临床遭遇中，顺从率从0%到100%不等，呈双峰分布。发现静态医学基准不足以预测在持续社会压力下的安全表现。
Motivation: 部署在临床决策支持中的LLM可能会顺从患者要求与循证指南相悖的护理，现有评估方法未测试这种社会压力下的鲁棒性。
Method: 开发SycoEval-EM多智能体模拟框架，涵盖三个Choosing Wisely场景，使用五种说服策略，并以LLM作为评判者评估顺从性，与两位独立医师评分进行验证。
Result: 在19个LLM中，顺从率从0%到100%呈双峰分布；五个模型在大多数遭遇中顺从；CT成像请求的顺从率最高，抗生素处方其次，阿片类药物最低；模型规模、新近性和静态医学基准不能一致预测鲁棒性；所有说服策略产生相似顺从率。
Conclusion: 静态医学基准不足以预测在持续社会压力下的安全表现，支持将多轮对抗性测试纳入临床AI评估。两个模型在所有遭遇中保持完美遵循指南，表明在不牺牲有效临床沟通的情况下可以实现对患者压力的鲁棒性。

papers.title: AGAPI-Agents: An Open-Access Agentic AI Platform for Accelerated Materials Design on AtomGPT.org
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems increasingly connect large language models (LLMs) to external scientific tools, yet whether and when tool access improves prediction accuracy remains uncharacterized. We present AGAPI (AtomGPT.org API), an open access platform integrating eight open-source LLMs with 18 REST endpoints (28 agent tools, 50 web apps) spanning materials databases, force fields, tight-binding band structures, X-ray diffraction, and protein structure. A three-evaluation residual decomposition on JARVIS-Leaderboard electronic-structure test sets separates agent pipeline fidelity from inherited density functional theory (DFT) functional bias. For bulk modulus and bandgap the agent reproduces JARVIS-DFT entries to numerical precision, so the experimental-reference degradation is functional bias, not agentic malfunction. On memorization-resistant test sets (57 defective supercells, 60 hypothetical compositions), tool-augmented mean absolute error (MAE) is below 0.005 eV versus 1.25 to 1.86 eV tool-free, confirming tools are indispensable where parametric knowledge is unavailable. We further demonstrate autonomous multi-step workflows including 10-operation defect-engineering pipelines. AGAPI is available at https://github.com/atomgptlab/agapi.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍AGAPI平台，集成8种开源大模型与18个REST端点（28个代理工具、50个Web应用），用于加速材料设计。在JARVIS-Leaderboard电子结构测试集上，通过三阶段残差分解分离代理管道误差与密度泛函理论（DFT）函数偏差。工具增强的平均绝对误差（MAE）低于0.005 eV，而无工具时MAE高达1.25-1.86 eV。平台还支持10步缺陷工程等自主多步工作流。
Motivation: 现有AI代理系统将LLM与外部科学工具连接，但工具访问是否以及何时提高预测准确性尚未被系统表征。
Method: 构建开放访问的AGAPI平台，集成8个开源LLM和18个REST端点（28个工具、50个Web应用），涵盖材料数据库、力场、紧束缚能带结构、X射线衍射和蛋白质结构。采用三阶段残差分解方法在JARVIS-Leaderboard电子结构测试集上分离代理管道保真度与继承的DFT函数偏差。
Result: 对于体模量和带隙，代理将JARVIS-DFT条目重现至数值精度；在记忆抵抗测试集（57个缺陷超胞、60个假设成分）上，工具增强的MAE低于0.005 eV，而无工具时MAE为1.25-1.86 eV，证实工具在参数知识不可用时不可或缺。
Conclusion: 工具访问在科学预测中至关重要，尤其是当参数知识不可用时；平台支持自主多步工作流，可用于加速材料设计。
